sessions.t: Microsoft Ignite 101: Navigate, Connect & Maximize Your Experience
sessions.d: Join Rick Claus and Sonia Cuff for a fun, fast-paced guide to getting the most out of your time at Microsoft Ignite. Learn how the conference is laid out, how to plan your day, and where to find answers from the experts – be they MVPs, Microsoft Partners or the Product teams. Get the inside scoop on all the event experiences. From Breakouts to the "hallway track", this session will help you build your network and make the most of your Ignite experience.

sessions.d: Discover how Home in the Microsoft Copilot app helps you move seamlessly between quick assistance and complex task delegation to get from intent to outcome. Through demos with product experts, see how Home brings Chat and Cowork together in one experience, with new capabilities for creating skills, completing long-running work, and editing Office files. In addition, get a first look at what's next for Home in the Copilot app.

sessions.t: Automate the Follow-Through with Autopilot
sessions.d: What if AI could keep work moving without the next prompt? Explore how Autopilot works against goals, events, and signals to monitor what matters, surface risks and opportunities, and take proactive action with enterprise controls and human oversight. Through demos and real-world scenarios, learn where always-on automation fits, which use cases are ready, and how to prepare for adoption.

Through live demos, see how people can turn natural language into working dashboards, apps, automations, and other custom tools grounded in their work.

sessions.t: Beyond Chat: Delegate Complex Work with Copilot Cowork
sessions.d: Real work changes when AI moves beyond chat to handle repeatable tasks and workflows. In this expert-led breakout, see how organizations use Copilot Cowork to delegate complex, multi-step work across apps, files, and business systems. Product demos and expert guidance will show where Cowork creates value, what to consider for implementation, and how to accelerate adoption.

sessions.d: Discover how Copilot in OneNote helps turn your notes into action and your collection of information into instant answers and insights. Join to see demos of the refreshed OneNote app and experiences that help you reason over all types of notes and take action to support your workflows.

sessions.t: From Conversation to Completion: How Teams and Copilot move work ahead
sessions.d: Collaboration has always been conversation, and the gap between deciding and doing is where time and momentum quietly disappear. See how Microsoft Teams, Copilot, and agents close it. Agents join your meetings, chats, and channels as teammates you @mention and assign work to, grounded in your context by Work IQ and governed by Agent 365. Learn from specific scenarios where coordination becomes built in, moving your team from fragmented work to coordinated execution.

sessions.t: Beyond the Agent: Building Digital Teammates in Microsoft Teams
sessions.d: Organizations are rapidly building AI agents, but the challenge is helping them work effectively with people and business systems. Discover how Teams is becoming the collaboration platform where Microsoft, partner, and customer-built agents come together as digital teammates in the flow of work. Through customer examples and demos, learn how Teams enables human-agent collaboration and agentic workflows that help agents evolve from standalone assistants into productive members of the team.

sessions.t: Work IQ: Powering Copilot for the Frontier Firm
sessions.d: Becoming a Frontier Firm requires more than deploying AI - it requires AI that understands how work gets done across your organization. Work IQ brings together both work and business data with semantic context to help Microsoft Copilot deliver more intelligent actions and outcomes for frontier organizations. Learn what's new in Work IQ, how Microsoft Copilot differs from other AI solutions, and how customers are creating measurable business impact.

sessions.t: Secure and Govern Microsoft Copilot Chat and Cowork
sessions.d: Microsoft Copilot and Cowork are transforming how employees and agents work together, creating new opportunities and new governance challenges. Learn how to secure, govern, and manage Copilot & Cowork across your organization using Microsoft's integrated security, compliance, and governance capabilities. We'll cover protecting sensitive data, reducing oversharing risks, meeting regulatory requirements, and gaining visibility into usage so you can confidently scale Copilot & Cowork adoption.

sessions.t: Secure the Follow-Through: Trusting Autopilot at Scale
sessions.d: Autopilot keeps work moving, taking action across apps, data, and devices without constant direction. But how do you secure work that continues when you're away? Learn how to protect Autopilot's access and actions, safeguard sensitive data even when AI is misled, and contain activity across computers, apps, and networks. Because when AI works independently, security can't be an afterthought.

sessions.t: Defend Against External Threats in Teams
sessions.d: AI-generated threats are becoming more convincing and disruptive. Discover how Microsoft Teams helps protect users with built-in detection for impersonation, voice phishing, and suspicious external activity across meetings, calls, and messaging. Learn how external collaboration protections and certified security partner integrations help identify untrusted participants, malicious content, and AI-powered threats before they become incidents.

sessions.t: Manage and Secure your AI Agents at Enterprise Scale with Agent 365
sessions.d: Move from experimentation to AI agent adoption at scale. In this session, explore how Microsoft Agent 365, the control plane for agents, can help your organization operate and scale agents with confidence by providing comprehensive visibility, built-in governance, and enterprise-grade security across your AI ecosystem. See what's new with Agent 365 and learn how to accelerate agent adoption while maintaining trust, meeting compliance requirements, and keeping operational control.

sessions.t: Your On-prem estate: Act now. Reduce risk.
sessions.d: AI-accelerated threats put exposed, unpatched, and unsupported servers at growing risk. Join Microsoft to learn how to protect the on-premises workloads your organization relies on. Learn where cloud migration can reduce risk, how to prepare workloads to move, and how to secure those that stay. Leave with clear priorities to protect critical operations.

sessions.t: Multi-model AI in Copilot: Performance and value with built-in trust
sessions.d: No single AI model is best for every task. As AI advances, organizations need access to the latest models without adding complexity for users, cost uncertainty for leaders, or administrative risk for administrators. Join us to see how Microsoft Copilot provides one governed front door to multi-model AI, with Microsoft evaluation and integration, intelligent routing with Auto, and cost management tools to you optimize AI value while maintaining security, compliance, and control.

sessions.t: Real-World AI Transformation with Copilot in SharePoint
sessions.d: Organizations are moving beyond AI experiments and into production. See how customers are using Copilot in SharePoint to modernize knowledge management, organize content at scale, automate business processes, preserve expertise, and strengthen Copilot experiences. Through real-world examples and customer stories, learn practical approaches for turning scattered content into organizational knowledge and transforming knowledge into action across the enterprise.

sessions.t: SharePoint: Modernize your knowledge foundation for the AI era
sessions.d: Most organizations have the content they need, but it remains scattered across files, sites, and business processes. Learn how Copilot in SharePoint helps transform content into organizational knowledge by modernizing information architecture, enriching content with AI, scaling expertise through reusable skills, and strengthening Copilot and agent experiences across Microsoft 365.

sessions.t: AI in the Flow of Work: OneDrive for the AI Era
sessions.d: As AI becomes part of everyday work, content plays a more important role than ever. Discover how OneDrive helps people find knowledge, organize information, collaborate across teams, and move from information to action with Copilot. Through practical demonstrations, explore new experiences that make it easier to work across files, libraries, and shared content while keeping work secure, connected, and ready for the flow of work across Microsoft 365.

sessions.t: Copilot Connectors: Unlock your enterprise knowledge and workflows
sessions.d: Discover how Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors bring business context from enterprise systems into Copilot. See how rich insights, interactive experiences, and actions help complete real-world workflows. Learn how to get started with ready-to-use or custom connectors, access them across Copilot experiences, and scale securely with enterprise-grade governance.

sessions.t: Govern Once, Use Everywhere: Scale Copilot with Microsoft Plugin Registry
sessions.d: As Microsoft Copilot extensibility grows, governance can get complex. Learn how the Copilot plugin registry creates one source of truth for plugins, connectors, MCP servers, skills, and agents across Chat, Cowork, Scout, Code, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform. See how unified publishing, approval, security, and governance help IT reduce overhead, improve discovery, and scale trusted AI innovation.

sessions.t: What's new in Microsoft Copilot for functional roles
sessions.d: Go deeper into how Microsoft Copilot and Cowork supports high-value functional work. See how Copilot plugins and Microsoft apps bring trusted business and industry data into everyday workflows across legal, finance, sales, and more. Explore flexible, role-specific solutions across priority functions, with customer examples showing business impact.

sessions.t: Getting work done with Copilot as a small business
sessions.d: Small businesses want outcomes, not setup. Join this session to see how Copilot plug-in packages bring pre-built skills, scenarios, and connections to key systems of record together in one turnkey experience. See demos focused on key outcomes—like month end accounting—to show how the right skills, integrations, and workflows light up instantly. We'll walk through the top SMB scenarios end to end, showing how to drive measurable outcomes. Leave this session ready to get work done with Copilot.

sessions.t: The AI Reality Check: What We’re Learning from Customers
sessions.d: What does AI transformation look like in the realities of an enterprise? Hear from Microsoft’s customer-facing teams on what organizations are experiencing as they put Copilot and AI to work. Explore the questions, challenges, and tradeoffs around trust, governance, adoption, readiness, and value, and learn how Microsoft works with customers to address them and move forward with confidence.

sessions.t: Built for work: What sets Copilot apart
sessions.d: Your organization is already using AI, but is it delivering real value at scale? In this session, we’ll compare Microsoft 365 Copilot to alternative AI solutions across real work scenarios. See how Work IQ, organizational context, multi-model intelligence, security, and trust work together to deliver more relevant results and higher-quality outcomes. Bring your laptop and evaluate the differences firsthand!

sessions.t: Building an AI Operating System: The Layers of Frontier Transformation
sessions.d: Organizations often evaluate AI through individual tools and models, but lasting transformation requires an AI operating system, not a patchwork of offerings. In this session, we’ll explore the layers of Frontier Transformation: Infrastructure, Data, Context and Knowledge, AI Platform, Build Tools, Productivity and Collaboration, and Security. You’ll see how these layers work together to enable enterprise AI at scale and gain a framework for evaluating AI platforms holistically.

sessions.t: What Microsoft Benefit Is Right for Your Use Case?
sessions.d: Most organizations know their goals; the hard part is finding the right path, resources, and investments to scale. Learn how to close that gap across everyday work, team productivity, and business processes. Discover Microsoft offerings and benefits aligned to your priorities, use cases, and maturity stage.

sessions.t: Frontier Accelerate: Microsoft benefits that help you move forward
sessions.d: You know where you want AI to take your business, but getting there can raise as many questions as answers. Where do you start? What foundation do you need? Which AI opportunities should you pursue? How do you scale what works? Through this session, you will learn how Frontier Accelerate brings together Microsoft experts, investments, and skilling to help you navigate those decisions, how customers are putting these benefits to work, and leave knowing what to do next and how Microsoft can help.

sessions.t: How customers are unlocking value & growth with Copilot
sessions.d: Every leader has AI on their priority list. Far fewer have defined what success looks like or how to measure it. Matt Firestone, General Manager of Microsoft Copilot, sits down with leaders from Lumen Technologies, Wells Fargo, and Vodafone to get specific about what's working, what's failing, and what surprises them. Hear how they're preparing their workforce, placing their AI bets, redesigning work around agents, and moving from pilots to payoff.

sessions.t: How Microsoft Connects Employees, Leaders, and Knowledge at Scale
sessions.d:
In the AI era, trust is your organization's most important capability.
Join Microsoft Corporate Communications and product leaders to learn how Microsoft supports 200K+ employees through workplace transformation. Discover practical strategies to create clarity during change, build psychological safety, scale shared knowledge, and accelerate AI skills through leadership engagement, communities, Teams events, Copilot, and agents—and preview upcoming Viva Engage and Microsoft 365 innovations.

sessions.t: Customer stories: Transform business functions with Microsoft Copilot
sessions.d: Organizations are moving beyond AI experimentation to transform how work gets done. Microsoft and customers will showcase functional solutions built on Microsoft Copilot that redesign workflows, accelerate decisions, and drive business outcomes across legal, finance and more. Learn how leaders identify high-value opportunities, align AI to strategy, and scale repeatable solutions across teams.

sessions.t: Beyond the Benchmark: Evaluating Copilot and AI Tools
sessions.d: How do you know which AI delivers the most value for your organization? In this session, you'll learn a repeatable framework and methodology for evaluating Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Cowork and other common AI tools against real work scenarios. We'll walk through how to measure accuracy, trust, speed and cost, so you leave equipped to test your own scenarios, judge where each tool delivers value, and share feedback that helps shape better Copilot experiences.

sessions.t: Agentify your business processes-the next era of business applications
sessions.d: Stop managing work. Start accelerating it. Join this session to see how AI agents can intelligently connect people, data, and applications to move business processes forward with less friction and fewer delays. Explore what the next era of business applications looks like and how it can help your organization make faster decisions, free up valuable resources, and achieve more with every team.

sessions.t: Agents in Copilot: help every user get more done
sessions.d: Getting value from agents takes more than deployment. Learn how to help users discover, trust, and use agents in Microsoft 365. See practical approaches for identifying the right use cases, guiding everyday workflows, and driving adoption so teams can get more value from Copilot and agents.

sessions.t: Plugins for Copilot: build once, govern once, use everywhere
sessions.d: As organizations extend Copilot, skills, connectors, MCP servers, tools, and agents can create fragmented catalogs, publishing paths, and controls. Learn how Microsoft’s plugin ecosystem brings these capabilities into a shared lifecycle, from building and importing to publishing, discovering, deploying, governing, evaluating, and maintaining them across supported Copilot experiences. See how the pieces relate and what the model means for users, IT, developers, and partners.

sessions.t: Frontier tuning: Optimize AI agents for real-world business outcomes
sessions.d: AI success depends on more than the model. Learn how Frontier Tuning helps organizations optimize models, tools, skills, knowledge, and evaluation frameworks to improve performance on real business workflows. See how Copilot Studio and Foundry work together to deliver better outcomes, higher quality, and improved cost efficiency at scale.

sessions.t: Employee Self-Service to Enterprise Scale: Managing Intelligent Agents
sessions.d: Discover how Employee Self-Service (ESS) agents streamline IT and HR support, connect enterprise systems, improve response quality, and automate workflows. Go beyond deployment to drive adoption and manage governance, evaluation, analytics, and lifecycle operations at scale. Through customer stories and implementation lessons, learn practical patterns to reduce duplication, govern deployments, and scale intelligent, action-oriented support that improves employee experiences across your business.

sessions.t: Build and scale the next generation of AI agents in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: See the complete journey from a developer’s first line of agent code to measurable business impact. Build locally with GitHub and VS Code, deploy to hosted agents, connect governed tools through Toolboxes, and ground agents across enterprise data with Foundry IQ. Then use tracing, evaluation, optimization, and cost and ROI insights to continuously improve quality and economics before publishing agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams.

sessions.t: How SThree is reimagining recruitment with human-led AI
sessions.d: Most AI agents tackle a single task. SThree, a global STEM workforce consultancy, took a bolder approach with Microsoft and Foundry, building agents that work alongside consultants so people and technology each do what they do best. Human judgment stays at the center. SThree leaders and Microsoft's VP of Core AI Product Management discuss key lessons, the impact on consultants, and how amplifying human attention creates more time for relationship-building that drives business.

sessions.t: Build your self-improving AI Platform with Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: In a world of abundant models, winning means continuously adapting to customer context—not just choosing the best model. The hill-climbing machine connects inference, observability, evaluations, optimization, model selection, post-training, and RL into one learning loop. Every interaction improves quality, cost, and reliability, turning AI into a governed, self-improving business platform.

sessions.t: How much should you own? Choosing the right agent architecture
sessions.d: Choose the right Foundry build path for each agent without creating a platform dead end. Start quickly with simple prompt agents, add the Microsoft Copilot harness for skills, sandboxed execution, long-running work, and agent definitions managed as files through CI/CD, or use hosted agents when you need full control of your code and framework, including OpenClaw or Hermes. See how Foundry applies identity, authorization, governance, tools, and publishing across these paths, including autopilots.

sessions.t: Voice agents in Microsoft Foundry: Prototype to production in 45 mins
sessions.d: Voice is the fastest-growing way people use agents, and the hardest to put in production. Voice-first agents in Microsoft Foundry give you one place to build a speech-native agent, ship it to web, mobile, Teams and telephony, and operate it with audio-aware tracing and evaluation. We'll cover what ships, how it differs from voice-enabling a text agent, and what enterprise customers are running today.

sessions.t: Trusted agents need Document Intelligence & Content Understanding
sessions.d: What if your AI agents could read documents, understand images, and process audio and video to act on business content? In this session, learn how Azure Content Understanding and Document Intelligence turn unstructured, multimodal content into actionable insights and automated workflows. Through live demos, see how to ingest content, extract structured data, and orchestrate AI agents using trusted enterprise content, spanning process automation, knowledge extraction, and agent-driven workflows.

sessions.t: From open weights to workload: Operationalizing at enterprise scale
sessions.d: Open-weight models offer greater choice and control, but production at scale requires the right infrastructure, serving stack, and operations. See how Microsoft Foundry Managed Compute helps teams move from model selection to enterprise deployment. Learn from AT&T’s OTel 2.0 experience using multiple open models and GPU types to balance performance, economics, and workload needs without standardizing on one model.

sessions.t: Token economics: Get more from your production AI budget
sessions.d: Make every token count with Microsoft Foundry. Learn to match workloads to models and inference tiers, reuse prompt caches, route requests intelligently, and handle capacity limits with smart fallbacks. Hear how WolterKluwer and Enhans optimized token usage to better serve customers. Leave with a practical framework for balancing quality, cost, and latency in production AI.

sessions.t: Trust at scale: Governance lessons from Microsoft
sessions.d: As Microsoft deploys AI across products used by hundreds of millions of people, trust has become an operational imperative. In this session, Sarah Bird, Microsoft's Chief Product Officer for Responsible AI, shares how Microsoft approaches AI governance, safety, security, and compliance across its own AI systems. Learn practical lessons in risk-based governance, embedded guardrails, continuous monitoring, and scalable controls that enable trusted AI at scale.

sessions.t: From traces to better agents: The Foundry improvement loop
sessions.d: Building an agent is the start. Improving it in production is the real work. See how Microsoft Foundry connects traces, evaluations, and optimization to help teams find high-impact issues, test improvements, and re-measure results. Learn a repeatable loop to improve quality, manage cost, and ship better agents while developers stay in control.

sessions.t: Govern AI everywhere: From open frameworks to enterprise control
sessions.d: Your teams already picked their tools, and telling them to start over is how an AI program loses a year. This session shows the alternative. Start with open source that runs against agents built in any framework, then bring those same agents into Microsoft Foundry when you need enterprise identity, policy, and one view of quality across the estate. Leave knowing what you get for free, what requires a platform, and where lock-in risk actually sits.

sessions.t: Agents in production: Observe, evaluate, and optimize with Foundry
sessions.d: Getting an agent into production is only the beginning. Learn how Microsoft Foundry helps teams observe agent behavior, evaluate quality, uncover unexpected issues, and optimize performance over time. Through practical guidance, demos, and a customer story from Tata Consultancy Services, explore how tracing, evaluations, insights, human feedback, and optimization come together in a repeatable continuous improvement loop. You’ll also see how to monitor quality, reliability, latency, safety, and cost across your agent fleet.

sessions.t: Turn your data into AI advantage with Training in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: Frontier models are available to everyone. Your advantage is how you train them for your business. See how Microsoft Foundry unites fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and RL environments to turn production data and agent experience into continuous model improvement. Explore managed and programmed training, and how task feedback boosts agent performance and token efficiency. Hear how Docusign and Heidi Health customized open models with Fireworks on Foundry.

sessions.t: Operate AI at enterprise scale with Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: AI adoption is expanding to fleets of agents, making governance an operational challenge. Explore how AI Gateway, Responsible AI controls, agent identity, FinOps, and governance integrations provide visibility and control across your AI estate. Microsoft Foundry provides the governance foundation for AI systems, integrating with Agent 365 for enterprise operations and administration. Leave with a practical framework for running AI securely from development to production.

sessions.t: Turn enterprise data into a durable advantage with Microsoft AI models
sessions.d: AI agents and apps are only as good as the data and models behind them. Get a first look at the latest MAI model innovations for reasoning, coding, voice, image, and multimodal work, built on a clean, traceable data lineage and already powering Microsoft 365 Copilot, PowerPoint, Excel, OneDrive, GitHub, and Bing. Then see how Frontier Tuning closes the loop, using your data, workflows, and evaluation criteria to continuously optimize models and agents in Microsoft Foundry.

sessions.t: Build private, responsive on-device AI agents with Foundry
sessions.d: Bring AI closer to users, data, and decisions. This session shows developers how to build responsive, private, and resilient AI applications and agents on-device — running across Windows, macOS, Linux, and emerging mobile scenarios, without requiring a cloud connection for every inference.

sessions.t: Video AI at scale with Microsoft Foundry and fal
sessions.d: Video AI is expanding what organizations can create, and Microsoft Foundry and fal are coming together to make more of those possibilities available to enterprises be creative professionals. Join us to learn more about fal on Microsoft Foundry and see how the partnership expands the multimodal model portfolio. Through creative demos and a conversation with the teams behind the partnership, explore how to move from an idea to concept to video, choose models for different creative needs, and bring those experiences into production.

sessions.t: Inside Microsoft: How we scale expertise with Foundry agents
sessions.d: Expertise is scarce. Demand is not. Discover how Microsoft uses Foundry agents to scale expert knowledge in two very different teams: Product Marketing and Engineering Operations. From content reviews to incident and problem management, explore how teams capture expertise, automate repeatable work, and preserve human judgment. Leave with practical patterns for building agents that scale quality and consistency while freeing experts to focus on complex decisions and meet growing business demands.

sessions.t: Agentic automation: How Copilot Studio blends workflows and agents
sessions.d: Deterministic and non-deterministic thinking are the core of why Copilot Studio enables mixing Workflows and Agents. See how we're taking this to the next level with new workflow authoring experiences, integration with agents, and enhanced reliability.

sessions.t: See how the Microsoft Copilot harness powers Copilot Studio
sessions.d: Go behind the build of the new Microsoft Copilot harness in Copilot Studio. Learn how hooks, skills, multi-agent orchestration, models, context, and tools come together to power complex, long-running agents, and explore the Azure container architecture that underpins the runtime. See how this architecture helps organizations create agents that are more capable, reliable, reusable, and secure, while providing a durable foundation that evolves with AI models and business needs.

sessions.t: The next evolution of AI FinOps: From cost to value
sessions.d: Visibility into AI spend is just the beginning. Learn how leading organizations optimize investments across IT, business leaders, makers, and end users. Discover how new capabilities, help you manage costs, prove value, and scale the AI initiatives that deliver the biggest results.

sessions.t: From tool to teammate: Persistent agents for shared processes in Copilot Studio
sessions.d: Learn how to build Copilot Studio agents that behave like teammates for recurring business processes. See how agent accounts, triggers, business process memory, and agent refinements help agents work as their own entity, act proactively, retain process context, and continuously improve to facilitate recurring business processes - while the makers stay in control. See how these agents benefit from additional capabilities like app UIs in agents and computer use too.

Explore how different layers of Microsoft technology work together to provide governance, security, and cost management. With Copilot Studio agents as a practical focus, learn how to establish guardrails, understand usage and spend, and optimize as adoption grows.

sessions.t: Master AI spend management with Agent 365: Govern your AI budget
sessions.d: See the tools IT needs to govern, control, and optimize AI spend at scale. Join this deep dive into Agent 365 and Microsoft 365 Admin Center capabilities for AI FinOps. Learn how to establish guardrails with policies, monitor consumption across AI vendors, measure value, and confidently scale AI across your organization. This is the essential session for IT to understand the latest innovations in AI cost management and governance.

sessions.d: When should you not build using the Microsoft Copilot harness in Copilot Studio? Come learn about how factors like the business process, its complexity, user experience, and cost influence which harness you would want to build your agent with. Leave the session knowing how to match the right harness to the job, while building agents that are fit for their intended purpose.

Come and see how makers and developers can build with natural language, connect enterprise data and actions, and move solutions from idea to production with shared security, governance, and lifecycle management.

sessions.t: Maximize your Copilot Investment: Scale with flexibility and control
sessions.d: AI investments are growing, but are organizations getting the most value from them? Learn not only how to gain visibility and control over AI spend, but also how to measure business value and continuously optimize. Explore new capabilities designed to help organizations manage spend against budget, allocate resources effectively, and maximize the value of their AI investments.

sessions.t: What's new in Copilot Studio
sessions.d: A keynote-style talk on the biggest recent Copilot Studio features, including the newly upgraded all-in-one platform to build apps, workflows, and agents as well as exciting updates coming in the near future.

sessions.t: Build as a team with GitHub Copilot tailored to your workflow
sessions.d: Help your team ship faster without giving up the checks you rely on. See how GitHub Copilot can follow your team’s instructions, connect to your tools, and take on tasks as part of your everyday development process. Walk through how testing, code review, and your organization’s policies help keep people in control as agents do more of the work. Leave with a practical approach to making Copilot useful across your team, not just for individual developers.

sessions.t: Agentic AI in action: Reimagining software engineering at scale
sessions.d: Discover how HPE Networking developed and operationalized the AI Management System - (AIMS), a unified agentic AI platform built on top of GitHub Copilot that integrates domain-specific intelligence, automation, and advanced analytics to transform software engineering. Explore how AIMS enables a closed-loop engineering ecosystem, connecting insights, decisions, and actions across the software development lifecycle to accelerate innovation and drive continuous improvement at enterprise scale.

sessions.t: Ship more software with parallel agents in the GitHub Copilot app
sessions.d: Build a new feature while agents investigate issues, add tests, and prepare other changes for review. In this demo-led session, follow an idea from prompt to merged pull request in the GitHub Copilot app. See how to choose models for different tasks, hand off work to Autopilot, and turn repeatable tasks into automations. Keep track of what's running, step in where needed, and validate the results, so you can take on more without losing control of what ships.

sessions.t: Manage GitHub Copilot spending and understand team adoption
sessions.d: Make informed decisions about your Copilot investment. Explore how model choices, agent workflows, and GitHub Actions contribute to development costs, then use billing reports, budgets, and alerts to manage spending. Learn to interpret adoption and engagement trends, spot underused capabilities, and target support where teams need it. IT admins and engineering leaders will leave with practical steps to manage costs and help developers use Copilot effectively.

sessions.t: From 2 days to 45 minutes: Bradesco’s agentic AI transformation
sessions.d: What if core technology modernization that once took 2 days could happen in just 45 minutes? Bradesco is putting agentic AI to work across 5,126 services, building on the AI foundation behind 600+ initiatives serving 74 million customers. With Azure AI Foundry and GitHub Copilot, teams are transforming how they assess, plan, and modernize services while maintaining architecture, security, and quality gates. Join Bradesco and Microsoft to see agentic AI in action across the engineering lifecycle.

sessions.t: Bring GitHub Copilot where you work
sessions.d: You build software across more than one tool, and GitHub Copilot can meet you in each of them. See how Copilot supports the full development lifecycle across IDEs, the terminal, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and mobile devices. Follow work from planning and building through review, security, and release, choosing from multiple AI models along the way. Understand how Copilot connects these experiences to improve developer flow and help organizations deliver better software faster.

sessions.t: Hand off the task or take the keyboard in VS Code
sessions.d: AI coding should not make you choose between delegating the work and staying close to the code. Follow a real task through GitHub Copilot in VS Code, from handing it off in the agents window to reviewing, editing, and debugging in the editor. See how familiar Claude and Codex workflows carry over while your files, terminal, extensions, and project context stay within reach. You will leave with a practical understanding of when to use each experience and how they work together.

sessions.t: What should you build when you can build anything?
sessions.d: What do you build when the answer is “anything”? We'll take you on a fast, fun tour of Windows, GitHub, OSS and all the fun new shiny things. Expect big ideas, surprises, and a parade of demos showing what happens when powerful tools meet relentless curiosity. Come for the awesome. Leave with new possibilities and an urge to build something.

Expect big ideas, surprises, and a parade of demos showing what happens when powerful tools meet relentless curiosity. Come for the awesome. Leave with new possibilities and an urge to build something.

sessions.t: Beyond coding: Build next-gen agents with the Microsoft Copilot SDK
sessions.d: Explore the applications unlocked by the Microsoft Copilot SDK, from internal support agents and business workflows to coding experiences and software factories. Through practical demos, see how an agent harness brings models, context, tools, and execution together, and how the same building blocks power many app experiences. Learn to turn your organization's expertise and systems into capabilities agents can use.

sessions.t: Hack the harness: Copilot SDK agents from prototype to production
sessions.d: Follow a solution from a simple agent session to isolated execution, task-specific workers, and complex dynamic orchestration. Explore what belongs in a modern harness, how context, tools, models, and execution fit together, and which requirements should drive your next architectural decision for agents. You'll leave with a practical framework for maturing any own agent solution, not just adding more features.

sessions.t: Inside Copilot code review: From context to approval
sessions.d: Merge your code with confidence after Copilot reviews it. Learn how Copilot pulls context from the right places to conduct informed reviews, and how it can be tailored to your team's coding standards. We'll show how we built 3 review effort levels, each backed by an ensemble of agents and tuned to different cost and quality preferences. Finally, learn how we built confidence in Copilot's ability to approve pull requests. You'll leave knowing how to make Copilot code review work for you.

sessions.t: Building a model for software development from the ground up
sessions.d: Benchmarks alone can’t predict how a model will perform in a real product. Follow Microsoft AI’s journey building a model for coding and agentic software development, with GitHub Copilot as its proving ground. Explore how model design, training, real-world workflows, and product signals shape iteration across quality, latency, cost, and control—and leave with practical lessons for building specialized production models.

sessions.t: Designing an agent harness that orchestrates models
sessions.d: Choosing a model is becoming less important than deciding how and when models are used. Explore how routing can match models to different tasks, constraints, and stages of development. We’ll examine the signals and tradeoffs that guide these decisions, and approaches such as GitHub Copilot Fusion that coordinate models as a portfolio. Leave with a framework for building adaptable agent systems across quality, latency, cost, and control.

Leave with a framework for building adaptable agent systems across quality, latency, cost, and control.

sessions.t: Securing coding agents and their code
sessions.d: Coding agents can write code in minutes. Security teams need confidence that both the agent and its output can be trusted. Learn how GitHub helps organizations secure agent-driven development with isolated sandboxes, protections against supply chain threats, and automated validation of AI-generated code before deployment. Discover how to scale the use of coding agents while maintaining security and governance across the development lifecycle.

sessions.t: Always-on agentic security platform for code security
sessions.d: With agentic development, developers are shipping faster than ever, while attackers are rapidly shrinking the window from public disclosure to exploitation. Security teams can't review every change, and headcount won't scale. See how GitHub Advanced Security uses AI to extend your reach: scanning surfaces multi-step exploits, secret scanning with push protection stops leaked credentials, and Agentic Autofix delivers fixes as ready-to-merge PRs.

sessions.t: The backlog problem gets worse with AI. Here's how to fix it.
sessions.d: Getting ready for AI means getting ahead of security debt. As development accelerates, security teams need a better way to prioritize risk than severity scores alone. Learn how organizations identify the vulnerabilities, dependencies, and secrets most likely to matter, then drive remediation at scale through security campaigns and agentic autofix that help teams reduce backlogs and focus on what needs fixing.

sessions.t: Production-ready Microsoft Foundry agents with Azure AI Landing Zones
sessions.d: Build AI apps and agents that are ready for production from day one. Learn an end-to-end approach for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale agentic solutions with Microsoft Foundry. See how Azure AI Landing Zones provide a proven architectural foundation and extensible implementation that accelerates infrastructure deployment and application development for AI solutions. Then explore how Foundry Models, Agent Service, Tools, Control Plane and Microsoft IQ come together.

sessions.t: Your agent works. Now make it enterprise-ready.
sessions.d: Creating AI agents has never been easier. But what happens when they need to handle complex scenarios, connect to enterprise systems, take action, operate safely, and scale? Join us as we take you from experimentation to enterprise-grade agentic solutions through real examples, including autonomous resolution agents. Learn how Microsoft is moving from assisted to autonomous agents, and the architecture decisions, tradeoffs, guardrails, evals, and observability practices with trusted AI at scale.

sessions.t: Secure the CI pipeline: Practical defenses for GitHub Actions
sessions.d: GitHub Actions workflows can access credentials, networks, and production systems, making them high-value software supply chain targets. Using an attack-path map and before-and-after demos, we'll show how to defend against pull_request_target misuse, floating action refs, cache poisoning, over-permissioned credentials, widened trust boundaries, and open egress. You'll leave able to audit workflows, pin and scope what runs, contain blast radius, and expose malicious behavior.

sessions.t: Trusted code at scale, from legacy to AI
sessions.d: Every codebase carries quality debt, and AI adds to it faster than teams can pay down. Performance issues inflate cloud cost, maintainability debt slows every future change, and reliability gaps surface as incidents. GitHub Code Quality catches these across new and existing code where developers work, recommends fixes, and gives engineering leaders governance to enforce standards. Agentic autofix then remediates findings at scale, turning backlogs into reviewable pull requests.

sessions.t: Visual Studio governance for the agentic era
sessions.d: AI is changing how developers build software. Learn how IT administrators can enable AI across their organization while maintaining security and compliance. See how Visual Studio supports Copilot and BYOK policies, private extension marketplace, allow and deny controls for extensions, and centralized management, empowering every developer to use AI securely and productively at scale.

sessions.t: GitHub, the agent native engineering system
sessions.d: AI agents are reshaping engineering beyond code generation. Discover how GitHub provides an agent-native system where humans and agents collaborate across defining, delivering, and assessing software. Learn how integrated governance, shared knowledge, and continuous feedback help organizations safely scale agentic development—accelerating delivery while maintaining quality and focus on customer value.

sessions.t: Humans, agents, and a game plan: AI governance with GitHub Enterprise
sessions.d: Give developers, knowledge workers, and AI agents room to innovate with enterprise control. Follow an admin journey in GitHub Enterprise and Copilot: set model policies and managed settings, customize for teams, onboard fast, and manage access and spend. Review config changes via pull requests and use agent activity data to assess governance. See the roadmap linking policy, usage, and cost. Leave with a plan to set guardrails, measure impact, and grow AI adoption without friction.

sessions.t: GitHub Intelligence: The intelligence layer for the self-improving SDLC
sessions.d: What if engineering systems could learn from everything an organization has already solved? GitHub Intelligence turns knowledge buried in code, pull requests, reviews, and AI agent activity into answers: what's happening, why, and what should change next. It finds patterns across teams, identifies affected repos, builds a plan, and dispatches coding agents under human review. We'll share results from Microsoft and customers—and show how teams can stop solving the same problems repeatedly.

sessions.t: Getting the most out of GitHub Copilot and Azure DevOps
sessions.d: Azure DevOps customers can use GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows whether their repositories are hosted in Azure Repos or GitHub. In this session, we will demonstrate Copilot code review for Azure Repos and show how to use the Azure DevOps MCP Server with Visual Studio Code, GitHub CLI, and GitHub Copilot app. We will also cover how to use Auto fix with GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps.

sessions.t: Build your IQ using your unique enterprise context with Microsoft IQ
sessions.d: Unveiling new features in Microsoft IQ to enable enterprises users to equip agents with the context they need to succeed. See how teams can curate data that bring together knowledge, data, tools, and skills, then publish them for agents across the enterprise. Learn how a shared, governed context can accelerate agent development, improve consistency, and help every agent understand how your organization works.

sessions.t: Web IQ: The new search engine for agents
sessions.d: Web search was designed for people: type, scroll, click. But agents need structured data and act in milliseconds. This session explores how modern search, designed for agents, drives business outcomes. Learn how Web IQ adds value to AI systems with fresh information and world context, including news, data feeds, images, videos, commerce and more. See why the agentic web demands a new retrieval architecture, and what you can build on Web IQ today.

sessions.t: Work IQ governance and trust: Control the intelligence layer
sessions.d: Trust is the foundation of enterprise AI. Explore the governance controls that help administrators secure and scale Work IQ across apps and agents. Learn how to manage data access, apply policy controls, monitor consumption, and optimize costs so teams can innovate with confidence while maintaining security, compliance, and oversight.

sessions.t: The shift from RAG to context: Grounding agents with Foundry IQ
sessions.d: The market is moving from app-specific RAG to shared context layers to give many agents secure access to trusted enterprise knowledge. We'll explore how Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search) improves grounding across the stack: from core search innovations and knowledge graphs to purpose-built models that make agentic retrieval faster, higher quality, and easier to configure. We'll also show how Foundry IQ fits into Microsoft IQ, enabling people and agents with easier knowledge discovery and consumption.

sessions.t: Bringing conversational analytics to where decisions happen
sessions.d: Data should meet users where decisions happen. Learn how Microsoft Fabric brings conversational analytics into the tools people use every day. Powered by Fabric IQ, which unifies OneLake, the Power BI semantic layer, ontologies, and data agents, Fabric provides a trusted intelligence layer for copilots, applications, and workflows. See how organizations connect analytics, context, AI, and governance to turn questions into actions.

sessions.t: Give agents and people the business context to act with Work IQ
sessions.d: See how Business Apps in Work IQ brings together CRM, ERP, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and more to create a real-time view of your end-to-end business processes. Discover how connected business context helps agents and employees make better decisions, take action faster, and work more effectively across the organization.

sessions.t: Building agentic retrieval: From DIY to Foundry IQ
sessions.d: Why does agentic retrieval matter, and what does it take to build it yourself? In this session, we will first code an agent loop that decomposes a question, runs parallel searches, inspects evidence, and decides whether to search again. Then we'll see how Foundry IQ can replace that plumbing with a managed agentic knowledge base. Learn how we made the managed service cheaper, faster, and better, thanks to serverless execution, compression, fine-tuned task-specific models, and built-in ranking.

sessions.t: Building context-aware agents with Microsoft IQ
sessions.d: What if your agents could reason with the full intelligence of your organization? Learn how Microsoft IQ grounds agents in your company’s unique data, knowledge, work, and business context across Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, and Web IQ. Discover how your IQ helps agents take more relevant actions, enable trusted decisions, and accelerate business outcomes.

sessions.t: Build personalized AI experiences with Work IQ
sessions.d: See how information workers and developers use Work IQ to power intelligent experiences across declarative agents, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and third-party platforms. Learn how Work IQ combines organizational context with connectors, agent-to-agent experiences, and external systems to create secure, personalized solutions grounded in your organization's knowledge, processes, and permissions.

sessions.t: Secure your business presence in the AI web with Web IQ
sessions.d: Your next customer may never visit your website. AI assistants and agents increasingly research products, evaluate vendors, and influence buying decisions. Learn how WebIQ powers AI discovery, why some brands get recommended while others are overlooked, and what you can do to improve visibility and trust. Leave with a practical playbook to help your business get found, recommended, and chosen in the AI web.

sessions.t: What's new in Work IQ
sessions.d: Discover the latest innovations in Work IQ. Learn how Work IQ is expanding organizational intelligence through richer context across M365 data such as emails and chats, advanced retrieval and grounding experiences, and unified intelligence endpoints. Get an inside look at new capabilities, integration patterns, and the vision for powering smarter agents and personalized AI across the Microsoft ecosystem.

sessions.t: Microsoft IQ: Build trusted AI agents that know your business
sessions.d: Agents are only as good as what they know about your business. Your business context is your AI advantage, and much of it already lives in Microsoft 365 and Fabric & Power BI. See how Microsoft IQ unifies and governs all your business context across Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, Web IQ, and 400+ other sources to securely power your agents built on any platform. Watch us build an agent live using the capabilities available at Ignite, and learn what’s coming next.

See how Microsoft IQ unifies and governs all your business context across Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, Web IQ, and 400+ other sources to securely power your agents built on any platform. Watch us build an agent live using the capabilities available at Ignite, and learn what’s coming next.

sessions.t: Fabric IQ: Trusted business context for enterprise AI
sessions.d: Enterprise AI is only as effective as the business context behind it. Discover how Microsoft IQ unifies knowledge across the Microsoft ecosystem and how Fabric IQ provides trusted business meaning that helps AI understand how an organization operates. Learn how enterprises can reuse existing data and knowledge to deliver consistent answers, make informed decisions, and enable agents to act with confidence.

sessions.t: Foundry IQ: Knowledge graphs for better enterprise context
sessions.d: Our agents can only reason over what they can retrieve. Classic RAG answers fact lookups but misses themes, trends, and relationships that live across a whole corpus. Get an early look at what's next in Foundry IQ: retrieval that clusters content into topics, graph structures that turn documents into entities and relationships, and a Microsoft-hosted agentic retriever you don't supply model capacity for. Live demos, before-and-after quality, and where enterprise context is headed.

sessions.t: How Microsoft IQ shapes the cost of enterprise AI
sessions.d: Enterprise AI does not have one cost model. It has three: people, consumption, and capacity. Through a retail AI scenario and a live cost estimation demo, this session shows how Work IQ, Foundry IQ, Fabric IQ, and Web IQ create different cost shapes, and how to optimize each one for scale, value, and control.

sessions.t: Optimizing AI agents to meet your goals: Grounding with Web IQ
sessions.d: Every grounding call is a trade-off. The highest-quality answer isn’t always the right one — sometimes your agent needs speed, sometimes freshness, sometimes precision at any cost. This session breaks down the quality-latency-cost frontier behind agent retrieval with Web IQ: when to let auto routing decide, when to orchestrate yourself, and how to design grounding strategies that hold up in production. Leave with a decision framework for any agent you’re building.

sessions.t: The evaluation loop for Microsoft IQ
sessions.d: Better context leads to better AI applications, but improvement requires more than trial and error. In this session, we'll build an evaluation loop for Microsoft IQ applications, using evaluations to compare retrieval configurations, context strategies, prompts, and models. Learn how to identify weak spots, measure the impact of changes, and systematically improve application quality. See how evaluations can transform context engineering from guesswork into an iterative, data-driven practice.

sessions.t: Web IQ in action: How enterprises build grounded, governed AI agents
sessions.d: Join Microsoft and a customer to explore how Web IQ enables enterprise-grade AI agents grounded in the public web. Through a real-world customer experience, learn how Web IQ supports high-value business scenarios while meeting enterprise requirements for security, governance, quality, and scale. Hear directly from the customer about the business need, implementation journey, key learnings, and outcomes achieved with Web IQ.

sessions.t: The trust foundation for the next era of intelligence
sessions.d: AI is entering a new era where agents reason, collaborate, and take action across business systems. As intelligence becomes more autonomous, trust becomes the critical infrastructure that enables innovation to scale. Join Sarah and Mohammad to explore Microsoft's vision for the next generation of Trustworthy AI: from policy and oversight to security, transparency, and accountability. Learn how organizations can confidently unlock the promise of agentic AI while staying in control.

sessions.t: Build with Web IQ: From API call to cited answer
sessions.d: The web can bring fresh knowledge to AI, but great grounding takes more than search. In this session, learn how to use Web IQ to retrieve relevant web information, generate grounded answers, and connect responses to supporting sources. We’ll cover the end-to-end architecture and show how latency, token usage, and traces help optimize experiences from prototype to production. Leave with practical patterns for agents, copilots, and AI apps.

sessions.t: Agentic incident management: Lessons from production AIOps
sessions.d: Explore how agentic orchestration can transform incident management in production AIOps. This session examines how AI agents coordinate investigations, connect operational signals, and support human decisions. Discover practical design patterns, implementation challenges, and lessons for building reliable, responsible workflows that help teams respond to incidents more effectively.

sessions.t: Winning the Race Against Time with Autonomous Protection
sessions.d: AI is changing the economics of cyberattacks, compressing the gap between discovery and exploitation. Learn how Microsoft is rethinking autonomous protection for an era where exposure evolves faster than traditional defenses can keep pace.

sessions.t: What the Frontlines Reveal About Modern Security
sessions.d: What threats and challenges are Microsoft experts seeing on the frontlines of cyber defense? Hear directly from frontline experts and explore practical guidance for making threat intelligence actionable, operationalizing AI agents, and building cyber resilience.

sessions.t: Project Perception: How Agentic Security Works
sessions.d: Stay ahead of evolving threats with Project Perception, Microsoft’s new agentic security system. See how specialized red, blue, and green team agents work together with shared security context to expose weaknesses, investigate threats, prioritize risk, and strengthen defenses. Learn how coordinated multi-agent defense helps your team move from reactive security to continuous protection, while keeping people in control of critical decisions.

sessions.t: Find and fix code vulnerabilities faster with Codename MDASH
sessions.d: Accelerate vulnerability discovery with multi-model agentic security. Codename MDASH orchestrates specialized AI agents and security-focused AI models to identify, validate, and prioritize vulnerabilities, helping teams understand risk and focus on the issues that matter most.

sessions.t: Agentic Security Unfiltered with Allie Mellen: Hype vs. Reality
sessions.d: Explore the real-time architectural breakdown of what happens when agentic AI hits production IT environments. Together, Forrester principal analyst Allie Mellen and two Microsoft executives will tear down a modern SOC architecture live on stage—mapping out where agents safely automate outcomes, where non-deterministic AI breaks IT change controls, and how to design guardrails that CISOs and IT Directors can actually trust.

Explore the real-time architectural breakdown of what happens when agentic AI hits production IT environments. Together, Forrester principal analyst Allie Mellen and two Microsoft executives will tear down a modern SOC architecture live on stage—mapping out where agents safely automate outcomes, where non-deterministic AI breaks IT change controls, and how to design guardrails that CISOs and IT Directors can actually trust.

sessions.t: Threat Intelligence reimagined: From signals to protection at AI speed
sessions.d: Go beyond static threat intelligence feeds. See how Microsoft combines industry-leading visibility, expert-led research, and AI automation to turn intelligence into action. Explore demos and practical strategies to defend against today’s top threats.

sessions.t: Stay ahead of endpoint risk with AI-powered discovery and remediation
sessions.d: Outpace endpoint risk with AI-powered insight and governed remediation. See how Microsoft helps IT and security prioritize exposure, apply patches or mitigations, stage change safely, and verify risk reduction without disrupting work.

sessions.t: Project Perception Roadmap: New Capabilities, Use Cases & What's Next
sessions.d: How must security operations evolve when AI can act? Explore Microsoft’s agentic security vision and roadmap and learn how people, AI agents, and trusted controls can work together to accelerate defense across the security lifecycle.

sessions.t: The Alert Is Dead. The Blueprint for the Agentic SOC
sessions.d: What replaces alert-centric operations? In this session, we'll map the blueprint of the Agentic SOC and show how the integrated security operations center (ISOC) provides the foundation for outcome-driven defense. Learn how leading teams are shifting from triage to continuous attack disruption, how humans and AI divide responsibilities, and the architectural changes required to unify protection, operations, and AI into a single security system.

sessions.t: Behind the AI models built for security at scale
sessions.d: Always-on defense demands AI that runs continuously, but accuracy, latency, cost, and trust can keep powerful models out of security workflows. sessions.t: Building high-performance analytics with Fabric Data Warehouse
sessions.d: Fabric Data Warehouse is an AI-native warehouse built for high-performance analytics. Learn how its open, SaaS-first architecture on OneLake combines enterprise scale, reliability, and predictable performance with innovations like GPU acceleration and built-in AI experiences to simplify your analytics architecture and power demanding analytics and AI workloads.

sessions.t: Unify your data estate with Microsoft OneLake
sessions.d: Microsoft OneLake is designed to unify your entire multi‑cloud data estate on a single data lake. In this session, we'll cover the latest investments across data storage, governance, discovery, and domain-oriented data, and share what's next as we continue to simplify data management, strengthen governance, and prepare data for the next generation of AI experiences.

sessions.t: Scale mission-critical data and AI applications with Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: When analytics and AI run your business, the platform underneath must be reliable, secure, and ready to scale. Go inside Microsoft Fabric to see how we engineer for resilience and safely roll out changes to deliver new capabilities. Learn how to protect your data with network isolation, encryption, and identity, with real customer examples. Get practical guidance for managing capacity, governance, and deployment as people and agents scale.

sessions.t: AI-ready data integration with Fabric Data Factory
sessions.d: See how Fabric Data Factory helps teams connect, transform, govern, and operationalize enterprise data for AI. Learn patterns for pipelines, Dataflows, Copy Jobs, Mirroring, OneLake integrations, data quality, and analytics engineering with dbt to deliver trusted data for copilots, agents, and analytics. Additionally, learn how to modernize your data estate by migrating Azure Data Factory workloads to Microsoft Fabric.

sessions.t: Migrate to Microsoft Fabric: Modernize your data estate
sessions.d: Learn how to modernize your data estate by migrating Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse workloads to Microsoft Fabric. This session covers migration strategy, workload assessment, pipeline and dataflow modernization, warehouse and lakehouse patterns, CI/CD, governance, customer case studies and operational best practices to reduce risk and accelerate analytics and AI on Fabric.

sessions.t: Build like a startup. Deploy like an enterprise.
sessions.d: Microsoft Copilot is evolving into a platform where apps are built, shared, and run. See how Rayfin enables anyone to create intelligent applications powered by Fabric data, enterprise APIs, and AI models directly within Copilot. Learn how Rayfin provides the runtime, connectivity, governance, and deployment capabilities needed to move from a simple prompt to a production-ready application. Discover how you can use Copilot to build the next generation of business solutions.

sessions.d: Building an AI agent is no longer the hard part. Running it in the enterprise is. Production-ready agents need identity, clear authority, policies, approvals, quality controls, and governance across teams. Today, organizations piece these capabilities together manually for every agent. Join the Microsoft IQ product team for a roadmap session exploring what's next for the operating system for AI agents, how we're simplifying enterprise readiness, and where the platform is heading.

sessions.d: Get more from every dollar with Microsoft Fabric. See how Fabric combines Spark with native optimizations, intelligent workload management, and flexible consumption options to deliver industry-leading price performance. Learn how customers can process data faster, reduce infrastructure costs, and scale analytics efficiently. We’ll walk through benchmarks, real-world scenarios, and practical strategies for maximizing performance and value from Spark in Fabric.

sessions.t: Build intelligent PostgreSQL apps with Microsoft Fabric HorizonDB
sessions.d: Discover Microsoft Fabric HorizonDB, a Fabric-native PostgreSQL experience that helps developers build operational applications on a unified platform for transactions, analytics, and AI. Learn how HorizonDB enables applications to query operational and analytical data through a single PostgreSQL experience, reducing data movement and ETL complexity while delivering real-time insights. Build AI-ready applications faster with built-in governance and seamless access to OneLake-scale analytics.

sessions.t: The semantic layer for the AI era with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: AI is changing how people interact with data, but trusted answers still depend on shared business meaning. Explore how Power BI and Microsoft Fabric provide a trusted semantic foundation that connects data and business context across analytics and AI experiences. Learn how to create consistent definitions, reuse trusted semantics, and help everyone move from questions to insights and decisions faster.

sessions.t: Azure HorizonDB: Deep dive into architecture and internals
sessions.d: Join the engineer and product leaders behind Azure HorizonDB for a deep dive into the architecture and internals of a cloud-native PostgreSQL service. Explore the storage engine, disaggregated compute and storage architecture, replication pipeline, recovery design, and elasticity mechanisms that enable predictable performance and resilience at scale.

sessions.t: Data foundations for modern apps, AI, and agents
sessions.d: Every AI application and agent depends on a strong data foundation. Join Shireesh Thota, CVP of Engineering for Databases to explore how Microsoft databases help organizations modernize mission-critical applications while building a new generation of intelligent experiences. Through vision, product innovations, and live demos, discover how operational, analytical, relational, and NoSQL data platforms work together to power modern applications, AI agents, and business transformation.

sessions.t: Less hunting, more building: Database agents in a unified estate
sessions.d: Growing data estates create fragmented tools, limited visibility, and operational complexity that slows innovation. See how database hub in Fabric and database agents work with the tools your teams already use—SSMS and the MSSQL extension for VS Code—to surface the issues that matter, explain the likely cause, recommend a fix, and act with your approval. Come away with practical ways to reduce risk, cut operational overhead, and boost productivity, no matter where your data lives.

sessions.t: Powering AI with Azure Databricks, Foundry, Fabric, and Copilot
sessions.d: AI is only as powerful as the data behind it. Join this session to explore how Azure Databricks can power the next generation of AI experiences through deep integrations with OneLake, Fabric, Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power BI, Teams, and Microsoft 365. Learn how to build a governed, open data estate with Unity Catalog, activate trusted enterprise data for copilots and AI agents, and accelerate business outcomes with shared governance, interoperability, and enterprise-scale analytics.

sessions.t: Build self-optimizing AI agents with Azure Cosmos DB and Fabric
sessions.d: Everyone's shipping AI agents - but are they fast, cheap, and actually working? We'll instrument a multi-agent app with Azure Cosmos DB and Fabric to analyze cost, latency, and outcomes and build feedback loops for optimization. We'll also show how Kinectify applies these same principles to a 15+ agent KYC platform, using deep observability, QA agents, and quality gates to improve reliability and prevent bad data from reaching production.

sessions.t: Database SOS: Choosing the right engine for your job
sessions.d: Apps and AI agents rely on databases to serve data that's fresh, fast, and scalable. But with so many types of databases - relational, NoSQL, open-source, and more - how do you know which database is right for your project? Join experts as they explore different Azure Databases, and share insights on how to choose for your next project.

sessions.t: Designing the data layer for AI apps and agents with Azure Cosmos DB
sessions.d: AI apps and multi-agent systems need operational data, memory, state, and retrieval to work together. Learn how to design these patterns with Azure Cosmos DB through real-world use cases and customer examples. See how full-text, vector, hybrid, semantic, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval can ground agents in current application data, while Azure Cosmos DB supports conversation history, memory, personalization, and global production scale.

sessions.t: Postgres in production on Azure: Lessons in fleet modernization
sessions.d: Running PostgreSQL at scale requires performance, security, resilience, and cost efficiency. Explore the latest innovations in Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including fleet management, Elastic Clusters, next-generation compute and storage, immutable backups, expanded regional availability, and more. Leave with practical guidance, proven patterns, and real-world insights for modernizing and operating mission-critical PostgreSQL workloads on Azure.

sessions.t: Humans to agents: Mission-critical starts with Azure SQL Hyperscale
sessions.d: AI applications are evolving beyond chat and copilots into systems that reason, retrieve context, maintain memory, and take action. These workloads demand a database that can unify transactional, vector, analytical, and agentic workloads without sacrificing scale, performance, or governance. Learn how Azure SQL Hyperscale provides the foundation for building production-ready AI applications with the scale and resilience required for the agentic era.

sessions.t: Build integrated AI apps with Azure HorizonDB
sessions.d: Build AI applications grounded in operational data without assembling a fragmented data stack. See how Azure HorizonDB brings PostgreSQL data together with AI functions, durable AI pipelines, vector and hybrid search, semantic ranking, and knowledge graphs. Through a fast-paced technical walkthrough and live demo, learn how to transform continuously changing operational data into powerful, connected, and context-aware AI experiences.

sessions.t: Why Azure is the best cloud for SQL
sessions.d: Your SQL workloads demand a platform built for performance, security, and what’s next. Join us and see how Azure can unify SQL across on-premises, cloud, and Fabric to simplify operations and maximize existing investments. Modernize mission-critical workloads and empower developers to build AI-ready apps without sacrificing reliability or control. Hear why customers like H&R Block are building their business on Azure SQL Hyperscale.

sessions.t: Where agents meet analytics: Build with SQL Database in Fabric
sessions.d: Build AI agents on operational data and turn every interaction into insight with SQL database in Microsoft Fabric. See how native vectors, governed data access, MCP, and built-in mirroring to OneLake connect agentic applications with analytics on a shared data foundation.

sessions.t: Build AI-ready apps on Azure SQL with GitHub Copilot in VS Code
sessions.d: Go from an idea to an AI-ready SQL app with the MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code and GitHub Copilot. Build it step by step: prototype locally with the Azure SQL Database container, design your database with Microsoft SQL Agent Skills, build retrieval augmented generation(RAG) using native vector support, create a data API, and deploy to the cloud. See how the tools work together so you can spend less time on database setup and more time building your app.

sessions.t: Beyond the cache: How Sitecore builds to scale on Azure Managed Redis
sessions.d: Applications need fast, reliable data access as demand grows. Sitecore, a global content and digital experience provider, built Content Hub to govern, structure, and distribute content and assets across digital channels. Sitecore will share how it uses Azure Managed Redis to support Azure Kubernetes Service-based workloads and complement database-backed applications. Explore caching patterns, practical guidance, and agent kit resources to improve performance and scalability.

sessions.t: Migrate and modernize MongoDB applications with Azure DocumentDB
sessions.d: Learn how to move existing MongoDB applications to Azure DocumentDB with less migration risk and disruption. We'll walk the migration journey—from assessing compatibility and moving data to validating behavior and optimizing for production—while showing how familiar MongoDB drivers, tools, and patterns preserve existing investments. See how the latest Azure DocumentDB capabilities help teams move beyond migration and modernize on Azure.

Learn how organizations reduce administrative burden, automate sales processes, and equip every seller with an AI-powered sales team. Explore Microsoft’s vision for Dynamics 365 Sales in the flow of work, where people and agents collaborate to drive revenue growth.

sessions.t: The Agentic Shift: Reimagining Customer Service
sessions.d: Customer service is evolving beyond traditional CRM and agent desktops into autonomous operations where people and AI agents resolve issues faster and deliver better experiences. Learn how organizations modernize self-service, empower teams, automate processes, and reduce operational complexity.

Catch up on the latest WinUI platform updates and momentum and see how WinUI Agent and WinAppCLI support agent-ready workflows across Visual Studio, VS Code, and the command line.

sessions.t: Inside WSL containers for application development
sessions.d: Understand WSL containers from architecture to deployment. Learn how to build and run Linux containers on Windows while exploring Windows integration, performance, security, management, and policy controls for enterprise-scale development.

sessions.t: Raising the Bar for Windows Quality: Built with Your Feedback
sessions.d:
You told us what matters most. See how we're improving Windows quality with more reliable updates, fewer disruptions, and more dependable experiences across your organization.

Learn how your feedback, Windows Insider participation, and initiatives like the Driver Quality Initiative (DQI) are helping shape the future of Windows, driving improvements across reliability, performance, updates, and the devices and peripherals your business depends on.

sessions.t: Edge for Business: Browser security in the age of AI productivity
sessions.d: AI adoption and AI-enabled cyberthreats are proliferating in the browser—hourly. In this session, IT and security teams will learn practical ways to address both: use Edge for Business to help reduce browser risk and protect sensitive data, while opening the door to new AI and agentic productivity. See how built-in visibility, policy enforcement, and compliance help you stay in control, even on unmanaged devices—without adding more tools to your security stack.

sessions.t: From Prevention to Recovery: Building a More Resilient Windows Estate
sessions.d: Microsoft is enabling resiliency across physical devices and Cloud PCs. Explore how we’re securing the driver ecosystem, delivering Windows recovery innovations, and enabling Windows 365 Reserve to reduce downtime and accelerate recovery.

sessions.t: Intelligence on Windows: Unlocking the Full Value of Microsoft Copilot
sessions.d: You invested in AI. Now it's time to maximize its value. Learn how Windows helps organizations drive AI adoption, improve productivity, support data sovereignty requirements, and get more from AI investments, including Microsoft Copilot.

sessions.t: Windows 365 – Your flexible, trusted workspace for the age of AI
sessions.d: As AI and agents rapidly reshape how work gets done, organizations need a flexible computing foundation that can adapt quickly. Windows 365 delivers an AI-ready foundation for desktop computing that is simple to manage and scale, where agents can work securely just like people do. From like-local experiences for Cloud PC users to new ways of running agents securely to a new AI-powered admin experience, see the latest Windows 365 innovations.

sessions.d: Not sure where to start with modernizing on-premises VDI? See how Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 let you modernize at your own pace, from extending existing investments to embracing cloud-managed desktops, with lessons from real customers.

sessions.d: Whether you shape endpoint strategy or manage daily operations, this session is for you.
