sessions.t: Microsoft and SAP bring a connected system of intelligence
sessions.d: See how mission-critical SAP workloads run resiliently on Azure, how SAP business data becomes grounded and governed AI context, and how Copilot and agents move from insight to action across finance, supply chain, and operations. Includes live demos and customer proof points, plus a practical roadmap for taking your SAP landscape to the AI frontier without compromising trust, compliance, or uptime.

sessions.t: Modernize faster with AI-powered discovery, planning, and execution
sessions.d: Turn a fragmented estate into an AI-powered modernization plan ready for action. See Azure Copilot Migration Agent unify estate data, discover applications, build defensible business case with Azure value across cost, security, management, and operations, generate CAF and WAF aligned application and network designs, recommend migration waves, and orchestrate governed runbook execution across infrastructure, containers, databases, and storage.

sessions.t: Accelerating Java, .NET, and database modernization with agents
sessions.d: Modernization projects often stall under the weight of technical debt, complex dependencies, and aging databases. See how organizations are using AI-powered agents to transform Java and .NET applications alongside the databases they depend on. Learn how GitHub Copilot accelerates framework upgrades, code remediation, containerization, and database modernization to help teams move faster from assessment to deployment and build an AI-ready foundation for future innovation.

sessions.t: Beyond code conversion: Business-led modernization with AI
sessions.d: Modernization goes beyond code conversion. Join Microsoft Frontier Company, Raincode, and LSEG to explore a business-led approach to modernizing core systems, using mainframe as a real-world example. Learn how AI, modern platform engineering, and cloud-native architecture on Azure can reduce risk and technical debt, preserve critical business logic, maximize existing investments, and lay the foundation for continuous innovation and AI transformation.

sessions.t: Rethink modernization end to end with agents
sessions.d: Discover how AI agents can help modernize apps, data, and infrastructure, from discovery and design through execution. Explore how Azure services bring performance, scale, and AI capabilities to modernized workloads, and learn how to get started with expert guidance from Microsoft. Hear Lumen share lessons from its modernization journey and gain practical insights to reduce risk and move forward with confidence.

sessions.t: Govern, secure, and operate anywhere with Azure Arc
sessions.d: Your infrastructure is distributed. Your control plane shouldn’t be. Discover how Azure Arc extends Azure management, security, and governance across servers, Kubernetes, databases, and applications wherever they run. See how a unified approach helps close security gaps, control costs, and improve operational consistency for your Arc-enabled SQL Server instances through Database Hub in Fabric.

sessions.t: Inside Azure engineering: Lessons from our own frontier transformation
sessions.d: Microsoft engineers are building and scaling AI applications and agents on Azure at enterprise scale. Through Customer Zero, get an inside look at the use cases, architectures, operational practices, and governance strategies that power frontier AI workloads across Microsoft. Learn proven approaches for accelerating AI adoption, avoiding common pitfalls, and delivering AI solutions that are secure, reliable, and ready for production.

sessions.t: Put AI agents to work in Azure cloud operations
sessions.d: Move from AI assistance to agentic cloud operations. Through live demos, see Azure agents use rich operational context to investigate incidents, uncover cost optimization opportunities, and take corrective action with granular controls. Explore new Azure Copilot experiences and Azure Resource Manager MCP Server enhancements that give agents deeper environmental awareness. This session is built for FinOps, SRE, platform engineering, and AI infrastructure teams.

sessions.t: Drive modern operations with Azure Monitor
sessions.d: Modern operations teams need visibility across an increasingly complex technology stack. In this session, discover how Microsoft unifies observability across infrastructure, applications, and AI agents. Learn how Azure Monitor, health models, advanced platform metrics, and Observability Agent capabilities help identify issues faster, accelerate investigations, and reduce complexity. See how Microsoft Fabric connects operational and business data to enable more resilient, intelligent operations.

sessions.t: Scale operations, not toil, with your AI SRE teammate
sessions.d: Cloud scale shouldn’t mean scaling toil. Discover how Azure SRE Agent helps operations teams move from reactive firefighting to proactive reliability. See how AI SRE agents investigate and resolve issues faster, automate operational workflows, and strengthen resilience across growing environments—giving engineers more time to improve platforms, ship new capabilities, and build what’s next.

sessions.t: What’s new and what’s next for Windows Server
sessions.d: Windows Server 2025 is a tour de force. Join this demo-filled session for the latest release news and a preview of the next version of Windows Server. We’ll cover Hyper-V, Active Directory, Storage, and Networking, while showing how the next release raises the bar for security, performance, and AI. Don’t miss it.

sessions.t: From VMware to Hyper-V: Hyperscale virtualization in your datacenter
sessions.d: As organizations pursue greater efficiency, scalability, and flexibility, they must also manage rising costs and operational complexity. In this demo-filled session, we will show how Windows Admin Center (WAC) Virtualization Mode helps you build cost-effective, cloud-connected on-prem virtualization solutions with the Hyper-V hypervisor in Windows Server.

sessions.t: Deploy and run Microsoft Foundry models and agents on AKS
sessions.d: This session walks the integrated path: pick a model in Foundry and deploy it to your own AKS cluster, set a runtime tuning profile, and run it on GPU node pools with workload identity, policy, and built-in observability. It also covers Foundry hosted agents on AKS in both bring-your-own-cluster and managed modes, so you choose how much of the infrastructure you own. Leave knowing how to take a model or agent from Foundry to a governed, scalable production deployment on AKS.

sessions.t: Operate a global AKS fleet across regions, edge, and sovereign clouds
sessions.d: As Kubernetes deployments expand across regions, public cloud, virtualized and bare-metal environments, and sovereign clouds, operational complexity grows. Learn how Azure Kubernetes Service Fleet Manager and AKS Flex Nodes help you standardize operations, enforce compliance, and simplify day-to-day management across distributed environments. Walk away with practical strategies to keep large-scale Kubernetes estates secure, consistent, and resilient as they grow.

sessions.t: Run open-weight models, post-training, and agents on AKS
sessions.d: Serving open-weight models, post-training on new data, and running agents that take action each place different demands on GPUs, isolation, and cost. This session shows how Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and open source give platform teams control across all three: scaling GPU capacity, serving models, and isolating agents, with Ray for distributed post-training and MCP for connecting agents to tools. Hear how a customer runs AI in production on AKS and leave with patterns for your own tenant.

sessions.t: Build AI-native with Azure's agentic application platform
sessions.d: AI has raised the bar on velocity, and enterprises need an application platform that ships fast without giving up operations, management or enterprise readiness. See how Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps and Azure Functions now form an agentic application platform, with secure isolation for agent code, native connections to enterprise systems, event driven scale and built in governance. Customer examples show it running in production today. Leave knowing where applications go next.

sessions.t: Modernize legacy integration with Azure Logic Apps
sessions.d: Moving from BizTalk Server or another legacy integration platform isn’t just about migration. It’s an opportunity to modernize the business processes your enterprise depends on. See how the Logic Apps Migration Agent accelerates migration to Azure Logic Apps Standard for B2B, EDI, legacy integration, and custom code. Build on that foundation to create agentic business processes with Logic Apps Automation. Learn how customers are modernizing in weeks, not months, and unlocking new value.

sessions.t: Secure and manage AI workloads at enterprise scale with AI Gateway
sessions.d: As AI adoption grows, IT teams need consistent controls across the models, tools, MCP servers, applications, and agents used throughout the enterprise. Learn how AI Gateway provides a centralized runtime layer to secure, govern, monitor, and manage AI interactions across Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Agent 365, and applications built anywhere. See how to implement policies, manage cost and traffic, monitor usage, and operationalize AI governance across development and production environments.

sessions.t: Red Hat on Azure: Advancing unified hybrid cloud together
sessions.d: Hybrid is an operating model, not just a step on the way to cloud. Microsoft and Red Hat share their unified vision for Red Hat workloads on Azure, including what’s available today and what’s coming next across virtualization, cloud economics, and hosted control planes. Hear how joint engineering is simplifying hybrid operations, anchored by Goethe-Institut’s real-world modernization journey with Azure Red Hat OpenShift.

sessions.t: Plan, migrate, operate Linux estates with Azure and GitHub Copilot
sessions.d: Linux estates rarely consist of a single distribution. See how Azure helps you preserve the Linux choices you have while expanding what your teams can do. Follow a multi-tier logistics workload across RHEL, SUSE, Ubuntu, and Azure Linux as it moves from Hyper-V to Azure, gains capacity, and recovers from an audience-selected failure. Learn how Azure Migrate, Azure Monitor, and GitHub Copilot connect planning, visibility, and operations across the Linux estate.

sessions.t: Delivering AI innovation at scale with Open Source and Azure
sessions.d: The future belongs to organizations with owned AI systems, from the data, workflows, agents, and expertise. In this demo-focused session, learn how Microsoft's open source investments (including Azure Linux, Kubernetes, and GitHub) provide the infrastructure to build and manage self-controlled environments. Leave with practical insights on how Microsoft's open source initiatives accelerate AI innovation.

sessions.t: The evolution of Azure infrastructure for AI models, apps, and agents
sessions.d: Agentic AI is reshaping AI infrastructure. As workloads move from training to production, success depends on a balanced foundation of CPUs, GPUs, storage, networking, and operational intelligence. In this session, learn how Azure IaaS helps optimize the full AI stack, from training and inferencing to autonomous agents, using infrastructure intelligence to recommend, right-size, and continuously optimize resources for better performance, efficiency, and innovation.

sessions.t: Architecting your workloads for maximum compute flexibility
sessions.d: In an era where compute is an increasingly sought after resource, it's more important than ever to ensure your workloads can expand and adapt to grow cost efficiently. Learn how Azure is investing in ways for customers to dynamically and cost-optimally obtain, allocate, and manage appropriate compute resources across workloads. Discover how organizations are architecting and modernizing their IaaS estate to take advantage of the latest compute flexibility and cost-efficiency innovations.

sessions.t: Secure by default. Azure's multilayered embedded security capabilities
sessions.d: The rise of AI and hybrid environments is redefining enterprise security. The new security perimeter is no longer the network. It's the infrastructure stack itself. Explore how Azure IaaS delivers a defense-in-depth approach spanning compute, storage, networking, identity and operations to help organizations protect their most critical workloads. Learn why leading enterprises are taking a system-level approach to security and how Azure helps them stay secure while embracing AI-driven innovation.

sessions.t: Running AI workloads efficiently on Azure general compute
sessions.d: Cloud infrastructure is entering a new era driven by AI, custom silicon, and intelligent automation. Join us for a strategic look at the latest Azure Compute innovations and how they are helping organizations prepare for the future. Learn how Azure is evolving its compute platform to support emerging AI workloads, improve workload efficiency, simplify operations, and provide the scalability required for the next generation of digital transformation.

sessions.t: How Azure Networking is ready for the next generation of AI solutions
sessions.d: AI is fundamentally changing network requirements. Massive data flows, distributed agentic systems, low-latency inference, and globally connected applications are putting new demands on infrastructure. In this session, explore how Azure Networking is evolving to meet these challenges through innovations in performance, security, automation, and intelligent traffic management. Learn what these changes mean for your cloud strategy and how to prepare for the next generation of AI solutions.

sessions.t: AI runs on data. Is your storage architecture ready?
sessions.d: The success of AI depends on more than models and compute. It depends on getting the right data to the right place at the right time. As organizations scale AI and cloud-native applications, storage is becoming a strategic differentiator. Join us to see how Azure Storage is advancing performance, resiliency, security, and intelligent data management, and learn how to prepare your architecture for the next generation of AI-powered applications.

sessions.t: Bring agentic operations to Oracle and SAP on Azure
sessions.d: Oracle and SAP are among the most critical and complex enterprise workloads. Join us to see how new solutions combine workload intelligence and AIOps to help teams proactively monitor health, identify issues, diagnose root causes, and streamline remediation through a unified view of infrastructure, databases, applications, and cloud resources.

sessions.t: Scaling Azure infrastructure: From intelligence into enterprise impact
sessions.d: Scaling Azure infrastructure for AI takes more than adding compute, memory and capacity. It requires maximizing “useful yield”: optimizing how efficiently custom silicon, memory, networking, power, cooling and datacenter design are co-engineered for performance per watt, higher throughput, and lower latency. Join us for an inside look at how Microsoft designs and operates end-to-end to turn AI infrastructure into predictable, efficient, and affordable intelligence for the next frontier.

sessions.t: Learning from disruption: Resilience against force majeure
sessions.d: What happens when the unexpected occurs? Join us to explore real-world incident learnings, the platform investments driving greater resilience, and the established reliability practices and resiliency principles that help customers prepare for, respond to, and recover from force majeure events with confidence.

sessions.t: Building sovereign private cloud for mission-critical environments
sessions.d: Organizations are adopting AI and modernizing critical systems while facing increasing requirements for operational control, resilience, and continuity. Learn how our Sovereign Private Cloud combines Azure Local, Microsoft 365 Local, GitHub Enterprise Local, and sovereign AI capabilities to support mission-critical workloads across connected, hybrid, and disconnected environments. See real architectures, deployment models, and demos that help you maintain control without sacrificing innovation.

sessions.t: Sovereign cloud mythbusters: Separating fact from fiction
sessions.d: Does digital sovereignty require a local cloud provider? Is disconnected always more secure? Does data residency alone address sovereignty requirements? Join Microsoft experts as we separate fact from fiction and examine the real-world tradeoffs behind sovereignty, AI governance, resilience, data protection, and cloud operations. Through practical examples and customer scenarios, you'll gain a framework for evaluating requirements and making informed cloud and AI decisions.

sessions.t: Cobalt 200: Delivering Azure's best performance and efficiency
sessions.d: Compute efficiency has become a first-order design constraint for modern workloads, and gains no longer come from silicon alone. Join us for an inside look on how Cobalt 200 is engineered end-to-end from silicon through systems to deliver exceptional price-performance compute on Azure. Learn more about the Cobalt roadmap, what's new in Cobalt 200 virtual machines (VMs), and hear how Azure customers are translating the performance gains in Cobalt 200 into greater business value.

sessions.t: Inside Azure Maia: Purpose-built for AI inference at scale
sessions.d: Building world-class AI infrastructure requires more than a great chip. Learn how Azure Maia combines custom silicon, systems, networking, and software into a unified platform optimized for AI inference and see how end-to-end co-design translates into better customer outcomes.

sessions.t: Build sovereign AI with Azure Local and Foundry Local
sessions.d: Learn how Foundry Local on Azure Local brings model deployment, evaluation, agents, retrieval, and scalable inference to customer-controlled datacenters, factories, branches, and sovereign environments. See live demonstrations, evaluate model quality without data leaving the environment, and explore patterns for sovereign AI, disconnected operations, multi-GPU inference, and Azure-consistent management.

sessions.t: From models to infrastructure: Confidential AI at Hyperscale on Azure
sessions.d: Learn how Azure Confidential VMs on the next-generation VR72 platform help organizations run frontier-scale AI workloads with hardware-backed protection for models, prompts, data, and infrastructure, enabling trusted AI innovation without compromising performance or scale.

sessions.t: How does the next wave of quantum impact scientific discovery?
sessions.d: Learn how the recent news across our emerging Microsoft Discovery platform and Quantum evolves agentic scientific R&D. Understand how customers are utilizing Discovery to push their scientific development and how it could accelerate your business.

sessions.t: Architecting for end-to-end resiliency on Azure
sessions.d: To modernize on Azure, resilience must be built into the fabric of cloud environments across compute, storage, networking, and apps. Use Azure to move from reactive recovery to proactive resilience by identifying critical dependencies, validating recovery readiness, and architecting for failure. Learn practical approaches and discover the innovations for building resilient apps and infrastructure that can adapt, recover, and operate during disruptions, improving confidence and reducing risk.

sessions.t: Build portable applications with Adaptive Apps
sessions.d: As AI, regulatory, sovereignty, and edge requirements reshape application design, organizations need architectures that operate consistently across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments. Discover Adaptive Apps, Microsoft’s approach for separating application intent from platform implementation using Azure Arc, Radius, and Kubernetes. Learn proven patterns for building portable, governable, and resilient applications that adapt to changing business, compliance, and technology needs.

sessions.t: Build the future of software on Microsoft
sessions.d: The next generation of software is intelligent, agentic, and connected. Companies developing software have a central role in driving Frontier Transformation. Discover how to use the Microsoft platform to build differentiated AI-powered products, bring your offers to market, and turn your innovation into revenue. Explore the technologies, programs, and commercial capabilities that can help you reach more customers and sell at scale through Microsoft Marketplace.

sessions.t: Run secure agent loops in production with isolated sandboxes at scale
sessions.d: Every enterprise is discovering how running agents in production is a platform problem, not a model problem. Agents need secure isolation, identity, governance, observability and cost control before anyone trusts them. This session defines how Azure Container Apps enables you to deliver an agentic platform with production-ready defaults, microVM isolation and governance. Learn how Copilot Studio and Foundry Agent Service leverage this architecture and how you can implement it in your enterprise.

sessions.t: Modernize Windows Server apps with no code rewrite to App Service
sessions.d: Most enterprises still run their revenue critical .NET and Windows Server applications on virtual machines that are expensive to maintain and risky to move. This session shows the fastest path to land those applications on Azure using App Service Managed Instance, and GitHub Copilot App Modernization, with real customer migrations that finished in weeks rather than quarters. Attendees leave with an assessment approach, a landing pattern, and a clear view of what stays and what gets modernized.

sessions.t: No cloud required: Build AI apps with SQL Server on Azure Local
sessions.d: Performance and AI innovation should not come at the expense of compliance and control. See how Microsoft brings SQL and local AI to sovereign, regulated, edge, and disconnected environments. Learn how Azure Local and Microsoft Foundry help keep sensitive data within trusted boundaries, bring AI inferencing closer to operational data, and support data residency, governance, resiliency, and low-latency requirements.

sessions.t: Accelerate your move to PostgreSQL with AI-assisted migration
sessions.d: Migrations stall when risk, downtime, and governance aren't clear from the start. In this session, we share the playbook for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migrations using AI-assisted and built-in tools that simplify assessments, schema and code conversion, and data movement. Best practices plus a live demo will show you how to spot blockers earlier, coordinate migration steps, and build a repeatable path to Postgres on Azure.

sessions.t: AI-powered resiliency for modern workloads with Mark Russinovich
sessions.d: Join Mark Russinovich and Azure resiliency experts to explore how organizations can engineer for failure as they modernize and adopt AI. Learn how customers use Azure to identify critical dependencies, assess resilience gaps, strengthen recovery capabilities, and modernize infrastructure. Attendees will gain practical strategies for building resilient architectures, improving business continuity, and preparing applications and data to better withstand disruption.

sessions.t: AI-powered resiliency for modern workloads with Mark Russinovich (Overflow Viewing)
sessions.d:
Overflow Viewing: This session will be livestreamed from its primary breakout room to a separate overflow viewing location. Speakers will not be presenting in-person in this room.

Join Mark Russinovich and Azure resiliency experts to explore how organizations can engineer for failure as they modernize and adopt AI. Learn how customers use Azure to identify critical dependencies, assess resilience gaps, strengthen recovery capabilities, and modernize infrastructure. Attendees will gain practical strategies for building resilient architectures, improving business continuity, and preparing applications and data to better withstand disruption.

sessions.t: What's new and what's next in Azure Storage
sessions.d: AI, cloud-native applications, and business-critical workloads are changing how organizations think about storage. In this session, get up to speed on the latest Azure Storage innovations across object, file, block, and data movement solutions. Learn how new capabilities are helping organizations improve performance, strengthen resiliency, simplify operations, optimize costs, and build AI-ready data foundations.

sessions.t: What's new and what's next in Azure Storage (Overflow Viewing)
sessions.d:
Overflow Viewing: This session will be livestreamed from its primary breakout room to a separate overflow viewing location. Speakers will not be presenting in-person in this room.

AI, cloud-native applications, and business-critical workloads are changing how organizations think about storage. In this session, get up to speed on the latest Azure Storage innovations across object, file, block, and data movement solutions. Learn how new capabilities are helping organizations improve performance, strengthen resiliency, simplify operations, optimize costs, and build AI-ready data foundations.

sessions.t: From discovery to award: transforming grant management with AI agents
sessions.d: Securing grant funding is critical to nonprofit impact, yet the process remains time-intensive for many organizations. In this session, we'll demonstrate how Microsoft Copilot and AI agents can transform the grant lifecycle by identifying funding opportunities, evaluating eligibility, assessing readiness, and accelerating proposal development. Through a live demo attendees will see how agent teams reduce administrative burden, improve proposal quality, and help nonprofits secure funding faster.

sessions.t: Reimagine telecom with agentic AI
sessions.d: Microsoft operates one of the world's largest networks, with demand expected to grow 10x in four years. Learn how we moved from human-driven operations to agentic workflows that autonomously detect issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate remediation. See the three agents behind the solution and how they helped reduce time to repair by 25%.

sessions.t: Beyond the AI pilot: How leading operators scale
sessions.d: Only 29% of operators are ready to scale AI on their own data. Learn how leading telecom providers moved from AI pilots to production by automating operations and customer interactions with agentic AI. Explore the connected data foundation, governance model, and practical roadmap needed to scale AI securely and deliver measurable business impact.

sessions.t: Every asset, every signal: How AI is transforming asset performance
sessions.d: Downtime is the most expensive word in energy. Hear how BHP, Chevron, and Constellation are using AI to improve reliability, availability, and output from the assets they already own. From robotic inspection at remote facilities to AI-driven maintenance planning and machine learning that optimizes hydro generation, learn the data and OT foundations behind these solutions, the results delivered, and how agentic AI is enabling continuous asset optimization.

sessions.t: Beyond the pilot: How governments are scaling AI with confidence
sessions.d: Governments have the ambition for AI. Scaling it is harder. Learn how agencies can move from pilot to production by building on proven AI use cases grounded in their data and designed with trust. Then hear directly from Mikko Laakso, Head of Technology and Platforms product group, Product Management Unit at the Finnish Tax Administration, on what that looks like in practice. Leave ready to follow the path others have marked and make it your own.

sessions.t: Reimagining clinical workflows: A Brown University Health story
sessions.d: Brown University Health is moving from AI-assisted documentation to agentic workflows across clinical and operational settings. Learn how Dragon Copilot helps clinicians reduce documentation burden and stay focused on patients, while AI agents built with Copilot Studio surface hospital guidance, connect care teams with specialists, and streamline operations. Hear practical lessons for embedding trusted AI into existing workflows and scaling innovation across a health system.

sessions.t: From data silos to healthcare intelligence with Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: See how healthcare organizations can turn siloed data into trusted insights and AI-powered action with Microsoft Fabric. Drawing on lessons from Peterborough Regional Health Centre and live demonstrations, experts will unify EHR, operational, and multimodal data with OneLake, Spark, semantic models, and real-time intelligence. Learn how to build analytics that power copilots and agents—and take home proven architectures for scaling healthcare AI.

sessions.t: Putting AI to work for nurses with Dragon Copilot

sessions.t: Your Most Valuable AI Asset Isn't a Model
sessions.d: Organizations are discovering that their most valuable AI asset is not a model, but their own institutional knowledge, expertise, and operating context. Learn how leading organizations are becoming Frontier Firms by putting their unique intelligence to work with AI and building an advantage that can compound over time.

sessions.t: How to Transform with AI While Keeping Your Business Running
sessions.d: AI creates enormous opportunities to reinvent how businesses operate, but organizations can't put critical operations on hold while they transform. Drawing on Microsoft's Customer Zero experience, this session explores how to modernize complex environments, introduce AI into critical workflows, and balance innovation with the reliability businesses depend on. Learn practical approaches to advancing AI transformation while continuing to deliver for customers and the business.

sessions.t: Guardrails That Accelerate: Matching AI Ambition to Risk Appetite
sessions.d: Leaders should not have to choose between AI innovation and enterprise risk management. This session explores an approach for aligning AI initiatives with organizational risk appetite and identifying governance and security capabilities that can support adoption. Learn how leaders can establish clear guardrails that accelerate adoption, strengthen trust, and give teams the confidence to innovate at scale.

sessions.t: From AI Ambition to Value at Scale
sessions.d: As AI moves from experimentation into everyday business operations, growing usage alone does not tell leaders whether an investment is working. Learn how organizations can connect AI consumption to measurable business value, establish the visibility and accountability needed to manage it, and determine whether the economics continue to hold as adoption grows. Leave with a practical approach for deciding where AI has earned the right to scale, where to adjust, and where continued investment may not be justified.

sessions.t: The AI Accessibility Flywheel: Ask, Act, Automate
sessions.d: What if work could move as fast as ideas? This session explores using Copilot to ask sharper questions, turn insight into action, and deploy tasks and agents that enable people with disabilities (and everyone) to work more efficiently. Learn how each step builds on the last—and how AI empowers frictionless work for all.

sessions.t: Japan Wrap-up Session
sessions.d: 本セッションでは、Microsoft Ignite で発表された主要なアナウンスと技術的インサイトを、日本からご参加の皆様に向けて日本語で凝縮して解説します。マイクロソフトのロードマップが、アーキテクチャ、セキュリティ、運用、データ、開発ワークフロー、そしてビジネス戦略に何をもたらすのか。本セッションにご参加いただくことで、すぐに実践に活かせる知見と、「何が変わり、なぜ重要で、自組織として次に何を検討すべきか」という社内共有に使える明確なストーリーを、あわせてお持ち帰りいただけます。 A focused recap of key Microsoft Ignite announcements and technical insights, delivered in Japanese.

sessions.t: Inside Azure with Mark Russinovich
sessions.d: Join Mark Russinovich, CTO and Technical Fellow for Microsoft Azure, for a fast-paced tour inside Azure’s latest breakthroughs. See how advances in AI infrastructure, networking, storage, confidential computing, and more are coming together to power intelligent applications and help organizations innovate at global scale.

sessions.t: Inside Azure with Mark Russinovich (Overflow Viewing)
sessions.d:
Overflow Viewing: This session will be livestreamed from its primary breakout room to a separate overflow viewing location. Speakers will not be presenting in-person in this room.

Join Mark Russinovich, CTO and Technical Fellow for Microsoft Azure, for a fast-paced tour inside Azure’s latest breakthroughs. See how advances in AI infrastructure, networking, storage, confidential computing, and more are coming together to power intelligent applications and help organizations innovate at global scale.

sessions.t: Scott and Mark learn to... live again
sessions.d: AI is changing not just how fast software gets built, but where intelligence runs and how much control developers retain. Mark and Scott explore frontier models, private local inference, agentic coding, and the limits of autonomous system. Through candid debate and live demos, they examine what AI can build today, where it still fails, and how developers can stay in control of what comes next.

sessions.t: From Market Signals to Trusted Intelligence: LSEG's AI Architecture
sessions.d: Go deep on how LSEG can turn your financial data into trusted, finance-native intelligence. The session should unpack the data foundation, semantic/ontology layer, permission-aware retrieval, grounding, citations, and workflow integration required to move from a finance-native question to an answer professionals can trust and act on.

sessions.t: AI-Powered Factories at Scale: Lessons from Rockwell Automation
sessions.d: What does industrial AI look like when it's deployed at scale in a real manufacturing environment? Join Rockwell Automation to learn the architecture, technology, and organizational choices behind its AI-powered transformation across its global manufacturing network, including a WEF Lighthouse location. Explore how edge-to-cloud data flows, analytics, digital twins, and AI work together to deliver business value.

sessions.t: Agent Orchestration at Scale: How Replit Builds and Deploys on Azure
sessions.d: A deep dive into Replit's architecture that allows anyone in your organization to become a builder. This session covers agent design, sandboxing, enterprise data security and governance of the Replit platform along with how Replit hosts and secures millions of vibecoded apps for enterprises and millions of users. The session will also cover how Replit 3x'd per-engineer output while keeping incidents flat, with security and safety in mind.

sessions.t: From Cloud to AI: Zurich’s Resilient Enterprise Blueprint
sessions.d: What does it take to build an enterprise ready for AI at scale? Go inside Zurich’s approach to connecting cloud modernization, modern workplace, Copilot and agentic solutions across the technology stack. Learn how Zurich is advancing resilience, modernization and AI adoption together to automate complex processes and build a secure, adaptable foundation for what’s next.

sessions.t: Lost in San Francisco: Build AI agents that find their way
sessions.d: Move beyond the AI prototype. Learn how Microsoft Foundry, GitHub Copilot, VS Code, Microsoft Agent Framework, and MCP form a connected developer loop for building grounded, observable AI agents, then put those skills to work in Open Hack.

sessions.t: Putting the I in AI; a chat with Kelsey Hightower & Scott Hanselman
sessions.d: We're living in a world where anyone can build anything, at least that's what they say. How much of this is artificial, and where does human intelligence fit in? Join legendary programmer Kelsey Hightower in this fireside chat, moderated by Scott Hanselman.

sessions.t: Navigating the AI revolution
sessions.d: My entire career has been about maximizing the leverage, salaries, and careers of developers and IT Pros. This is not another incremental tech cycle—the physics of our industry are fundamentally shifting. This AI revolution will aggressively accelerate the careers of those who adapt and cause an extinction event for those who cling to the past. Let's cut through the fluff and get comfortable being uncomfortable, because the only way forward is engineering through the chaos.

sessions.t: Enabling Partners to Position the Copilot Advantage
sessions.d: As AI options multiply, customers increasingly evaluate solutions feature by feature, a comparison that shifts every few weeks. This session equips partners to elevate the conversation from objection to objective, dealing with what customer really want to achieve: uncovering the customer's business outcome, through practical examples of Copilot and Cowork differentiators, and demonstrating enduring platform value. Partners will leave with practical guidance based on real customer conversations to handle a confident discussions equipped with objection-handling frameworks.

sessions.t: Hybrid Intelligence: Making It Real with Windows PCs
sessions.d: Discover how hybrid intelligence puts each AI workload in the right place across local, shared and cloud compute. See how Windows AI PCs and on-premises inference complement the cloud, watch live demos of AI-assisted development and productivity scenarios, and explore real-world customer examples. Leave ready to assess workloads, size device capacity, build the investment case, and prototype your own agent.

sessions.t: Developer's guide to Copilot Studio - Why and How
sessions.d: You know how to build an agent in code. So what does Copilot Studio add? In this session, we’ll show how developers can bring familiar pro-code practices like GitHub repo-backed development and agentic editing to Copilot Studio's connectors, monitoring and no-code experience. Build what your org needs locally in Visual Studio or even a terminal, then hand off to business owners to maintain and manage in Copilot Studio. Come see how Copilot Studio can complement the way you already build!

sessions.t: Beyond the Pilot: Turning Copilot & Agents into Business Value
sessions.d: AI pilots are everywhere. Sustainable business impact is harder. This session explores how organizations have moved beyond experimentation and are creating real enterprise value. Srini Raghavan moderates this panel discussion on prioritizing the right scenarios, aligning stakeholders, and measuring business impact.

sessions.t: Model to mission: Azure Infra for agentic enterprise
sessions.d: AI innovation goes beyond models and GPUs. Enterprise value comes from the complete cloud system connecting compute, data, networking, storage, security, orchestration, and applications. This session follows an AI request across Azure to show how an open, connected infrastructure helps organizations build with Microsoft or their technology of choice and operate at enterprise scale.

sessions.t: The evolution of Pages: Your dynamic surface for AI work
sessions.d: See the next evolution of Pages in action. Learn how Pages turns an idea into a dynamic surface that you, your team, and Copilot can iterate and collaborate on together. Microsoft experts will demonstrate how Pages brings together human and AI collaboration, interactive content, and agentic activity in a new type of file that evolves with your work.

sessions.t: Scale AI Adoption Without Scaling Your Services Budget
sessions.d: How can business and IT leaders increase AI usage without another major services engagement? Discover how Microsoft Adoption resources and Digital Accelerator’s expert-led journeys can help answer three critical questions: Which AI experience fits the work? How do we turn access into active usage? How do we scale what works? Leave knowing the question to solve, the resource to use now, and the Digital Accelerator journey that can help you put it into practice without additional services spend.

sessions.t: Build the managed intelligence stack for SMBs with Pax8 and Microsoft
sessions.d: SMBs are eager to adopt AI, but many lack the security, governance, and expertise to do it safely. See how partners can turn Microsoft's SMB offers into a managed intelligence stack, helping customers adopt AI more securely while building profitable services. Leaders at Pax8 will show how to leverage SMB-focused security bundles, partner-led service opportunities, and scalable partner programs to create a repeatable AI adoption motion for SMB customers.

sessions.t: Give every agent a boss and build a scalable AI services practice
sessions.d: AI pilots are easy. Running agents at scale is where partners create lasting value. Learn how to govern, monitor, and optimize AI agents across customer environments, turning agent operations into recurring, outcome-based engagements. See how to build the operational layer, scale it across customers, and create a sustainable AI services practice with Ingram Micro.

sessions.t: Move from complexity to opportunity with ArrowSphere and AI Agents
sessions.d: Selling Microsoft solutions brings opportunity and complexity. Discover how ArrowSphere and AI agents can simplify the sales journey, helping you identify opportunities, access the right insights, and accelerate customer conversations. See how distribution can evolve beyond transactions into an intelligent sales engine that reduces complexity, improves seller productivity, and helps turn Microsoft opportunities into revenue.

sessions.t: Scale your AI practice from AI curiosity to frontier transformation
sessions.d: AI demand is rising across the SMB market, but many customers remain stuck in pilot mode. Learn how Microsoft partners can build an AI practice that delivers repeatable services, measurable outcomes, and sustainable growth. Discover how TD SYNNEX has helped partners uncover high-impact opportunities, accelerate adoption, and create scalable offerings through enablement, hands-on experiences, and adoption services. Leave with a practical framework to turn AI interest into business value.

sessions.t: Own your intelligence with Fireworks on Foundry
sessions.d: Generalized model gains are flattening because the data that would improve a model on your domain sits inside your company. Discover how customers use Fireworks to customize open models and create differentiated AI experiences at lower cost. For architects and technical leaders weighing open models: Explore which workloads to consider, the training needed, and how shifting 2% of weights can propel an application past its category. Hear from PayPal on their experience with Fireworks on Foundry.

sessions.t: Get an AI advantage when the Microsoft ecosystem works together
sessions.d: Organizations often evaluate productivity tools, developer platforms, devices, and security solutions separately, but greater business impact happens when they work together. Join Insight experts Parker Johnston and Will Pocknell to explore how leading organizations are connecting investments across the Microsoft ecosystem to accelerate AI adoption, strengthen security, and improve workforce productivity. Leave with practical strategies for turning isolated AI initiatives into scalable business

sessions.t: Optimize data, security, and AI with AMD on Azure
sessions.d: Every infrastructure decision carries tradeoffs between performance, efficiency, scalability, and cost. In this session, discover how Microsoft leverages AMD technology across Azure to support critical database platforms, confidential computing capabilities, and emerging AI workloads. Walk away with practical insights on optimizing your cloud infrastructure today and an understanding of the technologies shaping what's next on Azure.

sessions.t: Turn a capable open model into a domain expert in your business
sessions.d: How do you turn a capable open model into an expert for your business? Join Microsoft, NVIDIA, and EY to explore NVIDIA's Nemotron open model strategy and new Microsoft Foundry training services, and see how EY used Programmed Training in Microsoft Foundry to post-train NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra with enterprise data for spend classification. Walk through the business challenge, custom reward design, and reinforcement learning loop behind the results.

sessions.t: The end of IT as we know it?
sessions.d: See an AI technician resolve incidents end to end by taking real actions across Windows endpoints and servers, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, mainframes, and networks. Watch Robin by Atera demonstrate autonomous incident resolution and explore what 92% autonomous resolution and sub-two-minute fixes can mean for SLAs, IT capacity, and employee productivity.

sessions.t: Avoid common pitfalls in Azure landing zone deployment
sessions.d: Every Azure landing zone looks great on paper, until reality hits. Drawing on lessons from enterprise deployments, we help unpack five common pitfalls: governance that slows innovation, identity and network decisions that don’t age well, policy sprawl, overlooked operating models, and foundations not ready for AI. Hear candid stories, hard-won fixes, and practical guidance you can apply to build an Azure foundation that scales with the business.

sessions.t: Scale industrial physical AI with Hitachi and Microsoft
sessions.d: Hitachi and Microsoft are scaling physical AI across industries by combining industrial expertise, real-time asset data, operational technology, and advanced AI. Built on a robust digital foundation, the collaboration improves manufacturing productivity, product quality, predictive maintenance, asset reliability, and supply chain performance. Hitachi serves as Customer Zero, validating solutions internally before scaling them globally with Microsoft's technology and go-to-market capabilities.

sessions.t: Turn shadow agents into governed digital coworkers
sessions.d: Agents are everywhere, from Copilot Studio to custom Python apps, often without IT visibility. In this live demo, see how organizations transform unmanaged agents into governed digital coworkers using Entra Agent IDs, Conditional Access, lifecycle workflows, access packages, and Purview policies. Then watch an external Python agent come under the same control plane using the Agent 365 SDK. Leave with practical strategies to govern, secure, and manage every agent in your tenant.

sessions.t: Move from AI pilots to enterprise impact in insurance
sessions.d: How can insurers move AI from limited proofs of concept to enterprise-wide value in a highly regulated industry? NTT DATA will be joined by senior leaders from two global insurers to discuss scaling AI use cases, building effective guardrails, and developing AI fluency across the workforce. Hear how insurers are reimagining underwriting, claims handling and fraud detection, turning AI investment into lasting business outcomes.

sessions.t: When growth outpaces data, AI closes the gap
sessions.d: Highstreet Insurance Partners grew through a deliberate, well-capitalized acquisition strategy, and every new agency brought its own data. Rather than fix that later, Highstreet used it as an opportunity to consolidate its data and build Ora, an innovative AI platform driving business outcomes. Ora maps become part of carrier negotiations, and producers open Ora to prepare for clients ready for renewal conversations. Learn how to use consolidation and AI to create value from every acquisitition.

sessions.t: Meet your sovereign cloud goals with Dell and Azure Local
sessions.d: Build a hybrid Azure environment with consistent operations, automation, and control over your data using Dell Private Cloud with Azure Local. Through demos and a customer story, see how automated deployment and remediation across connected and disconnected environments can simplify operations and support sovereign requirements, with services that help accelerate adoption.

sessions.t: Sovereign by design with smarter AI on Azure Local
sessions.d: How do you move AI from pilot to production while keeping control of your data, models, and infrastructure? See how Lenovo and Microsoft bring Smarter AI to Azure Local, from right-sized deployments to sovereign AI factories. Learn how to choose the right infrastructure, protect sensitive AI with confidential computing, operate connected or disconnected, and scale with confidence. Leave with a practical path from assessment to pilot, production, and scale.

sessions.t: Frontier intelligence you can trust: Claude in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: Your teams want the most capable models. Your leaders want controls they can stand behind. Here's how to get both with Claude in Microsoft Foundry. See how Anthropic and Microsoft bring the Claude model family to the Azure identity, governance, and billing you already run, and why staying at the frontier keeps paying off. Then learn what it takes to trust agents with sensitive work: how your data is handled, and how Anthropic's safeguards work with Foundry controls.

sessions.t: Witness AI interoperability in action with SAP and Microsoft
sessions.d: No enterprise runs on one system, and neither should your AI. Learn how SAP and Microsoft deliver AI interoperability across business processes, data, and workflows. Explore Autonomous Domains, Joule Agents and Joule Assistants, Joule Work, and the bidirectional integration between Joule and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Walk away with a better understanding of how connected AI experiences can work across enterprise systems.

sessions.t: Beyond the license: How Accenture used Copilot to turn AI into value
sessions.d: Scaling AI is one challenge. Realizing value from it across the enterprise is another. Join Accenture and Avanade for a candid discussion on scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 740,000 employees globally. Hear Anthony Leraris, Accenture CIO, and Ben Beath, Chief AI Officer, Avanade, share critical lessons on governance, adoption, and value realization, and learn how leading organizations can move beyond productivity gains to achieve frontier transformation.

sessions.t: Transform operations across industries with physical AI in action
sessions.d: Physical AI is transforming how products are made, goods are moved, infrastructure is maintained, and critical operations are performed. Join Capgemini and industry leaders to explore how organizations are navigating this next phase of transformation. Gain practical perspectives of where momentum is building, how Physical AI is being put into practice, and how intelligent systems, physical operations, autonomous workflows, and human expertise are beginning to reshape enterprise operations.

sessions.t: Go inside SEI's journey to a governed agentic platform
sessions.d: Many organizations struggle to move beyond isolated AI pilots to enterprise-scale adoption. This session explores how SEI built a governed AI operating model connecting strategy, governance, architecture, and delivery through Project Imagine, an intelligent platform for designing, running, and governing your digital workforce. Learn how use cases were prioritized, moved into production, and measured against business outcomes, creating a repeatable framework for scaling AI organization wide.

sessions.t: Driving AI-led business reimagination at McDermott with Microsoft
sessions.d: As McDermott accelerates its digital transformation journey, AI is becoming a strategic catalyst for reimagining business processes, engineering excellence, workforce productivity, and operational decision-making. Learn from McDermott and TCS how a hybrid AI strategy across Microsoft Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem, and NVIDIA accelerated computing is helping build and scale intelligent solutions. Explore real-world use cases and the business outcomes they are delivering.

sessions.t: The end of token-maxxing? Scale AI with less spend
sessions.d: Enterprise token consumption has exploded, leaving engineering teams balancing AI innovation against rising costs. Learn how intelligent model routing for software development can help you do both. Discover how task- and cache-aware routing directs requests to the right open and closed models to maintain code quality while reducing token spend. See real coding workloads in action through a customer example and live demo of Fireworks Nexus.

sessions.t: Assume the breach: Build readiness for the modern threat era
sessions.d: Cyber resilience starts long before an incident occurs. Join Jeremy Nelson, CISO at Insight, to explore how leading organizations are shifting from a response-first mindset to a readiness-first strategy. Learn how greater visibility across assets, identities, and software, risk-based patching, managed SOC services, and well-defined response plans can help your organization reduce risk, accelerate recovery, and create the resilience needed to thrive in today's evolving threat landscape.

sessions.t: AMD Instinct on Azure: More models. More agents. More choice.
sessions.d: AI builders need choice, from simple open-model deployment to greater control for inference and training. Learn how Microsoft Foundry Managed Compute and Azure ND MI300X v5 VMs provide access to AMD Instinct GPUs and how ROCm improves performance and token economics. See how the new Azure ND MI455X v7 VM, powered by the AMD Helios rackscale solution, can help teams run more models, serve more users, and scale agentic AI efficiently.

sessions.t: Industries reimagined with physical AI
sessions.d: Join industry leaders and experts from Microsoft and NVIDIA to explore how physical AI and frontier AI models are changing the way organizations design, simulate, and optimize autonomous factories and robotic systems. Hear industry perspectives on where these approaches are taking shape and what they could mean for the next generation of operations.

sessions.t: How Autonomous IT changes the way we work
sessions.d: Employees lose time daily to IT friction. For years, the answer was more efficient ticketing: detect, flag, suggest, and route faster. But what happens when AI agents eliminate the ticket altogether? See how AI agents autonomously resolve incidents end to end within the tools your team already uses, giving employees their time back; and what that shift means for IT teams when issues no longer require a technician in the loop.

sessions.t: Scale agentic AI and turn data into autonomous action
sessions.d: Many organizations have AI pilots. Few have AI that can operate reliably in production. Success depends not on the model, but on trusted, governed data. Learn how Azure OpenAI, Azure Databricks, and modern lakehouse architectures help organizations build agentic AI at scale. Through real-world examples in life sciences, insurance, and telecommunications, discover how leading organizations are reducing complexity, improving decisions, and creating AI-ready foundations for autonomous action.

sessions.t: The manufacturing tech stack for the physical AI era
sessions.d: The next chapter of manufacturing moves from connected factories to intelligent, adaptive operations. We’ll explore the business imperatives driving Smart Manufacturing, the possibilities of Physical AI, and the technology stack to make them real. We’ll connect the dots across PLM, MOM/MES, industrial data, edge and cloud, digital twins, AI agents, robotics and automation, showing how these layers transform how products are engineered, manufactured, operated, and continuously improved.

sessions.t: Build AI-powered Microsoft Fabric workflows with GitHub Copilot
sessions.d: AI coding assistants are changing how Microsoft Fabric professionals build solutions. This practical session is designed for experienced developers who are new to AI-assisted development. Learn how data engineers and BI developers use GitHub Copilot to accelerate coding, automate testing, and reduce repetitive work. You'll leave with a clear understanding of where AI adds value, how to get started, and the confidence to build AI-powered workflows in Fabric.

sessions.t: Scale AI without slowing innovation: From experiment to enterprise
sessions.d: How can organizations scale AI agents without slowing innovation? Explore Gilead Sciences’ experience with GENIE (Gilead Enterprise Navigation and Information Engine), built on a low-code Microsoft foundation. As interest grew, challenges included duplication, ownership, investment, risk and trust. Learn how centralized intake and early governance can improve decisions, while a reusable foundation and distributed ownership help move pilots toward enterprise capability with people accountable.

sessions.t: One assistant, every system: A governed AI front door for healthcare
sessions.d: AI is everywhere, but work remains fragmented. Explore how Copilot can become one governed front door across enterprise systems with Microsoft and Cognizant. Through a healthcare scenario and live demo, Srinivasan Venkatarajan and Manpreet Singh show how architecture, governance, and human oversight can connect disconnected AI experiences into production-scale workflows.

sessions.t: Build the agentic workplace with Dell and Microsoft
sessions.d: AI agents are changing how work gets done, and the PC is where it happens. As Copilot evolves from assistant to agent, the connection between device and cloud becomes a foundation for enterprise AI. See how Dell Technologies and Microsoft bring together PCs, Windows, Copilot agents, Scout, supercomputers, and infrastructure to support secure agentic workplaces, with a practical path to deploy and scale these experiences across your organization.

sessions.t: Secure the enterprise with cyber resiliency in the AI era
sessions.d: In the AI era, cyber resiliency is no longer just about prevention. Discover how Lenovo Security Services, powered by Microsoft Security technologies, helps organizations build a resilient security posture through continuous monitoring, threat detection and response, identity protection, vulnerability management, and proactive risk reduction. Walk away with a practical framework to secure the modern enterprise while enabling innovation, productivity, and trust at scale.

sessions.t: Claude Keeps Building: How coding agents in Foundry change software development
sessions.d: Coding agents make sustained, autonomous progress on real software. The question is what happens to the rest of the software development lifecycle. Claude Code runs for hours unattended, works beyond the terminal, and takes on more of the work around the code. We'll show how engineering changes when the whole lifecycle becomes automatable: what engineers do, how review and testing evolve, where quality comes from when code is cheap. Live demos with hosted agents in Microsoft Foundry.

sessions.t: Build and govern context-aware AI agents with SAP and Microsoft
sessions.d: Building agents is now a commodity. Building agents that understand how your business runs is the next level. This session covers the full lifecycle: the right tooling, semantically rich data so AI can reason accurately, and governance to keep agents observable and accountable across SAP and Microsoft. Leave with a practical understanding of the architecture connecting both platforms so your agents work as intended and scale with confidence.

sessions.t: You can't defend an AI-powered enterprise with yesterday's SOC
sessions.d: AI is expanding the attack surface. Agents, autonomous workflows and human-AI collaboration are creating risks traditional SOC models were never designed to address. Join Accenture and Avanade to explore how security leaders are evolving from reactive operations to adaptive defense using AI to defend AI. Learn how Accenture Adaptive MxDR and Microsoft Security technologies help organizations secure agents, govern non-human identities and build trust in the agentic enterprise.

sessions.t: Turn AI ambition into measurable outcomes in financial services
sessions.d: Leading financial institutions are turning AI ambition into measurable business outcomes. Through real-world examples and live demos, discover how banks and insurers are using AI to transform compliance and risk, improve customer and employee experiences, enhance decision-making, and increase operational efficiency. Hear lessons learned from organizations at the forefront of AI adoption and walk away with practical insights for scaling AI in highly regulated environments.

sessions.t: Scale AI for enterprise value with lessons from Chevron
sessions.d: Chevron and IBM share how a large enterprise is scaling AI to drive measurable business value. Learn how Chevron applied IBM's Client Zero approach, powered by Microsoft, to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and accelerate transformation. Through real-world examples and lessons learned, discover what it takes to move AI from isolated initiatives to scalable enterprise outcomes.

sessions.t: Reimagine cloud and AI platforms for the Frontier Enterprise
sessions.d: Customers are accelerating their journey to become Frontier Enterprises by modernizing cloud and AI platforms. This customer panel will share how they are modernizing cloud infrastructure, applications, and data to enable AI adoption at scale. Hear how investments in agent marketplaces and context intelligence are helping agents operate with greater accuracy and efficiency. The discussion will also explore agent governance and AI observability approaches to trust, security, and FinOps.

sessions.t: Power accelerated computing on Azure with NVIDIA
sessions.d: Discover how the NVIDIA full-stack accelerated computing platform on Microsoft Azure can transform demanding AI, data science, and simulation workloads. Learn how the powerful combination of Azure cloud infrastructure and NVIDIA GPUs, software, and services can improve performance, scale efficiently, and accelerate the journey from experimentation to production through practical approaches and use cases.

sessions.t: Scale agentic AI: Transforming enterprise operations at Celanese
sessions.d: Manufacturers are using AI to rethink operations, supply chains, engineering, workforce productivity, and customer value. In this 45-minute breakout, NTT DATA will be joined by Celanese to share real-world perspectives on moving AI from experimentation to enterprise-scale impact. Hear how these industry leaders are applying AI, data, cloud, automation, and intelligent agents to address complex business challenges, improve decision-making, and unlock new opportunities

sessions.t: Rogue agents? Not on my watch
sessions.d: AI success starts with trusted data. Join Cisco, Splunk, and Microsoft to see how One Cisco, Splunk's AI-powered data platform, and Microsoft Azure help organizations build a foundation for Trusted AI and agentic AI. See how leading enterprises unify security, observability, infrastructure, and operational telemetry to strengthen resilience, accelerate AI transformation, and turn operational intelligence into business value at enterprise scale.

sessions.t: Security for systems that won’t obey
sessions.d: Agent identity: verified. Token: scoped. Gateway: approved. Tool calls: allowed. Policies violated: zero. Production: gone. Two questions expose why your architecture failed to notice. Most teams aren't asking them. After this talk, you will.

sessions.t: Orchestrate the intelligence layer for an autonomous supply chain
sessions.d: Join Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Blue Yonder to see how organizations can build greater control and flexibility into their AI architecture. Learn how Blue Yonder pairs frontier models on Azure with NVIDIA Nemotron open-source models tailored to its workflows, creating a hybrid approach designed to deliver fast, precise warehouse decisions while optimizing cost and performance.

sessions.t: From model selection to agent optimization: The intelligent enterprise
sessions.d: Hosted by Microsoft and NVIDIA, this executive brunch explores how enterprise AI is evolving from single-model strategies to integrated systems of frontier, open, specialized, and domain-specific models. Leaders will discuss model routing, agent orchestration, and inference optimization, along with approaches to balancing performance, cost, governance, and control to turn greater AI choice into competitive advantage.

sessions.t: The people impact of cyber conflict: Midnight in the War Room
sessions.d: Cyber war is more than systems, threats, and defenses—it has a human cost. This session features highlights from Midnight in the War Room, a documentary about the people behind cyber conflict. Hear from experts across government, intelligence, healthcare, critical infrastructure, and business, alongside reformed hackers who explain how attackers think. An open discussion invites questions and practical insight into how organizations can prepare—and what’s at stake.

sessions.t: Expanding what’s possible: How AI is redesigning work
sessions.d:
AI is changing how people work and how organizations build new business capabilities. Join Jacob Andreou, Executive Vice President, Copilot, to explore how Copilot brings asking, delegating, building, and scaling together, and how Windows extends that experience across the PC. Learn how Teams connects people, agents, and business processes across functions, and how new FinOps capabilities help organizations manage and scale Copilot with confidence. See what becomes possible when AI is built into the flow of work, from the individual to the organization.

Seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to arrive early to secure a seat before the session begins.

sessions.t: Harnessing Your IQ with a continuously improving agent platform
sessions.d:
Join Arun Ulag and Jay Parikh to discover how Microsoft IQ helps your organization activate, protect, and build on the knowledge that makes it unique. Learn how to keep improving as models evolve, with model choice and control intact. Explore how your data and expertise become AI that understands your business, so work runs faster, more accurately, and at lower cost.

Seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to arrive early to secure a seat before the session begins.

sessions.t: Observability at every layer for every role
sessions.d:
As AI and agents scale, visibility, trust, and security become business imperatives. Join Charles Lamanna, Executive Vice President, Copilot, Agents, and Platform, and Hayete Gallot, Executive Vice President, Microsoft Security, to explore how observability at every layer of the stack helps organizations understand where AI is being used, how agents are operating, what risks are emerging, and whether investments are delivering results. See how organizations can turn visibility into action to scale AI with confidence.

Seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to arrive early to secure a seat before the session begins.

sessions.t: AI infrastructure from cloud to edge
sessions.d: As AI workloads and agents scale in production, infrastructure is more critical than ever. Hear real examples of how organizations are operating AI at scale and join leaders, Mark Russinovich and Pavan Davuluri to discuss why Azure is the foundation for mission-critical AI systems. Together, Azure and Windows provide the core platform for running intelligence where it delivers the most value, from cloud and datacenter environments to the edge and over a billion Windows devices.

sessions.t: Build a Knowledge-Powered Workspace with Copilot in SharePoint
sessions.d:
Learn how to transform content into organizational knowledge and put AI to work across your team. You'll use Copilot in SharePoint to organize information, enrich content with metadata, create pages and reports, build reusable skills, and automate common processes. Along the way, you'll see how better-organized knowledge helps strengthen Copilot experiences across Microsoft 365. Leave with practical techniques you can apply immediately to build a modern, AI-powered knowledge workspace.

sessions.t: Delegate complex work: Hands-on with Copilot Cowork
sessions.d:
Agent usage is up 15× year over year, and more multi-step workflows can now be delegated end to end. In this hands-on session, build a real workflow with Copilot Cowork: turn a complex process into a skill, extend it with plugins and automations, and see how Cowork plans, executes, and delivers work across systems and apps. Leave with a publishable skill and a practical model for deciding what to delegate, how to scope it, and how to move work from intent to done.

sessions.t: Continuous improvement for agents: From open source to Foundry
sessions.d:
Take a working agent that misses its target and apply continuous improvement: a repeatable process for making one measured change at a time. Use open-source ASSERT to generate evaluations and test data from requirements, create scoring criteria with rubrics, and implement controls with Agent Control Specification (ACS). Then run live with Microsoft Foundry models, the first step toward production, and use GitHub Copilot with the run-assert-eval skill to automate the improvement loop.
