sessions.t: Compliant Web Search: Compliant web grounding for Microsoft Copilot
sessions.d: Organizations in regulated industries often face a tradeoff between AI innovation and compliance requirements. Discover how Compliant web search enables Microsoft Copilot to safely access and ground responses in web content while supporting security, privacy, compliance, and sovereignty needs. Learn how CWS helps organizations unlock web-connected AI experiences with the controls and confidence required for highly regulated environments.

sessions.t: Show, Don't Tell: Helping Teams Discover the Value of Copilot
sessions.d: The fastest path to Copilot adoption is helping employees see how it improves the work they do every day. In this session, we'll share practical activities that make AI tangible for teams. You'll leave with actions you can take to spark engagement and build momentum.

sessions.t: Copilot Champions in Action
sessions.d:
In this lightning talk, we'll showcase real customer stories and practical adoption tactics from Champions who successfully introduced, launched, and scaled Copilot within their organizations.
From training activities and activation campaigns to community building and ongoing engagement, you'll discover the strategies Champions use to create momentum and sustain adoption.

sessions.t: Preparing for usage-based billing
sessions.d: Learn practical approaches to visibility, governance, forecasting, optimization, and flexible purchasing that help organizations accelerate AI adoption while keeping investments aligned to business outcomes.

sessions.t: Your Work, Anywhere: The New OneDrive Experience Across Web and Mobile
sessions.d: Work happens everywhere, and OneDrive is evolving to help you stay productive wherever you are. Explore the latest OneDrive experiences across web and mobile, designed to help you quickly find, organize, and act on content from any device. See new innovations, real-world productivity scenarios, and how OneDrive helps you stay connected, streamline tasks, and work smarter across Microsoft 365.

sessions.t: Deploy OneDrive Sync with Confidence: The Desktop Playbook
sessions.d: Learn how to successfully deploy and manage OneDrive Sync across your organization. Explore deployment best practices, configuration tips, user adoption strategies, and troubleshooting guidance to deliver a reliable and scalable file sync experience for your users.

sessions.t: When AI Agents Go Off Script: Rewind unintended actions
sessions.d: “Assume Breach” is a foundational security principle. In the agentic era, preparing for unintended agent actions becomes equally important. Discover how new recovery capabilities across Microsoft 365, including SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams, help organizations quickly restore resources to a known good state when agents go off script.

sessions.t: Customer Zero: How Microsoft Uses Agents to Scale Knowledge Work
sessions.d: How can organizations move beyond AI assistants to transform how work gets done? As Customer Zero, Microsoft is exploring how agents can scale expertise, reduce repetitive work, and accelerate decisions. Learn how teams combine human judgment with agentic workflows to keep knowledge current and create tailored outputs on demand. Hear lessons on human-agent collaboration, governance, trust, and adoption—and get guidance for moving from isolated AI experiments to scalable business processes.

sessions.t: How Microsoft is Scaling Thousands of AI Agents with Agent 365
sessions.d: What does it take to manage thousands of AI agents across a global enterprise? Join Microsoft for an inside look at how we're using Agent 365 to observe, govern, and secure agents at scale. Learn how we gain visibility across our agent ecosystem, implement controls that enable confident deployment, and move from isolated experimentation to enterprise-wide adoption. Leave with practical lessons and best practices for managing agents across your organization.

sessions.t: Why every community needs an agent
sessions.d: Communities succeed because people help people. Learn how agents built on communities, conversations, and organizational knowledge can answer questions, surface expertise, connect people to content, identify trends, and turn conversations into reusable knowledge, while keeping humans at the center. See how these signals power AI experiences like Cowork, Autopilot, Work IQ, and the workplace of the future.

sessions.t: Scale Enterprise AI Transformation with Frontier Accelerate
sessions.d: Scaling AI across the enterprise requires more than technology. Learn how Frontier Accelerate helps leaders align priorities, modernize processes, build workforce readiness, and create a secure foundation for adoption. Through examples across productivity, business processes, secure AI, and intelligent apps, see how expertise, investments, and skilling resources help organizations accelerate transformation.

sessions.t: AI-Powered Workplace: AI removes the taxes on teamwork
sessions.d: Work charges a tax: hunting space, guessing the right day, joining from the edge. AI removes it. The workplace knows why you came in and who's there. It reads the space and everyone in it, and adapts to how people actually work. Reach scales without losing the audience. Copilot and agents thread it all together. The result is a workplace that anticipates instead of asks, where collaboration feels seamless and natural, and being in the office is the best seat, not the only one.

sessions.t: Run your week: Five ways to use Copilot and Planner to manage work
sessions.d: Managing work means keeping track of tasks, follow-ups, meeting preparation, and shifting priorities. Join this fast-paced session to explore at least five practical ways to use Copilot and Planner to keep work moving across Microsoft 365.

sessions.t: The End of Starting Over: AI That Understands Your Work
sessions.d: AI is moving beyond responding to prompts toward understanding you and your work. Learn how memory on Work IQ helps Copilot retain what matters and build understanding over time, while context in Work IQ grounds each interaction in the information most relevant to the work at hand. See how memory and context work together to deliver more relevant, personalized responses that move your work forward and drive better business outcomes.

sessions.t: Scaling AI Agents Securely: What to Protect Next
sessions.d: As AI agents scale, security teams must know what to protect next. Through practical customer scenarios, learn how Microsoft Entra, Purview, Defender, and Agent 365 connect security insights to action. Using a FastTrack lens, we’ll show how to identify risks like oversharing, assess readiness from “safe to start” to “safe to scale,” and prioritize the protections needed for agent adoption.

sessions.t: Skills for agents: reusable expertise that scales
sessions.d: What separates a good agent from a great one? Skills. Learn how reusable, task-specific expertise helps agents deliver more consistent, useful, and scalable results. Through practical examples, you'll discover when to use skills, how to design them effectively, and where they can have the biggest impact.

sessions.t: Foundry Labs: Exploring the rise of decision models
sessions.d: As AI powers more enterprise workflows, applications increasingly need fast, structured decisions about what happens next. Specialized decision models address this need through classification, prioritization, verification, and evaluation—bringing a new approach to balancing quality, latency, and cost. Explore this shift through a practical demo of a production-ready model from Foundry Labs, and learn how to apply decision models in your own applications and agents.

sessions.t: Build an AI customer support agent with Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: Learn to build an AI Customer Support Agent with Microsoft Foundry to triage requests, coordinate specialized agents, analyze diagnostic data, and draft customer updates. Explore hosted agents, routines, and tools to create long-running workflows that help teams manage cases from intake to resolution, with human oversight. Ideal for AI developers, support engineers, and solution architects.

sessions.t: How Microsoft uses AI to manage its datacenter supply chain
sessions.d: What does it take to manage the supply chain behind Microsoft’s global datacenter network? See how Microsoft’s Circular Centers use Copilot Cowork and Dynamics 365 to enable more agile supply chain operations. Learn how analysis in minutes—not days—helps Microsoft decide faster, return valuable components to the supply chain, and meet AI demand more sustainably.

sessions.t: Beyond the tools: Preparing your employees to thrive with AI
sessions.d: As AI becomes more capable, how do you help your employees make the most of it? Explore how employees’ roles evolve as they work alongside AI and agents, from creating work to directing it, and why human skills become even more valuable. Leave with practical ideas for developing your teams’ skills and confidence, beyond teaching them how to use the tools.

sessions.t: Let GitHub Copilot find and fix a browser bug
sessions.d: Watch GitHub Copilot open an app reproduce a bug collect evidence update the code and confirm the fix in a browser. See how sandboxes permissions tests and human review keep the agent focused and make the result easy to trust.

sessions.t: When AI agents can use a computer
sessions.d: AI agents are moving beyond chat and code. They can now navigate websites use business tools collect information and complete work across applications. See practical examples and learn how to decide what agents can access where they should stop and when a person must approve the next step. Built for IT admins security teams and technology leaders.

sessions.t: The browser for every agent: Remote MCP Playwright Cloud Browser
sessions.d: Browser automation is becoming a core capability for agentic applications. This session explores how Remote MCP exposes Playwright Cloud Browser as a shared browser service across Copilot, Foundry, GitHub Copilot, and custom agents. Learn how it enables reliable web navigation, data extraction, and task execution, with built-in observability to simplify debugging. We’ll also demonstrate secure access to public websites and private VNet applications for enterprise-ready browser automation.

sessions.t: A practical guide to FinOps for GitHub Copilot
sessions.d: AI costs can grow quickly and become unpredictable without the right tools and insights. GitHub FinOps can turn usage and cost data into actionable insights, spending controls, and shared accountability. See how admins can scale AI adoption across their organizations, apply effective policies and controls, and connect AI investments to business outcomes.

sessions.t: Build a plugin once and use it everywhere with GitHub Copilot!
sessions.d: In this lightning session, learn how to build one agent plugin and use it across VS Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and GitHub Copilot App. See how portable plugins bring reusable skills and MCP integrations to each environment while still feeling native. Leave with a practical blueprint for shipping cross-surface agent experiences.

sessions.t: Control how AI agents operate across GitHub
sessions.d: AI agents can transform how software gets built, but enterprises need confidence that they operate within organizational policies. During this 15 minute demo, see how a GitHub administrator can define enterprise guardrails for agents running on the GitHub platform, giving teams room to move quickly while maintaining security, compliance, and control.

sessions.t: From feedback to fixes: Event-driven coding agents
sessions.d: A new pull request review shouldn't leave a coding agent waiting for its next API poll. GitHub's Events Streams API lets agents subscribe to changes and react when feedback arrives. Watch an agent address a review and prepare code updates for human approval. You'll learn how to connect GitHub events to coding agents, build reactive agentic workflows, and shorten the feedback-to-fix cycle without polling loops or public webhook infrastructure.

sessions.t: Keep GitHub Copilot agent sessions moving wherever you work
sessions.d: Agent work should not stop because you closed a folder or changed where you are working. Start a GitHub Copilot session in VS Code, keep it running in the Agent Host, then reconnect through the Agents window and a browser to monitor progress, guide the agent, approve actions, and review changes. See how the open Agent Host Protocol keeps one long-running session synchronized across clients, so you can choose the right surface for each moment without losing context or starting over.

sessions.t: From prompt to hosted: The next generation of agents
sessions.d: Prompt-based agents helped developers get started, but production workloads demand more. This session explores the evolution from prompt agents to hosted agents, covering identity, sessions, tool integration, resiliency, deployment pipelines and enterprise governance. Learn how teams are moving from prototypes to scalable AI systems while preserving developer productivity and choice.

sessions.t: Optimizing AI decisions with the model router in Foundry Models
sessions.d: Model router in Foundry Models continues to evolve with new capabilities that give developers greater control over how requests are routed across models. In this session, we'll highlight the latest innovations in model router and show how teams can optimize quality, latency, and cost for AI applications and agents. You'll see how model router helps simplify model selection, adapt to changing workloads, and improve application performance at scale.

sessions.t: From idea to agent in minutes with Foundry Canvas
sessions.d: What if building an AI agent felt as natural as sketching an idea? This session showcases Foundry Canvas and its vision for simplifying agent creation through visual design, model selection, toolbox integration and deployment workflows. Learn how developers can move from concept to running agent faster, reduce setup complexity, and focus on delivering business value instead of wiring infrastructure together.

sessions.t: Microsoft Foundry Toolkit: The developer shortcut to production
sessions.d: Modern AI development requires more than models. Foundry Toolkit brings together development, testing, deployment and management experiences in one workflow. Discover how developers can accelerate agent engineering, connect tools and services, iterate faster, and reduce friction between local experimentation and enterprise deployment. Ideal for teams building production-ready AI applications at scale.

sessions.t: Agent FinOps: Designing agents that scale responsibly
sessions.d: As agents become long-running and autonomous, cost management becomes a core engineering concern. Discover practical approaches to measuring ROI, controlling resource consumption and balancing performance with efficiency. Learn how optimization, monitoring and operational governance help teams move from experimental agents to sustainable production systems.

sessions.t: Governance of tools and skills with Foundry Toolboxes
sessions.d: The future is not a single agent but ecosystems of agents, tools and skills. Learn how reusable toolboxes, skills platforms, MCP integrations and agent orchestration can accelerate development while improving maintainability. Explore emerging patterns for composing capabilities once and enabling their reuse across teams, projects and business processes.

sessions.t: Publishing agents where work actually happens
sessions.d: Building an agent is only half the challenge. Delivering it to users is where value is created. Learn about emerging patterns for publishing agents into Teams, Microsoft 365 and existing business workflows. We explore governance, discoverability, distribution and the lessons learned from connecting developer experiences to the applications people use every day.

sessions.t: Architecting Claude agents on Microsoft Foundry: Design to production
sessions.d: Go from idea to production-ready agent with Claude in Microsoft Foundry. In 15 minutes, watch a workflow grow from a single model call into a capable agent using Claude's built-in tools: structured outputs, web search and fetch, and MCP connections. Then see how the agent stack, data, evals and governance fit together for production. Leave ready to build your own, with clear controls over cost, tools and the domains your agent can reach.

sessions.t: Package custom models for adoption in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: Publishing weights makes a model available, not adoptable. In 15 minutes, see how Microsoft Foundry turns a custom model into a complete product with task-specific evaluators, reference prompts, a working harness, integration guidance, and evidence on quality, performance, and cost. Learn which assets accelerate time to value, create differentiation beyond the weights, and help customers evaluate, customize, and deploy with confidence.

sessions.t: Beyond search: Enabling agents to operate business critical systems
sessions.d: Most enterprise agents can search. The real opportunity is agents that act. See how Work IQ, MCP servers, and enterprise connectors extend agents into ERP, CRM, ITSM, and other business systems where work actually happens. Learn how to create reusable business skills that connect systems, automate actions, and can be shared across copilots and agents throughout your organization.

sessions.t: Fabric IQ + Foundry IQ: From business data to agent knowledge
sessions.d: See how Fabric IQ and Foundry IQ work together: Fabric IQ brings OneLake data, business semantics, and metrics; Foundry IQ turns that context into agent-ready knowledge through retrieval. Learn where each fits in the Microsoft IQ stack.

sessions.t: Observability for AI with Fabric Data Agent, Foundry, and Agent 365
sessions.d: As organizations move AI into production, they need visibility into how AI apps perform and how agents operate. See how Microsoft Foundry and Fabric Data Agent help teams monitor AI operations, investigate issues, and uncover insights. The new integration with Microsoft Agent 365 gives admins visibility into Fabric Data Agent usage and activity org-wide. Together, they offer a connected approach to troubleshooting and managing AI, from applications to the enterprise agent estate.

sessions.t: GitHub Copilot meets Microsoft IQ: Bringing enterprise context to devs
sessions.d: Join a conversation on how Microsoft IQ can bring enterprise context into the developer workflow through GitHub Copilot. Explore how business data, workplace knowledge, and retrieval-powered context can help developers reason across code, docs, workflows, and organizational knowledge.

sessions.t: Identity-aware knowledge retrieval with Foundry IQ
sessions.d: AI agents rely on retrieved knowledge to answer questions, but not every user should have access to every document. This session shows how Foundry IQ enables identity-aware knowledge retrieval using document-level access controls, Microsoft Entra ID user and group filtering, and permission-aware retrieval. Learn how permissions from SharePoint, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, and other enterprise content sources are enforced so agents retrieve only authorized content.

sessions.t: Knowledge retrieval architectures for Foundry IQ
sessions.d: Learn how to deploy knowledge bases in Foundry IQ for production agents. Compare architectures for indexed and remote sources, design for multitenancy, and choose between serverless and consumption deployments for cost and scale.

sessions.t: WIQD in 15 minutes: Build, validate, and publish plugins
sessions.d: Meet Work IQ Dev Tools (WIQD) and see the plugin developer lifecycle in action. Build, validate and publish a Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork plugin through a streamlined developer experience, from project scaffolding to organizational sharing.

sessions.t: Work IQ and Agent 365: Build and govern workplace agents
sessions.d: Learn how Work IQ and Agent 365 work together to build useful workplace agents and govern them at scale. Ground agents in Microsoft 365 context, then see how Agent 365 supports visibility, lifecycle management, policy, security, and operational control.

sessions.t: Project Perception Live: turn threat intel into detections
sessions.d: A new threat report lands. Are you ready to detect it? See Project Perception in action as it transforms a third-party threat report into proposed detections, validated against your own tenant environment. Discover how security teams can identify coverage gaps, understand what each detection will do before deployment, and move faster from threat intelligence to actionable detections.

sessions.t: Why Every SOC Needs attack disruption
sessions.d: Modern attacks move faster than human response. Join Microsoft security experts to learn how attack disruption helps stop attacks in progress, automatically containing threats and limiting attacker movement before damage occurs. Discover why autonomous defense is quickly becoming a core requirement for modern security operations.

sessions.t: Threat Intelligence reimagined: Expert Q&A and Deep Dive
sessions.d: Have questions about Microsoft Threat Intelligence? Join an interactive discussion with product experts. Dive deeper into architecture, capabilities, and use cases. Bring your toughest questions and we'll answer them live with demos and real examples.

sessions.t: Apply Zero Trust for AI: the practitioner's shortlist
sessions.d: Fifteen minutes, five controls. See the Zero Trust for AI guidance practitioners apply first across identity, data, endpoints and SecOps, how to baseline where you stand, and what to fix before your agents go live.

sessions.t: Beyond Data Classification: Understanding Human and Data Interactions
sessions.d: Data security goes beyond knowing what's sensitive. It's understanding how people interact with data, where insider risk may emerge, and whether that activity fits the business need. Learn why user-data interactions are critical to reducing risk and securing AI.

sessions.t: Customers Expect a Frictionless Login. Attackers Do Too.
sessions.d: External users expect every interaction with your application to be fast, seamless, and secure. Attackers are looking for the gaps in that experience. See what’s new in Microsoft Entra External ID, with innovations that help you deliver low-friction customer experiences while strengthening protection for customer identities.

sessions.t: Oops! Someone Deleted a Critical Identity. Can You Get It Back?
sessions.d: A deleted identity can quickly become a major business disruption, especially when it has dependencies across applications, groups, policies, and access. See how Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery helps protect critical identity data and recover from accidental or malicious changes. Learn how to build resilience into your identity environment before deletion becomes downtime.

sessions.t: Govern & protect local agents for safe access to enterprise resources
sessions.d: See how Windows and Microsoft Security help you discover local agents, understand their impact, enforce least-privilege access, monitor runtime behavior, and respond when agents move outside their approved scope.

sessions.t: Agent 365 in Action: Managing MCP Servers, Plugins, and Skills for AI Agents
sessions.d: Who approved the tools your agents call? MCP servers, connectors, plugins and skills can come in from catalogs, plugins and gateways, and the usual control is blocking a tool for the whole tenant. This demo walks through how Microsoft Agent 365 helps IT find these tools, register them and then block the unsanctioned tools or selectively allow a selective functionality of the tool or for certain set of users, instead of blocking it for everyone.

sessions.t: Dive into new intent-based playbooks that accelerate agent risk defense
sessions.d: Securing your riskiest agents is now as simple as choosing an outcome. Discover new intent-based playbooks that help security teams protect, govern, investigate, and remediate agents through a simple, guided experience. See how Dynamic Agent Risk continuously evaluates agent risks, permissions, exposure, and impact to prioritize what matters most and intelligently recommends your next best actions.

sessions.t: Build AI on identities you can trust
sessions.d: As AI makes credentials more valuable to attackers, trust must be built deeper into the platform. Learn how silicon-based credential protection helps prevent device impersonation and creates a stronger foundation for trusted AI agents, devices, and services.

sessions.t: Stay audit-ready for every AI interaction with Microsoft Purview
sessions.d: Effective governance requires visibility. Learn how Microsoft Purview helps organizations track agent activity, support investigations, and maintain the auditability and evidence needed to satisfy organizational and compliance requirements.

sessions.t: AI agents need access. Your network needs controls.
sessions.d: AI agents need network access to get work done, but every connection can expand their blast radius. Learn how network controls help security teams see where agents connect, govern what they can reach and do, and contain risky activity while approved work continues.

sessions.t: Turn global regulations into operating control with Microsoft Purview
sessions.d: Regulatory demands are outpacing evidence. Understand how Microsoft Purview turns global AI and data requirements into assigned actions, operating protections, and reviewable records across data security, insider risk, and compliance management.

sessions.t: From insight to action: Planning in Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: Analytics tells you what happened. Planning determines what happens next. Learn how Microsoft Fabric enables connected planning experiences that leverage trusted enterprise data, unified governance, and integrated analytics. See how organizations can build planning workflows, run scenario analysis, improve forecasting accuracy, and drive faster decision-making using a single platform.

sessions.t: Unify your data for AI projects with Microsoft OneLake
sessions.d: Microsoft OneLake is designed to help you unify your data estate on a secure, AI-ready foundation. In this theater session, we'll highlight how you can use zero-copy, zero-ETL tools in OneLake to connect your data estate, and fuel AI experiences in Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, and Microsoft Copilot.

sessions.t: Operate Microsoft Fabric with greater visibility and control
sessions.d: Keeping data and AI workloads running smoothly requires more than reactive troubleshooting. In this theater session, we'll show how Workspace Monitoring, Monitor Hub, and Operations Agent work together to provide a unified view of your Fabric estate. Learn how to monitor across workspaces, detect issues earlier, accelerate root cause analysis with AI-powered insights, and improve operational reliability from a single experience.

sessions.t: Maximizing developer experiences in Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: Learn how the latest developer experiences in Microsoft Fabric help teams deploy, operate, and optimize data solutions with confidence. Explore new capabilities for job scheduling, proactive and reactive monitoring, troubleshooting, versioning, and deployments, along with improvements in Git integration, CI/CD, automation, and observability. See how Fabric brings software engineering best practices to data workloads, helping teams move from development to production faster and more reliably.

sessions.t: Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric: Open data, one copy
sessions.d: Learn how Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric work together using OneLake, Apache Iceberg, and the Iceberg REST catalog. See how teams can query and govern shared Iceberg tables with Snowflake while keeping data open and accessible to Fabric engines—reducing duplication, simplifying architecture, and supporting analytics and AI.

sessions.t: Do you really need a separate vector database?
sessions.d: Choose a retrieval architecture based on the problem, not the label. In 15 minutes, learn when PostgreSQL-native vector, keyword, and hybrid search can support an AI application, when graph context adds value, and which workload signals truly justify a separate specialized service.

sessions.t: 5 ways to simplify your Postgres AI data pipelines on Azure
sessions.d: You can't ship AI features if pipelines break, drift, or need constant glue code. Learn five PostgreSQL patterns to keep content fresh, generate embeddings, and serve context to applications. Each pattern is framed around one decision you can apply to an AI architecture immediately.

sessions.t: All or nothing: Distributed transactions in Azure Cosmos DB
sessions.d: What if 'all or nothing' just worked across your whole database? In 15 minutes, go deep on ACID-compliant distributed transactions in Azure Cosmos DB: atomic multi-item writes across partitions and containers, serializable isolation, and automatic rollback when anything fails. We'll live-code the classic move-money-and-place-order scenario, look at how two-phase commit works under the hood, and cover where it fits today. If you've been hand-rolling consistency, this one's for you.

sessions.t: Upgrade smarter with next-gen Postgres on Azure
sessions.d: Upgrades stall when compatibility and rollback risk aren't proven early. See how to turn your Azure Database for PostgreSQL evaluation for PostgreSQL 19 into a repeatable test plan that checks extensions, performance, operations, and rollback. Build a move first shortlist.

sessions.t: Break your Postgres before production causes a breakdown
sessions.d: Validate recovery before an outage becomes the test. Watch a controlled PostgreSQL failure exercise and trace how backup, restore, immutability, geo-redundancy, and retention choices affect recovery objectives. Leave with a resilience-testing pattern your team can adapt today with Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

sessions.t: How Frontier Firms Evolve Planning & Operations with Agentic ERP
sessions.d: Agentic ERP is transforming supply chain planning and operations. See how organizations use Copilot, Cowork, and agents to predict disruptions, optimize inventory, and coordinate procurement and fulfillment. Learn how Dynamics 365 connects data and processes to help leaders respond to change, improve agility, and make better decisions.

sessions.t: Service operations: how frontier firms are using agentic ERP
sessions.d: New services-based business models demand new ways of working. See how Frontier Firms use Copilot, agents, and connected business applications to launch new services, coordinate work across business processes, and unlock growth. Learn how Dynamics 365 helps organizations agentify service operations and scale new business opportunities.

sessions.t: How Microsoft uses Copilot and Dynamics 365 to grow revenue
sessions.d: What does it take to build an agentic sales team? Go behind the scenes of Microsoft's Customer Zero journey. See how Microsoft 365 Copilot has become the front door to Dynamics 365 Sales to help our sellers identify and accelerate opportunities, engage customers holistically, manage sales teams, and unlock growth. Learn practical approaches that you can apply in your Sales organization.

sessions.t: Simplifying Enterprise App Lifecycle Management with MSIX
sessions.d: Explore how MSIX makes enterprise app deployment and management simpler, more reliable, and easier to control. Discover recently shipped capabilities and what's coming next to streamline the app lifecycle, from deployment to removal.

sessions.t: AI at Your Fingertips: Foundry Local on Windows
sessions.d: Get started with Foundry Local on Windows. This lightning talk shows how to find, run, and integrate local AI models into your apps, enabling faster experiences, reduced cloud dependency, and greater control over data.

sessions.t: Simplify enterprise app packaging and deployment with MSIX
sessions.d: See how a consistent MSIX workflows can improve release automation for developers and give IT a more predictable, supportable lifecycle across managed devices. The demo follows a Windows application from compiled output to an enterprise-ready package.

sessions.t: Build from first sign-in with Project Zenith
sessions.d: Developer productivity starts before the first line of code. Project Zenith brings together a ready-to-code Windows experience, curated tools, and focused settings so teams can begin faster and personalize the environment around how they work.

sessions.t: Trust Beyond Today's Cryptography: Post-Quantum Security in Windows
sessions.d: The security decisions organizations make today must stand up to tomorrow's computing breakthroughs. Learn how Windows is helping customers extend trust into the quantum era through post-quantum cryptography, compliance-ready capabilities, and platform investments designed to protect against future threats. Discover what post-quantum readiness means in practice, where organizations should begin, and how Windows is building the foundation for a trusted future.

sessions.t: AI in Edge for Business: Enterprise ready, from day one
sessions.d: AI delivers the most value when it shows up where work is already happening: the browser. For IT and Security leaders, the challenge is enabling that value without adding management complexity or compromising organizational requirements. Join this Edge for Business lightning talk to learn how new productivity experiences work alongside controls, compliance, and greater visibility to support AI adoption from day one.

sessions.t: Edge for Business: Keep work secure, even on devices you don't manage
sessions.d: Work no longer happens only on managed devices. Discover how Edge for Business extends enterprise-grade protection to BYOD, contractor, partner, and mobile scenarios without requiring full device enrollment. Deeply integrated with Microsoft Entra, Intune, Defender and Purview, Edge for Business applies browser-based security controls that protect organizational data wherever work happens.

sessions.t: Extend Your Hardware Investment with Windows 365
sessions.d: Rising hardware costs are forcing organizations to rethink the traditional PC refresh. In this demo-heavy session, see how Windows 365 Boot can give existing devices a new role, and how Cloud PC devices like Windows 365 Link can provide a simple and secure way to connect to Windows 365. Learn how to reuse what you have, replace differently, and get more from every hardware investment.

sessions.t: Stay productive through disruption with Windows 365 Reserve
sessions.d: See how Windows 365 Reserve provides secure, temporary Cloud PCs when physical devices are unavailable, compromised, or being replaced. Explore practical demos and learn how it supports workforce productivity, rapid recovery, and operational resilience.

sessions.t: Simplify Cloud PC operations with AI-powered management
sessions.d: Discover how Windows 365 AI operations use AI and agents to simplify Cloud PC management. Predict issues, automate routine tasks, recommend changes, summarize insights, and help IT troubleshoot through AI-powered operations.

sessions.t: Automate Business Operations with a Secure Computer for Agents
sessions.d: See how Windows 365 for Agents enables AI agents to work across the Windows apps and systems businesses rely on. Through a real Microsoft Business Operations use case, learn how agents can execute complex workflows in dedicated Cloud PCs, while giving IT the security, control, and governance needed to scale agent work.

sessions.t: Windows recovery at scale: From disruption to productivity in minutes
sessions.d: When devices fail to boot or business-critical incidents disrupt productivity, IT teams need recovery options that are fast, scalable, and secure. In this session, we’ll share the latest enhancements in Windows recovery capabilities and how organizations can quickly recover affected devices.

sessions.t: Trusting AI Agents: From Windows 11 to Cloud PCs (local to cloud)
sessions.d: AI agents are changing how work gets done. Learn how Windows uses MXC to provide containment, policy enforcement, and governance for agents across Windows 11 and Windows 365, creating a trusted runtime for AI.

sessions.t: Closing Azure’s customer feedback loop with AI agents
sessions.d: Azure uses AI agents to transform 10,000 to 15,000 monthly feedback reports into prioritized insights and actionable engineering work. See how the Great Experiences Matter initiative connects fragmented signals, human judgment, engineering action, and outcome measurement in a continuous learning loop, reducing manual synthesis time by more than 95%. Learn practical patterns for building auditable, human-guided agentic workflows that improve with every cycle.

sessions.t: Data resiliency and cyber recovery with Azure Backup
sessions.d: Explore the latest Azure Backup innovations for data resiliency and cyber recovery, including expanded workload protection, clean-room recovery, cross-tenant restore, Region of Choice, and AI-powered guidance. Learn how to align protection and recovery strategies with application criticality, compliance needs, and business outcomes. See how Azure Backup helps assess resiliency posture, strengthen ransomware preparedness, and enable confident recovery of critical applications and data.

sessions.t: Operationalize MCP with enterprise governance controls
sessions.d: As agents connect to more MCP servers and enterprise tools, organizations need visibility into what can be accessed and how those interactions are used. Learn how to publish enterprise MCP servers, secure access to enterprise tools, apply runtime policies, and monitor agent interactions through a centralized gateway. Gain practical approaches for bringing MCP into enterprise environments with the visibility and controls required for production deployment.

sessions.t: Agentic Linux operations with multiple distros
sessions.d: After moving a multi-distro Linux estate to Azure, what happens when you put an AI agent in the operator’s seat of a real Linux environment? Can an agent make sense of an unfamiliar system, navigate distribution differences, and help restore the business without overstepping its authority? This fast-paced demonstration explores what agentic Linux operations look like when the environment and the failure are real.

sessions.t: Azure Linux 4.0: What's new
sessions.d: Learn what’s new in Azure Linux 4.0, Microsoft’s Linux distribution built for Azure workloads. Explore its Azure integration, security-focused design, modern package ecosystem, and streamlined experience across virtual machines, containers, and Kubernetes. See how Azure Linux 4.0 provides a consistent, supported foundation for organizations building modern and AI-enabled applications on Azure.

sessions.t: Where sensitive data meets trusted execution
sessions.d: Discover how Confidential Enclaves enable highly sensitive cryptographic operations and confidential workloads in isolated, hardware-backed environments. Learn how confidential VMs, enclaves, and containers protect critical data and code while supporting demanding scenarios such as payment processing, digital trust, identity verification, and secure transactions. See how organizations can strengthen security and compliance without compromising performance or scale.

sessions.t: Can competitors collaborate without sharing data?
sessions.d: Organizations are increasingly required to collaborate across organizational boundaries while meeting strict privacy and regulatory requirements. Learn how Azure Confidential Clean Rooms enables privacy-preserving analytics on sensitive datasets, including PII and PHI, allowing organizations and partners to derive insights together without revealing raw data to one another or to the cloud provider.

sessions.t: The future of trust: Proof without compromising privacy
sessions.d: Discover how Azure Zero-Knowledge Proofs are redefining digital trust by enabling verification without data exposure. Learn how enterprises can use managed proof infrastructure to protect privacy while streamlining compliance, identity, payments, and secure data sharing. See how proof-based computing is unlocking a new generation of trusted digital experiences.

sessions.t: Data modernization decision tree for growing businesses
sessions.d: This short session will map out options for migrating and modernizing on-premises SQL Servers, prioritizing cost efficiency, ease of transition, and future readiness. Get tips for assessing your current environment and choose options that are optimal for your business as it grows.

sessions.t: Design serverless architectures for speed, cost efficiency and AI apps
sessions.d: Serverless is an architecture decision, not just a deployment target. This session covers practical patterns for building agent-ready serverless apps on Azure Container Apps and tuning them for microVM-backed compute from scale-to-zero and cold-start behavior to right-sizing CPU and memory for per-second billing, isolation boundaries for untrusted and agent-generated code, and snapshot and resume for stateful work. Leave with patterns you can apply to your own workloads.

sessions.t: Build event-driven AI apps with Azure Functions
sessions.d: AI applications are most powerful when they can act across the systems your business already runs on. In this session, learn how to build event-driven AI apps with Azure Functions and enterprise connectors that react to emails, documents, tickets, messages, and business events in real time. See how serverless scale, AI-powered decision making, and secure integrations combine to automate workflows, accelerate operations, and turn enterprise data into intelligent action.

sessions.t: From code repo to a live production-grade app in under a minute
sessions.d: Project Embr is a code-first, agent-first, batteries-included application experience for modern web and full-stack applications. It takes developers and coding agents from a repository to a live production-grade application in under a minute, combining build, deployment, branch and pull-request environments, common application services, and operational feedback in one workflow. Teams can start simple, iterate with control, and extend to Azure as requirements grow.

sessions.t: Reimagine agentic business processes with Logic Apps Automation
sessions.d: Build business process automation faster with Logic Apps Automation. See how templates and an intuitive workflow experience help you quickly automate processes across applications, data, APIs, and people. Then supercharge your workflows with AI and agents built in Microsoft Foundry, combining reasoning with deterministic steps and human approvals while maintaining the security and governance IT teams need.

sessions.t: Simplify operations with Azure Red Hat OpenShift hosted control planes
sessions.d: Join this session to see how organizations can accelerate application modernization, improve resource efficiency, and scale OpenShift environments with greater flexibility. Learn how Azure Red Hat Openshift with hosted control planes helps platform teams focus less on infrastructure management and more on delivering modern, AI-ready applications.

sessions.t: Run clusters at the edge with AKS Flex Nodes
sessions.d: Bringing AI and cloud-native applications closer to users often means running workloads beyond the datacenter. Learn how AKS Flex Nodes extend Kubernetes to edge environments, enabling consistent operations across cloud and edge. See how organizations deploy AI inferencing, data processing, and mission-critical applications closer to where data is generated while maintaining centralized management, security, and scalability with Azure Kubernetes Service.

sessions.t: Vectors for free: Integrated embeddings in Azure Cosmos DB
sessions.d: Every RAG tutorial starts the same way: build an embedding pipeline. What if you just... didn't? In 15 minutes, see how integrated embeddings in Azure Cosmos DB (GA) create and sync vectors automatically — on insert, update, and at query time — via Microsoft Foundry models, no client code. Data and vectors never drift, because Cosmos DB owns both. We'll go from empty container to working semantic search live, and cover cost and model choices. Leave ready to rip out a pipeline you never needed.

sessions.t: Monitoring workload health with Azure Monitor health models
sessions.d: What if monitoring could tell you what’s healthy, what’s impacted, and why? Azure Monitor health models turn telemetry into a real-time health graph that understands your workload, dependencies, and what matters to your business. Learn how to model, evaluate, and propagate health across your architecture, investigate impact, and accelerate responses, while giving AI structured context to investigate incidents, identify root causes, recommend remediation, and drive intelligent operations.

sessions.t: Azure Databricks for government cloud: Modern data and AI, delivered
sessions.d: Azure Databricks brings the latest data, analytics, and AI innovations to Azure Government, helping agencies accelerate mission outcomes while meeting security, compliance, and sovereignty requirements. Join to learn how government organizations can leverage modern lakehouse architecture, AI-powered analytics, governance, and the newest Azure Databricks capabilities to strengthen data-driven decision making, accelerate AI adoption, and deliver greater impact across public sector initiatives.

sessions.t: Powering AI operations with Azure Monitor health models
sessions.d: Azure Monitor health models combine monitoring signals with application architecture, dependencies, and business context to provide continuous insight into workload health. Discover how this structured context empowers AI agents to investigate incidents, trace cascading failures identify potential root causes, recommend remediation and automate operational workflows, moving towards more intelligent and autonomous operations.

sessions.t: Your AI is ready. Your data isn't.
sessions.d: Most organizations have run the pilot. Far fewer are running AI in production against their own data — in telecommunications, just 29% are ready to scale AI on their data, with skills and cost cited as the barriers. In 15 minutes, we'll look at what separates the ready from the stalled: end-to-end visibility across customer, service, and operational data; a common business context that agents can actually reason over; and a data foundation built to scale rather than to demo.

sessions.t: Accelerating energy intelligence
sessions.d: Industrial AI is unlocking new possibilities. Explore how Energy & Resources leaders are turning operational data into intelligence for faster decisions, stronger reliability, greater productivity, safer operations, and resilience.

sessions.t: Where AI Delivers Value in Factory Operations and Frontline Work
sessions.d: Which AI investments deliver measurable value on the factory floor? This session uses new research conducted by Microsoft with IoT Analytics to show how manufacturers are applying AI across asset maintenance, production optimization, exception response, frontline guidance, and operational knowledge. Learn which scenarios can improve throughput, uptime, quality, and workforce productivity, what separates scaled deployments from pilots, and how to prioritize investments across factory operations.

sessions.t: Unifying Workload Health at Scale with Azure Monitor Health Models
sessions.d: Discover how Azure Monitor health models and model of models bring together workload health to provide a unified view across your entire Azure estate. Understand cross-workload dependencies, trace the end-to-end impact of incidents, and identify emerging issues before they escalate

sessions.t: LIVE DEMO: From Repeatable Partner Expertise to a Governed Agent
sessions.d: Partners have repeatable expertise but often struggle to turn it into scalable IP. This lightning talk and live demo shows how a partner can capture an offer-qualification method as a Skill and operationalize it as a governed Frontier Offer Qualification Agent. See how the agent converts customer context into a recommended offer, identifies gaps and risks, and guides the next step—connecting technical delivery to reusable IP and repeatable commercial services.

sessions.t: Accelerating Agent Adoption with Trust, Teamwork and Community
sessions.d: We’re all driving agent adoption. But rapid adoption can become a customer’s biggest risk—or opportunity. At a healthcare organization, makers built 1,800+ agents faster than IT could govern. Three principles turned scale into growth. Trust: governance cut provisioning from 4 days to under an hour. Thriving community: 3,000 makers led adoption. Teamwork: customer, partner, and Microsoft sellers worked as one. Get the 3Ts playbook and see how Microsoft programs and incentives speed adoption.

sessions.t: The building blocks of BCDR: Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery
sessions.d: What does it take to recover when disruption happens? Get a rapid tour of the BCDR capabilities available across Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery. From protecting data against accidental deletion, corruption, and ransomware to continuous replication, recovery orchestration, test failover, and failback, see how Azure helps customers protect critical workloads and build a comprehensive recovery strategy across their environments

sessions.t: Agentic source-to-pay: a whole process, not a task
sessions.d: Most agent stories automate a task. Source-to-pay changes how a whole business function runs - procurement, finance, legal and every employee who needs to buy something. We walk the process end to end: where guided buying in the flow of work meets agentic execution behind it, where the agent decides, where a human approves, and what the CFO office actually measures. A practical look at agentifying one complete function, and how partners can spot the next one.

sessions.t: De-risking Azure migrations with UiPath Test Cloud
sessions.d: Migration risk is regression risk. Before moving a business-critical workload to Azure, you need to know what worked - and prove it still works after. This session shows how automated test generation and execution create a migration safety net: capture current-state behavior, run the same suite post-migration, and surface regressions before users do. We walk a live example plus the WEX experience, then cover where this attaches in an Azure migration engagement.

sessions.t: Frontier Accelerate for Azure: Turning Partner Momentum into Wins
sessions.d: Frontier Accelerate is reshaping how partners drive Azure adoption. In this lightning talk, we'll unpack what Frontier Accelerate for Azure means in practice — the motions, incentives, and partner surfaces that turn pipeline into deployed workloads. You'll see a practical example of how partners accelerate Azure consumption and modernization, plus the top actions to plug in today. Built for questions — bring yours.

sessions.t: How IDB Bank agentified commercial loan underwriting
sessions.d: Commercial loan underwriting stalls in the work around the credit decision: intake, extraction, exceptions, approvals, and system updates. IDB Bank built that process on Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams, with UiPath IXP and Maestro Case adding document intelligence and case orchestration across Loan IQ. See the design, where the human checkpoints sit, and the numbers: file prep from five hours to ninety minutes, 5,000 analyst hours returned each year.

sessions.t: MAICPP | AI Business Solutions & benefit updates
sessions.d: AI is reshaping how customers choose partners. Explore how the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program is evolving to help partners differentiate and grow across AI Business Solutions and Copilot. Learn about in-demand capabilities, emerging specialization pathways, and new benefits and investments supporting Copilot adoption, agentic solutions, and cloud innovation. Gain insights to align your capabilities, demonstrate value, and accelerate growth in the AI era.

sessions.t: MAICPP | Cloud & AI Platform & Healthcare offer updates
sessions.d: AI is reshaping how customers choose partners. Explore how the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program is evolving to help partners differentiate and grow across Cloud & AI Platform and Healthcare. Learn about in-demand capabilities, emerging specialization pathways, and new investments supporting cloud innovation and AI transformation. Gain insights to align your capabilities, demonstrate greater value, and accelerate growth in the AI era.

sessions.t: Build trust with Security specializations in the AI era
sessions.d: Explore how Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Security specializations help partners demonstrate expertise and build customer trust in the AI era. Learn what’s changing and how audit requirements connect to demonstrated security capabilities. You will gain: A clear view of specialization updates, what the audits assess, and practical steps to prepare your organization and communicate your value to customers.

sessions.t: Raising the bar: Evolution of the Support Services designation
sessions.d: The Support Services designation helps partners stand out by demonstrating support excellence to customers and Microsoft sellers. Learn how the designation is evolving beyond reactive support to include proactive services, enhanced support, and performance-based credits. Whether renewing or applying for the first time, get a preview of the customer success capabilities assessment coming in H2.

sessions.t: When the right answer is not enough: AI that earns trust at scale
sessions.d: Across 35,000 retirement plans, every interaction comes with different rules, context, and expectations. When people decide about their savings, getting the answer right is only part of the challenge. They need confidence to act. See how Vanguard, Kore.ai, and Microsoft use AI to move from answering questions to resolving requests end to end, with associates looped in when needed. The result: an experience that earns trust every time, delivering 80%+ successful closures and strong satisfaction.

sessions.t: Make the Most of Microsoft's Go-to-Market
sessions.d: Microsoft offers a wide range of go-to-market benefits, tools, programs and opportunities to help CSP channel partners grow. But knowing what’s available and where to start isn’t always easy. In this lightning session, discover GTM Titan, a foundational learning path designed to help you navigate Microsoft GTM, connect your business priorities to the right opportunities, and identify what to activate next.

sessions.t: Make the Most of Microsoft's Go-to-Market
sessions.d: Microsoft offers a wide range of go-to-market benefits, tools, programs and opportunities to help CSP channel partners grow. But knowing what’s available and where to start isn’t always easy. In this lightning session, discover GTM Titan, a foundational learning path designed to help you navigate Microsoft GTM, connect your business priorities to the right opportunities, and identify what to activate next.

sessions.t: Make the Most of Microsoft's Go-to-Market

One is Fabric-native | the other is portable. We'll build the bronze medallion layer on both, and cover why you can only enable one per database.

sessions.t: Find Your People: Growing Community with Purpose
sessions.d: Strong communities do more than bring people together, they create connection, learning, and a shared sense of purpose. Hear practical lessons from community leaders on finding the right audience, creating meaningful ways to participate, and turning individual connections into a community that can grow and sustain itself.

sessions.t: Champions Create Change
sessions.d: Technology doesn't transform an organization on its own. People do. Explore how the Champions Community help colleagues experiment, learn, and build confidence—and how everyday employees can become catalysts for meaningful change.

sessions.t: Starting a Local AI Community
sessions.d: Learn how one MVP turned curiosity about agents into a local developer community, including how to pick topics, attract first-time attendees, and keep people coming back.

sessions.t: Leveraging community engagement in the AI era
sessions.d: Explore how AI is reshaping engagement in the Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) community. Discuss welcoming contributors, managing AI-assisted contributions, and turning feedback into improvements while maintaining trust and meaningful collaboration.

sessions.t: Running a Global AI Chapter
sessions.d: Explore lessons from leading a global AI community, including how to scale programming, support local leaders, and create an inclusive experience across regions.

sessions.t: From Blog to Workshop
sessions.d: See how MVPs repurpose one strong idea into blog posts, talks, workshops, demos, and community resources for different audiences and skill levels.

sessions.t: Building Trust in AI
sessions.d: Learn how MVPs help communities navigate AI hype, uncertainty, and responsible adoption through honest guidance, practical examples, and open discussion.

sessions.t: Grow Your AI Community: What Actually Works
sessions.d: Building a larger AI community takes more than great speakers and good events. I’ll share lessons from helping grow the Global AI Community Dallas chapter, covering what worked, what didn’t, and practical approaches to increasing attendance, membership, partnerships, and long-term engagement.

sessions.t: Bring Real-Time Intelligence to Life Through Play
sessions.d: See how Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence became the engine behind a fun, interactive, and engaging customer experience. We’ll share the technology behind the Fabric Real-Time Challenge, an Ignite Community activation that uses the product to power both the participant experience and the surrounding displays. We’ll discuss how the concept evolved from earlier RTI activations, how we built the project, and what we learned about making Fabric tangible and approachable for a crowd.

sessions.t: Teaching Agent Building with Copilot Studio
sessions.d: Learn how to make agent building with Copilot Studio approachable through practical examples, community Q&A, and real-world scenarios that connect agentic AI concepts to everyday work for everyone!

sessions.t: Foundry IQ Use Cases
sessions.d: See how MVPs help communities identify useful Foundry IQ scenarios, from discovering technical knowledge to turning questions into repeatable workflows.

sessions.t: Making WebIQ Useful
sessions.d: Explore how MVPs introduce WebIQ with relatable examples that show how web knowledge, research, and discovery can support better technical decision-making.

sessions.t: WebIQ Community Demos
sessions.d: Learn how MVPs design engaging WebIQ demos and sessions that make the experience clear, useful, and easy for attendees to try themselves.

sessions.t: Inside MAI-Cyber: Specialized Models, Better Security Economics
sessions.d: Learn how purpose-built models like MAI-Cyber-1-Flash deliver high-quality reasoning more efficiently and improve security economics. Understand how Microsoft leverages specialized models within MDASH to strengthen discovery and analysis at scale, getting more security work from every token. You'll leave with a clearer understanding of how specialization can deliver better security outcomes at optimized cost.

sessions.t: Microsoft Perception: Multi-agent defense in action
sessions.d: Discover how Microsoft Perception brings multi-agent security defense to life, helping security teams move from reactive operations to continuous, proactive defense. See how specialized red, blue, and green team agents work together to uncover security gaps, investigate threats, and drive remediation. Through real-world scenarios and live demonstrations, learn how to put ready-to-use playbooks and AI agents to work across your security operations.

sessions.t: Ghost Agents: Insider Risk Management for Agents at Scale
sessions.d:
What happens when your newest insider isn't human? Autonomous AI agents are introducing a new class of insider risk, operating at machine speed with access to sensitive data, systems, and business processes. Explore how compromised, manipulated, or misconfigured agents can become powerful insider threats.

Learn practical strategies for securing agent identities, enforcing least privilege, monitoring agent behavior, and containing threats before trusted AI becomes your biggest security blind spot.

sessions.t: From prompt to finished project with Fabric data engineering agent
sessions.d: Data engineering is entering a new era: autonomous agents can execute complex, long-running work while people focus on higher-value decisions. In this demo-driven session, see Fabric’s data engineering agent turn an ambiguous specification into a complete, validated project by inspecting code and data, updating notebooks and artifacts, orchestrating sub-agents, applying guardrails, and refining results under human supervision.

sessions.t: Build and trust an AI-powered Fabric Data Agent in minutes
sessions.d: Generative AI can help users chat with data, but how do you set it up for enterprise data and ensure the answers are accurate? In this demo you'll see how AI can accelerate the creation of a Microsoft Fabric Data Agent from an existing semantic model. Then we'll take it a step further by automatically generating and maintaining a ground truth dataset used to validate responses, improve trust, detect drift and measure agent quality at scale.

sessions.t: Governing AI agents on the endpoint
sessions.d: AI agents are already running on your endpoints, often unseen. Learn how to find them, set clear boundaries for what they can access, and act fast when they step outside policy, so you can cut shadow AI risk and scale agent adoption with confidence.

sessions.t: Designing resilient multi-cloud connectivity with Azure Networking
sessions.d: Build multi-cloud applications that stay available when networks, clouds, or regions fail. Explore Azure ExpressRoute, AWS and GCP interconnects for native cloud-to-cloud connectivity, plus ExpressRoute Metro resiliency and ExpressRoute Last Mile. Through architecture walkthroughs and failure scenarios, learn practical patterns for traffic routing, rapid failover, and resilient connectivity that keep applications running across clouds and regions during disruptions.

sessions.t: Build once, deploy across AKS and ACI with Radius
sessions.d: Cloud-native applications often become tied to a specific runtime, making workloads difficult to move without significant rework. Radius, an open-source application platform from Azure Incubations, separates application intent from infrastructure. In this live demo, well deploy one application across AKS and ACI using the same definition and no code changes, showing how platform teams can support multiple Azure runtimes while preserving a consistent developer experience.

sessions.t: Azure Local disconnected operations: Tenant onboarding and IDP setup
sessions.d: Learn how operators bring Azure Local disconnected operations (ALDO) online and connect it to their own identity provider (IdP). This session walks through the operator's end-to-end experience, from initial setup to configuring external identity and enabling secure access, all in fully disconnected environments. We'll cover the key steps, roles, and experiences that make identity setup simple and secure, and share a look at what's coming next for ALDO.

sessions.t: From resilience gaps to confident recovery
sessions.d: Explore Azure’s vision for operational resilience across infrastructure and cyber recovery. See how Azure Infrastructure Resiliency Manager helps identify resiliency gaps, assess dependencies, validate posture, and improve preparedness. Then discover Azure Backup’s cyber recovery capabilities, including clean room recovery, to safely restore critical applications. Learn how Azure helps organizations get resilient, stay resilient, and recover confidently.

sessions.t: Stop Waiting for Annual Feedback: Build Your Own Leadership Coach with Copilot
sessions.d: Growing as a leader depends on feedback, yet most of us get it only a few times a year, and it's often too vague to act on. Copilot can change that. In this lightning talk, see how to turn your own meetings, chats and emails into a daily coaching loop. You'll leave with a simple setup, a reusable prompt, and guardrails that keep the coaching private and safe, so you can start getting better feedback tomorrow, not next review cycle.

sessions.t: From AI Hype to Reality: Building Agents That Actually Work
sessions.d: AI agents are everywhere, but turning impressive demos into real enterprise solutions is a different challenge. Drawing on practical customer scenarios, this session explores what it takes to build, deploy, and govern AI agents, from connecting enterprise data and systems to managing identity, security, and human oversight.

sessions.t: Would You Let an AI Agent Fix Production?
sessions.d:
AI agents can write code, analyze data, and reason through complex problems. But would you let one touch production infrastructure?

This lightning talk explores what changes when AI moves from assisting engineers to taking actions in real cloud environments. Drawing from hands-on work with AI-powered cloud operations, I’ll break down the permissions, context, guardrails, human escalation, and safety mechanisms that autonomous agents need before we can trust them with production systems, and what this shift could mean for the future of cloud engineering.

sessions.t: Azure Copilot for Agentic Cloud Operations
sessions.d: Explore new Azure Copilot experiences and Azure Resource Manager MCP Server enhancements that give agents deeper environmental awareness. This session is built for FinOps and AI infrastructure teams.

sessions.t: Turn What Your Best People Know Into Copilot Agents
sessions.d: Your customer's best processes and practices live in someone's head. They know what to do, what to look for, and when to make an exception. In this practical walkthrough, learn how to capture that hidden expertise from documents, recordings, and interviews and turn it into reusable skills for Copilot agents. Follow a real sales workflow from expert walkthrough to an agent that produces research, talking points, and a tailored deck. Leave with a repeatable approach you can use with customers.

sessions.t: Confidently Wrong: What Bad Data Does to Good Agents
sessions.d: An agent running on bad data doesn't crash. It answers confidently, it's wrong, and somebody acts on it. Before two agents went live, we had to decide whether the data underneath could be trusted with a business decision: a heavy equipment onboarding agent, and a Microsoft Fabric modernization for a global energy operator. Neither was ready on day one. We'll show the governance work each one needed, what broke early, and a short checklist to run before you hand your next agent the keys.

sessions.t: Theory to revenue: build a Microsoft practice that fits your stage
sessions.d: Discover how top software and AI companies accelerate growth by building a strong Microsoft partner practice. Drawing on lessons from leading Microsoft partners like Citrix and Redis, and from building and running Microsoft's exclusive high-growth startups program, learn how to apply the same partner frameworks to maximize revenue, align with Microsoft's priorities, and scale faster in FY27. Leave ready to grow your own Microsoft partnership with practical, proven strategies.

sessions.t: Same Migration, Two Payouts: How Your Routing Decides a Deal's Worth
sessions.d: Two partners move identical workloads to Azure. One earns materially more than the other, and the difference is not technical. It is how the opportunity was routed before any work started. This talk covers that routing decision: when it has to be made, who makes it, who inside Microsoft has to be involved, and what it is worth to get right. Aimed at partners running server, SQL, or VMware migration practices who are leaving money behind without knowing it.

sessions.t: Could You Pass the New Security Specialization Audit Today?
sessions.d: The bar has been raised for earning Microsoft Security Specializations, with partners needing to pass a third-party audit. Join this panel to learn what's changing, where partners commonly fall short, and how to prepare before timelines become compressed. Experts who've helped 40+ partners through specialization audits will share guidance on documentation, customer evidence, operational readiness, and audit preparation.

sessions.t: Accelerate agentic AI at the edge and data center with Azure Local
sessions.d: Demonstrating Wipro's Differentiated Capabilities and Expertise to Accelerate the Agentic AI Journey Leveraging Microsoft Azure Local to Enable Secure, Scalable, and Autonomous Enterprise Decision-Making

sessions.t: Secure the edge. Protect your data
sessions.d: Learn how to secure private application access, apply Purview data-loss policies, and protect users and sensitive information wherever work happens. See how Cisco SASE extends Microsoft Edge and Purview with unified, zero-trust access and data protection.

sessions.t: Your AI agent needs more than a prompt and a prayer
sessions.d: A great demo doesn't guarantee production success. Before your AI agent starts racking up token bills or making creative assumptions, learn how Dell Services helps organizations map the right use cases, ground agents in trusted, secure data, and govern spend with FinOps and tokenomics. Walk away with a practical playbook for running Microsoft AI agents at scale.

sessions.t: When AI finds the bugs first: Lessons from PHP2Shell
sessions.d: In October, two hidden flaws in PHP pushed some banks, airlines and governments offline. AI found them, and attackers used AI to exploit them within hours. Aikido Security explains in plain language what happened, why it matters to both technical and nontechnical teams, how we shipped free fixes within a day, and five questions every team should ask. See how Aikido for Azure DevOps, GitHub and VS Code, and Noon for Microsoft 365 work with the Microsoft tools you already use.

sessions.t: Transforming KYC operations with agentic AI at Tatra banka
sessions.d: Discover how Tatra banka and Capgemini are applying agentic AI to transform KYC operations. Starting with a highly manual process, the team built AI agents alongside robust AI governance and model risk foundations. See how the solution reduces analyst effort, improves consistency, and accelerates decision-making while maintaining regulatory compliance and creating a scalable foundation for future AI use cases.

sessions.t: Speed, scale, sovereignty: Azure Local and Bridge on Armada
sessions.d: Cloud and AI projects stall when infrastructure is slow to build, hard to scale, or outside the customer’s control. Armada solves for speed, scale, and sovereignty together. Learn how Azure Local runs in Galleon modular datacenters for edge sites, and in datacenters for sovereign clouds. Then see a preview of what’s coming: GPU as a service with Bridge on Azure Local Multi-Rack (Linux), bringing sovereign AI capacity to the Azure operating model.

sessions.t: Your cloud. Your data. Your control.
sessions.d: Discover how Intel and Microsoft enable sovereign cloud innovation with hardware-based confidential computing. Explore how Intel® TDX capabilities across Azure Cloud and Azure Local can support a sovereignty strategy, with deployment options across private and public cloud environments.

sessions.t: Secure the future of agentic AI on device
sessions.d: As AI agents transform how we work, securing workforce interactions, sensitive data, and agentic workflows is more critical than ever. Discover how Intel and Microsoft are advancing security on the AI PC through hardware-enabled capabilities and on-device AI. Explore new approaches to data protection, threat detection, and agent guardrails that help organizations embrace agentic AI with greater confidence, without compromising device performance.

sessions.t: AI beyond the screen. Intelligence in motion.
sessions.d: AI is moving beyond screens and into the physical world. Experience how Intel and Microsoft are enabling machines to see, understand, and act through two real-world demonstrations. Watch a robotic arm recognize objects and execute AI-planned actions, then see how 3D LiDAR transforms anonymous people movement into real-time insights for safety and operational efficiency. From intelligent robotics to spatial awareness, discover how edge AI is bringing intelligence into motion.

sessions.t: Optimize AI routing and lower costs with NVIDIA SwitchYard
sessions.d: AI coding assistants deliver powerful results, but every token comes at a cost. Experience NVIDIA SwitchYard, an AI router that connects tools such as Cursor and Codex to Microsoft Foundry and local models. See real examples of routing configurations designed to optimize token usage and lower AI costs.

sessions.t: From Digital Twins to Physical AI:Azure Meets NVIDIA Omniverse & cuOpt
sessions.d: How do optimized routes in a digital factory connect to robots in the real world? This lightning talk explores an architecture combining Azure, NVIDIA Omniverse, and cuOpt to compute routes and visualize them in a simulated factory. We’ll examine how NVIDIA cuOpt may be used with Isaac Sim to optimize factory operations in real time.

sessions.t: Fine-tune NVIDIA Nemotron models with Azure Databricks AI Runtime
sessions.d: Learn how to turn an open model into one that understands your business data. Join Azure Databricks and NVIDIA for a hands-on walkthrough of post-training with AI Runtime and NVIDIA Nemotron models. Using receipt extraction as a multimodal example, see how to prepare labeled data, adapt a model with NVIDIA NeMo, and compare base and fine-tuned results. We'll also cover serverless GPU infrastructure and key security, governance, and operational considerations.

sessions.t: Agent 365: Governing agent access to Microsoft 365 content
sessions.d: An agent without your content isn't very useful. An agent with the wrong access is a risk. See how Agent 365 helps you govern how agents use your Microsoft 365 content. In demos, use the agent access heatmap to see which content agents use, how sensitive it is, and whether they read or change it. Then set content guardrails once, on agent blueprints, so they apply to every agent, today's and tomorrow's, and bring in the content owners best placed to decide.

sessions.t: Agent Rewind: When agents go off script
sessions.d: AI at scale demands resilience by design. Agent Rewind helps organizations monitor agent activity across Microsoft 365 including SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams (and more to come), to rapidly recover from unintended actions, and maintain the trust, control, and compliance required for enterprise AI operations. Plus, AI-powered Enterprise management skills help control and achieve a clean and optimized storage environment to power optimal agent grounding and security risk.

sessions.t: Understand how attackers use AI to create and evade malware
sessions.d: AI is changing how attackers create, evade detection, and deliver malware, while giving defenders new ways to identify threats. See demonstrations of AI-assisted malware creation, exploit detection, and delivery methods, and learn how to distinguish human-driven techniques from those enabled by AI.

sessions.t: Streamline Microsoft 365 administration with AI agents
sessions.d: Microsoft 365 administration still means jumping between portals, reports, exports, and scripts. In 20 minutes, Microsoft MVP Richard Harbridge shows how AI agents and MCP can shorten that path. See agents investigate governance data, prioritize risk, generate evidence, and prepare action while keeping human approval, permissions, and accountability clear.

sessions.t: More to support. More to secure. No more capacity.
sessions.d: Recurring tickets drain IT resources when teams already have more to support and secure. Learn why these issues persist and what leading organizations are doing to prevent them.

sessions.t: Build identity resilience across Microsoft Entra ID and Intune
sessions.d: As AI, automation, and cloud services expand the identity surface, Microsoft Entra ID and Intune become even more critical to access and business continuity. Explore a practical identity resilience model built around change visibility, configuration control, targeted recovery, and continuity planning, and see how Backupta helps teams keep Microsoft identity operations dependable as environments become more dynamic.

sessions.t: Build the data layer for enterprise AI
sessions.d: Enterprise data is scattered across SQL Server, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and other systems. Learn how to unify that data in OneLake, continuously extract and maintain context from operational data, and bring it into Fabric IQ so Copilot, AI agents, and Power BI can work across enterprise data without adding more pipelines, compute, storage, or data movement. The result is an AI-ready data foundation that makes enterprise context easier to access and put to work.

sessions.t: Move beyond AI pilots and build the frontier firm
sessions.d: Most organizations have moved past asking whether AI delivers value. The challenge now is scaling it. Many have deployed AI platforms and piloted agents, but few have built the governance and digital foundations required for enterprise-wide transformation. Learn how to move from isolated AI wins to business-wide impact through agent governance, operating models, and responsible adoption practices. Leave with a practical framework for scaling AI across your organization.

sessions.t: Turn personal agents into enterprise assets
sessions.d: AI is moving beyond individual assistance toward enterprise agents that work across teams, data, and systems. EY explores how organizations can select agents, govern data access, scale personal agents into enterprise assets, and balance speed, risk, and human accountability. Gain a practical view of the operating models, validation approaches, controls, and ways of working needed to move from copilots and experimentation to responsible, scalable AI agent ecosystems.

sessions.t: AVD Hybrid in action: Modernize with VMware vSphere and Nerdio
sessions.d: See how Nerdio simplifies Azure Virtual Desktop Hybrid management on VMware vSphere. In this demo, explore how IT teams can deploy and manage AVD while continuing to use existing on-premises infrastructure, giving organizations more flexibility in how and when they modernize. See the experience in action and learn how Nerdio helps make hybrid desktop delivery easier to manage, automate, and optimize.

sessions.t: Frontier-driven AI: Evaluating LLMs at scale
sessions.d: Enterprises are adopting foundation models at an unprecedented pace, creating new challenges around governance, risk, cost, and model quality. This demo shows an automated evaluation and promotion framework built on Microsoft Foundry, using benchmark datasets, safety testing, and cost analysis to assess candidate models. Attendees will see how organizations can establish trusted baselines, automate decision-making, and deploy AI solutions with governance and operational controls at scale.
