sessions.t: The wire stalled. The closing didn’t. AI agents for regulated banking.
sessions.d: Wires and sanctions holds run across systems, rules, and reviewers. Most AI agents can’t carry that work to a consistent outcome. See how enterprise AI can be grounded in trusted data, governed across complex workflows, and continuously evaluated at every step, using Kore.ai pre-built agents on Microsoft Azure.

sessions.t: Multimodal agents: Muse Spark Open in Microsoft Foundry Models
sessions.d: Explore Muse Spark Open's multimodal capabilities, available through the Hugging Face collection in Microsoft Foundry Models. With text, image, video, and audio inputs and a 1M-token context window, Meta's open-weight model can reason across what it sees, hears, and reads. Learn how developers can connect documents, screenshots, and recordings with code and tasks and combine multimodal understanding with tool calling in an agentic harness.

sessions.t: Your path from AI pilots to a Frontier Firm
sessions.d: What defines a Frontier Firm, and how does an organization become one? Explore a practical path from individual AI use to governed agents and redesigned workflows. Learn which activities matter, where Microsoft 365 E7 fits, and how SoftwareOne services support readiness, adoption, security, and ongoing operations. Leave with a framework to choose your next steps.

sessions.t: Unlocking AI workflows: A blueprint for leading teams
sessions.d: Every organization is adopting AI, but what does it take to become truly AI-native? Discover a practical blueprint for moving from early experimentation to operational transformation with Atlassian Rovo. Learn how leading teams evolved from manual processes to deploying AI agents that run in the background, surface critical insights, and power everyday workflows across delivery, operations, and knowledge management.

sessions.t: AI-supported decision making in transport: Optimizing split orders
sessions.d: When delivery routes exceed truck capacity, planners make rapid decisions that affect cost, service levels, and operational efficiency. EPAM and Ahold Delhaize share how they captured expert planner knowledge and turned it into an AI-powered decision-support solution built on Microsoft AI. Learn how AI, real-time optimization, and human-in-the-loop decision making reduced standby truck usage, improved route utilization, and created a foundation for intelligent supply chain operations.

sessions.t: Any source to Azure: Infrastructure, applications & databases together
sessions.d: Enterprise migrations fail when infrastructure, application, and database workstreams run separately. Each team handoff is a potential failure point. Concierto's unified AI platform assesses, migrates, and modernizes all three layers together in a single coordinated execution, from any source to Azure. One assessment pass covers your entire estate. One platform takes it to completion - in weeks, not the several months that fragmented approaches routinely take.

sessions.t: The adaptive enterprise: Ready for what’s next
sessions.d: AI, evolving security threats, workforce expectations, and greater IT complexity change what enterprises need from technology. In this on-demand session, Brian Madden explores what it means to become an adaptive enterprise and how Citrix helps organizations respond to change with greater agility, resilience, and control while they provide secure, high-performance work experiences across complex environments.

sessions.t: Accelerate safe AI with three essential checks
sessions.d: AI mistakes are happening. Learn three key things to help you confidently scale AI with Microsoft 365 and Veeam. See what AI can actually reach, clean up what it shouldn't, and keep the whole estate recoverable if needed. You'll leave with three checks to run before your next AI rollout.

sessions.t: Your apps are down. What comes back first?
sessions.d:
When Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams go down together, most IT teams have backup, but no plan for what comes back first. Rubrik heard this everywhere, including from Simpson Strong-Tie: nobody had defined critical people in advance, so recovery got improvised, costing days.
In this fireside, Varun Grover and Mohammad Akram cover Autonomous Business Recovery: restoring the Minimum Viable Company first. Recovery that took 7-10 days now lands under 3 hours.

sessions.t: What should you expect from Enterprise Linux today?
sessions.d: Learn what to consider when building a Linux environment that can stay secure, consistent, and manageable across your enterprise. Explore four key areas: silicon and cloud compatibility, ecosystem support, codebase consistency, and security and compliance. See how Ubuntu and Landscape put these principles into practice with fleet management and automation, plus integration with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.

sessions.t: Accelerate mission-critical modernization with agentic AI
sessions.d: Modernizing mission-critical systems is complex, but delaying change can increase risk. Join Kyndryl and Microsoft to explore how agentic AI can accelerate modernization across complex application estates while maintaining governance, resiliency, and control. Learn how AI-powered insights help assess workloads, prioritize opportunities, reduce complexity, and speed transformation. Discover practical approaches that deliver measurable business value and support an AI-ready future.

sessions.t: Demystify Oracle AI database to Azure migrations
sessions.d: Think migrating Oracle AI Database from an on-premises environment to Azure is complex and risky? Think again. Discover a proven framework that takes the guesswork out of migration. See how Oracle Zero Downtime Migration minimizes disruption, and how programs like Microsoft Cloud Accelerate Factory provide deployment assistance and architecture guidance from Azure experts. Gain the tools, expertise, and confidence to plan and execute a smooth migration to Oracle AI Database@Azure.

sessions.t: The click your Zero Trust strategy needs to watch
sessions.d: Zero Trust verifies your laptops and servers, but what happens when an AI agent reads, classifies, and routes every document moving through your print and scan environment? Corey Ercanbrack, CTO of Vasion, runs a live audit: agent identity against verify explicitly, folder scope against least privilege, and a hidden prompt inside a real document against assume breach. Walk out with three questions to take back to your own security team.

sessions.t: Go beyond the license to govern Copilot adoption and AI budget
sessions.d: Getting value from Copilot goes beyond licensing. Adoption efforts can rely on guesswork, and requests for more tokens can be inconsistent and ungoverned. This session tackles both challenges. Organizations that succeed with Copilot run targeted adoption campaigns and turn requests for additional AI budget into a governed cycle tied to stated business needs. Join this session to learn how to turn your Copilot investment into ROI you can prove.

sessions.t: Protect the endpoint before Windows even loads
sessions.d: AI-era threats don’t wait for Windows to load, so endpoint security can’t either. Discover ASUS ExpertGuardian, the enterprise-grade, multi-layer security architecture built into ASUS ExpertBook business PCs. See how a physically isolated Security Processor Unit, self-healing BIOS Recovery, chassis intrusion detection, NIST SP 800-193-aligned resilience, post-quantum cryptography, and UEFI-level media sanitization help keep your fleet protected, compliant, and future-ready.

sessions.t: Gain hybrid cloud flexibility beyond legacy virtualization
sessions.d: Licensing changes and rising costs in legacy virtualization are prompting infrastructure teams to rethink where workloads run. See how Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) on Azure extends the Nutanix software stack to Azure BareMetal Infrastructure. Learn how to migrate VMware workloads to Azure while preserving familiar tools, skills, and operating practices and minimizing the disruption of adopting a new stack.

sessions.t: Future of work with AI: How AI changes the workplace
sessions.d: As enterprises navigate the next phase of digital transformation, artificial intelligence serves as an important enabler of productivity, agility, and employee experience. In this leadership conversation, Jared Spataro of Microsoft and Shishank Gupta of Infosys share insights on the digital workplace and how enterprises can prepare for a more intelligent, connected future of work.

sessions.t: HPE ProLiant Compute Premier Solutions for Azure Local
sessions.d: Discover how HPE ProLiant Compute Premier Solutions for Azure Local simplify hybrid cloud with pre-integrated infrastructure, Azure integration, and enterprise-ready performance. Learn how these solutions help organizations modernize, scale, and deploy from edge to cloud.

sessions.t: Govern AI at scale with HCLTech Agent Passport
sessions.d: Explore how Agent Passport provides risk and compliance oversight across AI agents through a unified portfolio view. Visualize risk exposure by harm and reach, track mitigation and enforce regulatory guardrails. Manage exceptions through time-bound approvals and compensating controls while monitoring incidents from detection to closure. Gain visibility into risk tiers, regulatory obligations and compliance gaps to strengthen governance and ensure AI agents operate within defined risk boundaries.

sessions.t: Modernize IT service management with AI and automation
sessions.d: AI is transforming ITSM. See how Azure AI Language and Azure AI Foundry, with deep, native integrations across Microsoft Teams, Intune, and Office 365, can help automate ticket triage, resolve requests faster, and unify service management across applications. See these capabilities in action with TeamDynamix through a no-code platform built for power without complexity and low admin overhead. Walk away with a practical, real-world blueprint for modernizing ITSM in your organization.

sessions.t: Validate continuous change at the speed of AI
sessions.d: AI has accelerated enterprise change, but validation remains manual and slow. As remediation timelines shrink from days to hours, IT teams can face a difficult choice: delay critical updates or deploy without proof. See how Microsoft’s agent platform enables continuous, autonomous validation with governed identity, audit-ready evidence, and human approval at every critical step through a demonstration from WorkspaceDNA CTO Samit Halvadia.

sessions.t: AI SRE in production: What actually gets automated safely
sessions.d: AIOps has moved past the demo stage and into real on-call rotations, but its effectiveness sits somewhere between the hype and the skepticism. This talk is a field report from running LLM-driven remediation in production: what it fixed, what it broke, and where automation has to stop and human judgment has to take over.

sessions.t: Take the mystery out of Autopilot enrollment
sessions.d: An Autopilot enrollment is a black box: it either finishes, or it doesn't. Reconstructing what happened from logs on a wiped device can be difficult. See how Autopilot Monitor tracks enrollments live with 200+ signals per session, event timelines, automatic diagnostics, failure analytics, and fleet health. Through live demos, explore how companies and MSPs can investigate enrollment issues and query telemetry using an AI assistant over MCP.

sessions.t: Simplify identity and device migrations during business transformation
sessions.d: Business mergers, acquisitions, and modernization demand speed and accuracy. Identity expert Conrad Murray demonstrates how PowerSyncPro automates AD synchronization and enables workstation migrations while preserving user profiles, apps, and identities. See the solution in action and learn how to simplify identity and device migrations while minimizing disruption.

sessions.t: Prepare for the next wave of AI and identity cyber risk
sessions.d: Managing AI initiatives while navigating the potential risks to your cyber resilience? You aren’t alone. Agentic and generative AI are multiplying the number of non-human identities (NHIs), secrets, and access paths in your environment. Explore how these shifts are changing the risk profile of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta, and what IT and cybersecurity teams can do now to stay ahead of AI-related threats.

sessions.t: Govern IT at frontier pace: Endpoint readiness in an AI world
sessions.d: AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery and shrinking the time IT teams have to respond. Can your ITOps team keep pace without sacrificing governance, security, or control? Explore why endpoint management is critical in the AI era, where automation can introduce risk, and how policy-driven operations can help your team move from reactive work to proactive endpoint readiness. See how Automox approaches Frontier Pace Governance to help IT move quickly while maintaining control.

sessions.t: Overcome the challenges of adopting AI for DevOps and SRE
sessions.d: Coding agents have transformed how software gets written. Bringing that same impact to infrastructure operations is harder: context is scattered across tools, systems are live, and actions can affect production. Explore those challenges and see how Plural addresses them with hosted agents, connected infrastructure, and configurable permissions. Through practical examples, learn how to configure agents to investigate issues, gather evidence, and reduce manual effort.

sessions.t: Unlock more value from voice, CX, and AI
sessions.d:
AI is changing enterprise communications, but the real opportunity comes when conversations connect to the wider business.
More insight. More efficiency. Better customer experiences.
In this session, we share three real-world examples showing how voice, conversational intelligence, workflows, and AI can improve customer experiences, automate processes, unlock actionable insights and deliver more value from your Microsoft 365 investment. Experience practical examples of what’s possible.

sessions.t: CiraSync in action: One platform, always synced
sessions.d: One platform. Every contact. Every calendar. Every device. This live virtual demo shows how CiraSync keeps contacts and calendars connected across Microsoft 365 and employee endpoints, automatically, securely, and at enterprise scale. See how CiraSync takes manual updates and duplicate data entry off IT Teams plate, saving hours of support tickets every month while giving them one less thing to manage.

sessions.t: Strong enough for the enterprise, built for IT
sessions.d: See how a privileged access management solution delivers the security depth large organizations demand while being designed around the people who actually run IT. Watch it in action and learn how it can simplify privileged access management for your IT teams.

sessions.t: Get trusted answers to compliance questions in Copilot
sessions.d: AI answers are only as trustworthy as the knowledge they draw from. See how getAbstract curates and verifies knowledge across industries and job roles, then brings that knowledge into Microsoft Copilot. Explore how organizations can provide role- and sector-relevant knowledge for areas such as consulting, regulatory compliance, and financial services to help users get more grounded, trusted answers.

sessions.t: Extend Microsoft ADCS for the AI and post-quantum era
sessions.d: Microsoft ADCS is a proven foundation, but CA sprawl, shorter certificate lifetimes, AI and post-quantum security are increasing operational pressure. Learn how Entrust helps simplify and govern ADCS environments, strengthen lifecycle management, protect critical CA keys with crypto-agile nShield HSMs, and preserve Microsoft investments while building a more resilient, post-quantum-ready PKI.

sessions.t: Strengthen identity recovery across Entra ID and hybrid environments
sessions.d: As organizations rely more on Microsoft 365, identity is essential to business continuity. Access to email, applications, devices, collaboration, and administration depends on Microsoft Entra ID, while many organizations still operate Active Directory and hybrid identity environments. Learn where recovery gaps emerge, how administrative and synchronization failures disrupt operations, what Microsoft’s native capabilities address, and how to build a more resilient identity recovery strategy.

sessions.t: Build data security for an AI-enabled workforce
sessions.d: Employees paste customer records, source code, and financial data into AI tools every day, often without security visibility. Learn how to protect sensitive data across an AI-enabled workforce using data classification, DLP, and DSPM, supported by identity, endpoint, and Zero Trust controls. Through a real deployment, we cover data labeling, Copilot prompt governance, and Shadow AI risk mitigation, leaving you with an L300 blueprint and actionable next steps.

sessions.t: SAP frontier transformation with AI intelligence
sessions.d: Modernize your SAP estate with an ontology-driven intelligence layer that connects transactional data with Microsoft IQ and Microsoft Foundry. Explore how unified business ontologies connect core enterprise entities to support insights across supply chain, inventory, assets, and plant operations. Through customer case studies and demos, learn how AI systems help organizations move from reactive analytics toward proactive, automated decision processes.

sessions.t: Transform your IT with adaptive cloud innovation from Azure Local
sessions.d: This session dives into how Azure Local brings hybrid agility to your infrastructure, combining cloud-native management with the ability to run services like Azure Virtual Desktop and Azure Kubernetes Service on-prem. We’ll spotlight DataON Premier Solutions+, which expands on Microsoft Premier Solution requirements to provide a robust experience that includes a turnkey Azure Local solution, deployment, integration, hybrid implementation, and lifecycle training services.

sessions.t: From installer to Intune: AI-powered app packaging
sessions.d: Every Intune admin knows the drill: download an installer, hunt for the silent switch, write a detection rule, test it, and start over when a vendor ships an update. In this demo, Microsoft MVP Maxime Guillemin shows how an AI-powered workflow handles package creation, detection logic, validation, and built-in security checks, turning a raw installer into a validated, Intune-ready package. The result: less time spent on repetitive packaging work and a faster path from update to deployment.

sessions.t: Unimax at a Glance
sessions.d: Discover Unimax, a leading provider of UC Management Software that simplifies communications management, reduces operational costs, strengthens security, and improves organizational efficiency. Explore its innovative solutions for automation, analytics, provisioning, and unified administration across multi-vendor communication environments.

sessions.t: Turn DNS and network data into actionable workflows
sessions.d:
You run Microsoft DNS and DHCP. You also run everything else. That fragmentation leaves network and security teams with an incomplete view of what is on the network. 
This demo-led session shows how EfficientIP overlays Microsoft, Azure, and third-party DNS, adds IPAM and asset discovery, and builds one authoritative network view. See how that intelligence feeds network and security workflows to strengthen governance, reduce risk, and accelerate anomaly investigation.

sessions.t: Make agent-generated documents consistent and auditable
sessions.d: LLMs are great at drafting but not designed for repeatable output. When AI generates a contract or invoice, consistency matters. See how Doctavian uses MCP to interpret intent, render deterministic output, and add eIDAS-compliant digital signatures and audit trails. Learn a practical approach to building consistent, compliant agent-driven document workflows in Microsoft 365 and beyond.

sessions.t: Govern Microsoft and hybrid collaboration lifecycle automation
sessions.d: Migrating to or expanding use of Microsoft Teams is only the beginning. Learn how to move from one-time migrations to governed collaboration operations at scale. See how to unify readiness assessment, validated planning, and governed provisioning across hybrid environments with Akkadian Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform. Use drift detection and event-driven orchestration to help reduce risk, cut manual effort, and maintain auditable control.

sessions.t: Beyond the bot: AI-powered customer experiences in Microsoft Teams
sessions.d: See how Landis delivers modern customer experiences in Microsoft Teams. This session demonstrates an AI chatbot that answers questions and transfers conversations with full context, live supervisor monitoring and intervention tools, and a no-code CRM and CX connector that brings business data into the agent experience—all supporting a vision of the contact center as the hub for interactions, context, and tools.

sessions.t: Turn AI ambition into business impact
sessions.d: What does it take to operationalize AI at scale? Straive’s CEO, Ankor Rai, explains how combining AI development and deployment with expert-in-the-loop operations helps global enterprises reduce costs, accelerate processes, and create new customer offerings. Discover Straive’s approach to selecting fit-for-purpose technology, moving from ideas to working proofs of concept in 7–14 days, and continuously improving AI in real-world business environments.

sessions.t: Know when AI should yield to human judgment
sessions.d: AI has become remarkably capable at analysis, correlation, recommendation, and prediction. Yet the closer AI gets to decisions with real operational consequences, the more administrators insist on human authority in the final dispatch. Using 2026 survey data from more than 1,000 sysadmins, this session examines where that boundary exists, why it persists, and what it tells us about the future of autonomous IT.

sessions.t: Secure AI infrastructure on Azure
sessions.d: Securing AI infrastructure on Azure requires consistent visibility and control. In this demonstration, see how customers can gain visibility into the AI applications running in their Azure environment. Explore transitioning from discovery to enforcement using Palo Alto Networks' firewall portfolio to apply consistent, AI-powered security policies.

sessions.t: Scale governed AI from pilots to production
sessions.d: Many organizations have piloted AI and deployed copilots, but scaling across the enterprise requires production-grade governance. This session shares frameworks for moving from experimentation to measurable impact: governance models, LLMOps/AgentOps, risk management, and human oversight. Attendees leave with practical guidance for turning AI investments into repeatable business outcomes.

sessions.t: Overcome pricing complexity and sales inefficiency in Dynamics 365
sessions.d: Complex companies live and die by how fast they can turn a pricing decision into a quote a buyer can act on. When pricing and quoting operate separately from CRM, handoffs can add delays and slow deals. See how Conga's pricing and CPQ solutions work within Microsoft Dynamics 365 to bring intelligent, guided selling into the sales workflow, helping teams make informed pricing and margin decisions and move from pricing to quote more efficiently.

sessions.t: Navigate Frontier Accelerate incentives to drive partner growth
sessions.d: Identifying eligible customers, qualifying opportunities, estimating Azure growth, and managing incentives from nomination through claim approval can be complex. See how SDC, ISV, and services partners can navigate Microsoft’s Frontier Accelerate incentives with experts from TPM. Learn how partner-led models work, how Microsoft connects incentives to customer ACR, and what to know about eligibility, customer qualification, governance, and proof of execution.

sessions.t: AI-scale growth: How Hugging Face and Instacart scale in-memory data
sessions.d: AI companies can experience rapid growth that places new demands on in-memory data infrastructure, from thread bottlenecks and resharding to tail latency and backup memory use. Explore how two teams address these challenges. Hugging Face split its Redis setup as the Hub reached 3 million models, then adopted Dragonfly to simplify operations. Instacart replaced 348 ElastiCache nodes with 100 Dragonfly nodes and reduced average and P99 latency by 40–50%, with no customer impact.

sessions.t: Is it still C#? Practical systems programming with .NET
sessions.d: We built a database in .NET and pushed the runtime to its limits. In this session, we’ll dissect the engineering decisions we made, extracting hard-won lessons you can use to build truly high-performance software. Expect battle-tested techniques you can apply to any demanding .NET service, even if it’s not a database. Explore JSON & Beyond, The Memory Game, Taming the State Machine, Beyond Cache Line, and more.

sessions.t: Connect Microsoft 365 and the built environment
sessions.d: Discover how to connect Microsoft 365, Microsoft Places, and Copilot to the built environment with Eptura. In this technical session, explore the architecture, data, and orchestration that turn digital context into physical workplace action. Learn how to coordinate people, buildings, rooms, desks, visitors, assets, and services through one connected experience.

sessions.t: Build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start
sessions.d: Enterprises often treat migration and governance as separate phases by moving data first and then planning to clean up permissions and compliance gaps once the dust settles. When that cleanup doesn't happen on schedule, the gap becomes a growing liability the moment AI agents and Copilot start touching that same ungoverned data. Explore how to approach migration and governance as one project and build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start.

sessions.t: Teams private chat migration
sessions.d: Microsoft Teams plays an important role in how organizations communicate and collaborate, which makes private chat history an important consideration for Microsoft 365 migrations. The Teams Private Chat Migration capability in MigrationWiz helps organizations migrate private chat history as part of a tenant-to-tenant migration.

sessions.t: From concept to containment, see the agentic SOC in practice
sessions.d: Explore the evolution from traditional MDR to an agentic SOC through three simulated security incidents of increasing severity. Learn how machine-speed investigation and response, combined with security context, pre-authorized actions, and granular governance, enable faster threat containment without sacrificing control. Gain practical guidance for evaluating modern security providers based on speed, decision quality, policy integration, and auditability.

sessions.t: Protect your identity layer with Entra ID backup and recovery
sessions.d: Identity systems are prime targets for ransomware and AI-driven attacks, making recovery planning an essential part of cyber resilience. Explore what organizations should consider protecting across Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, app registrations, and Conditional Access policies. Learn how backup and recovery strategies can complement Microsoft’s identity capabilities, help organizations prepare for compromised accounts, accidental deletions, and misconfigurations, and reduce recovery

sessions.t: Build agentic Al applications with Azure Cobalt 200
sessions.d: Explore the growing partnership between Arm and Microsoft and how their collaboration is advancing cloud computing and AI innovation. This session will highlight Microsoft Azure Cobalt 200, real-world customer adoption and the benefits of Arm-based infrastructure. Discover how CPUs are powering agentic AI workloads through a live demonstration, and learn about the tools, resources and best practices available to help developers migrate and optimize applications for Arm-based cloud environments.

sessions.t: Make always-on compliance a reality
sessions.d: Learn how to move beyond periodic reviews and manual updates. See how continuous intelligence and agent-led workflows strengthen risk coverage, reduce operational costs, and build regulatory confidence within your existing tech stack.

sessions.t: MSIX transformation and delivery of the modern Windows app lifecycle
sessions.d: Modernizing identity, cloud, and virtual desktops is only part of the journey. Legacy installers, packaging backlogs, and slow application delivery can still stand in the way. See how appCURE works with Microsoft technologies to turn legacy and new applications into clean MSIX packages, then deliver and manage them at runtime. Learn how Microsoft Entra and appCURE work together to help organizations modernize application access and delivery.

sessions.t: Secure Copilot with lessons from real-world AI vulnerabilities
sessions.d: As AI works across enterprise data, understanding emerging security risks is essential to using it with confidence. Explore three vulnerabilities identified by Varonis Threat Labs: Reprompt, SearchLeak, and CoSnitch, all responsibly disclosed and fixed in collaboration with Microsoft. Learn from this research and explore practical steps organizations can take to strengthen security as they adopt Microsoft Copilot.

sessions.t: Beyond code conversion: Rebuild COBOL applications with Azure AI
sessions.d: Moving COBOL to the cloud shouldn't mean taking decades of technical debt with it. See how Publicis Sapient's Sapient Slingshot AI platform uses Azure OpenAI to extract business logic from legacy code, turn it into reviewable specifications and rebuild applications as cloud-native Java microservices. In this demonstration, explore AI-driven modernization from code analysis to generated services and automated tests—and discover a smarter path beyond line-by-line translation.

sessions.t: How AI coworkers can run IT, HR, and service operations
sessions.d: Most service teams are buried in questions they have already answered. This session shows how autonomous service operations take that load off the queue: AI coworkers resolve access requests, password resets and troubleshooting end to end, verifying identity and following your access policies, with a human in the loop wherever policy requires one. Learn how conversation insights reveal why tickets keep coming, so deflection rises because you fix the cause, not because you add headcount

sessions.t: The path to Copilot success: From readiness to business impact
sessions.d: The challenge with Microsoft 365 Copilot isn't understanding what it can do—it's knowing where it can create real business value and being ready to scale it. Join New Charter to explore a practical approach to identifying use cases, preparing your data and governance, and driving adoption. We'll share real-world lessons and introduce our Wayfinder approach for moving from AI experimentation to measurable outcomes.

sessions.t: Prepare for .NET 8 and .NET 9 end of support
sessions.d: .NET 8 and .NET 9 reach Microsoft end of support on the same day, November 10, 2026. Learn what this transition means for security, compliance, and cyber insurance considerations. This session covers why the shared deadline matters for mixed .NET 8 and .NET 9 environments, what changes after support ends, how auditors and insurers assess unsupported software, and how to evaluate applications for migration to .NET 10 or continued security support.

sessions.t: Guardrails and governance strike back
sessions.d: An AI agent can stay within every permission, touch only allowed data, pass every security check and still potentially cause harm. Cut through the noise around agentic guardrails and governance with two anchors: Can vs. Should, which asks whether an agent’s next action makes sense beyond permission; and Point-in-Time vs. the Chain, which shows how risk can emerge across a sequence of individually reasonable actions. Learn how to question governance claims and build more effective controls.

sessions.t: Future of AI collaboration in the workplace with Neat and Microsoft
sessions.d: Watch Neat CEO Javed Khan and Ilya Bukshteyn, Corporate VP of Microsoft Teams Calling, Meetings, and Devices, discuss the evolution of intelligent collaboration spaces, modern IT management, and how Neat and Microsoft work together to support shared customers and their Microsoft Teams Rooms investments.

sessions.t: AI, security, and Microsoft 365 integrations with Foxit
sessions.d: Join Foxit's Lisa Caudillo and Connor Porter to see how employees can use AI on their documents while IT stays in control. Learn the three ways Foxit AI Assistant runs: cloud models including Azure OpenAI from Microsoft Foundry, on-device models from Microsoft Foundry, or your own endpoint. See AI Workspace turn Microsoft 365 content into finished work. Then watch Foxit roll out with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft Purview.

sessions.t: Transform meeting spaces with easy-to-deploy collaboration solutions
sessions.d: Walk through a full demo of Yealink MeetingBar A50 and MeetingBoard Pro. With straightforward deployment, these devices can seamlessly transform your meeting spaces and boost collaboration efficiency. See the MeetingBar A50 and MeetingBoard Pro in action and explore their capabilities firsthand.

sessions.t: Evolve from AI-assisted coding to AI-enabled SDLC
sessions.d: AI coding tools can accelerate development, but speed alone does not create production value. Learn how to evolve from AI-assisted coding to an AI-enabled software development lifecycle by redesigning processes, team roles, governance, and cost management. Explore practical lessons for limiting technical debt, governing agent ecosystems, and applying the engineering discipline needed to move AI solutions from prototype to trusted, scalable production.

sessions.t: Beyond backup: Easy disaster recovery for complex Azure workloads
sessions.d: Backups and a runbook won’t recover a complex Azure application fast enough. In this 20-minute session, Arpio’s Christopher Chandler shows how Total Environment Recovery™ protects 70+ Azure resource types (data, infrastructure, networking, identities and config) and brings your entire environment back online in minutes in another region or subscription. Learn about pilot-light architecture, clean-room ransomware recovery, and nondisruptive DR testing.

sessions.t: Govern autonomous engineering inside your Azure tenant
sessions.d: Bring autonomous engineering into your existing Microsoft environment with BuildEngine by Eido. Use Microsoft Foundry to access models from OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, and others while keeping execution, governance, and control inside your Azure tenant. See agents tackle real engineering tasks with Windows 365 for Agents and existing Intune policies, with human approval gates, audit history, model choice, and cost controls.

sessions.t: Transform your SDLC into a self-improving software factory
sessions.d: Building AI agents is easy. Keeping them accurate, cost-efficient, governed, reliable, and secure in production is the hard part. As AI multiplies code volume, engineering teams face "agent sprawl" and technical debt. Learn how to transform your SDLC into a self-improving software factory, with real-world examples for private agent evaluations, governance, and cost management, regardless of the coding agent harness.

sessions.t: From AI assistance to accountable execution
sessions.d: See how AI agents, human review, and business systems work together in an accountable workflow. Follow a customer inquiry from information review through human decision points to response preparation, and explore the platform that supports the application, data, identity, and operational visibility across the process.

sessions.t: Capture, curate, and deliver trusted knowledge for people and agents
sessions.d: Synthesize and store context scattered across tools—like past decisions, judgements, and learnings—to build a living memory. As an always-on curation engine, Stack Internal resolves stale, conflicting, and missing information in real-time, eliminating manual documentation and costly knowledge loss. Verified knowledge is mapped to role-based permissions and domain-specific scopes, and surfaced where the work is happening.

sessions.t: Give AI agents data they can trust
sessions.d: AI agents are moving from copilots to autonomous action. But agents need trusted enterprise context to reason, decide, and act with confidence. Learn how Reltio, an SAP company, puts trusted data and business context to work for agentic AI, turning fragmented information into grounded intelligence that helps AI agents deliver real business outcomes.

sessions.t: Build a Frontier Firm with enterprise AI in practice
sessions.d: Frontier Firms emerge when AI becomes part of governed business and technology operations. Reaching this point requires trusted data, production-ready platforms, clear controls, and teams ready to adapt. Improving shares practical patterns across Azure AI landing zones, Microsoft Fabric data foundations, agent development, GitHub Copilot adoption, governance, and workforce enablement. Explore the next phase of enterprise AI and the operating changes required to support it.

sessions.t: Manage your AI risks and outcomes across your security operations
sessions.d: Managing AI risk requires connecting governance, compliance, exposure management, and security operations. Learn how to protect agents, identities, data, endpoints, and infrastructure while maintaining human accountability. See how CyberMSI AI Trust, built on Microsoft’s Unified Security Operations platform, combines AI-driven protection, 24x7 MDR, and analyst-on-the-loop oversight to help organizations manage AI risk.

sessions.t: Set AI in motion with agent squads for legacy systems
sessions.d: AI ambition is everywhere. Operational impact is not. In this session, watch a working squad of AI agents tackle one of the toughest enterprise challenges: understanding legacy systems that still run the business. Working within defined roles, tools, and guardrails, the agents analyze an unfamiliar codebase and produce a traceable inventory of business rules and risks. Learn three design principles behind the approach: composable agents, engineered context, and human oversight.

sessions.t: Manage SharePoint agents with SharePoint Advanced Management
sessions.d: Site owners and business users can build their own agents on top of SharePoint content, creating new considerations for admins around visibility, access, and governance. In this 20-minute session, see how SharePoint Advanced Management reports, PowerShell, and the Microsoft Agent 365 control plane can help you discover and report on agents across your tenant and govern potential risks. We will close by showing how Syskit Point can extend these capabilities to help take agent governance further.

sessions.t: Follow one record: What an AI agent will hand over if you ask nicely
sessions.d: A shopping assistant built on Azure AI Foundry does its job: answer questions, look up accounts, be helpful. Then someone asks it to confirm a record “for the migration,” and it returns a name, email, Social Security number and full card number. Follow that record from Blob Storage through the agent’s tool call into the answer, trace where data can be exposed on the way, and find the one configuration change separating an agent that leaks from one that refuses, though both look protected.

sessions.t: Your global admin deserves better than your everyday laptop
sessions.d: As AI changes the threat landscape, protecting privileged access is increasingly important to an assume-breach security strategy. See how to separate privileged access from everyday work and strengthen protection beyond traditional approaches. Explore a Microsoft architecture using Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Conditional Access, and AVD to help limit lateral movement and better protect critical assets.

sessions.t: Yealink AuraVision: Where sound meets sight, naturally
sessions.d: Based on AV ONE intelligence, AuraVision orchestrates multiple cameras and Yealink Dante ceiling microphones within a unified spatial coordinate system, creating seamless mic‑camera coordination with minimal setup. The coordination makes for a more natural, intelligent meeting experience.

sessions.t: From legacy recording to AI-ready communications data
sessions.d: AI does not solve fragmented communications data. It makes the quality, accessibility, and trustworthiness of that data more important. Learn how regulated organizations can unlock historical communications, retire aging infrastructure, and create a trusted data foundation on Microsoft Azure to prepare communications data for AI.

sessions.t: Scale AI beyond pilots with a practical operating model
sessions.d: Every enterprise is investing in AI, yet many pilots never reach production because organizational readiness, not technology alone, determines success. Drawing on 25+ enterprise engagements, iLink Digital’s Field CTO shares a practical Frontier Transformation framework for transforming processes, decisions, and the workforce. Learn how structured agent discovery, portfolio-based delivery paths, and a Microsoft AI foundation can help drive adoption and scalable business outcomes.

sessions.t: Meet an AI receptionist that answers calls, 24/7
sessions.d: Businesses want to respond to every customer quickly, but high call volumes and limited staff can make that difficult. Missed calls and long waits can mean lost opportunities and frustrated customers. See how an AI receptionist can handle common requests, schedule appointments, and route callers to the right person. Explore how conversational AI can help reduce missed calls, support consistent service, and extend responsiveness beyond staffed hours.

sessions.t: Agentic procurement in action: From a Teams request to a compliant PO
sessions.d: Procurement teams lose hours chasing approvals and retyping data across disconnected systems. See how UiPath flips that: requests start in Microsoft Teams, policies apply in real time, and AI agents handle price benchmarking and contract checks while buyers and approvers make the calls. Two demos show a catalog order and a complex software purchase with parallel legal and security approvals, orchestrated across your existing ERP and tools.

sessions.t: Build durable workflows with Temporal
sessions.d: Through a practical Azure-focused demo, see how Temporal helps developers build reliable AI applications with standard application code. Learn how Temporal’s Durable Execution model simplifies state management, retries, and failure recovery across multi-step workflows while it preserves progress through failures. Explore how engineering teams can address reliability challenges as AI applications move from prototype to production.

sessions.t: Semantic foundation for enterprise AI
sessions.d: Give AI agents a shared understanding of your business data. See how Semantic Fabric builds the foundation for trusted agentic AI by creating a governed ontology, semantic layer and knowledge graph on OneLake. Aligned with Fabric IQ and Power BI and governed through Microsoft Purview, it provides shared enterprise context to Fabric data agents, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, enabling grounded, repeatable and contextually relevant responses.

sessions.t: Deliver trusted, accessible AI where your teams work
sessions.d: Business users work in Microsoft 365, but vital enterprise data lives in Snowflake. In this session, learn how Snowflake Cortex Agents integrate with Microsoft Copilot Studio to bring governed answers directly into Teams and Copilot. Users can query structured and unstructured data in plain language without bypassing Snowflake’s security. We’ll cover the architecture, live setup, and best practices to deploy trusted, data-backed AI agents inside everyday workflows.

sessions.t: The future of intelligent service with Zendesk and Microsoft
sessions.d: Hear Jay Emery, Sr. Director of Solution Engineering & Architecture at Microsoft, discuss how Microsoft and Zendesk are bringing AI-powered service into the flow of work through Teams, Copilot, and Agent 365, so employees can get help where they work and IT can manage agents with confidence.

sessions.t: Build an enterprise LLM platform with vLLM, Ray, and Anyscale
sessions.d: Whether you want to cut costs or gain control over your AI, open models offer a path forward. The hard parts are running LLMs at scale and building a platform that goes beyond inference, all securely within your environment. Ray is the open-source framework AI natives use to scale the full AI lifecycle, and Anyscale with its Azure-native service makes it enterprise-ready. In this session, we’ll deploy a coding agent on open models using vLLM and Ray Serve, all running in your own account.

sessions.t: When AI finds the bugs first: Lessons from PHP2Shell
sessions.d: In October, two hidden flaws in PHP pushed some banks, airlines and governments offline. AI found them, and attackers used AI to exploit them within hours. Aikido Security explains in plain language what happened, why it matters to both technical and nontechnical teams, how we shipped free fixes within a day, and five questions every team should ask. See how Aikido for Azure DevOps, GitHub and VS Code, and Noon for Microsoft 365 work with the Microsoft tools you already use.

sessions.t: Where does your data live? Unifying AI data on Azure with VAST
sessions.d: Data silos leave the average IT organization managing around 13 copies of its data, hiding business context, creating stale and ungoverned copies, and slowing AI projects. This session shows how VAST AI OS on Azure unifies file, object, database, and vector search in one platform, with event-driven processing and a global data view. Same software and APIs as on-premises, so teams can move AI from experiments to production.

sessions.t: Give AI agents grounded context for complex codebases
sessions.d: AI coding agents can move quickly, but they need reliable system context before they modify a complex codebase. In this session, see how CoreStory builds persistent, code-grounded intelligence across architecture, behavior, and intent and makes it available to people and AI agents through MCP. Learn how teams use that shared context to assess impact, understand constraints, and create implementation-ready specifications for maintenance and modernization work.

sessions.t: Many Domain Agents, One Governance Model: An Azure Pattern
sessions.d: Every business unit wants its own agent, and most platforms give each one its own identity, tool access and blind spots. This session traces a production multi-domain architecture end to end: one governed entry at the Azure API Management AI gateway, per-domain agents with scoped Entra Agent IDs, brokered tool access through governed MCP with content safety on tool-call arguments, and Foundry Control Plane across the fleet, all in the customer's own tenant.

sessions.t: From Ticket to PR: Field Lessons from an Autonomous Code Agent
sessions.d: What happens when an autonomous coding agent becomes part of the engineering team? For seven months, seven teams have run isolated agents 24/7, reviewing 100% of pull requests and implementing about 20% of tickets before human review. This session shares the field lessons behind that journey: where autonomy delivered value, where it broke down, where human approval remained essential, and the architectural boundaries needed to run autonomous coding safely and reliably in production.

sessions.t: Production Ready AI Agents: Identity, Containment, and Cost governance
sessions.d: Most teams can build an agent. Far fewer can operate one safely in a shared tenant. This session takes a document-processing agent with three production defects, over-scoped permissions, an unbounded retry loop, and uncontained code execution, and remediates each live: Entra Agent ID for per-agent identity, Microsoft Execution Containers for isolation, Agent Framework circuit breakers with Application Insights, Copilot Credits attribution, and portable policy via the Agent Control Specification.

sessions.t: AI Governance Playbook: Scaling Agents Without Chaos
sessions.d: AI agents are quickly moving from experimentation to enterprise deployment, but most organizations lack a governance model to manage them at scale. Learn how leading enterprises are governing agent lifecycles, ownership, permissions, security, compliance, and business value using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI. Leave with a practical framework to accelerate innovation while maintaining control and accountability.

sessions.t: From Champion to Community Leader: Turning Passion into Impact
sessions.d: Every community leader starts somewhere—helping a colleague, joining a user group, sharing what they've learned, finding a mentor, becoming a champion, or taking the leap to speak for the first time. Hear real stories from people who turned those moments into opportunities to lead, connect others, and create impact. Whether you're an AI champion, aspiring speaker, community organizer, MVP candidate, or simply looking for your next step, you'll leave with practical ideas for growing your influence, building your network, sharing your expertise, and finding your place in the Microsoft community.

sessions.t: Beyond Deployment: The Human Side of Copilot Adoption
sessions.d: Deploying Copilot is only the beginning. Lasting adoption happens when people understand the value, build confidence, learn from one another, and discover new ways of working. Explore how champions, peer learning, storytelling, and community can turn initial experimentation into sustained adoption. Hear practical approaches for creating momentum, surfacing success stories, building confidence, and helping employees develop AI habits that last.

sessions.t: Building Real Agents
sessions.d: Learn how to move from simple prompts to working agent experiences using Microsoft Foundry, with practical patterns attendees can apply in their own projects.

sessions.t: Safer Agentic Workflows
sessions.d: Explore guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop patterns that help agents stay useful, reliable, and easier to trust.

sessions.t: RAG: Two years later
sessions.d: Discover practical retrieval patterns that make agents more useful, grounded, and accurate when working with organizational or domain knowledge.

sessions.t: Choosing the Right Model
sessions.d: Panel: A practical discussion on how to match models to scenarios by balancing quality, cost, latency, and user experience in AI applications.

sessions.t: Closing the AI Adoption Gap: Women Shaping What's Next
sessions.d:
AI is transforming how we work, how companies operate, and the future of work. At the same time, research suggesting that women are adopting AI at a slower pace than men raises an important question: How do we ensure more women have the confidence, skills, and opportunities to shape what comes next? This panel brings together women working in AI today to share how they're driving innovation, empowering their teams and communities, and creating new opportunities for others to participate.

Panelists will share candid perspectives on the barriers that remain, practical approaches to closing the AI adoption gap, and actionable ideas to help more women move beyond using AI to influencing, building, and leading with it.

sessions.t: Azure Unplugged: Foundry IQ with Pablo Castro
sessions.d: Join Pablo Castro for a discussion on Foundry IQ, including the product vision, key scenarios, and how it can help developers and teams work with AI-powered knowledge more effectively.

sessions.t: Foundry Discord Live: Product Updates & Community AMA
sessions.d: Join Microsoft product teams, MVPs, and developer advocates for a live discussion on the latest Microsoft Foundry updates. We'll cover new capabilities, share real-world insights, answer community questions, and discuss what's next for developers building AI applications and agents. Bring your questions, connect with experts, and leave with practical ideas you can apply immediately.

sessions.t: BlueVoyant Perspective on ISOC
sessions.d: What does the shift to an integrated SOC look like in practice? BlueVoyant shares its early experience ISOC in Microsoft Defender, what they're hearing from customers, and how partners can help organizations bring SIEM and XDR together and take the next step toward agentic security.

sessions.t: AI at Risk: An Executive Frontier Immersion
sessions.d: Your organization is embracing AI faster than ever, but are you prepared for what comes next? In this interactive executive immersion, join the leadership team of a company facing the realities of AI agents operating across the enterprise. Through a series of strategic decision points, you'll tackle challenges in governance, security, visibility, accountability, and human oversight, gaining practical insights into how organizations can innovate faster while maintaining control and resilience.

sessions.t: Creating agent-ready data with Azure SQL Hyperscale & Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: Every organization runs on transactions, yet most still shuttle that transactional data around with fragile ETL jobs and schedulers, which often leaves AI agents making instant decisions using stale snapshots. Join us to see how Azure SQL Hyperscale, change event streaming, and Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric combine to create truly agent-ready data. Build a less fragile, event-driven architecture that keeps your agents current and your data IQ-ready.

sessions.t: Azure Friday with Scott Hanselman: Kinectify fights financial crime
sessions.d: Can AI help uncover the next big money-laundering scheme? Join Scott Hanselman and Kinectify for an interactive look at how machine learning and AI agents help detect suspicious activity in the gaming industry. Through a fictional investigation scenario, explore how transaction monitoring identifies potential risks and how agentic AI helps analysts connect the dots. Discover the engineering behind financial crime detection and why effective AI solutions go far beyond chatbots.

sessions.t: Azure Unplugged: A Chat with Kim Manis, CVP Real-Time Intelligence
sessions.d: Join Kim Manis, Corporate Vice President for Real-Time Intelligence & Observability, for a candid conversation about Microsoft Fabric’s journey from early mockups to a leading data platform. We’ll explore the future of real-time intelligence, Azure and AI-agent monitoring, and how product teams and communities can turn innovation into meaningful customer outcomes.

sessions.t: Scaling Copilot Studio Adoption Through Community-Led Agent Building
sessions.d: Building agents is only the first step. Sustainable adoption requires a community that helps people learn, experiment, share reusable practices, and move successful ideas forward. Explore how community-led agent building can create momentum for Copilot Studio, connect makers with experts, surface high-value scenarios, and help organizations scale agent adoption with greater confidence.

sessions.t: From Community to Production: Scaling Agentic Business Apps
sessions.d: Moving an agentic business application from an idea to production takes more than technology. It requires engaged users, practical feedback, shared standards, and a repeatable path from experimentation to business value. Learn how community programs can identify promising scenarios, connect builders and decision makers, and support the responsible scaling of agentic business applications.

sessions.t: Mentorship Matters: Relationships That Shape Careers
sessions.d: Careers rarely grow through hard work alone. Often, an important opportunity began because someone offered advice, opened a door, made an introduction, provided honest feedback, or simply said, "You should go for it." Hear candid stories about the relationships that changed career trajectories and explore the roles mentorship, sponsorship, allyship, and community can play in professional growth. Leave with practical ideas for strengthening your network, finding mentors and sponsors, becoming a better ally, and creating opportunities for others.

sessions.t: Azure Unplugged: Perspectives on sovereign public cloud
sessions.d: Join Allison Nachtigal, VP of Azure Customer and Field Experiences and Meena Gowdar, Partner Director of Product Management at Microsoft, leading Azure’s adaptive cloud infrastructure portfolio, including Azure Local, Azure Operator Nexus, Azure Stack, and Sovereign Private Cloud and Steve Melan, Azure MVP and Senior Solution Architect, for an engaging Azure Unplugged conversation on the growing importance of sovereign cloud.

sessions.t: Your existing apps, your next decade of cloud-native
sessions.d: Your existing applications still run the business. The question is what you gain from modernization and what it costs to stay put. This demo-first session shows how to move applications to Azure Container Apps without a rewrite or Kubernetes expertise. See how to operate production-ready autoscaling, identity, secrets, scale-to-zero economics and live operations/troubleshooting, investigation. Learn how operations change after migration and how the same platform enables AI and agent workloads.

sessions.t: Best practices for secure network architecture in the AI age
sessions.d: AI is transforming cybersecurity on both sides of the battle. Threat actors are using AI to automate attacks, while organizations must adopt more resilient defenses. This session explores secure networking architectures for the AI era, including Zero Trust, AI workload protection, segmentation, and multi-cloud security. Learn proven patterns and customer examples for securing AI environments, reducing risk, protecting data, and accelerating AI adoption with confidence.

sessions.t: AI Infrastructure Intelligence: Powering the next generation of AI
sessions.d: Maximizing performance, improving efficiency, increasing reliability, and simplifying operations are essential to delivering AI at scale. Join this session to see how AI Infrastructure Intelligence uses AI-driven insights and predictive analytics to help customers choose optimal AI infrastructure, maximize GPU efficiency, improve resiliency, and accelerate issue resolution. Discover how built-in intelligence across Azure AI Infrastructure helps organizations deploy faster and scale confidently.

sessions.t: Monitoring without polling: Real-time, change-driven monitoring
sessions.d: Modern observability collects telemetry in near real time, yet many monitoring workflows rely on periodic evaluation, adding latency and missing transient or absent conditions. This talk introduces change-driven monitoring, where continuous queries evaluate system state and trigger reactions as conditions change. Using Drasi, a Microsoft-backed CNCF Sandbox project, we’ll demonstrate detection of failures, stalled workflows, missing heartbeats, and SLO violations, with alerts and self-healing.

sessions.t: Copilot Cowork for Finance: Turn Forecasts into Review-Ready Insights
sessions.d: See how Copilot Cowork can support a real Microsoft Finance workflow. In 25 minutes, explore how skills and plugins can extend Cowork and help turn raw forecast numbers into clear, review-ready commentary. Leave with a reusable prompt and practical ideas for making recurring finance work more efficient while keeping people in control.

sessions.t: The New Rules of Enterprise Innovation: Build, Buy, or Partner?
sessions.d:
AI is rewriting the rules of enterprise innovation. As the pace of technological change accelerates, the traditional build-versus-buy decision is evolving into a more strategic question: What should enterprises build, buy, or partner on to stay competitive?

Increasingly, leading enterprises are turning to AI-native startups not just for access to cutting-edge technology, but to accelerate innovation, rethink existing workflows, and unlock new business opportunities.

Drawing on real-world examples and insights from across the global AI startup ecosystem, this session explores why startups are becoming strategic innovation partners, how enterprise leaders are rethinking their build-buy-partner strategies, and practical ways organizations can discover, evaluate, and collaborate with startups to turn emerging innovation into measurable business impact.

sessions.t: Writing the Referral That Gets Prioritized, and Working It to Stage 2
sessions.d: Enable partners to prioritize the highest-value customer opportunities. Improve co-sell execution and customer readiness. Increase conversion of Microsoft-generated opportunities into revenue outcomes.

sessions.t: Grow your business with Unified Broker and Unified EA Co-sell
sessions.d: Partners need new ways to create demand, reach customers, and accelerate growth. Learn how Unified Broker, a proven global partner motion, and Unified EA Co-sell, Microsoft’s newest collaborative selling pilot, help partners generate pipeline, expand reach, and accelerate deal closure. Hear real partner examples and leave with practical guidance to activate both motions.

sessions.t: From Millions of Signals to Ten Accounts You Can Actually Call
sessions.d: Microsoft propensity signals only create value when they become a call list. Walk through how partners prioritize the highest-value customer opportunities, convert Microsoft-generated signal into qualified pipeline, and improve co-sell execution and customer readiness — with the filters, thresholds, and account-selection logic partners can apply the same week.

sessions.t: The Missing Ingredient in Frontier Transformation
sessions.d: AI creates the possibility of Frontier Transformation, but technology alone does not make change stick. Through partner examples, this session reveals the missing ingredient between investment and measurable outcomes: the capacity to lead change. See how leadership, skills, adoption and experimentation combine with IAMCP's connect, learn and grow community model so partners learn from one another, transform their own organizations and guide customers with greater credibility and confidence.

sessions.t: What 164 ISVs Reveal About Winning with Microsoft AI
sessions.d: Partnership Leaders surveyed 164 technology companies and interviewed Microsoft partners to learn what separates AI ambition from AI growth. This session gives CEOs, CIOs, and CTOs four decisions they must get right: how to fund responsible AI deployment, use co-sell, remove Marketplace friction, and keep teams enabled as AI changes. Attendees leave with a data-backed plan to use the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program to speed customer adoption and revenue.

sessions.t: 10 Partner Center Hacks Microsoft Partners Need to Know
sessions.d: We'll reveal 10 overlooked Partner Center features, settings, and best practices that can help partners drive more incentives, improve co-sell readiness, strengthen performance, and uncover hidden growth opportunities. This will help you and your organization improve profitability, visibility, and operational efficiency within your Microsoft partnership. From referrals and business profiles to benefits, analytics, and incentive programs, gain new insights from Partner Center.

sessions.t: Frontier Firms Start with People
sessions.d: An energy services company with tens of thousands of field workers wanted to do AI. You cannot hand an agent to everyone on day one. Microsoft's Frontier Firm puts people and agents side by side, and people come first: map people, processes, and goals before picking a tool, then route each piece of work to an agent, a workflow, a process change, or leave it with people. Kori Hale of CultureBanx moderates a conversation with Ludia's Lucas Diaz and Danielle Estrada on a real engagement.

sessions.t: Why Copilot Adoption Stalls, and How Partners Can Fix It at Scale
sessions.d: Your customer bought Copilot. So why aren't they using it? They finished the training workshops, but then adoption stalls. Employees return to work, old habits take over, and reinforcement becomes difficult to sustain. Learn how partners are identifying what's blocking adoption and using AI to personalize support for every employee, at scale. Leave with the exact steps you can take to increase Copilot usage, reinforce new habits, and turn adoption support into a recurring services opportunity.

sessions.t: Jumpstart your partner-to-partner motion through Microsoft Marketplace
sessions.d: For software companies, one of the fastest ways to scale profitably and globally is to sell through channel partners. For services companies, reselling software products through Marketplace increases sales and retention with existing clients. In this intimate group session, software and services companies work through the partner-to-partner motion in real-time and leave with a concrete action plan to start theirs.

sessions.t: Nobody Becomes a Frontier Firm Alone
sessions.d: Microsoft partners are being asked to help customers become Frontier Firms, but transformation is never achieved through technology alone. In this small group discussion, partners share real journeys and work through how leadership, organizational change, experimentation and peer learning turn AI ambition into outcomes. Through IAMCP's global community, the group explores how shared experience helps partners transform their organizations, strengthen customer guidance and avoid common pitfalls.

sessions.t: 7 Operating Principles for Winning with Microsoft in the Age of AI
sessions.d: Microsoft resets priorities every July 1, and AI is rewriting how customers buy. With 40 years in the ecosystem and 300+ conversations with partner leaders, Vince Menzione shares the 7 Operating Principles behind the partners Microsoft sellers reach for first: Growth Mindset, Executive Commitment, Vision and Value Alignment, Maniacal Focus, Brand and Story, Getting Results, and Adaptability. Leave ready to sharpen co-sell and Marketplace execution and turn FY27 changes into growth.

sessions.t: Agents Are the New Service Principals. Only More Dangerous
sessions.d: Organizations are deploying AI agents faster than they can govern them. Unlike traditional apps, agents can reason, act, and interact across systems. In this fast-paced session, learn how to govern agents across Microsoft 365, Entra, Purview, and Foundry before they become your next security and compliance headache. Leave with a practical framework to answer: Who owns it, what can it access, how is it monitored, and who can shut it down?

sessions.t: Build an Agent Harness with Microsoft Agent Framework
sessions.d: Asking an LLM to generate a response in a chat is easy, but what about performing more complex tasks or workflows? Join this demo session to see how Microsoft Agent Framework helps you create an agent harness. You will see how to invoke functions, persist the session history, compact it, track to-do items, use memory, or handle approvals. YouÆll learn how to combine these building blocks into a practical, stateful agent to execute multi-step workflows - not just generate chat responses.

sessions.t: Building Cost Confidence for AI Transformation
sessions.d: As AI usage expands across users, agents, and workloads, organizations need confidence in cost planning. Join Andrews Bryant to explore AI FinOps and how AI Flex Plans, usage-based billing, and Copilot Credits can help align investment with adoption. Learn practical strategies for forecasting, cost governance, consumption insights, and building greater visibility, predictability, and control.

sessions.t: Skills in Microsoft Copilot
sessions.d:
Turn the way you work into expertise Copilot can reuse. In this session, discover how skills capture your processes, examples, and standards as reusable instructions—so you spend less time explaining recurring tasks and bring a more consistent approach to everyday work.
Learn how to create, refine, and share skills across supported Microsoft 365 experiences.

sessions.t: Why AI Fails Without a Knowledge Strategy
sessions.d:
Employees spend hours searching for information spread across emails, chats, meetings, documents, and business systems. AI can only be as effective as the knowledge it can access and understand. Discover how organizations can move beyond AI assistants that answer questions and toward AI systems that understand people, projects, content, relationships, and business context.

Leave with actionable next steps to help your organization unlock more value from its knowledge and AI investments.

sessions.t: Build AI-ready teams with Work IQ people and org context
sessions.d: AI workforce transformation starts with understanding your people and the work they do. Discover how people and organizational context in Work IQ personalizes Copilot experiences with trusted answers, while helping leaders identify opportunities and redesign workflows so teams are AI-ready. Learn how organizations can move beyond AI adoption and accelerate workforce transformation with actionable insights grounded in real work.

sessions.t: Monday morning triage: from Shadow AI to Governed AI in minutes
sessions.d: Start your Monday triage with known-agent risk, then expand to Shadow AI. See Microsoft Agent 365 demonstrations of Dynamic Agent Risk and Shadow AI discovery, including available device and user context. Hear Zenity’s perspective on runtime security, explore available controls, and understand the roadmap from discovery to governance. Leave with a repeatable routine to assess risk, investigate context, and prioritize action.

sessions.t: From goals to done: AI-powered work management with Microsoft Planner
sessions.d: Work management is where goals become real: plans are shaped, owners align, tasks move, and teams need to know what changed. See how AI-powered work management is coming together across Microsoft 365 through Planner Agent inside a plan, Planner capabilities in Copilot, and Cowork experiences that help work keep moving through the day. Explore practical scenarios that show how teams can stay aligned, adapt faster, and turn goals into results.

sessions.t: Mission Forward: Take Another Look at Copilot for U.S. Government
sessions.d: The pace of innovation in Microsoft Copilot for U.S. Government has never been greater. Join this demo-rich session to see how the latest AI innovations can help government organizations work more efficiently, make better decisions, and realize greater value from AI. See what’s new and discover new ways to move your mission forward.

sessions.t: Secure, Govern, and Scale: Protecting AI Agents with Microsoft Agent 365
sessions.d: See how Microsoft Agent 365 brings agent context and security evidence together. Follow demonstrations of registered-agent security and Microsoft Defender investigation, with Cyera and Darktrace perspectives on data and behavioral signals. Explore how proposed partner integrations could inform agent-risk assessment, then learn to choose supported responses. Leave with a practical workflow to discover, assess, investigate, and protect AI agents.

sessions.t: Driving business innovation with Copilot, Work IQ, and Power Platform
sessions.d: Your apps and Copilot just became one workflow. See how Microsoft 365 Copilot, Cowork, Work IQ, and Power Platform come together to create a single intelligent experience for getting work done. Learn how Work IQ grounds agents in business context and how existing apps can plug directly into Copilot and Cowork to drive productivity and automation. Live demos included.

sessions.t: One endpoint, every tool: MCP, A2A, and skills in Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: You don't have a tool problem. You have an integration problem — every agent team wiring the same MCP servers, APIs, and credentials over again. See how Toolboxes in Foundry unifies MCP servers, OpenAPI services, A2A agents, built-in tools, and skills behind a single MCP contract any framework can call. Change tools without touching agent code, send the model 3 relevant tools instead of 127, and govern identity, policy, and audit in one place.

sessions.t: Make every agent better: The continuous optimization loop
sessions.d: Building an agent is just the start. Watch a continuous improvement loop in action: use traces to spot a quality issue, review a proposed fix, optimize the agent, and measure what changed. See how improvements in quality, token use, and latency help you decide what to deploy and what to improve next.

sessions.t: Frontier open models, production-ready: Fireworks on Foundry
sessions.d: Open models are only as good as the platform that runs them. In this session, see how Fireworks on Microsoft Foundry takes frontier open models from evaluation to production — better price-performance, workload-specific sizing, and enterprise-grade reliability on Azure and learn how to use open models on Fireworks on Foundry to build agentic workloads for your customers.

sessions.t: Prompt caching at scale: Build faster, more efficient AI applications
sessions.d: Every AI request pays for a prefill phase before it generates a single token, and most production apps recompute the same system prompts, tool definitions, and retrieved context on every turn. Prompt caching removes that waste.In this session, learn how prompt caching reduce AI application cost and latency while increasing throughput, and how to pick the right Azure OpenAI caching strategy for your workload, from automatic to fully managed.

sessions.t: Build, scale, and monetize apps and agents with Microsoft Marketplace
sessions.d: AI is fundamentally changing cloud architecture. In this technical session, learn how to build, scale, and monetize AI applications and agents with Microsoft Marketplace. Explore best practices for architecting solutions for commercialization, packaging and monetizing your offerings, and leveraging Marketplace to reach millions of customers through Microsoft channels and partner ecosystems.

sessions.t: From code to control: Building on the agent platform
sessions.d: Building an agent is more than writing code; it requires an SDLC that carries it from idea to enterprise operation. Follow one agent end to end as we use GitHub to plan, build, review, secure, and evolve it; deploy it to Microsoft Foundry; and register, secure, govern, and monitor it with Microsoft Agent 365. You'll leave understanding how these platforms connect development and operations into a repeatable lifecycle for production-ready agents at enterprise scale.

sessions.t: Navigating AI spend across your organization
sessions.d: Follow a real-world journey from establishing spending policies and controls to optimizing AI investments and demonstrating business impact, with a live walkthrough of governance, analytics, forecasting, ROI insights, and experiences for IT admins, business/team leaders, and end users.

sessions.t: Turn a team conversation into a pull request
sessions.d: Watch GitHub Copilot turn a conversation in Teams or Slack into working code. The agent gathers context creates a fix runs tests and opens a pull request for review. See how a good idea can keep moving without another handoff meeting.

sessions.t: Is DOOM a Tensor?
sessions.d: Every AI model runs on tensors. But what is a tensor and can one run DOOM? Watch a classic game come to life inside an AI model while learning how models process information and why hardware matters. It is a ridiculous experiment with a useful payoff. You will leave understanding tensors better than any slide deck could manage.

sessions.t: Beyond the browser: Build a mobile app with GitHub Copilot
sessions.d: Take your idea beyond a browser prototype and onto a phone. Native mobile development brings platform tooling, device behavior, and build failures that generated code alone cannot solve. Watch GitHub Copilot agents help implement features, run builds and tests, and fix failures as we move from an idea to an app running on a device. Learn how to give agents the context and tools to do the work, while you guide the experience and review the results.

sessions.t: AT&T's enterprise-scale transcript intelligence with Foundry IQ
sessions.d: AT&T built the Ask Transcripts Insights Ecosystem on Foundry IQ, turning daily call volume into answers business teams act on minutes after a call ends. See the architecture: multi-model routing that holds quality while keeping cost sustainable, near real-time pipelines at telco scale, and a plugins design that ships new use cases without a rewrite. AT&T shares what they would do differently, and how it now powers proactive marketing, care coaching, anomaly detection, and compliance monitoring.

sessions.t: Build once, ground many with Fabric IQ
sessions.d: See how Fabric IQ can help teams create governed business context once and reuse it across analytics, copilots, and custom agents. This session shows how shared concepts, relationships, and rules can reduce duplicated grounding work, improve consistency, and help organizations prepare for broader AI adoption across domains with ontologies in Fabric IQ.

sessions.t: Move to Web IQ: What changes and how to get started
sessions.d: Learn what developers need to know when moving from Grounding with Bing to Web IQ. This practical session will explain what changes, how to approach the transition, and how to start building with Web IQ. It will bring together migration guidance, a concise product walkthrough, and answers to common implementation questions, giving attendees a clear path forward and access to Web IQ experts.

sessions.t: From reactive to proactive: Agents that listen for work
sessions.d: Learn how agents move beyond waiting for prompts. A live scenario shows and agent detecting an approved business signal, gather relevant context, doing the next action and involving a person for HITL.

sessions.t: Protect continuously and proactively with multi-agent defense
sessions.d: Most organizations won't jump from copilots to autonomous defense overnight. Learn how security teams are progressing from AI-assisted workflows to agentic security, and the trust, governance, and platform foundations required along the way. We'll share lessons from early Project Perception adopters and provide a practical framework to assess readiness and build a roadmap toward scalable autonomous defense.

sessions.t: Get ready for AI with the E5 you already own
sessions.d: Most organizations with Microsoft 365 E5 own more security capability than they use. See how E5 already helps you stop attacks, control access, protect data, and reduce risk, all within the same license. Then, discover what’s new with ISOC and expanded SIEM capabilities and see them in action in a live demo. Leave with a clearer view of your E5 security capabilities and three concrete steps to get more from what you already own.

sessions.t: AI agents: access granted. Trust not included
sessions.d: AI agents need access to apps, data, and resources, but should they get a blank check? See how Microsoft Entra Agent ID helps secure agent connections, limit risky permissions, and apply network controls to reduce risk and block compromised access before it becomes an attack path.

sessions.t: Secure exfiltration gaps with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
