sessions.d: Users move between devices, browsers, apps, and AI experiences faster than ever. Learn how Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention combines endpoint, browser, and network controls to eliminate blind spots and create a layered defense against data exfiltration. See real-world scenarios and how each enforcement layer stops them.

sessions.t: Secure exfiltration gaps with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
sessions.d: Users move between devices, browsers, apps, and AI experiences faster than ever. Learn how Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention combines endpoint, browser, and network controls to eliminate blind spots and create a layered defense against data exfiltration. See real-world scenarios and how each enforcement layer stops them.

sessions.t: Rayfin: Building the next generation of apps with enterprise data
sessions.d: Rayfin makes it easy to build, connect, and run intelligent applications powered by enterprise data and AI. See how Rayfin brings together Fabric, business data, APIs, functions, and AI models into a single developer experience. Learn how developers and makers can go from idea to production-ready applications, deploy directly from Microsoft Copilot, and create experiences that users can discover, share, and use where work happens every day.

sessions.t: Microsoft Fabric HorizonDB: One PostgreSQL endpoint for AI apps
sessions.d: Build intelligent applications without stitching together databases, analytics platforms, and AI services. Join us to explore Fabric HorizonDB, a new Fabric-native PostgreSQL experience, which unifies transactional and analytical workloads through a single PostgreSQL endpoint. Learn how to query live operational data and large-scale analytics together, reduce data movement, and accelerate the development of AI-ready applications.

sessions.t: Stop tuning databases, start optimizing with AI
sessions.d: Most organizations don't have a database performance problem. They have an expertise bottleneck. Critical optimization work often depends on a few experts overwhelmed by growing fleets, increasing complexity, and nonstop alerts. Discover a new approach to database management, combining observability, diagnosis, optimization recommendations, and controlled remediation into a single AI-powered experience. See how you can accelerate database optimization while retaining governance and control.

sessions.t: Ship database changes faster with agents in Database Hub
sessions.d: Database work still slows delivery. Schema changes, query tuning, and drift pull developers out of flow and into ticket queues. See how agents in Database Hub bring that work into the tools you already use, including the MSSQL extension for VS Code and GitHub Copilot: draft and review schema changes, explain and optimize queries, and validate before you commit. In a live demo, watch an agent carry a feature request from schema change to working query with your approval at each step.

sessions.t: Two PostgreSQL services, one confident architecture decision
sessions.d: Which Postgres on Azure service is the right fit for your workload? The answer is in the architecture Choose between Azure Database for PostgreSQL and Azure HorizonDB using concrete workload signals. This fast architecture demo compares scale, availability, AI integration, operations, and modernization needs, then applies the decision framework to common application patterns so you can identify the best starting point.

sessions.t: Agentic ERP in action:Build agents & skills with Dynamics 365 ERP MCP
sessions.d: Go beyond copilots and build agents that can act on real business processes. Take a technical deep dive into Dynamics 365 ERP MCP, ERP apps for Cowork, and Copilot Studio. Learn how to connect agents to finance and operations data, workflows, and actions while maintaining enterprise security and governance. Leave with practical architecture patterns and development techniques you can apply immediately.

sessions.t: Bring Dynamics 365 business data into the flow of work with Cowork
sessions.d: AI is moving beyond individual productivity to take on work across the business processes that run your organization. What does that mean for your business applications and architecture? Join this session to see demos of how Copilot Cowork with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, and ERP plugins can connect how people work with how your business operates—and what it takes to enable agentic business processes with the governance and controls your organization requires.

sessions.t: Build an enterprise app from a single prompt with Copilot Studio
sessions.d: One prompt. One coding agent. One working app, built live. See how app building in Copilot Studio turns natural language into an intelligent business application and dramatically changes how reliable business software gets created. Watch the experience unfold end to end, then see how easily an idea becomes an enterprise ready business solution.

sessions.t: Build an enterprise app from a single prompt with Copilot Studio
sessions.d: One prompt. One coding agent. One working app, built live. See how app building in Copilot Studio turns natural language into an intelligent business application and dramatically changes how reliable business software gets created. Watch the experience unfold end to end, then see how easily an idea becomes an enterprise ready business solution.

sessions.t: Build On-Device AI Experiences w/ Windows AI APIs
sessions.d: See Aion Instruct and Windows AI APIs in action. Learn how to add on-device language and vision capabilities to Windows apps using practical APIs, patterns, and tools for responsive AI experiences on Windows.

sessions.t: Agents in Action: Use Cases on Windows
sessions.d: See how companies are deploying trusted AI agents on Windows today. Live demos show real agentic solutions built on identity attribution, containment, and governance. See practical patterns you can evaluate and apply in your own environment.

sessions.t: Secure by Default: Simplify Windows device security at scale
sessions.d: IT teams need a simpler way to deploy, verify, and maintain devices safely. Learn how new capabilities in Windows help to establish a secure-by-default foundation, bringing critical protections into a trusted, measurable state. See how organizations can reduce complexity, improve consistency, and gain confidence that devices stay protected while creating a strong starting point for secure AI adoption.

sessions.t: Behind the scenes of patch management: Windows, drivers, models & apps
sessions.d: Security and IT teams face growing pressure to patch devices quickly in order to reduce exposure while maintaining business continuity. In this session, learn not just how we recommend managing patches for all of the devices and content type in your estate and what's new to make this management easier, but also take a look behind the scenes at how these various patching mechanisms work so you can best leverage them to your advantage.

sessions.t: Behind the scenes of patch management: Windows, drivers, models & apps
sessions.d: Security and IT teams face growing pressure to patch devices quickly in order to reduce exposure while maintaining business continuity. In this session, learn not just how we recommend managing patches for all of the devices and content type in your estate and what's new to make this management easier, but also take a look behind the scenes at how these various patching mechanisms work so you can best leverage them to your advantage.

sessions.t: Reliable by design: Driver Quality Initiative in Action
sessions.d: Whether you’re an IT professional, security practitioner, or technology partner, discover how Microsoft and its partners are working together to advance driver quality, reduce kernel risk, and shape the future of a more reliable and resilient Windows platform and ecosystem.

sessions.t: Cancelled: Next-gen streaming protocol for Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop
sessions.d: Learn more about DirectStream, a collection of protocols, encoders, drivers, apps, services, and SDKs that work together to enable a like-local streaming experience for Microsoft’s enterprise end users.

sessions.t: Landing zones in minutes with agentic deployment on Azure
sessions.d: Watch an AI-guided experience turn your requirements into a secure, resilient, and scalable Azure landing zone in minutes. See how agentic deployment applies governance and Microsoft best practices, reduces manual effort and configuration risk and creates a reliable cloud foundation that helps teams migrate faster and scale with confidence.

sessions.t: AI for FinOps, continuous optimization for every workload
sessions.d: Plan, manage, and optimize cloud spend with AI for FinOps. Discover how Azure Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and coding agents bring cost insights, investigation, estimation, and optimization guidance into the tools you use every day—right where decisions are made. Through real-world scenarios, learn how to identify idle and underused resources, forecast costs before code ships, and use agentic workflows to turn cost signals into action for engineering and FinOps teams alike.

sessions.t: Bring VMware workloads to Azure and modernize with confidence
sessions.d: VMware customers are at an inflection point: many are making strategic decisions on their VMware footprint, but few can move everything at once. See how Azure has practical options for every stage of that journey. We’ll cover patterns for stabilizing critical VMware estates in Azure, connecting them to Azure data services and Foundry, and creating a durable bridge to AI adoption for SQL Server, Oracle, and other business-critical workloads.

sessions.t: Cloud management for every Windows Server
sessions.d: IT organizations face growing complexity as they manage distributed environments across datacenters, branch offices, multiple clouds, and edge locations. Arc-enabling Windows Server delivers consistent management wherever workloads run—while also lowering ESU costs, providing free Hotpatching, and helping optimize SQL Servers.

sessions.t: From chaos to confidence validating resilience with Azure Chaos Studio
sessions.d: Resilience isn't proven by design alone, it must be validated. Join us to see how Azure Chaos Studio is evolving beyond fault injection to enable continuous resilience validation. Through new AKS testing capabilities and emerging agent-driven operational experiences, learn how teams uncover hidden weaknesses, validate recovery strategies, and build confidence that critical applications can withstand real-world disruptions.

sessions.t: Build intelligent physical systems with Foundry Local and Azure Local
sessions.d: Physical AI applications, from robotics to industrial automation, demand infrastructure that runs where the work happens. Azure Local’s small form factor options and Foundry Local bring sovereign AI capabilities to edge and constrained environments, giving organizations the ability to deploy AI close to physical operations while maintaining the same governance and control as their core data center.

sessions.t: Build Python AI pipelines powered by Ray with Anyscale on Azure
sessions.d: Python has become the language of AI, but scaling AI workloads from prototype to production can be complex. Microsoft and Anyscale demo how Ray on Anyscale with Azure simplifies building end-to-end AI pipelines. See how teams can process large datasets, train and fine-tune models, and deploy AI applications using familiar Python frameworks while taking advantage of cloud-scale infrastructure. Leave with practical insights for accelerating AI innovation and operating AI workloads efficiently.

sessions.t: The agentic path from legacy apps to AI-native on Azure Container Apps
sessions.d: Your existing apps still run the business. This demo-first session shows IT decision makers how to modernize legacy workloads onto serverless, cloud-native infrastructure with Azure Container Apps, and agent-led rewrite. Watch a live containerize-and-deploy, production-ready defaults for autoscaling, identity, and secrets, and scale to zero on per-second billing. See what changes operationally, where costs bend, and how the same platform readies you for AI.

sessions.t: Take control of runaway AI costs with AI Gateway
sessions.d: As AI usage grows across applications and agents, costs can become difficult to predict and manage. Learn how AI Gateway helps platform teams understand and control AI consumption using centralized visibility, token quotas, rate limits, semantic caching, and intelligent routing. See how to apply FinOps controls directly in the AI runtime to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support AI adoption at scale.

sessions.t: Never Drop an Activation: Run with Intelligence, Win on Experience
sessions.d: eSIM has transformed connectivity across phones, wearables, vehicles, and IoT, creating new demands for scale and resilience. Discover how Amdocs engineered a carrier-grade eSIM platform on Azure that delivers 12,000 TPS and 99.999% availability across three active-active regions. We'll explore the multi-region architecture, security model, and deployment approach that accelerated multi-market expansion.

sessions.t: The AI-native operator: Building telecom’s next advantage
sessions.d: As AI models and agents become widely available, what creates lasting advantage for telecom operators? Follow a broadband fault from customer issue to network resolution to see how identity, governance, and shared context enable agents to act safely. Drawing on Nokia innovation and Far EasTone experience, learn practices for improving outcomes while retaining control of intelligence. Leave with three 90-day priorities and one question: when you change AI vendors, what intelligence do you keep?

sessions.t: Intelligence at the edge
sessions.d: As AI, IoT, and physical AI converge, Manufacturing and Energy organizations are bringing intelligence closer to where work happens. Discover how leaders are turning real-time operational data into actionable insights that improve reliability, productivity, safety, and resilience across assets and operations. Learn how intelligent systems support faster decisions and more autonomous operations, powering the next generation of connected industrial enterprises.

sessions.t: Choosing the right AI models for healthcare solutions
sessions.d: Healthcare organizations have more AI model options than ever, making it difficult to choose the right approach. Should you use an off-the-shelf model, fine-tune a specialized model, combine models, or orchestrate them in a workflow? This session offers practical frameworks for selecting, customizing, and evaluating healthcare AI models based on cost, performance, accuracy, and scalability. Leave with a clear approach you can apply to your next healthcare AI project.

sessions.t: Duke Health reduces risk and strengthens resilience with Azure
sessions.d: Learn how Duke Health modernized disaster recovery with Epic on Azure. In this session you’ll discover how Duke Health improved resilience and strengthened security with Microsoft Defender - resulting in reduced downtime risk and lowered costs, while enabling future AI readiness.

sessions.t: Unlock up to 50% ROI with PCs powered by Verizon 5G
sessions.d: In the era of modern hybrid work, connectivity can make or break enterprise momentum. Join Verizon Business to explore how deploying PCs powered by Verizon 5G yields up to 50% ROI for organizations. Grounded in recent Forrester research, this session unpacks the operational playbook for maximizing field productivity, streamlining device management, and eliminating public Wi-Fi risks. Learn how real-time network access transforms workflows and unlocks measurable value.

sessions.t: Seismic shift: Turning subsurface data into decisions
sessions.d: Subsurface decisions carry the most risk and the biggest prize, and both start with accessible, governed data. Learn how Azure Data Manager for Energy connects seismic, well, and reservoir data with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and Snowflake, while enabling advanced analytics, AI, and reservoir modeling at scale. Discover how organizations turn complex energy data into intelligence that powers analytics, copilots, and agents, accelerating decisions and reducing uncertainty.

sessions.t: Pitch to platform: The premier league's AI transformation
sessions.d: Premier League Studios produces live coverage of one of the world's most-watched sports leagues. In this fireside chat, its Managing Director Nick Morgan and Microsoft's Head of Media & Entertainment Simon Crownshaw discuss what the studio's new facility already proves, the platform and partners being built now, and the studio of the future. You don't need a finished case study to move from pitch to platform. Come away with practical advice on starting with connected data and a bounded use case.

sessions.t: AI in pre-production: create smarter before the camera rolls
sessions.d: The biggest creative gains happen before the camera rolls. Collective Artists Network, one of India's largest talent and media companies, has agentified its production pipeline on Azure and Microsoft Foundry: its Agentic Canvas turns a creator's intent into a working pipeline, with an agent orchestrating 100+ models across 3D, CGI, and VFX. See how parallel production replaces linear production, how worlds are built once and reused, and where human judgment stays decisive.

sessions.t: From Copilot to cockpit: Building the AI-powered vehicle with Bosch
sessions.d: Bosch and Microsoft are taking AI from the workplace to the vehicle with an AI-powered cockpit that combines automotive expertise and Microsoft AI. A custom-trained SLM delivers low-latency, context-aware experiences, voice, memory, and vehicle functions across offline and online scenarios. Microsoft AI adds cloud intelligence, orchestration, APIs, and governance. See how Bosch is building the journey from AI assistant to AI-powered companion.

sessions.t: Industrial AI in Action: From Insight to Autonomous Operations
sessions.d: Industrial AI has advanced from assisting on insights, to actions, across industries from front line operations to boardroom. Discover how ABB Genix™ combines predictive, generative and agentic AI to identify asset and operational risks, contextualize industrial data, investigate through 3D Digital Twins and recommend guarded actions. Combining ABB’s industrial and technology expertise with Microsoft’s cloud and AI capabilities, Genix improves assets, process and energy performance, supports sustainability, and advances self-healing assets and autonomous operations.

sessions.t: Where AI Delivers Value in Product Engineering & Lifecycle Management
sessions.d: Which AI investments are delivering measurable value for OEMs? New research from Microsoft and IoT Analytics reveals how manufacturers are applying AI across product engineering and development, and which scenarios are driving improvements in time to market, quality, and product-line profitability. The session concludes with an expert discussion with Microsoft partner Siemens on how leading OEMs are putting agentic AI to work in engineering today.

sessions.t: Modernizing trading with agent-to-agent negotiation
sessions.d: BNY and Microsoft FDE have built a secure agent-to-agent negotiation network in which software agents can discover counterparties and negotiate within human-defined objectives, risk limits, and approval controls. Initial use case is Microsoft Treasury trading with BNY, with future applicability to FX, repo, collateral, and legal agreements.

sessions.t: How Vanguard is transforming advisor productivity with data and AI
sessions.d: Vanguard and Microsoft have built a sales advisor assist experience for Vanguard FAS using Microsoft 365 Sales Agent, Dynamics, and Microsoft Fabric. This session explores how the team is connecting relationship context, meeting preparation, outreach drafting, and coordinated follow-through into a human-reviewed workflow designed to reduce administrative effort and support more informed client conversations. Go behind the architecture to see how Dataverse Business Skills bring CRM capabilities into a conversational experience, alongside a Fabric-based approach to enterprise insights.

sessions.t: Inside Aon’s contact center: Putting Microsoft AI to work
sessions.d: Go behind the scenes of Aon’s contact center transformation in this demo-led session. See how Aon is using Microsoft AI to make better risk decisions, streamline operations, and deliver better outcomes at scale. Follow a practical, step-by-step walkthrough of how AI and human expertise come together in the flow of contact center work and learn patterns for moving from pilot to production. Continue the conversation at the Aon demo in the Financial Services Industry Showcase.

sessions.t: How agentic AI is transforming education
sessions.d: As AI moves from assistants that help people work to agents that take action, the choices in front of education leaders change. Explore what it takes to adopt agentic AI across education institutions: choosing scenarios tied to institutional outcomes, setting the right level of autonomy, connecting institutional data, keeping people in charge, and building in governance and security. See them come together in a live scenario and leave with actionable next steps for your institution.

sessions.t: Built to Scale: How Lean AI Is Transforming Global Supply Chains
sessions.d: AI transformation is easy to talk about, but much harder to operationalize. C.H. Robinson is proof of what is possible. By applying Lean AI across complex, business critical supply chain operations, C.H. Robinson has turned intelligence into action. In this session, learn how Lean AI drives faster execution, smarter decisions and measurable value across global supply chains, and take away practical applications for driving agentic transformation within your own organization.

sessions.t: You can just do stuff: with Kyle Daigle and Scott Hanselman
sessions.d: Developers are at the center of everything we build, but the way we build is changing fast. Join Scott Hanselman and GitHub’s Kyle Daigle for a candid conversation about what it means to be a developer in the age of AI. They’ll dig into how AI is reshaping the developer experience, changing our tools and workflows, and what developers should be paying attention to next. Expect practical insights, real talk, and a few thoughtful perspectives along the way.

sessions.t: What’s new for open-source data on Azure?
sessions.d: Catch the essential Azure open-source enhancements in one technical briefing. See where Azure HorizonDB, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Database for MySQL, Azure Managed Redis, and Azure DocumentDB migration, AI, operations, performance, security, and resilience updates fit in your workflows and learn which capabilities matter for your next modernization decision.

sessions.t: Sneak peek: What's next in SQL
sessions.d: What’s new in SQL? What’s coming next? Get an inside look at the latest innovations shaping the future of SQL. See how SQL is evolving to help developers and data professionals build faster, scale further, and get more from their data. Join us for a first look at where SQL is headed.

sessions.t: From prompt to production: Build a Fabric app live
sessions.d: Go from idea to a working Fabric app, live on stage. Starting from a natural-language prompt, we'll use an open-source workbench powered by GitHub Copilot to build an app, preview it, and deploy it, showing how Rayfin handles data, authentication, APIs, and hosting along the way. You'll leave knowing how to build your own app with Rayfin and share it in Fabric apps.

sessions.t: Power BI Development in the Agentic Era
sessions.d: Power BI development has entered a new phase that is shaped by agentic experiences. Join the product team to see how these capabilities are changing the way data solutions are built and improved, from semantic models to reports and even custom web apps. Learn how to best leverage Al agents, like GitHub Copilot, to build more powerful data experiences with less manual effort.

sessions.t: From Traditional Reports to Business-Ready Agentic Apps at Scale, Powered by Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: Turn multidomain customer signals into intelligent, agentic apps at enterprise scale. With the customer as the unifying lens, we bring together Support, Success, and Experience signals on Fabric to create governed intelligence that moves from insight to action. The result: business-ready use cases, AI-driven insights, and recommended actions delivered directly in the flow of work, with Entra security, DLP, guardrails, and end-to-end telemetry built in.

sessions.t: From Experimentation to Monetizing AI
sessions.d: The AI gold rush is here. The question is no longer Can you build it? It's Can you monetize it? Discover how leading partners are turning AI curiosity into measurable business outcomes. Learn how they’re building repeatable offerings, AI-powered IP, and agentic solutions that unlock new revenue streams. We’ll share practical playbooks, lessons learned, and proven strategies to help you get started and successfully package, sell and scale AI solutions that drive growth and deliver customer value.

sessions.t: Wire Agents Into Systems: Graph Engineering on Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: Agent loops made autonomous behavior possible; graphs make entire agent systems programmable. Learn agentic graph engineering: a stable graph defining which agent owns each capability, and a dynamic work graph defining what runs now. See a live build in Microsoft Foundry where a planner decomposes a goal, a WebIQ research agent and specialists run in parallel, a validator confirms evidence, and the graph adapts. Leave with a blueprint.

sessions.t: Grounding AI in the Physical World
sessions.d: AI that can't sense the physical world has a blind spot. Discover how Microsoft and its ecosystem of partners are bringing Physical AI to life, connecting industrial data, operational context, and AI to solve real-world challenges. Explore the Microsoft technology foundation, see how partners like Sight Machine and Siemens are delivering and advancing intelligent industrial solutions, and learn how Microsoft's partner programs help turn innovation into scalable businesses.

sessions.t: Edge for Business: Multi-tenant browser management for MSPs
sessions.d: Your customers spend their workday in the browser. If you don't manage it, they're unprotected. See Microsoft demo new multi-tenant management capabilities for Edge for Business through Inforcer, and leave knowing how to secure every customer's browser.

sessions.t: Competing and Winning with Microsoft Sovereign Cloud
sessions.d: As sovereignty expands beyond data residency to jurisdiction, proof, AI governance, and resiliency, customers are rethinking cloud and AI. Explore the four shifts redefining sovereignty, Microsoft’s approach to Sovereign Cloud and Sovereign AI, and how partners can address regulatory, geopolitical, and AI-era needs. Learn where EMEA opportunities are emerging and how to turn thought leadership into pipeline.

sessions.t: Power agentic connectivity across SAP and Microsoft with Work IQ
sessions.d: SAP Joule understands your business processes and enterprise data. Microsoft Copilot understands how people work. In this session, see how we’re bringing these worlds closer together through Work IQ and new integration patterns across SAP and Microsoft. Explore how agents can tap into richer context across both ecosystems, with identity and permissions providing the foundation for connected experiences. Learn what’s possible today and where the SAP and Microsoft integration is heading next.

sessions.t: From POC to Pattern: The Agent Factory Model for Partners
sessions.d: Building an impressive agent is now straightforward. Repeating, governing, and scaling it across customers is where the work begins. This session covers the factory, not the build: production readiness as enforceable stage gates, evaluation and observability baked in by default, and optimization patterns — model routing, context discipline, orchestration topology — as a reusable pattern library. Leave with a maturity model and a delivery structure designed for reuse.

sessions.t: 10 tips to maximize Microsoft Marketplace success
sessions.d: Hear what's new in Microsoft Marketplace and get the 10 most important actions partners can take to drive growth. From scaling digital sales and co-selling with Microsoft to monetizing AI offerings and maximizing customer cloud commitments, you'll gain practical guidance backed by real Marketplace success patterns. Leave with a concise checklist to help prioritize and accelerate your next steps.

sessions.t: Drive growth and scale with Frontier Accelerate for Marketplace
sessions.d: Customers are moving beyond AI pilots. They want trusted, production-ready solutions they can buy now. Learn how Frontier Accelerate for Marketplace helps software companies move from AI app and agent development to Marketplace sales with publishing guidance, GTM resources, co-sell, and growth investments.

sessions.t: Partner Skilling as a Growth Lever for Revenues & Profitability
sessions.d: Partner skilling is often treated as a cost. New data science and SCCM modeling shows it is a growth lever. This theatre session unpacks the quantified relationship between partner capability and revenue, pipeline volume, deal conversion, and operating margin — including which skilling signals predict commercial outperformance. Walk away with the evidence to justify skilling investment and a playbook for converting capability into measurable growth.

sessions.t: Leaders putting AI to work
sessions.d: What does it take to turn AI ambition into action? Hear from mission-driven leaders putting AI to work across their organizations and navigating the organizational changes that come with AI adoption. Through real-world stories, this conversation explores the leadership decisions, organizational changes, and lessons shaping how organizations move from experimentation to Frontier Transformation

sessions.t: Lean IT teams, big AI impact
sessions.d: AI transformation isn’t only for organizations with large IT teams. Hear how growing businesses are adopting AI, reimagining how work gets done, and building the skills and operating practices needed to move from AI experimentation toward practical business outcomes. Through real-world examples, explore how lean teams are putting AI into practice and building a foundation to scale responsibly.

sessions.t: Microsoft Marketplace: You don’t have to scale cloud and AI alone
sessions.d: Organizations can scale their cloud and AI strategy with solutions and expertise from across the Microsoft partner ecosystem. Learn how leaders can use Microsoft Marketplace to explore solutions and expertise that can support deployment and governance while building on existing Microsoft cloud and AI investments.

sessions.t: Trusted AI, transformative impact
sessions.d: Trust is foundational as organizations move AI into production and expand it across teams, workflows, and business processes. Hear lessons from leaders who are scaling AI across their businesses while strengthening governance, accountability, and confidence in AI-powered experiences.

sessions.t: AI at Risk: An Executive Frontier Immersion
sessions.d: As AI adoption expands, leaders may not always have visibility into how AI is being used across the organization. In this interactive tabletop, join the leadership team of a company confronting the risks of AI agents operating across the enterprise. Navigate decisions spanning visibility, governance, security, accountability, and human oversight, and explore the capabilities leaders need to govern and scale agents responsibly.

sessions.t: Skills to impact: Moving from AI experimentation to business results
sessions.d: AI doesn't create value on its own. People create value with AI. Explore how leading organizations are connecting workforce readiness, role-based skilling, and practical application to help employees adopt AI with confidence and turn AI investments into business results.

sessions.t: The ROI of AI skilling
sessions.d: A new study reveals why some organizations create value with AI faster than others. Explore insights from Microsoft's Total Economic Impact™ study on workforce readiness, adoption, and business outcomes, and learn what helps turn AI investments into measurable results.

sessions.t: The AI-fluent workforce: A customer conversation
sessions.d: What separates organizations that create value with AI from those that struggle to move beyond experimentation? Hear customer insights on tailoring AI learning to different roles, embedding learning into everyday work, and building cultures that sustain adoption over time.

sessions.t: Skills for a world that won't stand still
sessions.d: AI is changing not just what people need to learn, but how they learn and create value. Explore a practical playbook for building workforce capability through human skills, continuous learning, and learning in the flow of work. Leave with actionable strategies you can apply in your organization.

sessions.t: Skills that move the public sector forward: A customer conversation
sessions.d: Modernizing mission-critical services with AI while maintaining public trust requires more than technology, it requires skilling. Public sector organizations must build workforce confidence and capability as they pursue responsible adoption. In this customer conversation, hear how one organization is navigating these realities, putting employees at the center, and using skilling to accelerate adoption and turn AI ambition into meaningful public impact.

sessions.t: Supercharge your AI learning with AI Skills Navigator
sessions.d: Not sure where to begin your learning—or what AI Skills Navigator can do for you? Join us for a live exploration of the experience, from playlists and guided sessions to credentials and hands-on practice. With AI-powered capabilities and learning tailored to your needs and goals, whether you’re learning for yourself or supporting others, you’ll leave knowing how AI Skills Navigator is useful, where to find it, and what to try first.

sessions.t: Experience agentic learning with AI Skills Navigator
sessions.d: What could learning look like if the right support appeared exactly when you needed it? For learners and team leaders, this session shows how AI Skills Navigator uses AI to turn a broad goal into a clear path, offer guidance as questions arise, reinforce understanding, and keep learning moving forward. You’ll leave with a practical view of how AI-powered support can make skill building more focused, responsive, and effective.

sessions.t: Put AI Skills Navigator to work for your organization
sessions.d: Big goals require people and teams with the skills to deliver them. Designed for team, learning, and organizational leaders, this session shows how AI Skills Navigator can turn business priorities into relevant learning for employees while giving leaders greater visibility into progress. See how a more connected approach can help your organization build and apply the skills it needs.

sessions.t: Make learning personal and hands-on with AI Skills Navigator
sessions.d: Your goals and experience are uniquely yours—your learning should feel that way too. See how AI Skills Navigator can help you spend less time searching, focus on learning that matters to you, and build confidence by putting new knowledge into practice. You’ll leave with a clearer path from what you want to achieve to what you can do.

sessions.t: Learn in the flow of work with Microsoft Copilot + AI Skills Navigator
sessions.d: What if your next learning journey began with a question you were already asking at work? For Microsoft Copilot users and leaders, this session shows how Learning Agent uses personal and company context to recommend relevant learning from AI Skills Navigator and your organization. See how a real work need can become a clear next step toward lasting capability—right in the flow of work.

sessions.t: Your next cert move: A 3-minute decision
sessions.d: Confused by the growing credential portfolio? Learn the purpose of Applied Skills, Certifications, and Pro Badge, how they complement one another, and where to invest your time to maximize career impact.

sessions.t: Pro Badge: The credential you've been asking for
sessions.d: The Microsoft Pro Badge just dropped. Learn what it means, how to get it, why it matters for getting noticed, and why you should be in the early adopters.

sessions.t: Certified pros told us everything. Here's the playbook.
sessions.d: What do successful credential earners have in common? Learn how candidates prepared for Microsoft Certifications and Applied Skills, the resources they used, the challenges they faced, and the strategies that helped them succeed.

sessions.t: Learn how Training Partners turn AI ambition into workforce action
sessions.d: Discover how Microsoft Training Services Partners help organizations bridge the gap between AI ambition and workforce readiness through role-based skilling, hands-on learning, and tailored adoption strategies. You'll learn how strategic programs build confidence, accelerate AI adoption, and equip employees with the skills needed to thrive in the era of AI. Walk away with practical insights on how training partners can help you create a workforce ready to drive meaningful business outcomes.

sessions.t: From training to transformation: How partners drive AI business value
sessions.d: Technology alone doesn't drive AI transformation, people do. Learn how Microsoft Training Services Partners help customers translate newly acquired AI skills into measurable business impact. Through a customer success story, see how organizations move from learning concepts to implementing AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, streamline operations, and deliver tangible results.

sessions.t: Credly in action: Unlocking the full value of your credential
sessions.d: AI can now generate a convincing résumé, portfolio, interview, and even a face. What it cannot fabricate is a signed credential from the organization that assessed the skill. Microsoft Certifications issued through Credly already provide trusted, verifiable proof. See how organizations can use verified skills today and how Pearson's vision for a digital wallet could make that proof more portable across learning, workforce, and hiring experiences.

sessions.t: From AI fear to human agency
sessions.d:
Join Microsoft’s Aneesh Raman for a candid, audience-driven conversation about moving beyond AI anxiety toward human agency. Together, we’ll explore the fears and questions people are wrestling with as work changes, what becomes more valuable when technology can do more, and why human capability matters more, not less, in the age of AI.

Bring your questions, concerns, and curiosity. This is an open conversation about the future of work and the role each of us can play in shaping it.

sessions.t: From skills to opportunity: Building a talent signal hirers can trust
sessions.d: A profile tells you what someone says they know. What if it could also show what they’ve proven they can do? Learn how Microsoft verified proficiency, everyday work in GitHub Copilot, and LinkedIn Connected Apps turn learning and real work into trusted talent signals: proof people can carry with them, that hirers can see, and that connects skills to opportunity.

sessions.t: Why access isn't adoption: GitHub Learn's guide to AI enablement
sessions.d: AI access is growing, even for non-developers—but access isn't adoption, and training without measurable goals often fails. Join this session to see how GitHub uses proficiency modeling, hands-on skilling, certifications, and learning pathways to drive real impact.

sessions.t: From one automation to many: GitHub Agentic Workflows at scale
sessions.d: So you've built your first automation with Agentic Workflows (easy)! Now comes the hard part: How do you roll it out across repositories and teams? Learn how to deploy, monitor, and govern GitHub Agentic Workflows at scale, even across thousands of repositories, employees, and automations.

sessions.t: Copilot Studio unlocked: The new Microsoft Copilot harness for makers
sessions.d: See the new Microsoft Copilot harness in action and discover what it unlocks for Copilot Studio makers. In a live demo, learn how it expands what agents can do, enables richer experiences, and changes how makers build and extend agents.

sessions.t: IT operations as AI enablement
sessions.d: You've deployed a new product, but adoption is lagging. A simple “click here” video probably isn’t enough to get users started. Learn how IT can drive usage by becoming a champion for change and showing employees how new tools help them work smarter and get more done.

sessions.t: From VMs to Pods: A Kubernetes translation guide for IT/ops admins
sessions.d: You already know infrastructure, networking, storage, and HA. In 25 minutes, we'll map what you know to its Kubernetes equivalent — VM to pod, load balancer to Service, disks to PersistentVolumes — so AKS feels like an evolution, not a reset.

sessions.t: AI FinOps in practice: what IT and business owe each other
sessions.d: An IT Pro and a business pro trade perspectives on the real cost of running AI. In 25 minutes, see how token spend, model choice, and workload placement translate into budget lines — and how each side can stop surprising the other.

sessions.t: Skill or will? Diagnose what’s stalling AI adoption
sessions.d: AI adoption can stall even after training. Learn a skill-versus-will diagnostic to identify whether a workflow is blocked by capability, confidence, permission, incentives, or design, and choose the leadership response that unlocks value.

sessions.t: Building security skills through hands-on learning
sessions.d: As cyber threats evolve and security responsibilities expand, organizations need practical ways to help security professionals make better decisions. Explore how simulation-based learning enables learners to rehearse real-world security scenarios in a low-risk environment. From evaluating data sources and governance controls to determining when automation, AI, or human oversight is required, simulations help learners understand not just what to do, but why it matters.

sessions.t: What if your data agents spoke your business language
sessions.d: Your data records what happened, but rarely what it means to your business. In this session we take one real business scenario and build an ontology in Fabric IQ that captures its concepts, relationships and rules, then follow it through into data agents and Foundry. Leave able to model your own domain and give your agents the vocabulary your business actually uses.

sessions.t: Behind the skills: Life of a Microsoft Certified Trainer
sessions.d: Microsoft Certified Trainers (MCTs) help learners and organizations build critical technology skills through expert instruction and real-world experience. Hear inspiring stories of customer success, social impact, and community leadership that demonstrate how MCTs empower learners and advance Microsoft's global skilling mission.

sessions.t: Math in Microsoft 365: Easier to Create, Share, and Understand
sessions.d: Math powers education, research, engineering, and business. Explore Microsoft’s latest investments in math accessibility across Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, including MathML and LaTeX support, equation editing and conversion, and structured math experiences for screen readers, collaboration, and AI. Learn how these advances help educators, students, researchers, accessibility advocates, and technical professionals create and understand math more easily.

sessions.t: Inclusive Design in Action: Building Better AI Experience for Everyone
sessions.d: Inclusive Design is not a checklist. It’s a product development approach that helps teams build experiences that work better for more people. In this demo-driven session, learn how Inclusive Design can be applied across the product lifecycle to identify unmet needs, uncover innovation opportunities, and improve AI-powered experiences. Through real-world examples and live demos, explore practical techniques for product strategy, research, design, and development.

sessions.t: From Pilot to Productivity: AI Adoption in Action
sessions.d: Many organizations have moved beyond experimenting with AI, and turning pilots into measurable business impact remains a challenge. Join this theater session to see live demonstrations of AI-enabled workflows and learn how organizations are building workforce readiness, driving adoption, and scaling AI across teams. Walk away with practical strategies for transforming AI from a promising technology into a daily productivity engine.

sessions.t: From Assistance to Resolution: Customer Service in Action
sessions.d: Many organizations have deployed AI assistants, but few have unlocked true end-to-end resolution. Join this session for a hands-on look at how AI can understand intent, access business systems, execute workflows, and resolve customer requests with minimal human intervention. Through demonstrations and implementation examples, explore the architectural decisions, safeguards, and integrations required to deliver autonomous customer experiences.

sessions.t: From Reports to Reasoning: Reinventing PPM with AI and Power Apps
sessions.d: How do you rethink project portfolio management after 20 years of doing it the same way? Join Microsoft MVP Peter Kestenholz and learn how Context& used AI, Power Platform and Dataverse to replace traditional dashboards with AI-driven insights and build a fully interactive what-if scenario engine. Real-world lessons from serving 100+ global enterprises and accelerating innovation through AI-assisted development and user experience.

sessions.t: Hardening MCP: Advanced Security and Scale for Enterprise AI Hubs
sessions.d: Exposing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enterprise production introduces massive scalability and security hurdles. In this advanced, demo-first session, we address the architectural realities of deploying the new stateless MCP standard. Drawing from real-world FastTrack deployments, we will dissect advanced multi-tenant routing, stateless load balancing, and prompt-injection mitigation. Learn how to securely scale AI data pipelines without compromising corporate data boundaries.

sessions.t: Follow the Tokens: Finding the Real Cost of Your Foundry AI Models
sessions.d:
You have multiple Microsoft Foundry AI model deployments, but which one is driving your costs? 
In this lightning talk, you'll learn how to uncover per-model usage costs with Azure Monitor. Through a live demo and a simple unattended .NET app, I'll show how to turn raw metrics into actionable insights for reporting, budgeting, FinOps, and governance. Take home a practical solution for your AI projects.

sessions.t: Who Owns This Agent? Identity, Data, & Control across Microsoft Clouds
sessions.d:
Building an AI agent is easy. Governing it is the hard part.
A Microsoft Foundry agent can access Microsoft 365, Microsoft IQ data, identities, and business content across multiple platforms. But who owns it, what can it access, and how do you retire it safely? Follow a real-world agent from deployment to decommissioning and learn the four governance controls every production agent needs: Ownership, Identity, Data Boundary, and Lifecycle.

sessions.t: Essential Insights for Governing Copilot Agents
sessions.d: Organizations are rapidly deploying Copilot agents, but many lack the governance needed to scale securely. Learn a practical framework for managing agent lifecycle, security, compliance, and operational oversight using Microsoft Purview, Copilot Studio, DLP, and governance best practices. Leave with actionable guidance for preventing agent sprawl, protecting sensitive data, and enabling innovation while maintaining control.

sessions.t: Prompt, Skill, Cowork Task, or Agent? A Four-Signal Test
sessions.d: The most common question in the field has no documented answer. Is this a Copilot prompt, a Cowork task, a reusable skill, or a real agent? Guess wrong and you buy months of rework. I give you a routing test built on four signals: task shape, data gravity, governance burden, and reuse potential. Then I run real requests through it live, including two where the obvious answer is wrong and one I refuse to automate at all. You can apply it to your own backlog the same afternoon.

sessions.t: Scaling M365 Copilot in Finance: From Access to Impact
sessions.d: How does a regulated financial services organization turn M365 Copilot experiments into an everyday capability? OP Pohjola, FinlandÆs largest financial services group, shares its journey from the early pilots in 2023 to organization-wide adoption in 2026. Learn the practical operating model behind training, support and communications, focusing on how to move from providing access to driving active use. See how to drive value and create measurable changes in ways of working and business outcomes.

sessions.t: Agentic Data Platforms: Reusable Architectures with Fabric IQ
sessions.d: Multi-agent systems require repeatable architectures for business context, data connections, and governance. This session breaks down recurring reference patterns for agentic platforms built on Microsoft Fabric. Drawing on enterprise implementations, we present reusable blueprints for ontology design, agent grounding, and orchestration. Learn to combine semantic models, OneLake, and Fabric IQ into a coherent foundation for Data Agents, Copilots, and custom enterprise workflows.

sessions.t: Enterprise Data & AI with Azure, Azure Databricks and Snowflake
sessions.d: How do you build an AI-ready data platform when your estate spans Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks? This session examines a real enterprise architecture using medallion layers, Azure Data Lake Storage, Apache Iceberg, catalog federation, identity, and governed agent access. Learn the interoperability decisions, performance traps, and cost trade-offs that appear when multiple platform engines must operate as one trusted Data and AI ecosystem.

sessions.t: From Data to Agentic AI with Fabric
sessions.d: Agentic AI starts with trusted data. This session shows how Microsoft Fabric helps enterprises build AI-ready data with governance and compliance. Learn practical architecture patterns for connecting operational data to context-aware AI agents.

sessions.t: From Data to Decisions: Fabric Data Agent Meets Microsoft Foundry
sessions.d: What if AI could understand your business data and help decide what happens next? In this demo-heavy session, weÆll use Microsoft Fabric Data Agent and Microsoft Foundry to investigate a real-world retail sales decline across sales, inventory, and operations data. Watch AI uncover causes, connect trusted enterprise context, and recommend actions. WeÆll then go beyond Q&A with secure access, orchestration, evaluation, tracing, and human oversight.

sessions.t: From Fabric Machine Learning to AI Agents with Microsoft IQ
sessions.d: Build a customer-retention agent that turns Fabric data into action. Train a churn model with Fabric Machine Learning, enrich customer feedback at scale with AI Functions, and expose governed business context through a Fabric Data Agent and Fabric IQ, part of Microsoft IQ. Add an Agent Skill for investigation and escalation, then connect the pieces in Microsoft Foundry. See how predictions, semantic context, and reusable workflows combine to help agents reason and act on trusted enterprise data.

sessions.t: No More ETL? A Real-World Playbook for Fabric Mirroring
sessions.d: "No more ETL" sounds great until migration week. Fabric mirroring can genuinely retire your pipelines, or quietly become the outage nobody planned for. This session is a field-tested playbook for migrating off legacy systems ETL onto Fabric mirroring: sequencing that doesn't blow up your quarter, where CDC actually saves money, and the day-one mistakes we only learned by making them. Leave with a migration plan template, not a feature tour.

sessions.t: Mapping the Wholesaler's Mind: Fabric IQ for Enterprise Knowledge
sessions.d: AI initiatives struggle to scale when platforms unify where data lives, but not what it means. Disconnected tables leave agents without business context. This session shows how a German wholesaler built a unified intelligence foundation with Fabric IQ. We deconstruct designing an Ontology over existing semantic models and OneLake data. Learn how this layer fuels Data Agents and Microsoft 365 Copilot with factual context, connects business meaning, and avoids schema-centric design pitfalls.

sessions.t: Every agent is a principal now. Do you know what yours can reach?
sessions.d: Since July 2026 every new Copilot Studio agent gets an Entra Agent ID, and you can no longer opt out. That changes what an agent is: a principal with connector scopes, Conditional Access and a lifecycle. I build one live, then switch to the admin side and show what just landed in your tenant, including the part nobody enjoys. Agents created before the rollout cannot be migrated in place. You recreate them. Leave with a list of what to check in your own tenant on Monday.

sessions.t: Secure Workplace in the AI Era: An End-to-End Live Demo
sessions.d: Built on practical experience and proven best practices gathered since the early days of Microsoft 365, this end-to-end live demo shows how Microsoft Entra, Intune, Defender XDR, Purview, and Copilot security controls work together to create a productive and secure workplace. Gain a practical birdÆs-eye view of the Microsoft security ecosystem and understand how its technologies complement each other rather than operate as isolated products.

sessions.t: Trusting Your AI Workforce: Securing and Governing Enterprise Agents
sessions.d:
Discover how Microsoft helps organisations securely deploy and govern AI agents using familiar security, identity, and compliance controls. Through demonstrations and customer scenarios, you'll see how Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, and Copilot Studio work together to provide visibility, governance, and security for AI-powered agents.
Join us to learn the essential practices every organisation should adopt before scaling AI agents across the enterprise.

sessions.t: Your Agent Has Access. Now Prove What It Did.
sessions.d: AI agents don't just read enterprise data anymore. They act on it. In this fast-paced investigation, we follow a risky agent interaction from prompt to tool execution, then use Microsoft Purview to block sensitive data, trace agent activity, and reconstruct what happened with Audit and eDiscovery. You'll leave knowing which controls matter before, during, and after an agent acts.

sessions.t: Windows 365 for Agents in Action: Automating the App With No API
sessions.d: Your most important business system is fifteen years old, has no API, and nobody will sign off replacing it. So people do the clicking. Windows 365 for Agents changes that. The agent checks out a real Entra-joined, Intune-managed Cloud PC, does the work a person would, and hands it back. I will show an agent we built and now run internally that stands up projects across three systems, then build the same pattern live against a legacy desktop app. Including where it breaks and what a run costs.

sessions.t: 12,000 Seats. Six Months. A New Direction with Windows 365.
sessions.d:
An EUC renewal can be more than a licensing decision — it can be the catalyst for a completely different approach.

This session follows a real-world, 12,000-seat renewal and the six-month migration journey that followed, with Windows 365 at the heart of the replacement strategy. We’ll explore why we chose it, how we approached the transition, and the practical decisions and trade-offs along the way.

Find out what we replaced, what we retained, and what we’d do differently — with lessons for anyone considering Windows 365 as an alternative to their existing EUC platform.

sessions.t: Your Windows 365 Cloud PC Is Compromised. Now What?
sessions.d: What happens when the endpoint at risk is a Windows 365 Cloud PC? In this demo-led session, watch a healthy Cloud PC encounter a simulated threat and follow the resulting Defender risk, Intune compliance, and Entra Conditional Access signals. YouÆll see how Cloud PCs fit into a Zero Trust security model and leave with a practical pattern for detecting, containing, and recovering cloud-hosted Windows endpoints.

sessions.t: Identity first: Build business resiliency across Azure and M365
sessions.d: Rackspace and Rubrik explore business resiliency beyond backup, starting with identity. See how to sequence recovery across Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, Microsoft 365 data, and Azure infrastructure. Learn about immutable backups, rapid restoration, air-gapped protection, and the importance of a tested recovery runbook. Leave with a practical model for restoring identity, access, data, and infrastructure in the right order.

sessions.t: AI doesn't wait. Neither should your network.
sessions.d: AI runs at machine speed. Your network doesn't. Most enterprise networks weren't designed for workloads scattered across Azure, data centers, edge, and AI regions, and that gap can stall AI ambitions. See how to replace static networking with Lumen’s programmable network and gain a unified control plane for visibility, security, segmentation, and policy. Deploy in hours, not months, to gain flexibility and accelerate AI initiatives.

sessions.t: Connect people, spaces, and AI for better workplace experiences
sessions.d: The AI-Powered Workplace extends beyond applications into physical spaces. Learn how Q-SYS and Microsoft help organizations create high-performance workplaces that connect people, technology, and AI. Through a real customer example, see how a software-based approach simplifies management and delivers measurable business outcomes. Leave with a blueprint for transforming your workplace into an AI-powered environment that drives productivity and is ready for the future of collaboration.

sessions.t: Scale to 1,000 AI agents without scaling headcount
sessions.d: How can you expand AI agent operations without expanding the team responsible for governing them? Learn about the CNXN Helix approach, which shifts from reviewing agents individually to using a shared platform where governance controls are built in from the moment of creation. Take away an operating model that works within the Microsoft ecosystem and supports both everyday maker innovation and larger process transformations.

sessions.t: GPU liquidity means AI compute without data movement
sessions.d: What if you could run AI workloads wherever GPU resources are available, without moving your data? Discover how Qumulo enables GPU Liquidity by connecting Azure AI compute to enterprise data residing on-premises, in Azure, across regions, or in other clouds. In this live demonstration, see how organizations can eliminate costly data copying, staging, and migration while accelerating AI workloads, improving GPU utilization, and bringing compute directly to their data.

sessions.t: Connect M365 Copilot to your revenue engine for AI that executes
sessions.d: AI investments can stall when the connection between AI, approved content, and governance is missing. Close that gap by embedding trusted enablement intelligence into Microsoft 365 Copilot. See how Seismic Aura's AI agents surface approved content, ground responses, and drive consistent execution in the flow of work. Learn how to move GTM teams from preparation to performance, turning AI into action and revenue impact.

sessions.t: Secure workplace AI without slowing innovation
sessions.d: AI tools have the power to transform organizational productivity while exponentially increasing risk. Uncover how workplace AI tools can expose sensitive data, bypass controls, and introduce new attack surfaces. Explore what you can do to mitigate these risks effectively without impeding innovation.

sessions.t: How to keep up when everyone wants more AI
sessions.d: Using AI was supposed to save you time. For 71% of IT teams, it did the opposite: more permissions to check, more content to clean, and more places something can go wrong. But not for everyone. Teams that govern continuously, not in bursts, were about twice as likely to say their workload went down. Microsoft MVP Benjamin Niaulin explains which signals to watch and how to address governance gaps. You'll leave with prompts for your own tenant and a clear first move for Monday.

sessions.t: Beyond the endpoint: Smarter IT with Tia, Work IQ, and Fabric IQ
sessions.d: What if IT could understand not just what broke, but why? TeamViewer and Microsoft show how Tia takes agentic IT beyond the endpoint. Work IQ explains what changed, Fabric IQ defines what should be, and Tia brings those signals together to diagnose and remediate issues with approval. Through an MCP-native integration, Microsoft 365 Copilot calls on Tia as a specialist agent, enabling faster, smarter, context-aware IT operations at scale.

sessions.t: Who broke access? Recover Entra ID and Intune live
sessions.d: One configuration change can break access fast. In this live demo, we intentionally disrupt a Microsoft access path, trace the issue across Intune and Entra ID, identify what changed and who changed it, compare the current state with a known-good version, and recover only what is needed. See a practical identity resilience workflow in action, from incident to remediation.

sessions.t: Build the data layer for enterprise AI
sessions.d: Enterprise data is scattered across SQL Server, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and other systems. Learn how to unify that data in OneLake, continuously extract and maintain context from operational data, and bring it into Fabric IQ so Copilot, AI agents, and Power BI can work across enterprise data without adding more pipelines, compute, storage, or data movement. The result is an AI-ready data foundation that makes enterprise context easier to access and put to work.

sessions.t: Local when it matters. Cloud when it counts.
sessions.d: Learn how agentic AI can combine local and cloud capabilities without choosing one over the other. See how Intel and Microsoft are enabling AI experiences that bring together local models for speed, privacy, and efficiency with Azure intelligence for sophisticated reasoning and enterprise scale.

sessions.t: Build an intelligent search pipeline for grounded AI
sessions.d: Learn how to take a user question or instruction, retrieve relevant information from your company’s datasets, and provide it to the model at generation time. Walk away knowing how to create a search pipeline using a combination of Cohere search models.

sessions.t: Move beyond AI pilots and build the frontier firm
sessions.d: Most organizations have moved past asking whether AI delivers value. The challenge now is scaling it. Many have deployed AI platforms and piloted agents, but few have built the governance and digital foundations required for enterprise-wide transformation. Learn how to move from isolated AI wins to business-wide impact through agent governance, operating models, and responsible adoption practices. Leave with a practical framework for scaling AI across your organization.

sessions.t: Turn personal agents into enterprise assets
sessions.d: AI is moving beyond individual assistance toward enterprise agents that work across teams, data, and systems. EY explores how organizations can select agents, govern data access, scale personal agents into enterprise assets, and balance speed, risk, and human accountability. Gain a practical view of the operating models, validation approaches, controls, and ways of working needed to move from copilots and experimentation to responsible, scalable AI agent ecosystems.

sessions.t: Your cloud. Your path. Your pace.
sessions.d: There's no single right speed for moving to the cloud. Explore how to modernize desktop delivery today, using AVD Hybrid as a bridge or Windows Cloud as the destination, and build the path that fits where you are now.

sessions.t: Scale AI agents with visibility, governance, and cost control
sessions.d: As organizations adopt AI agents, copilots, and generative AI, visibility, governance, and cost control become increasingly important. Learn how to discover AI usage, understand token consumption, optimize costs, and govern access at scale. Through practical examples and real-world insights, you'll gain strategies for managing AI investments, reducing risk, and establishing accountability across the enterprise.

sessions.t: How global financial institutions put agentic AI to work
sessions.d: Enterprise AI has moved far beyond answering questions and completing tasks. Today, agentic AI can reason, act, adapt, and continuously optimize to deliver measurable business outcomes. Hear Kore.ai Chief Commercial Officer Uma Sandilya share how global financial institutions are putting agentic AI to work to transform experiences and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

sessions.t: Building with Muse Code on Windows
sessions.d: Explore Muse Code, Meta's AI coding agent that plans changes, writes code, and validates results. In this demo-driven session, see Muse Code in action through command-line workflows on Windows. Learn to work with the agent in your repository, use persistent background agents for longer-running tasks, and check changes with tests before review. See how Muse Code brings project context, file edits, commands, and tests together to help you build and improve apps in Windows development workflows.

sessions.t: Move beyond AI pilots with a Frontier Company approach
sessions.d: Move beyond AI pilots to measurable business value. Discover how Frontier Companies bring people, Copilot, and intelligent agents together to transform work. Through real-world customer scenarios, learn to secure executive sponsorship, balance innovation with governance, scale AI in production, and drive enterprise-wide adoption. Leave with practical steps to build an AI operating model that delivers sustainable business outcomes.

sessions.t: Create connected context to scale AI ROI
sessions.d: Scaling AI value requires connected context across the business, from R&D and IT to operations and GTM. See how the Atlassian platform brings organizational context together across teams, agents, and apps to help businesses scale AI. Learn how SpotOn used this connected foundation to expand AI adoption across 1,000+ employees in under six months, achieving a 55% question deflection rate and saving hundreds of operational hours each month.

sessions.t: Modernize industrial architecture for AI-powered operations
sessions.d: AI is only as effective as the data, architecture, and domain expertise behind it. See how Baker Hughes and EPAM are modernizing industrial software architecture, streamlining data strategies, and building a foundation for AI-powered operations. Explore approaches to platform simplification, trusted analytics, security, scalability, and user experience design to prepare industrial platforms for intelligent operations.

sessions.t: Transform your legacy estate for sovereign AI
sessions.d: Enterprises face a catch-22: modernize for AI, yet maintain control of your intelligence. Concierto breaks the bind. The speakers present a sovereign platform for migrating, modernizing, and managing enterprises for agentic AI within your VPC. Dual-engine architecture combines deterministic rules with private inference. Concierto delivers versatility, protecting and growing your intelligence solely for your company’s benefit.

sessions.t: Build a secure, AI-ready enterprise workspace with Citrix + Microsoft
sessions.d: As AI transforms the workplace, organizations need secure, resilient ways to deliver applications, desktops, and data across cloud and hybrid environments. Join Shawn Bass (Citrix) and Igal Figlin (Microsoft) to explore how Citrix Platform Flex and Microsoft Azure are advancing application delivery, security, performance, and operational efficiency. Learn how the partnership is evolving to support AI-ready workspaces and the future of enterprise digital work.

sessions.t: Move from AI cautious to AI confident with Veeam and Microsoft 365
sessions.d: AI mistakes are hard to reverse. Copilot and AI agents inherit every permission, stale file, and mislabeled document already in your Microsoft 365 estate. Most teams find that out after they deploy. In 25 minutes, we’ll show you how to see what your AI can actually reach, clean up what it shouldn’t, and keep the whole estate recoverable while you do it. You’ll leave with the three checks to run before your next AI rollout.

sessions.t: Build cyber resilience at AI speed
sessions.d: Build cyber resilience across data, identity, and AI as one Microsoft estate. As Copilot and AI agents read, write, and act across enterprise data, traditional human review can’t operate at the same speed. Explore why identity is the new front door, data remains the crown jewels, and AI introduces both risk and defense. Learn how monitoring, governance, and real-time controls can build trust in agents and advance Frontier Transformation.

sessions.t: Move from AI proof of concepts to enterprise-grade production on Ubuntu
sessions.d: AI stacks are complex, interdependent, and high stakes. Spinning an AI prototype is easy making it enterprise-ready is much more challenging. Many organizations can't keep track of their dependencies within their AI projects, leading to solutions that fail security checks and break easily. How do you move to a robust, secure AI solution that is built to last? Learn how to architect, secure, and maintain a resilient enterprise-grade AI infrastructure on Ubuntu, without sacrificing speed.

sessions.t: Build your frontier blueprint to turn AI potential into value
sessions.d: Organizations are investing in Microsoft Copilot and AI agents, but achieving business value requires more than deployment. Learn how to assess AI readiness across governance, security, adoption, and workforce transformation with Kyndryl’s Frontier Readiness Blueprint. Discover how to identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize business outcomes, and create a roadmap for responsible AI at scale. Leave with a clear path to accelerate value from Copilot and AI agents.

sessions.t: Want smarter AI workflows? Power them with Oracle data in Azure
sessions.d: Start using business-critical data to fuel your AI journey. Discover how migrating Oracle workloads to Azure with Oracle AI Database@Azure enables Azure AI services like Microsoft IQ and Copilot to securely and instantly access enterprise data. Explore how collocating Oracle infrastructure in Azure data centers and natively integrating Oracle and Azure services powers innovation by turning trusted data into intelligent agentic workflows.

sessions.t: Stop dark documents from multiplying your AI risk
sessions.d: Documents don't go dark over time. They can go dark the moment they're stored, scanned, or even printed, creating information that's harder to find, govern, and use with AI. Join Vasion CEO Ryan Wedig for a live look at what changes when you keep documents visible and governed from the source, helping keep business intelligence accessible and AI-ready as data volumes grow.

sessions.t: A practical 3 step approach to operationalize AI trust
sessions.d: Organizations are rapidly adopting AI agents, but confidence in AI strategies often outpaces the controls needed to manage risk. That gap between confidence and control is where AI agents can start acting outside their intended scope. Join Microsoft RD and MVP Dux Raymond Sy for a practical session on three steps to operationalize AI trust before an agent does something nobody planned for. Leave with a repeatable framework you can apply to your riskiest AI agent this week.

sessions.t: Go from idea to governed AI app with Replit and Microsoft Fabric
sessions.d: Accelerate AI application development by empowering more people across your organization to turn natural language prompts into software with Replit. As application development expands beyond traditional development teams, enterprises need confidence that every app meets their standards for security, governance, and data integrity. See how the Rayfin SDK connects Replit and Microsoft Fabric, enabling organizations to build apps in Replit and deploy them in Fabric.

sessions.t: Trust that travels starts on the endpoint
sessions.d: AI agents now act, not just read, and that action lands on the endpoint. Join ASUS and Intel to see how cloud policy, platform telemetry, and hardware root of trust combine to strengthen protection when a device is at risk or lost, and why post-quantum readiness starts today, years ahead of your next refresh cycle.

sessions.t: How onsemi is building an AI-ready enterprise with LTM
sessions.d: Becoming AI-ready requires more than adopting AI. It requires a secure, scalable foundation to operationalize it across the enterprise. Explore how LTM is helping onsemi build an AI platform on trusted data, governed access, AI agents, and reusable capabilities. Learn how this foundation is helping move AI beyond individual productivity toward human-agent collaboration at enterprise scale and accelerating onsemi’s journey toward becoming a frontier firm.

sessions.t: Go from outage to online with hybrid cloud disaster recovery
sessions.d: When a mission-critical workload goes down, recovery speed matters. See how Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) on Azure supports cloud-based disaster recovery. Follow workload preparation, a simulated outage, and failover using familiar Nutanix tools. We’ll confirm recovered VMs and applications are available, then show post-recovery management. See a practical path to cloud DR without retraining.

sessions.t: The Frontier Enterprise: From trusted data to AI at scale
sessions.d: What does it take to move beyond AI pilots to measurable business impact at scale? Explore a cross-industry perspective on combining trusted data foundations, agentic capabilities, and smarter model and token economics to scale AI across the enterprise.

sessions.t: Modernize today and build a secure, AI-ready foundation for tomorrow
sessions.d: Organizations are under pressure to modernize aging infrastructure, protect critical data, and prepare for AI. What if one modernization strategy could address all three? See how HPE and Microsoft can turn a Windows Server refresh into a modernization opportunity that strengthens security, supports sovereignty, and creates an AI-ready foundation for what comes next.

sessions.t: How Quest Diagnostics is improving the laboratory testing experience
sessions.d: Discover how Quest Diagnostics is enhancing customer-facing processes to improve experience, quality, and productivity for patients and providers. Learn how an AI-infused SDLC is accelerating innovation and reducing friction across the testing ecosystem, and how HCLTech is enabling this transformation through AI engineering with GitHub Copilot and application modernization to improve development, code quality, and scalability for future innovation.

sessions.t: Catch synthetic identity rings at scale
sessions.d: Most identity failures don't look like identity failures. A fraud ring looks like forty new customers. A repeat shopper with three cards looks like three people. Either way, it's scattered records, not the person behind them. In this session with Senzing, learn how entity resolution closes that gap in real time on Azure, turning millions of records into true identities as data arrives, on the risk side or the revenue side. You'll leave with a blueprint and three questions for your team.

sessions.t: Accelerate Microsoft AVD and Windows 365 adoption
sessions.d: Microsoft AVD and Windows 365 adoption is accelerating, but migration complexity, costs, and ongoing operations can slow progress. See how Liquidware helped three enterprise customers deliver applications, profiles, and a consistent user experience across AVD, Windows 365, and physical PCs. Learn how to resolve issues faster, connect experience and cost insights, and get a first look at new ways to simplify AVD management and optimization.

sessions.t: Your file estate has a second audience now. Is it ready for Copilot?
sessions.d: Copilot and enterprise agents are creating a second audience for your file estate, with different access patterns and governance considerations. Serving that second audience doesn’t require a second copy or a second permission model. See how enterprises on Azure activate one file estate for fast, VPN-less access for people and governed, permission-aware access for AI. Then measure your approach against PSYCHIC, a vendor-neutral framework for understanding what enterprise AI needs from file data.

sessions.t: Go beyond the model to secure AI apps, agents, and data
sessions.d: AI is now in production, expanding the attack surface beyond models and prompts. Modern AI connects to APIs, enterprise data, workflows, and autonomous agents across Azure and the edge, requiring organizations to protect the applications, interactions, and data that power it. Learn from Nirav Shah, SVP Products and Solutions at F5, how to secure AI apps, agents, APIs, and sensitive data, and how F5 and Microsoft enable secure, visible, and consistent AI scaling in Azure.

sessions.t: AI and collaboration in the enterprise
sessions.d: Explore human-digital interaction and AI-driven productivity with Logitech. Learn about Personal Workspace Solutions including the MX Master 4, MX Keypad with Copilot, and Teams certified Zone Vibe Pro headset. Be one of the first to hear about a new Microsoft partnership announcement. Additionally, see next-gen Teams Rooms solutions like the Rally Bar 2 and Rally System 2 Pro built on MDEP.

sessions.t: Strengthen Microsoft 365 backup, recovery, and archiving with Azure
sessions.d: Explore how modern SaaS data protection can extend Microsoft 365 and Azure to support backup, recovery, and archiving while optimizing storage and cost. Microsoft and CrashPlan experts will demonstrate an Azure-based approach to rapid recovery, space-saving archiving, eDiscovery, and anomaly detection. See how organizations can protect and preserve critical data while managing data growth and costs.

sessions.t: Strengthen data resilience for Microsoft Copilot and AI
sessions.d: Microsoft Copilot and AI depend on grounding data across M365, Azure, and SaaS. How that data is accessed, governed, and secured is becoming more critical. Cyberattacks, compromised identities, or overprivileged agents threaten that data and business continuity. Explore why data resilience must evolve for this new threat landscape and what organizations can do to better protect the data that powers AI.

sessions.t: Defend against vibe-coded Microsoft 365 attacks
sessions.d: Cyber threats are evolving as AI reshapes adversary tradecraft. Through the lens of Phishing-as-a-Service, explore the shift from legacy tools to emerging vibe-coded adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) platforms. Huntress research on Knight Office reveals how these toolkits bypass MFA and hijack Microsoft 365 session tokens.
