Learn from real-world incident data how organizations can improve resilience and how Huntress and Microsoft work together to help protect Microsoft 365 environments.

sessions.t: Simplify recovery with an Azure-native approach
sessions.d: AI is increasing reliance on cloud services, data, and identities while raising the cost of disruption. Yet recovery is often managed outside the cloud platforms organizations depend on every day. See how Microsoft and Commvault bring recovery directly into Azure through Commvault Cloud, an Azure Native ISV Service. Learn how a native approach can simplify operations, protect critical workloads, accelerate recovery, and strengthen the cloud foundation supporting AI-powered business initiatives.

sessions.t: AI Agents for banking file transfers: Faster answers, less manual work
sessions.d: In regulated banking environments, critical file transfers demand timely answers. Hear lessons learned from TowneBank’s use of AI agents to troubleshoot transfers, provision new customers, and simplify integration setup. See how Azure API Management, Logic Apps, and Files.com support natural-language troubleshooting, guided workflow setup, and the context agents need to act. Take away practical ideas for making your own file operations faster and less manual.

sessions.t: Deliver an intelligent workplace experience with Cisco
sessions.d: AI is changing how people work, and the workplace itself is becoming an ecosystem that can sense, reason, and act. See how networking, collaboration, real estate, and data can come together through a secure, intelligent architecture that connects people, places, and technology. Learn how to optimize workplace efficiency, simplify IT/OT management, and deploy Cisco devices for Microsoft Teams Rooms at scale.

sessions.t: Strengthen Copilot agent security with trusted data
sessions.d: Enterprises deploying Copilot and Copilot Studio agents move faster when built on trusted data foundations. See how Cyera and Microsoft work together to provide classification-aware context that strengthens Copilot Studio guardrails and helps security teams approve deployments faster. Discover every agent across your Microsoft estate, understand what data each can access, and reinforce runtime protection, including a live demonstration of agent quarantine grounded in trusted data classification.

sessions.t: Redefine connectivity for frontier firms
sessions.d: As AI moves into production, enterprises must securely connect workloads across clouds, private infrastructure, AI platforms, and the edge. See how Microsoft Azure and Equinix provide a connectivity foundation that evolves with AI demands. Experience a live demo of Equinix Fabric One connecting Azure to distributed data while extending connectivity across multicloud, neoclouds, and private infrastructure, keeping sensitive data where it is needed most.

sessions.t: See Elastic Nightshift and Azure SRE Agent investigate an incident
sessions.d: When an Azure incident fires, an SRE Agent starts from zero, even if root cause was found elsewhere. See how Elastic Nightshift’s detection engine exposes live, cited investigations to Azure SRE Agent via a connector to ground its answers. Explore the architecture, triage, root cause, and governed remediation, and see a live Azure Monitor alert route into Nightshift. Learn how to pair Azure’s agentic platform with Elastic’s investigation engine.

sessions.t: How Commvault reduced cloud storage costs by 40%
sessions.d: Commvault manages petabytes of data at scale, making the optimization of storage costs without compromising performance and resiliency a top priority. In this session, Karunakar Bojjireddy from Commvault and Vatsal Rastogi from Lucidity will share how Commvault improved storage efficiency to nearly 90% and reduced its cloud storage costs by 40%. See the approach they took and gain practical insights for optimizing storage at scale.

sessions.t: Turn Microsoft 365 into the foundation for secure AI services
sessions.d: The Microsoft 365 tenant is your customers' most critical piece of infrastructure. It's the focal point for identity, data, endpoints, communications, and now AI. Yet many MSPs still aren't managing that stack proactively. Join inforcer co-founder Will Connor to see how MSPs are building a complete management layer across Microsoft 365, strengthening security and governance while creating a foundation for secure AI services delivered consistently at scale.

sessions.t: Deploy intelligent SRE for autonomous cloud ops
sessions.d: As Azure environments get more complex, teams need to manage increasing alerts while maintaining context to act quickly. See three capabilities in action from Dynatrace and Microsoft: The Dynatrace Clouds App for AI-powered visibility across Azure; the Azure SRE Agent for autonomous, AI-guided incident resolution; and Dynatrace MCP integration with Microsoft Copilot for in-workflow observability. These capabilities help teams respond faster, reduce toil, and innovate with confidence.

sessions.t: Meet the demands of the AI era with behavioral security
sessions.d: AI is unlocking immense business potential, yet traditional security approaches lack the context needed to manage risk in increasingly autonomous and interconnected AI environments. Discover how behavioral security helps organizations safeguard AI, people, and infrastructure with confidence and at scale.

sessions.t: Scale AI delivery with forward deployed engineering on Azure
sessions.d: Coding agents can accelerate prototyping, but moving AI solutions into production requires architecture, security, governance, and deep business context. Learn how Fujitsu applies its forward deployed engineering approach alongside customers across manufacturing, financial services, retail, and other industries to deliver enterprise-scale AI on Azure. Discover how customer domain expertise, systems integration experience, and an AI-native platform help turn promising AI ideas into production-rea

sessions.t: Build agentic workflows with Microsoft Agent 365 and n8n
sessions.d: Enterprises want agents that get work done, not just answer questions. Building them requires identity, access, and orchestration. Microsoft Agent 365 provides identity and access, giving agents a Microsoft 365 presence, while n8n provides orchestration to reason over requests and act across your stack. See a workflow built live, what's GA today versus in Frontier preview, and practical lessons for building your first agentic workflow.

sessions.t: Protect your software supply chain from agents of chaos
sessions.d: AI agents are changing how software is developed and introducing new considerations for software supply chain security. Security and engineering leaders need visibility into what enters their software supply chain and whether it can be trusted. See why scan-and-patch approaches can fall short and how trusted open source and Microsoft Defender for Cloud can help teams strengthen security on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

sessions.t: How multimodal AI transforms property inspections at Ryan Specialty
sessions.d: Property inspections often require inspectors to gather and review information across photos, documents, forms, and notes. Learn how Ryan Specialty uses multimodal agents built with Azure AI Foundry to streamline this process. Discover how AI generates inspection checklists and recommendations from multiple data sources while keeping humans in the approval loop. Attendees will gain insights into using multimodal AI and agentic workflows to automate complex business processes.

sessions.t: Turn your network into the strategic control point for AI
sessions.d: AI is changing what organizations need from their networks. As AI expands across users, data, applications, and clouds, organizations need greater visibility, control, and insight to manage AI at scale. Learn how AI-grade networking can become a control point for AI, helping organizations strengthen security and governance, optimize performance, and build a foundation for sustainable AI growth.

sessions.t: Build resilience and recover Microsoft operations after compromise
sessions.d: If Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID were compromised tomorrow, how quickly can your organization restore trusted operations? In this session, explore a practical cyber resilience framework for Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, and Entra ID. Learn how to protect critical data, detect threats across your Microsoft environment, and recover trusted applications, identities, and data with confidence, using immutable recovery points, threat-informed recovery, and resilient infrastructure.

sessions.t: Copilot readiness doesn't stay ready
sessions.d: A tenant certified as Copilot-ready in March is only as ready as its configuration and identities are today. Discover why Copilot readiness is not a one-time milestone and explore practical ways to keep pace with changes across your Microsoft 365 environment.

sessions.t: AI changed what attackers find. It didn't change how they move.
sessions.d: Frontier AI changed what attackers can find and how quickly they can weaponize it. It did not change how attacks spread. Someone still has to move laterally to reach critical systems and data. See how Illumio Insights uses real-time east-west traffic across cloud and on-prem environments to identify lateral movement risk, validate segmentation, and prioritize remediation.

sessions.t: Extend Copilot Studio agents to securely act on enterprise data
sessions.d: Work IQ and Copilot Studio give your agents context and a place to run across the Microsoft estate. Together, CData and Microsoft extend that reach to live systems of record beyond the Microsoft ecosystem. See how CData Connect AI Gateway carries your Power BI semantic model forward, giving Copilot Studio agents a scoped, governed path to read and act on enterprise data, auditable end to end.

sessions.t: Connect Foundry to real-time communications with omnichannel AI agents
sessions.d: Omnichannel AI agents are difficult to deploy at scale. Learn how Foundry provides access to foundation models and enterprise governance, while Twilio orchestrates interactions across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and chat to maintain customer context. See how you can use the Twilio Agent Connect integration to move from concept to production faster and enable continuous, personalized conversations at enterprise scale.

sessions.t: Power to the practitioner: Connect Microsoft endpoint operations
sessions.d: Entra, Intune, Windows 365 Business, and Azure each have their own administration experiences. See how NinjaOne works across your Microsoft estate to connect endpoint operations and relevant data. In this live demo, watch Entra ID backup, Intune device enrollment, NinjaOne deployment on Windows 365 Cloud PCs, and Azure integration. Learn how a more connected view can help your teams save time and reduce risk.

sessions.t: Scale Azure VM storage and control costs with Everpure Cloud
sessions.d: Azure VM workloads need storage that can scale without adding unnecessary cost and operational complexity. In a live demo, see how Everpure Cloud Azure Native provides fully managed, enterprise-grade storage through familiar Azure workflows. Learn how to deploy and manage storage, scale performance and capacity independently, right-size resources, and simplify operations while supporting FinOps goals and controlling costs.

sessions.t: Microsoft 365 knows more than your workplace shows
sessions.d: A booking shows intent. What happens when people arrive? Join our panel to explore how Microsoft Places and digital signs connect workplace information with the experience at the desk or meeting room. Through customer stories and workplace transformation experience, see what drives adoption, what bookings leave out, and how better evidence supports decisions about space. Leave with practical questions to apply to your own workplace.

sessions.t: Apply quantum AI to complex business decisions
sessions.d: AI, copilots, and agents are helping businesses work more efficiently. But some challenges are becoming more complex, involving many possible variables, interactions, and outcomes that traditional approaches cannot fully explore. Learn how quantum AI may extend today's AI systems, how organizations are testing practical applications, and how SAS Viya on Azure and SAS Quantum Lab support use-case discovery, hybrid experimentation, and evidence-based decisions about what to try next.

sessions.t: Navigate the next wave of AI and frontier technologies
sessions.d: Learn practical lessons and diverse perspectives from leaders navigating the rapidly evolving landscape of AI and frontier technologies. Hear how organizations are approaching the next wave of innovation, transformation, and value creation in this executive fireside chat.

sessions.t: When the insider threat is a deepfake
sessions.d: Deepfakes are creating new identity and security challenges as fraudsters impersonate executives and bad actors use AI to pass interviews, compromise helpdesks, and infiltrate enterprise systems. Join Pindrop CPO Nicholas Holland to see real examples of deepfakes Pindrop has detected and learn how Pindrop and Microsoft can help safeguard conversations through real-time deepfake detection and continuous identity verification.

sessions.t: Extend Intune, AVD, and Copilot with autonomous endpoint management
sessions.d: Intune provides the foundation for endpoint management at scale, but IT teams also need visibility into employee experience. As Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, and Copilot adoption grow, DEX telemetry and agentic AI help correlate signals across devices, apps, and users. Learn how IT teams can proactively resolve issues, improve adoption, and demonstrate value from Microsoft investments.

sessions.t: Optimize your Azure costs with expert insights
sessions.d: More Azure teams are adopting Reservations and Savings Plans, but savings don't always keep pace. An analysis of $1B+ in Azure compute spend found coverage rising faster than Effective Savings Rate (ESR), while lock-in risk climbed. See how commitments cut costs without engineering changes or tradeoffs, why ESR hits a ceiling, and how automation pushes past it safely. See how ProsperOps automates rate optimization and explore new offerings. See how you measure up and learn steps to improve.

sessions.t: Turn AI ambition into enterprise impact
sessions.d: AI strategy is easy to write and hard to sustain. In this session, Wipro's Ramachandran Padmanabhan and Shiv Krishnan share the playbook that carries frontier organizations from pilot to P&L: a portfolio approach to agentic use cases, data and security foundations that scale, and change leadership that brings people along. Drawing on transformations across industries with Microsoft Azure and Copilot, they share the metrics, milestones, and traps to avoid that keep momentum compounding.

sessions.t: Build governed AI that understands your business context
sessions.d: Discover how Azure Databricks helps AI systems understand your business context, identify authoritative sources, and deliver trusted, governed answers grounded in your organization's data. From conversational analytics to autonomous AI agents and application development, see how teams can put trusted intelligence directly into Microsoft Teams and the tools they already use.

sessions.t: Accelerate business with AI-powered agreements from Docusign
sessions.d: What happens when your AI agents have the full context of what your business agreed to? See how Docusign's agreement intelligence—grounded in the terms, negotiation history, approvals, and business logic of your agreements—informs Microsoft Copilot to surface insights and trigger governed workflows, helping teams move from agreement to action, faster.

sessions.t: Build global data infrastructure with computing‑power‑cooling synergy
sessions.d: Learn real-world practices for deploying large-scale data center infrastructure to meet growing AI demands. Explore end-to-end infrastructure solutions, including highly reliable UPS and liquid cooling technologies, and see how the synergy of computing, power, and cooling can improve data center efficiency, increase deployment agility, and accelerate AI-ready infrastructure.

sessions.t: Build a secure platform for containers, VMs, and AI
sessions.d: Learn how to provide a robust security foundation with vulnerability management, backporting, CVE remediation, and more. Building on that foundation, Red Hat Lightwell and Red Hat Enterprise Linux share how Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes and OpenShift Virtualization accelerate application delivery. Join us to learn how to provide a security-first approach to deploy and manage containers, VMs, and agentic AI systems.

sessions.t: Trace, evaluate, and ship reliable AI agents
sessions.d: Catching a bad prompt, tool, or model change before it reaches production comes down to a repeatable loop: trace, evaluate, monitor, and test. Put this loop into practice with an agent deployed on Microsoft Foundry. Trace LLM and tool calls with Datadog Agent Observability to identify regressions and establish a repeatable framework for monitoring and governing AI applications at scale.

sessions.t: Skip the copy tax and ground AI on enterprise file data
sessions.d: Your best answers are locked in enterprise file data - and copying it into an AI platform is a tax you shouldn't pay. In 25 minutes, watch a Microsoft Foundry agent get grounded directly on Azure NetApp Files with zero data copy, then answer real questions inside Microsoft 365 Copilot. Then go agentic with MCP: drive that agent from VS Code, and manage Azure NetApp Files at scale in natural language with the Azure MCP Server. One live demo, no copies, no copy tax.

sessions.t: Create endpoint resilience: The missing layer in business continuity
sessions.d: Most continuity plans protect data and applications, but endpoint access is often the missing layer. Explore how immutable endpoint design, centralized control, and alternate access paths can strengthen resilience during cyber incidents. Through real-world customer examples, see how organizations can restore user access in minutes while preserving the Windows partition, helping maintain secure access to critical Microsoft workspaces.

sessions.t: Innovate for the frontier firm with ServiceNow and Microsoft
sessions.d: Microsoft and ServiceNow are developing new innovations together to help customers become frontier firms. See how recent releases are helping joint customers accelerate time to value, how Microsoft and ServiceNow co-design solutions that bring the two platforms together, and what’s ahead in the next wave of integrated capabilities.

sessions.t: Is your conference room ready for Copilot?
sessions.d: Copilot is transforming individual work, but many conference rooms were designed for AV, not AI. Copilot and Facilitator experiences benefit from the intelligence the room provides, including identified voices and better representation of remote participants. From Surface Hub transitions and Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows deployments, DTEN shows how AI-grade compute, room awareness, and meeting intelligence extend Copilot's value from the individual to the whole meeting.

sessions.t: Skip the pipelines and give AI live data with MongoDB
sessions.d: AI is only as good as the data it can access. In this live demo, the audience becomes the dataset. Responses submitted during the session are written directly into MongoDB Atlas and immediately used by AI agents powered by Foundry IQ, Fabric IQ and Work IQ. Watch agents uncover insights, compare trends, connect knowledge and recommend actions in real time. Learn how to build AI on operational data while reducing pipelines, avoiding separate vector stores, and simplifying retrieval architectures.

sessions.t: Secure remote onboarding with Yubico, CLEAR, and Entra
sessions.d: Remote onboarding is a high‑risk, Zero Trust phase for many organizations. Shipping a laptop and YubiKey is easy but proving a remote user’s identity before key registration is not. Attackers increasingly exploit Day Zero helpdesks to bypass MFA. Join Yubico and CLEAR to see an Entra‑powered workflow that verifies identity, issues a verifiable credential, and binds a YubiKey with no helpdesk needed. Come for the insights, leave with a blueprint for zero‑touch provisioning and reduced fraud.

sessions.t: Layer KnowBe4 behavioral AI and threat intelligence onto Microsoft
sessions.d: Build on Microsoft’s essential security foundation with a layered approach to zero-payload threats and outbound data leaks, one that understands user communication behaviors, automates with explainable verdict evidence, and calculates a unified Risk Score to measure security program effectiveness. Join to see why Microsoft selected KnowBe4 as an inaugural ICES Vendor Ecosystem partner and ranked KnowBe4 Defend #1 across every reported uplift metric in the 2026 email security benchmark report.

sessions.t: Enact one firewall policy across the enterprise
sessions.d: Explore key network security challenges across your Azure implementation and beyond. See how cloud firewall functionality delivered as a service through Microsoft Marketplace can support a consistent approach to security. Examine reference architectures, Azure migration in flight, and approaches to securing AI workloads.

sessions.t: Remove exploitable access before attackers find it
sessions.d: As Azure environments evolve, managed identities, role assignments, and network rules can accumulate long after their original purpose. AI gives attackers new ways to discover and exploit that access faster. See how to flip the model: compare configured access with observed access, define what should exist, and enforce it across identity and network, removing entire attack paths without breaking production.

sessions.t: Power the intelligent enterprise edge with Microsoft and Snapdragon
sessions.d: Enterprise AI is evolving into an intelligent ecosystem spanning devices and cloud. Explore how Microsoft and Qualcomm bring together AI models, Windows AI, enterprise services, and efficient heterogeneous compute for secure, responsive AI experiences. See how developers and enterprises can optimize across CPU, GPU, and NPU, orchestrate local and cloud workloads, and build a foundation for intelligent applications and AI agents that deliver business outcomes.

sessions.t: Secure AI on Azure with Fortinet’s AI-native Security Fabric
sessions.d: As organizations expand AI adoption on Azure, securing agents, applications, data, and MCP activity across the AI lifecycle becomes increasingly important. Learn how Fortinet security capabilities integrate with Microsoft Azure to strengthen protection from cloud governance through runtime security. See how customers are using Fortinet Security Fabric on Azure to support secure cloud and AI adoption.

sessions.t: Get a clean signal, faster answers with Cribl and Microsoft Sentinel
sessions.d: Security teams face noisy, growing telemetry volumes, a challenge accelerated by AI workloads, increasing data-ingestion costs and slowing investigations. See how Cribl Stream filters and enriches security data in motion, sending only clean, high-value signals to Microsoft Sentinel. Then learn how AI-powered investigations with Cribl Search connect to Microsoft Copilot, giving analysts a faster, more complete path from signal to answer.

sessions.t: Accelerate engineering innovation with AI-driven simulation on Azure
sessions.d: Engineering organizations need to innovate faster while managing increasingly complex simulation workloads. See how Siemens Simcenter X brings trusted engineering applications, scalable HPC, and AI-enabled capabilities to Microsoft Azure. Learn how engineering teams can expand design exploration, use predictive modelling, and make faster, more informed engineering decisions.

sessions.t: Leverage recursive self-improvement to train better AI agents
sessions.d: Recursive self-improvement is a closely scrutinized concept on the AI frontier. But for people building agents, it also presents compelling possibilities: giving agents the opportunity to train against synthetic customers, fix their own tools when they fail, and proactively improve. Napster CTO Edo Segal breaks down how to build AI agents with RSI capabilities responsibly, how RSI can improve agent performance, and what Agentic RSI means for future deployment of AI agents.

sessions.t: Turn customer intelligence into action with Adobe and Microsoft
sessions.d: Organizations have more customer data than ever, but turning insight into action remains complex. Bring customer experience intelligence into the flow of work with Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Discover how AI can bring customer context into the flow of human ambition, helping teams accelerate decisions, coordinate action, and turn customer intelligence into action.

sessions.t: Transform collaboration for users and IT using AI
sessions.d: AI has been improving meeting experiences since before most of us heard of ChatGPT or Copilot. But now it’s moving beyond the room itself and giving IT admins a new set of tools. See how it’s changing the in-room experience and walk through how it’s giving IT greater visibility and control.

sessions.t: Why are we still treating AI agents as software?
sessions.d: AI agents are gaining greater autonomy, but treating them only as software can limit how we think about trust and control. Organizations have faced this problem before: How do you delegate real authority without giving up control? The answer may already exist in a place few AI teams are looking. Explore an unexpected model for thinking differently about AI agents and the authority we give them.

sessions.t: Design resilient security for the agentic era
sessions.d: AI agents are expanding the attack surface, while manual security struggles to keep pace. Explore how organizations can build resilience by hardening infrastructure and enforcing Zero Trust principles across agents, endpoints, networks, cloud environments, and data centers. See how identity, segmentation, vulnerability shielding, and AI-assisted response can help teams limit exposure, govern agent actions, and respond at machine speed with human expertise guiding decisions.

sessions.t: Turn AI agents into AI experts with your trusted enterprise context
sessions.d: Your AI agents need more than data. They need trusted data and the enterprise context that gives it meaning. In this fast-paced, demo-first session, see how Informatica and Microsoft work together to deliver both. Watch an agent built in Microsoft Foundry explore business definitions, lineage, and governance before it ever touches the data. Then go behind the scenes to see how Informatica's deep Microsoft Fabric integrations provide the trusted data and context that make it possible.

sessions.t: Scale your cloud business through one marketplace
sessions.d: See how a modern cloud marketplace can simplify the way partners expand their portfolio and manage their cloud business. Through a live demonstration, discover practical capabilities including fraud protection, AI-powered support, automated Azure and Microsoft 365 provisioning, upgrades and subscription date alignment, all designed to help partners operate efficiently and scale. Then, see how these capabilities are coming to the US partner ecosystem through ALSO and Intermedia.

sessions.t: Build with Lovable, ship in your Microsoft environment
sessions.d: Your team has ideas for internal apps and a security review standing between them and production. Experience an app built with Lovable live, then see two ways to run it in your Microsoft environment: Copilot Managed Runtime and Lovable on Azure. Explore what each path looks like, who controls what, and how to choose between them. Leave ready to build something that week.

sessions.t: Building agents with Claude in Foundry: Choosing your stack
sessions.d: Can you use Claude's agent harness on Microsoft Foundry? Yes. The real question is how much of the agent you want to own. This session maps out your options, from the Claude Managed Agents to Claude Agent SDK and Microsoft Agent Framework to Foundry Agent Service and Copilot Studio, along with one trade-off: control versus managed hosting. Leave with lessons from building Claude Code and Cowork, a way to keep tools portable with MCP and skills, and a simple way to choose between your harness and hosting options.

sessions.t: Model Frontiers: Ask more of Claude in Foundry
sessions.d: Every few months a new model crosses a threshold and entire ways of working change, yet most teams still ask for last year’s tasks. See how to hand complex, multi-step work to Claude in Microsoft Foundry and get back results you can check, while staying in control of quality and cost. Choose the right model with your own evaluations, set how thorough it is with effort, and keep long jobs on track with context management and memory. Leave ready to keep pace as the frontier moves.

Leslie is a Microsoft MVP and has worked end-to-end in the data arena from capture and ETL to database design/engineering to analysis and dashboard design to ML use cases with a focus on improving productivity, performance, and data quality. She has extensive experience in enterprise deployment of Power BI, both as an admin and Power BI architect, and as a trainer and technical community organizer. She is passionate about data governance, truth-telling in data, and creating collaborative environments across data practitioners and the numerous data stakeholders. Leslie co-organizes Power BI DC and frequently attends and speaks at data community meetups in the DC metro area, including but not limited to Data Viz DC, Data Science DC, Women Who Code DC, Washington DC Power Platform User Group, and Generative AI DC. Leslie was recognized as a 2023 New Power Woman in Tech by DCA Live, on the RealLIST Engineers 2024 as one of 15 technologists helping the DMV ecosystem grow, and the Most Active Speakers 2025 on Sessionize.

Ankit Kumar Honey is a Senior Engineering Manager at GitHub, where he leads Dependabot, the system that delivers dependency alerts, automated security updates, and version updates across 30M+ repositories and 30+ package ecosystems. His work focuses on detecting vulnerable and malicious dependencies at ecosystem scale and on AI-agent-driven vulnerability remediation. Ankit has spoken at the NIST Software and Supply Chain Assurance Forum and Microsoft Reactor, and has written for Help Net Security and The Times of India. He is an IEEE Senior Member and is pursuing an M.S. in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at Harvard University Extension School.

Sergey Fayfer is Corporate Vice President of Copilot Product Experience at Microsoft, where he leads the experiences people use to create, build and delegate work with AI. He has spent more than a decade building AI products. He founded Spellwise, acquired by Perplexity, and Sayana, a Y Combinator company acquired by Headspace, and led product at Replika.

Sylvia Liu is a Senior Product Marketing Manager at Microsoft, driving go-to-market strategy for Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop. She focuses on translating product innovation into clear customer value, helping organizations modernize their workplace through secure, flexible, cloud-powered Windows experiences.

A.J. is Director of Product Marketing where he leads product marketing for Windows 365 Link, the first Cloud PC device. In his 20 years at Microsoft, he has held roles in sales, business planning and product marketing. Previous he worked at an investment bank as IT Pro.

Divya Chirasani is a Principal Product Manager at Microsoft, leading Agent Observability for Microsoft Foundry. Her work helps developers understand agent behavior, diagnose production issues, and improve agent quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. Previously, she was a founding team member and VP of Product at an AI startup, where she helped scale an AI agent platform from concept to millions of users. With a background spanning software engineering, strategy consulting, and product leadership, Divya brings a practical perspective on building and operating AI products at scale.

Naresh Venkat works on agentic AI at Microsoft Fabric and was co-founder of Osmos, an agentic data engineering startup acquired by Microsoft. Prior to Osmos, he led AI/ML product partnerships for Google Cloud. He has spent his career building at the intersection of data and AI, with a particular interest in turning technological breakthroughs into products that work in the real world.

Carlin is a Product Manager at GitHub working in GitHub Advanced Security, with a focus on Dependabot. Her background in software engineering and data science informs her approach to product management. She lives in Washington with her partner and their dog, Cookie, and spends her free time cycling and playing competitive board games.

Eugenie Burrage is focused on how AI is reshaping the way we manage and secure work, grounded in proven endpoint management strategies. Through her work on Microsoft Intune, she helps shape product strategies informed by close connections with customer communities and the real-world needs of IT and security professionals. She partners with product and engineering teams to translate those insights into practical experiences that help customers manage and secure work across platforms while embracing new AI capabilities.

Phil Gerity is a Partner Group Product Manager at Microsoft, where he leads the agentic platform and developer experiences for Windows Cloud. He helps organizations modernize work with secure, scalable cloud-powered Windows experiences built for AI and agentic workloads.

Manoj Jain is Global Frontier Partner Leader at Microsoft, helping MSPs, Distributors, Solution Providers and other Channel players move from AI experimentation to profitable growth. He works with partner leaders to develop outcome-led AI services, differentiated offers, recurring-revenue models, and scalable go-to-market motions built around Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI.
During his tenure at Microsoft, Manoj has held leadership roles spanning channel and direct sales, cloud service providers, strategic partner development and global TMT business. He also serves on the Wireless Division Board of the Consumer Technology Association. Manoj holds an MBA from the University of Toronto’s Rotman School of Management and a graduate degree in computer science from the University of Alberta. His work sits at the intersection of technology, business-model innovation, and ecosystem growth.

Srinivasan Manoharan (Srini) leads Generative AI and Agent Platform & Infrastructure at PayPal. His teams build PayPal’s agentic AI platform end to end, from GPU infrastructure and model serving to the agent layer and AI tools.. In short, he is responsible for the platform that empowers PayPal’s employees to increase their productivity and powers agentic product experiences for customers at global scale.

Pavan Tagirisa is a Principal Data & AI Engineer specializing in enterprise AI platforms, Generative AI, and production-scale AI architecture. He focuses on operationalizing AI workloads securely and reliably, bridging the gap between experimentation and enterprise-ready deployment. His work spans AI platform engineering, model deployment, governance, observability, and agentic AI, with a focus on enabling scalable AI adoption across the enterprise.

Experienced intrapreneur with track record of driving product and engineering strategy to bootstrap global programs with 100s of engineers contributing in building cloud scale services with 10s of millions in budget and 100s of millions in annual recognized revenue for Microsoft and Partners.

Shachaf Levy is a Principal Lead Technical Program Manager at Microsoft R&D, leading a team of research TPMs across Microsoft Defender and the broader Microsoft Security portfolio, where he blends strategy with delivering solutions at scale. His focus spans cross-product research and threats, XDR, cloud security, and the evolving AI threat landscape, and he was part of the team that brought generative AI to the SOC through Microsoft Security Copilot. With 15+ years in the field, including a prior decade as a cloud and mobile security architect – Shachaf is a CISSP, GCIH, and TOGAF-certified practitioner and a mentor to security startups. Fun fact: a big fan of basketball and the NBA.

As the lead of Portfolio Marketing at Commvault, I drive strategic positioning and go-to-market alignment across our dynamic partner ecosystem. With a focus on hyperscalers, cybersecurity alliances, and analyst relations, I help shape Commvault’s narrative around cyber resilience, quantum-safe security, and agentic AI. I’m a frequent contributor to thought leadership initiatives, including blogs, webinars, and industry events like Microsoft Ignite, Gartner SRM, and other partner forums.

I’m passionate about building bridges between innovation and execution, whether it’s launching joint solutions with partners, securing analyst recognition in Data Security, or simplifying marketplace offerings to accelerate co-sell motions with our partners. I bring a pragmatic, customer-first lens to every conversation, helping organizations navigate complexity with clarity.

Aruna Ranganathan is General Manager of Data Analytics at Microsoft, driving the convergence of data, analytics, and applied AI to build customer-centric, business-ready AI agents and agentic applications at scale. She is passionate about moving AI from experimentation to enterprise-scale impact, creating intelligent solutions that solve real customer challenges, enable smarter decisions, and deliver tangible business outcomes.

Alexandru Costin is Vice President of Adobe Builders eXperience (ABX), where he leads Adobe’s efforts to transform software development with AI and agentic technologies. With 25 years at Adobe, he previously led the development and expansion of Adobe Firefly as Vice President of Generative AI & Sensei. Today, he focuses on empowering teams to build, prototype, and operate AI-powered software. A champion of responsible AI, Alexandru advocates for technology that amplifies human creativity and ingenuity.

Prasad Kona is a Senior Staff Partner Engineer at Databricks, where he works with technology partners to build on and integrate with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Focused on AI agents and GenAI, he develops reference architectures and best-practice guidance that help partners take their solutions from prototype to production faster.

Chief AI Transformation Officer at Wortell, one of the largest Microsoft partners in the Netherlands. Microsoft MVP.

Most organizations are adding AI to the way they already work. I help lead teams redesign the work itself, because that’s where the real value is.

Founder of Dutch Women in Tech and Rockstar Women in AI & Security.

At Ignite I’ll be on the floor capturing customer stories: what actually changes when AI lands in day-to-day work. Spot me? Come say hi. I love talking agents, adoption and what Monday morning looks like in an AI-first organization.

Daniel Arrizza leads partner engineering at Anyscale, working with partners on shared products and go-to-market, and customers in their deep technical problems.

Co-Founder, COO and Managing Partner of Ludia Consulting, with more than 25 years of experience in technology, consulting and business transformation.

Career experience spans software development, technical and enterprise architecture, ERP project and program leadership, and local and global Microsoft Dynamics implementations. Starting as a developer and technical architect created a strong technical foundation that continues to shape a practical, hands-on approach to leadership, problem solving and delivery.

Today, the focus is on growing Ludia, building strong teams and leaders, and helping customers successfully navigate complex business and technology transformations. MBA from Portland State University and BS in Computer Science from Drexel University, along with PMP, Scrum Master and Microsoft technology certifications. Native German speaker.

Suff believes in combining meaningful design and intelligent technology to enable human value. He is passionate about building high-performing teams that build products/services that solve problems, discover product-market fit, delight people, generate user growth, influence culture, and drive strategic business value. He remains at the forefront of his craft by taking a cross-discipline approach. Prior to Microsoft, Suff has worked at and advised startups and Fortune 500 companies building creative and enterprise solutions. His in-depth knowledge and practical experience in software design, from design concept creation to development and release, enable him to build strong strategic partnerships with Research, Strategy, Design, Engineering, Brand and Marketing teams to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions. He maintains a fine balance between leading, managing, and being hands-on collaborative. His favorite TV show is Ted Lasso.

Jeff Boudier builds products at Hugging Face, the #1 open platform for AI builders. Previously Jeff was a co-founder of Stupeflix, acquired by GoPro, where he served as director of Product Management, Product Marketing, Business Development and Corporate Development.

Ondrej Vysek is a Presales Lead at SoftwareOne, specializing in Modern Work, Microsoft Security, Power Platform, and AI across Central and Eastern Europe. With more than 25 years of experience with Microsoft technologies, he has worked across infrastructure, identity, security, collaboration, automation, and workplace transformation. Today, his focus is on helping organizations get practical value from Microsoft 365, Copilot, security, and AI, connecting technology with real business outcomes and the way people actually work. A frequent speaker and technology enthusiast, Ondrej is passionate about making complex technology understandable, useful, and accessible to everyone.

Ricky is a product manager with Microsoft Teams Platform, his focus is largely centered around curating developer experiences and tools to bring the latest Teams capabilities to developers and their agents.

Nick brings a multidisciplinary perspective to the work, combining experience in enterprise technology, biotechnology, and entrepreneurship with an MBA and a master’s degree in biotechnology. He is especially interested in how organizations can move quickly from experimentation to real-world value while keeping people, governance, and usability at the center.

Cody Hosterman is a product leader at Everpure, focused on cloud, virtualization, and emerging infrastructure platforms. Cody has deep experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure and is particularly focused on helping customers modernize their data platforms across on-premises, public cloud, and next-generation virtualization environments.

Manmeet Dhillon is Head of Enterprise AI at Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) leading enterprise-wide AI strategy, platforms and transformation. He focused on scaling AI & agentic solutions, driving measurable business value and enabling responsible AI adoption.

Kimberly Bryant is an award-winning technology leader, entrepreneur, investor, and author working at the intersection of technology, innovation, and social impact. She is the founder and CEO of Ascend Ventures and Black Innovation Lab, where she supports emerging entrepreneurs building transformative, technology-driven companies and advances pathways to ownership and generational wealth.

Previously, Kimberly founded Black Girls CODE, a groundbreaking organization that introduced more than 100,000 girls of color to technology and computer science. Former President of the Project Management Institute (PMI) Dallas Chapter and a contributor to PMI's AI standard, she empowers nonprofits, project professionals, students, and youth leaders on their AI journeys.

speakers.bio: Brad Foss is Vice President and Head of Digital Platform Delivery at Zurich U.S., where he leads digital workplace services and Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption. He focuses on making AI practical at enterprise scale, combining thoughtful governance with real-world adoption to help employees integrate AI into everyday work and turn it into measurable business value.

Eric Wakkuri is Senior Vice President of Vendor Partnerships at New Charter Technologies, where he leads the company’s technology partner ecosystem and its Microsoft partnership. He turns the scale of more than 1,300 people across 50+ markets into vendor programs that give every New Charter team, and their clients, better technology, pricing and support. Eric builds what he recommends: he designed Wayfinder, a chief-of-staff agent built on Microsoft 365 Copilot with Agent Builder, which started as his own daily tool and now helps New Charter clients put Copilot to work.

Nick Pope is VP - AI Enablement at New Charter Technologies, an official Anthropic partner, where he built and leads a five-person team dedicated to making AI work in real business workflows. His approach is tool-agnostic and results-driven: build AI intuition first, then turn that intuition into augmentation, and finally automation. Every session is a live build, so people leave with something they can use that day. Across more than 100 client engagements since 2023, he's guided organizations ranging from small professional firms to franchise brands with 800+ locations through their AI adoption journey. Nick believes AI literacy isn't a one-time event, it's an ongoing practice that starts with leadership and scales from there.

Amanda Jack  is the Chief Technology Officer of ManpowerGroup, leading the global technology function across four regions and all shared infrastructure and product applications. As CTO, Amanda drives transformation with business strategy at the forefront, ensuring ManpowerGroup connects human potential to the power of business. Amanda brings more than 20 years of transformation experience across workforce solutions, retail, travel and leisure, global data standards, and supply chain. She joined ManpowerGroup in 2021 as Vice President of North America Information Technology, progressively expanding her responsibilities to include analytics, business operations, and regional technology leadership before being promoted to CTO in March 2025. Prior to ManpowerGroup, Amanda served as Chief Technology Officer at Smarte Carte, where she led the integration of two growth acquisitions and transformed the company's operating system for connected data monitoring. Earlier, she held an industry role at GS1 US, helping companies assess and improve their data management to deliver seamless customer experiences. Amanda began her career at Target, where she spent 20 years leading enterprise-wide improvements through strategy, technology, data and analytics, and process reinvention, with a focus on large-scale change initiatives in master data and business intelligence. Amanda serves as Chair of the MinnesotaCIO Advisory Board and is an advocate for women in technology.
