With more than 20 years of SharePoint experience and courses on LinkedIn Learning, Pluralsight, and ClipTraining, I help people turn Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Power Platform possibilities into everyday wins.

My favorite shortcut? Making technology click for the people using it. I bring practical know-how, a people-first approach, and a little humor to helping organizations work smarter, not harder.

At Ignite, I’m here to swap ideas, discover what’s next, and connect with fellow Microsoft enthusiasts. Let’s talk adoption, productivity, or your favorite “wait—you can do THAT?” moment!.
Senior Director of Enterprise Architecture and Software Engineering at Columbia Sportswear.

Patrick David is a Principal Product Manager in Microsoft Security's Customer Value Creation (CVC) organization. He focuses on Agentic AI, Security Copilot, Microsoft Purview, and Project Perception, partnering with customers and engineering teams to drive product innovation and accelerate customer success. With almost 20 years of experience across collaboration and security technologies, Patrick brings deep expertise in AI governance, security, data security, and enterprise adoption of emerging technologies.

Kevin serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Quorum Cyber, leading the company's mission to deliver Microsoft-first, threat-led cybersecurity services that translate real-world threat signals into clarity, confidence, and stronger defense.

I am EY’s Global Cybersecurity Consulting Leader, responsible for EY’s cybersecurity practice with over 18,000 practitioners and 4,500+ clients. I lead the growth of the practice, drives EY’s cybersecurity solutions and AI investments, and serve clients. I advise senior executives and boards on cyber risk and the transformation of cyber operations. I have worked in industries including financial services, government, telecommunications and technology, power and utilities, transport and retail. Before EY, I held leadership roles in the technology and defence sectors. Originally based in the UK, I have lived in Asia-Pacific since 2012.

Nick Granack is an Managing Director leading the EY Americas Digital Security practice covering data protection, privacy, cloud and application security. He has sixteen years of experience at EY working with Fortune 500 clients across multiple sectors, across the Microsoft security stack. Experience within cybersecurity includes data protection program transformation, operations management and execution, high value information asset (HVIA) programs, data classification and discovery, data loss prevention, secure data governance, Generative AI adoption, etc.
Engineering leadership at Legora. Previously founder of Cadastral, acquired by Legora.

Mahdi Ghodsi is an AI Solution Architect at AMD, specializing in the integration of open-source AI projects and the development of advanced AI solutions optimized for AMD GPUs. A decade of building AI applications, from early CNNs to today’s LLMs.

speakers.j: Deputy Director of the Office of Technology Services/ State Chief Platform Officer
speakers.bio: With over 26 years at the California Department of Technology (CDT), I’ve held roles in system platform specialization, network engineering, unit management, and executive leadership. As Deputy Director of the Office of Technology Services and State ChiefPlatformOfficer, I lead state data center to drive key IT initiatives to foster innovation and optimize solutions. I focus on aligning technology with department goals and customer needs, while fostering collaboration across leadership, agencies, and vendors to deliver impactful results for California.

Masaki Kumamoto is a Senior AI Solutions Architect at UiPath, based in Victoria, BC. He designs enterprise agentic orchestration and automation solutions, and he has led AI partnerships with Microsoft, Snowflake, Databricks and NVIDIA.

Eva Gram is Microsoft Strategic Partnership Manager at Proximus Luxembourg, leading the strategic relationship with Microsoft and helping translate technology innovation into business value. Her work focuses on AI, cloud and digital transformation, with a particular interest in responsible AI adoption and digital sovereignty. She connects technology, business strategy and partnership opportunities to help organizations turn the potential of AI into concrete outcomes.

Brendan Mislin is a senior technology and go-to-market leader focused on Cloud, AI, applications and infrastructure. As a Managing Director at Avanade, he leads solution strategy and growth initiatives aligned to the Microsoft ecosystem, helping organizations modernize their technology estates and translate emerging technologies into tangible business value.

Tina Schuchman is Corporate Vice President for Microsoft Foundry in CoreAI, leading product and engineering for the Foundry agent platform, the platform developers use to build, deploy, and operate AI agents at scale. Her team owns the end-to-end experience: everything developers need to take an agent from idea to production and run it with confidence.

Before Microsoft, Tina led Growth Engineering at Atlassian and scaled developer platforms at Meta and Dropbox, where she was one of the company's first mobile engineers. She holds a BS and MEng from MIT, and is a Scout with Sequoia Capital.

speakers.j: Corporate Vice President Microsoft Frontier Company
speakers.bio:
Tosca Is the EMEA CVP of Industry Solutions Delivery within the Microsoft Frontier Company. Tosca’s career has been founded on driving value with customers through technology and she was formerly the President of Kyndryl UK and Ireland; the new publicly traded Global Technology spinout of IBM. Tosca was the first female president for Kyndryl globally. A veteran technology leader with more than three decades in the Industry working at IBM for 28 years in Global, European and Country Leadership roles. Tosca was also the first female to lead IBM’s Systems and Technology Group and has a depth of leadership and solutions capability.

Tosca is a passionate champion of Diversity and Inclusion and has been an active supporter of Graduate, Future Leaders and Apprenticeship schemes. Tosca is Executive Sponsor of Microsoft's Disabilities Employee Resource Group and Diversity & Inclusion all up for Microsoft UK. She is a member of the Technology Leadership Group for The King's Trust (formerly Prince's Trust) and on the Business Advisory Council for Ada College, supporting their digital employability skills programs, ensuring young people are developing the right skills for a digital economy.

speakers.j: Principal Service Engineer: Azure Post Incident Reviews (PIRs)
speakers.bio: Azure reliability and post-incident transparency.

Lei Xu is a Product Manager at Microsoft working on Windows AI, where he focuses on enabling on-device experiences using Windows AI APIs + local models. At Ignite 2026, he will share practical approaches to integrating AI into real-world applications.

Pawan Tahiliani is a Product Manager in Microsoft's Windows CoreOS Silicon, Graphics, and Media (SiGMa) organization. He focuses on the DirectX Compute Graph Compiler (DXCGC), working across Microsoft engineering teams, silicon partners, and software developers to enable high-performance AI workloads on Windows. His work spans AI compiler technologies, model optimization, hardware acceleration across GPUs and NPUs, and the platform capabilities powering next-generation AI experiences.
Product Manager on Microsoft Foundry, focused on Observability - helping developers understand agent behavior, diagnose issues, and turn production evidence into actionable improvements.

Meng Tang is a product leader at Microsoft focused on Microsoft Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, and cloud-to-edge AI. His work spans model fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, on-device AI, model distribution, developer runtimes, and scalable enterprise deployments—helping developers, ISVs, and OEMs take AI applications from experimentation to production across cloud, edge, and local environments.

Gulsimo Osimi is a Technical Program Manager at Microsoft who leads initiatives that bring frontier AI innovations and open-source models to Microsoft Foundry, enabling developers and organizations to build, customize, and deploy AI solutions at scale.

Gustavo is an AI Engineer and Developer Advocate from Venezuela. His work encompasses developing practical solutions which implement AI in various forms, currently specializing in AI Speech, Agentic Development and Agent Memory.

Omar Shahine is a Corporate Vice President at Microsoft, where he leads Microsoft Autopilot, Microsoft’s effort to build the next generation of always-on personal agents for Microsoft 365.

Microsoft Autopilot builds on foundational work from OpenClaw and Microsoft 365 to create enterprise-ready AI agents that can operate securely across Microsoft 365. The team is focused on the cloud gateway and runtime layer for agentic workloads, including identity, governance, security, and compliance for continuously running assistants at enterprise scale.
Omar has worked at Microsoft for more than 27 years in product leadership roles. Prior to Microsoft Autopilot, he led the Microsoft Word team, including generative AI capabilities in Word as part of Microsoft 365 Copilot. Earlier, he led Product Management for OneDrive and SharePoint and is one of OneDrive’s co-founders.
Omar is known for building strong product-making cultures rooted in curiosity, inclusion, and craft. He writes a product review newsletter, OmarKnows.com, and an AI newsletter, OmarKnows.ai.

Derek Johnson is Vice President and General Manager of the PowerPoint Product Group, where he is responsible for the vision, strategy, and execution of PowerPoint. He is focused on reimagining how we use PowerPoint to tell stories with AI and is responsible for visual creation in M365 Copilot. Prior to his current role, Derek helped drive innovation across presentation and content creation experiences, leading the creation of Microsoft Designer, as well as driving the app shell for M365 Copilot. Derek is passionate about building products and teams with a curious mindset, always eager to explore the art of the possible. Derek has long invested and believed in the power of AI and the impact it can have on productivity, notably releasing Office's first AI feature, PowerPoint Designer.

Sophie Ke is a Senior Product Marketing Manager responsible for shaping the Trust, Security, and Governance narrative for Microsoft Copilot. With extensive technical expertise in Microsoft Purview and Security for GenAI, and a career spanning government, public, and non-profit sectors, Sophie is dedicated to making people’s lives more efficient and better.

Erica Toelle is a Senior Product Marketing Manager at Microsoft focused on securing and governing the next generation of AI agents. She partners across Microsoft Security, Agent 365, and Windows to define the security and governance strategy for emerging AI technologies, helping organizations manage risk while accelerating AI innovation.

Nirav Shah, Corporate Vice President at Microsoft, leads the Agent 365 and Agent Cloud team, focusing on building reliable AI platforms that help organizations solve business challenges and achieve meaningful results through advanced technology.
In this role, Nirav leads Agent 365—Microsoft’s control plane for managing AI agents—empowering organizations to deploy, govern, and accelerate agent productivity with unified management, robust compliance controls, and seamless integration into business workflows.
His team also drives initiatives like AI Tools, Power Platform Connectors, and Dataverse, enabling organizations to harness AI over business processes and enterprise data. Additionally, Nirav oversees the Azure cloud infrastructure services that power mission-critical applications across Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and Dynamics 365.
Over his two-decade career at Microsoft, Nirav has held engineering leadership roles in Dynamics CRM, Office, and Visual Studio. He earned his degrees at Rutgers University and lives in the greater Seattle area. Nirav’s leadership continues to shape Microsoft’s AI-first strategy, fostering innovation and trusted solutions for global enterprises.

Kalpana Berman is a Group Product Manager at Microsoft, where she leads the product management team for OneDrive Mobile, OneDrive Web, and OneDrive Photos experiences. Throughout her career at Microsoft, Intel, Nike, and a startup, she has launched innovative consumer technology experiences, fueled by a passion for media and helping people capture, discover, share, and connect with the moments that matter. Outside of her work, Kalpana enjoys playing tennis, discovering great food, reading, and traveling with her family.

Anna-Marie Scarberry is a Senior Product Marketing Manager at Microsoft focused on Microsoft Copilot, AI strategy, and market intelligence. She leads initiatives that help teams understand the technologies, trends, and market dynamics shaping the future of AI so that they can anticipate and respond to a rapidly evolving AI landscape.
TJ Devine is a Partner GPM, leading a global team of product managers and engineers who work with customers on Copilot value, adoption, and business strategy.

Chris Hoder is a Principal Program Manager at Microsoft, where he works on the capacity and commercial systems behind Microsoft Foundry. He focuses on helping customers turn AI demand into production-scale deployments, with a particular interest in token economics, utilization, and making capacity work harder.

Matt Soucoup is a Principal DevRel Lead for .NET at Microsoft, where he leads the team that helps .NET developers build with Azure, AI, and GitHub Copilot. He's spent years writing code, giving talks, and building demos that help them make the most of the tooling, lately focused on agentic AI and running Copilot as an agent in production applications.

Josh is a Cloud Developer Advocate at Microsoft, focusing on Azure Data, particularly Microsoft Fabric and operational databases. He works closely with engineering teams to provide valuable product feedback and develops content and code that helps developers get the most out of these technologies. He is Passionate about empowering developer communities, sharing knowledge and fostering collaboration. His goal is to help developers leverage technology to innovate and succeed.

Making the right decisions, combined with the eager to always be at the front of innovative technology, is why Anders Eide loves his job as Director at Sopra Steria. He's focusing on helping organizations implementing Microsoft technologies like Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure, and sharing his knowledge and experience from the field with the community, which is why he also has been a Microsoft MVP since 2014.

I'm a Business Intelligence professional and former software developer with over ten years experience in Microsoft products. An ALM/DLM enthusiast and Azure DevOps fan and co-founder and organiser of the Adelaide Power BI and Fabric User Group. I regularly attend tech events allover the world; Azure Bootcamps, DevOps days, SQLSaturdays, Data Saturdays, Difinity and PASS Summit.

Anna Bordioug is a technology consultant at Protiviti and Microsoft MVP specializing in security, compliance, and data governance solutions across the Microsoft 365 platform. She partners with organizations in the public services, retail, and financial services sectors to design and deliver scalable Microsoft Purview solutions that help protect sensitive information and meet regulatory and operational requirements. Her core areas of expertise include Microsoft Purview Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and Insider Risk Management, where she supports clients through assessment, recommendation, and implementation initiatives.

Anna brings a unique blend of technical and business experience, enabling her to translate complex compliance and data protection challenges into practical, sustainable solutions. At Protiviti, she has helped multiple organizations strengthen their security and compliance posture by identifying sensitive data, reducing oversharing risk, and managing insider risks using Microsoft Purview. She is particularly focused on helping organizations adopt modern collaboration and AI-enabled technologies while maintaining strong data security and governance foundations.

Martina Grom is Principal and co founder & CEO of atwork. She is recognized as a leading expert in Microsoft Cloud Services, Governance, and AI solutions. Martina advises organizations on cloud architecture, governance, modernization, Microsoft 365, Azure, AI adoption, cybersecurity, compliance, and change management. She is a long time Microsoft MVP and, since 2015, a Microsoft Regional Director. Martina is also the founder and organizer of the Global AI Community – Vienna Chapter, fostering community learning around modern AI, Copilot, and agentic solutions. She is an active author and speaker, publishing numerous articles and blogs on cloud strategy, security, governance, and enterprise productivity. Martina holds a master’s degree in International Business Administration from the University of Vienna. Her passion is helping companies build secure, human centric, and future ready cloud environments through strong governance and intelligent automation. Talk to her about: Cloud Computing · Cloud Architecture & Strategy · Governance · AI & AI Solutions · Change Management · Employee Experience · Microsoft Azure · Microsoft 365 · Cybersecurity · Compliance · Enterprise Security · Enterprise Social.

Hanna Schwab is Data & AI Lead at teccle group and a recognized Microsoft Foundry MVP who designs and delivers advanced data platforms and AI solutions with Microsoft Fabric and Foundry. Hanna has years of experience bridging tech and business to build practical enterprise applications that solve real-world challenges. Beyond her project work, Hanna runs career events for women in tech and mentors aspiring STEM professionals with the goal to build a more inclusive tech community.

Douglas Romão has worked for more than 18 years as a solution provider and advisor, helping companies of all sizes use Microsoft technology to get work done better. He has been a Microsoft Most Valuable Professional since 2017 in Office Apps and Services, Business Applications, and Copilot Studio, and has renewed every year since. In recent years his work has centered on AI transformation: designing and delivering AI solutions that teams can put into production and keep running. He is Senior Solutions Architect and AI Tech Advisor at Fellowmind, a European company, where he supports AI product initiatives and helps set both the business and technical direction. Day to day that means Copilot Studio, the Power Platform, and related Microsoft AI services, with a focus on solutions customers can run, maintain, and afford over time. He works at the point where product decisions, architecture, and real delivery meet. In the community, he leads Power Platform and SharePoint groups in Brazil and Europe, and organizes and speaks at events around the world. With his brother Renato Romão (also a Microsoft MVP), he co-hosts the podcast Romão’s Cast and produces content on YouTube.

Tanmay Bhagwat is a product leader with 15+ years of experience building and scaling AI, cloud, and enterprise software at Microsoft and Meta. He's driven product strategy across generative AI and agentic computing, including agent creation, orchestration, tools, publishing, and enterprise experiences. Tanmay has a track record of turning emerging technologies into platform capabilities, products, and business strategies at scale, from AI serving billions of users to Azure and Microsoft 365 platforms serving enterprise customers worldwide. He brings deep technical fluency and cross-functional leadership, with a history of delivering measurable outcomes across platforms, ecosystems, customer experience, and business models.

Zahraa Abbasi is a Product Manager at Microsoft passionate about helping people learn through technology. Her work focuses on AI-powered learning, search and discovery, and creating engaging experiences that connect learners with the right content at the right time.

Mike Shi is a Technical Program Manager at Microsoft focused on Responsible AI and AI governance. His work spans AI safety, security, and policy enforcement, including work on the Agent Control Specification (ACS) and ASSERT. His work helps organizations build and deploy trustworthy AI agents by translating responsible AI principles into practical controls, governance frameworks, and runtime safeguards. Mike collaborates closely with engineering teams, customers, and industry partners across the AI ecosystem to advance interoperable approaches to agent governance, policy enforcement, and risk management. He is passionate about helping organizations safely adopt agentic AI systems at scale and frequently works on standards, open-source initiatives, and product capabilities that improve trust, transparency, and accountability in AI.

Billy Grieco is Product Management Lead for Credly at Pearson, where he leads product for the Credly credentialing platform and the new Pearson Wallet. In over 20 years at Pearson, his roles have spanned higher education content development, courseware innovation, and digital credentials. His current focus is the intersection of education credentials and digital identity, including how verified skills data can create better visibility and more opportunity for learners and more trust for employers.

I am a Principal Group Product Manager at Microsoft, leading strategy and product investments across the SQL Engine and Azure SQL database platform.

My team is responsible for advancing the core technologies that power mission-critical cloud workloads, from query processing and storage engines to high availability, elasticity, performance optimization, and next-generation database capabilities. We work at the intersection of distributed systems, database internals, and cloud infrastructure, helping organizations run their most demanding applications.

Over the past several years, I have led product strategy for the core SQL engine, spanning query processing, storage, and performance, alongside competitive positioning for Azure SQL Hyperscale's distributed storage architecture, and initiatives across serverless databases, elastic pools, analytics integration, and intelligent database automation. My focus is on translating deep technical innovation into customer value, balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency for enterprises operating at global scale.

Before moving into product, I spent over a decade as a database administrator and engineering leader: running production SQL Server estates at scale and later leading data platform engineering and architecture teams. That operational grounding shapes how I build. I design for the engineers who carry the pager, not just the roadmap slide.

I am passionate about the future of data platforms, including AI-native databases, multimodel data, cloud-scale architectures, and the evolving world of relational systems. I enjoy collaborating with engineers, architects, customers, researchers, and industry leaders to shape the next generation of database technology.
Erin Miyake is a product manager for Microsoft Purview. She focuses on DSPM and Insider Risk Management. Prior to product management, she was an insider threat practitioner.

Christophe is a product leader in the Microsoft Security division, focusing on our data security solutions. He’s passionate about helping customers with their digital transformation. He worked in technical, marketing, & engineering roles in the US and Europe.

Safeena is a Principal PM Manager at Microsoft, focused on building enterprise security, data governance, and compliance capabilities for the AI era. Her work spans Microsoft Purview, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Agent 365, with a focus on helping organizations securely adopt AI and autonomous agents at scale. She is passionate about turning complex customer security challenges into simple, scalable product experiences.

Angela Byers is Senior Director of Field & Adoption Marketing for Microsoft Security, where she drives growth across the portfolio. With experience spanning cybersecurity, AI, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications, Angela has led go-to-market strategies for some of Microsoft's most transformative technologies, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Dynamics 365, and Microsoft Viva. Angela brings a unique combination of technical depth, product strategy, and business leadership. Earlier in her career, she conducted research on big data and cloud computing at McKinsey & Company. She holds a PhD in Decision Analysis and is passionate about translating complex technologies into practical solutions that help organizations innovate, improve productivity, and drive business impact.

Bill Curry is Head of Microsoft AI and Vice President of Consulting at Improving, where he helps organizations connect AI strategy with the technical foundations, delivery practices, and people needed to put it into operation. He brings nearly 30 years of consulting and leadership experience, including senior architecture and leadership roles at Microsoft and helping lead Improving’s Microsoft partnership. His career spans leading diverse teams, delivering mission-critical enterprise solutions, and developing technical leaders. He connects executive business priorities with technical decisions to help organizations put AI into practice. Bill focuses on what makes AI dependable in real business workflows: governed data, production-ready platforms, clear accountability, and evaluation that supports greater autonomy. He brings a practical perspective to preparing organizations and their teams for increasingly capable AI agents.

As part of the Azure Networking team, I focus on hybrid connectivity and cloud networking solutions. My passion is helping organizations adopt modern cloud technologies to solve classic infrastructure and networking challenges.

Thomas Kurth is MXDR Service Owner at baseVISION and a Microsoft security expert with a passion for helping organizations build modern, AI-powered security operations. He works closely with customers and SOC teams to turn security data into actionable insights using Microsoft Sentinel, Data Lake, and Security Copilot. His sessions combine real-world lessons learned, practical architecture guidance, and operational experience from the field.

Simon Waight is a Senior Product Manager at Microsoft, where he works on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager. With more than 30 years in the technology industry, Simon's career has spanned engineering, architecture, consulting and product management. He is a former Microsoft MVP for both Azure and Azure OpenAI Service and has been an active contributor to Australia's Azure community for more than a decade.
Product Marketing at GitHub.

Ali Ijaz is a Principal PM Manager at Microsoft leading strategy and enablement for agentic AI experiences across Azure supportability. He and his team build and scale autonomous agents that resolve customer issues, proactively identify and mitigate risks, and turn recurring problems into improvements across products and experiences. His work focuses on moving agentic AI from experimentation into trusted production environments at Azure scale, supported by evals, guardrails, observability, AIOps, and continuous improvement systems. Before Microsoft, Ali led product and technology initiatives at Amazon, 3M, and multiple startups he founded, bringing more than 15 years of experience building and scaling products across cloud, AI, SaaS, personalization, and digital transformation.

My journey into technology began when my dad brought home a RadioShack computer and told me to “figure it out.” That led to command-line programming (DOS), video games (Black Cauldron), messaging (IRC/AOL), and ultimately a career built on solving complex problems through technology.
At Microsoft, I’ve held roles as Partner Development Manager, Partner Technology Strategist, and Partner Solution Area Lead/Architect—across both local and global scopes, in channel sales and with system integrators. I bring this experience, along with a strong passion for security, to the tech team. Lately, I’ve been diving into agents, agent security, and the exciting ways that our discpline is evolving. 
I live in central Texas with my partner, our two kids, and a chihuahua who thinks he’s a cat. Outside of work, I enjoy yoga, gardening, hiking, ice hockey, and following sports—especially American football (Detroit Lions) and Formula One (Ferrari).
Looking forward to solving hard problems together.

Mike Morton is Vice President of Product for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Insights, where he leads the product management organization responsible for Microsoft's AI-powered sales, customer engagement, and customer data solutions. He oversees product strategy and innovation across a portfolio that helps organizations accelerate growth, strengthen customer relationships, and deliver more personalized customer experiences through the power of data and AI.

Prior to this role, Mike served as Vice President of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, leading Microsoft's cloud ERP solution for small and medium-sized businesses. Earlier in his career, he held leadership positions across Microsoft, including driving product development for SharePoint and Microsoft 365.

Over three decades at Microsoft, Mike has helped shape technologies spanning business applications, collaboration, and productivity. Today, he is focused on shaping the next generation of AI-powered business applications, helping organizations unlock new levels of productivity, insight, and customer value.

speakers.j: Sr Bus. Strategy Analyst, Global Partner Skilling
speakers.bio: Ben is the Global Partner Skilling Lead for Sales across all Microsoft Cloud Solution Areas. Ben's role is to help manage the worldwide sales skilling strategy for the partner community, ensuring they have access to the best resources, tools, and trainings to accelerate their Microsoft sales practice.

Alice Appleton is a product leader for Copilot Studio at Microsoft, where she manages the agentic loop for the new GitHub Copilot harness, including the portfolio of AI models available. Previously, she led product work for Dynamics 365 Sales agents, Microsoft 365 Copilot governance, and Microsoft 365 administration. Across these roles, Alice has helped organizations adopt AI to improve employee experiences and realize business value.

Danielle Crayton is Senior Director of Azure SMB Marketing at Microsoft, where she leads global marketing strategy to help small and medium-sized businesses realize the potential of cloud and AI. Her team focuses on accelerating Azure customer acquisition and growth through direct and partner channels, with an emphasis on translating emerging technologies into practical business value. Danielle is passionate about helping partners build profitable, scalable businesses and empowering SMB customers to modernize, harness their data, and take advantage of AI and agents. Over more than 16 years at Microsoft, she has held leadership roles across Azure, Microsoft 365, Surface, and Windows, spanning both sales and marketing. She is known for turning complex business challenges into clear, data-driven strategies that connect customer insights, technology, and go-to-market execution. Danielle holds an MBA from the University of Texas at Austin’s McCombs School of Business and a B.S. in Commerce from the University of Virginia.

speakers.j: Global Digital Workplace Consult Leader, MVP, Regional Director
speakers.bio:
I’m a global technology and business leader focused on helping enterprise organisations transform how work gets done by combining human expertise and cutting-edge technology platforms with AI, copilots, and intelligent agents. My passion is enabling organisations to shift from traditional digital workplace models to AI‑native operating models that drive innovation, connected experiences, and step‑change in both employee experience and productivity.

As Global Digital Workplace Services Consult Leader at Kyndryl, I set the strategy, portfolio direction, and talent model for a worldwide consulting practice—owning market strategy, financial performance, workforce strategy, delivery methodology, and C‑suite engagement. I’m accountable for building differentiating capabilities, shaping long‑term practice growth, and defining how automation, tools, and reusable assets elevate client outcomes. I'm also a Microsoft MVP for Copilot and Copilot Studio, and a Microsoft Regional Director.

Melinda Ma is a Senior Product Manager for Azure AI Speech at Microsoft. Over the past nine years, she has worked across text to speech, avatars, and voice agents, partnering with customers to create engaging, personalized, and scalable conversational experiences.

Nathan is a technology leader with billions of dollars in new revenue and operational savings created through technology transformations across industries. He is a 14x Microsoft MVP and frequent speaker at 100s of events and conferences. Nathan leads the application of transformative technology, digital workers, and architecture to amplify the mission of every business. Nathan is accountable for cross-practice Microsoft tech leadership at IBM, application of AI technologies, emerging technology innovation, and partnership with strategic clients.

In my role leading Microsoft’s software partner business, I work with a global network of solution providers to accelerate cloud innovation and deliver measurable customer outcomes. Together, we are shaping the next generation of AI-driven solutions, helping partners grow, innovate, and reach new markets at scale.

As CTO for the Red Hat and Microsoft partnership at Red Hat, Aaron Isom leads joint technical vision, product roadmaps, and engineering collaboration across Azure Red Hat OpenShift, RHEL, Ansible, and enterprise AI. His perspective draws from over two decades navigating shifts in enterprise computing, combining 15 years in global product and technical leadership at Microsoft with formative tenures at HPE and agile startups. Deeply rooted in open source and software supply chain security, Aaron unites core infrastructure fundamentals with modern cloud native architecture. Today, he helps enterprises establish security first foundations, leveraging innovations like Red Hat Lightwell to remediate open source risks and accelerate trusted deployments of containers, virtual machines, and agentic AI systems on Azure.

Raviv is a general manager, product and engineering for the protection knowledge layer, as part of the Agentic Security team in Microsoft Security, responsible for building the knowledge layer that unifies data, enrichment and insights on top of Defender, Sentinel and ISOC signals and actuators and powers humans, application and agents across Defender, Sentinel, Perception and Exposure Management products. 

Raviv is a 19-year veteran of Microsoft and 15-years in security, among his notable previous roles - head of product and part of the core inception team for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, head of product for Microsoft Defender XDR, head of product for the entire Defender suite of products and Sentinel and most recently 2 years as Defender and Sentinel product strategy.

Abed Sau is a Principal Cloud Solution Architect at Microsoft focused on AI security, cybersecurity transformation, and secure AI adoption. He works with enterprise organizations to modernize security operations, implement AI governance strategies, and securely deploy Agentic AI solutions. Abed advises executive and technical stakeholders on identity, data security, threat protection, and cyber resilience, helping organizations accelerate innovation while managing risk.

As the Corporate Vice President for the Fabric Team in Azure Data, Yitzhak Kesselman oversees the teams that deliver the Fabric Platform, Fabric Real-Time Intelligence, Fabric IQ, Microsoft IQ, Azure Messaging, and Observability.

Prior to his current position, Yitzhak was leading Alphabet’s Monitoring products, critical for the reliability of their infrastructure and systems that serve 4B+ users worldwide. These capabilities provide actionable insights into service health metrics, consequently strengthening the reliability of all products from Google search to autonomous vehicles.

Before joining Google, Yitzhak led Microsoft’s Power BI Platform team (now Fabric Platform team) that delivered the infrastructure, common functionality, and operations underpinning Power BI and other Azure Data cloud services. Under his leadership, the team scaled the platform more than 12x, earning it the best-in-class service by Gartner and Forrester.

Across every initiative, Yitzhak’s work is grounded in an unwavering commitment to customer value.

Jenn is a Senior Technical Product Marketing Lead for Microsoft Copilot, where she leads competitive intelligence across the AI assistant landscape. A quirky geek who moves comfortably between strategy and the technical weeds, while building her own AI agents along the way.

speakers.j: Director, Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program
speakers.bio: Steve is the Director of Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Offers & Benefits team. His team is accountable for designing and managing all partner program offers and benefits to meet customer outcomes, drive partner growth across all customer segments, industries and partner business models (channel, services, software companies, etc) worldwide.
Owner and builder of the dev experience across Azure services in CoreAI, including ACA Sandboxes, AI Gateway, App Service, Functions, Connectors, Hosted Skills, Durable Task Scheduler.
Senior Product Marketing Manager at Microsoft on the M365 and Copilot team, focusing on competitive strategy and enablement.
Product Manager on the Azure Governance and Azure Resource Manager team.
Karyl Singh is a Principal Product Manager at Microsoft helping business leaders maximize the business value and returns from their AI investments.

Kendra Springer is a Principal Group Product Manager on the Agent 365 engineering team at Microsoft, focused on how enterprises adopt, govern, and secure AI agents at scale. She joined Agent 365 after nearly seven years on Copilot Studio, bringing deep product experience across conversational AI and enterprise agent platforms. Kendra leads customer-facing product direction, guiding organizations through Agent 365's value, features, and roadmap. With a focus on security and agent governance: the agent registry, Entra Agent IDs, policy templates, and the observability that lets IT and security teams manage agents with confidence. Grounded on a background of product design, product development, and agentic transformations, she champions governance as an enabler, helping businesses deploy agents broadly while maintaining trust, oversight, and control.

Carole O'Malley is a Director of Business Program Management at Microsoft, focused on transforming the end-to-end experience for Microsoft partners. She brings together strategy, partner programs, digital experiences, and engineering to simplify how partners engage with Microsoft and create more connected, intuitive experiences at scale. She is passionate about the opportunity to use AI to fundamentally reimagine the partner journey, moving from fragmented experiences to intelligent, personalized engagement that helps partners find what they need, take action faster, and ultimately grow their business with Microsoft.

speakers.j: Head of Product, Azure Data Lake Storage & Azure Databricks
speakers.bio: Anavi Nahar leads the Azure Data Lake Storage and Azure Databricks product groups at Microsoft.

I lead across enterprise AI strategy, operating models, governance, AI platforms, intelligent automation, and enterprise AI adoption, with a growing focus on agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot, enterprise AI platforms, responsible AI, and democratizing AI across the organization.

At Microsoft Ignite, I’m looking forward to connecting with technology leaders and practitioners tackling one of the most important challenges in enterprise technology today: moving AI from experimentation to industrialized, enterprise-scale adoption and measurable business value.

Gareth Bland is Chief Data Scientist for Microsoft’s Enterprise Architecture Group and leads the Chief Data Science Office and Responsible AI for Industry Solutions Delivery. He works with customers on Frontier Transformation, moving from AI experimentation to measurable value, and presents the Tokenomics work on turning AI spend into yield per dollar.

As Vice President of Enterprise Data Architecture & Platforms at H&R Block, I help shape the technology strategy that powers trusted customer experiences, data-driven decision-making, and scalable business growth. I have led large-scale cloud, data, identity, and AI initiatives that have modernized enterprise capabilities, improved operational efficiency, and delivered measurable business value.

My passion is helping organizations turn data into a strategic asset while building the governance, platforms, and culture needed to innovate responsibly. Zachary Symm is a product executive at Rackspace Technology focused on AI, cyber resilience, cloud transformation, and managed services innovation. He partners with Microsoft and enterprise organizations to deliver solutions that help customers maximize the value of Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot, and modern data platforms while improving security, governance, and business outcomes.

James Brotsos is a Principal Product Manager at Microsoft leading product initiatives for MDASH. With deep domain expertise across Application Security Posture Management (ASPM), developer security tooling, and cloud protection, James focuses on bridging the gap between engineering workflows and production environments. His work centers on delivering seamless developer experiences—from CLI and agentless code scanners to contextual code-to-runtime visibility—empowering organizations to pinpoint and remediate critical risks across the entire software delivery lifecycle without slowing down innovation.

Lead creation and execution of global Co-sell partner strategies across all partner types (software development companies (SDC), channel, systems integrators (SI), distributors, telcos, resellers) covering all customer segments (Enterprise, Corporate, and SMB).
Carl is a cross functional leader helping manage platform, cloud apps, and partnerships integrations at Replit.

Banani is an Advanced Cloud Engineer at Microsoft, partnering with customers to resolve complex Azure challenges and strengthen the reliability and operational efficiency of their AI and cloud environments. Drawing on a varied background in databases, site reliability engineering, software engineering, and cloud engineering, she pairs extensive customer-facing experience with hands-on expertise in Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, and Azure Machine Learning. Her work centers on AI-powered troubleshooting, diagnostics, reporting, and automation that streamline operations and boost engineering efficiency. Banani is passionate about turning real-world operational challenges into practical, scalable solutions, and about helping engineering teams use AI to shift from reactive troubleshooting to smarter, more proactive operations.

Denise Jay is a Principal Product Manager of AI Enablement in Capital Group's Digital Workplace organization. She leads Microsoft 365 and Copilot adoption initiatives, helping associates realize measurable value from AI. Her work focuses on transforming emerging technologies into practical solutions that improve how people work.

Lars Thomas serves as Vice President of Business Shared Services (BSS) at Ryan Specialty, where he lead enterprise-wide operational strategy and shared services initiatives focused on driving efficiency, scalability, and business performance. Since joining Ryan Specialty more than two years ago, Lars has played a pivotal role in advancing operational excellence across the organization, building on a 30 year distinguished leadership career in Brokerage Industry. Lars was instrumental in helping stabilize, optimize, and transform key business processes during Ryan Specialty’s transition to Genpact as a strategic services partner. An advocate for innovation and digital transformation, Lars has championed the adoption of emerging technologies, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled solutions across the Business Shared Services organization. Under Lars’s leadership, the BSS organization has delivered measurable improvements in productivity, automation, operational resilience, and service quality across all business segments.

Mahesh Balachandran leads product for reasoning models and the broader AI model ecosystem in Microsoft Foundry, working with flagship models and providers including OpenAI, SpaceXAI, Meta, and other frontier AI innovators. Prior to this role, he was a Product Leader in Bing AI and later held product leadership roles at Amazon. With more than 15 years of experience across artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud platforms, and developer ecosystems, Mahesh thrives on making customers successful and accelerating the adoption of production-ready AI applications and agents through Microsoft Foundry.

Dimitri Maltezakis is a Developer Relations Manager in the NVIDIA Cloud Service Providers team. He focuses on supporting and enabling Developers using NVIDIA technology in the Cloud, advocating for best practices, as well as creating educational content on NVIDIA’s full stack integration with Cloud Native Services. Dimitri’s background includes a Solutions Architecture role, a BSc. in Computer Science and a MSc. in Engineering Management.
Jon Callahan is a Senior Product Manager at Microsoft Security, helping customers adopt, deploy, and get more value from Microsoft’s device management and data security technologies.

Stuart Giles is a Product Marketing Director at SAP, where he focuses on building and growing the partner ecosystem around SAP Business Data Cloud. These days, Stuart spends most of his time at the intersection of technology and partnerships, helping organisations understand how SAP Business Data Cloud and partners like Microsoft fit together to unlock real business value from their data.

Robyn Guarriello is a Senior Product Manager at Microsoft focused on Microsoft Planner and the future of AI-powered work management. She works across product strategy, customer insights, and AI experiences that help people and teams plan, organize, and get work done more effectively.

Hari Pulapaka leads engineering and product for Project Perception at Microsoft, the agentic security system for Microsoft Defender. Perception is an agentic SOC. Specialized red, blue, and green agents continuously probe for weaknesses, investigate threats, and remediate them. His background is in systems. He spent his career in operating systems, working on the Windows kernel, Azure Host OS, hypervisor and virtualization architecture, and Windows on ARM from concept through silicon. At Microsoft he previously led the product organization across Windows and Azure Host OS. He shipped Windows on ARM, its x86 emulation layer, Windows Server 2025 and CloudHost OS across the Azure fleet, built the Confidential Computing product team from zero, and created Windows Sandbox, ELAM, and Protected Process Light. Before returning to Microsoft he led endpoint detection product management at CrowdStrike across Windows and macOS. He holds 50 patents across OS, virtualization, and security. He cares about building platforms that are secure by design, perform at scale, and stay grounded in systems fundamentals, and building them to solve customer problems.
Cyber Security Product Manager. Data security, threat protection, security for AI.

Omar is the Partner Program Lead for membership offers and benefits. He also manages the Support Services designation. In nearly a decade at Microsoft, Omar has previously worked across Monetization & Business Planning as well as in Customer Experience & Success roles where his work has enabled customers and partners to maximize the value of their Microsoft investments.

Joanna Belvedere is a Senior Business Program Manager at Microsoft focused on simplifying how partners navigate and activate Microsoft’s go-to-market ecosystem. With more than a decade of experience across partner marketing, channel marketing, training, and sales, she brings a practical, partner-first perspective to building programs and experiences that help partners understand and take advantage of Microsoft’s GTM benefits, tools, resources, and opportunities. Today, Joanna’s work spans GTM benefits and partner activation, with a focus on creating scalable experiences that help partners turn Microsoft’s go-to-market opportunities into action. This includes leading initiatives such as Microsoft Go-to-Market Titan, a foundational learning experience designed to help partner leaders understand what’s available, why it matters, and where to start.

Christine Bongard is the Founder & CEO of The WIT Network, a global nonprofit advancing women and their allies through leadership development, education, and community. A recognized technology and nonprofit executive, she brings more than 30 years of experience across the Microsoft partner ecosystem, where she built and scaled businesses, led strategic alliances, and drove measurable growth. Throughout her career—often as the only woman in the room—Christine developed a deep passion for creating spaces where women can connect, grow, and lead with confidence. Today, she leads a global community supporting thousands of members across industries and geographies, helping them transform experience into impact and confidence into influence. Known for her warm, authentic, and direct style, Christine blends inspiration with practical, real-world insight. She is a sought-after speaker and leadership voice on topics including influence, sponsorship, career growth, and the evolving skills required to lead in today’s fast-changing workplace. Her mission is simple but powerful: to ensure that every woman has the access, support, and opportunity to thrive—and to lift others as they rise. To learn more about The WIT Network: Home.

Shawn Bass is the Senior Vice President and General Manager of Citrix’s DaaS and VDI portfolio. With more than 30 years of experience in the end-user computing industry, Shawn has dedicated his career to advancing how organizations deliver secure, high-performance digital workspaces.

Amy Curley, PhD, is a TA Feasibility & Planning Manager at Boehringer Ingelheim, where she plans global clinical trials. She leads the Future-Proofing Project Tracking initiative, a collaboration with Microsoft Pathfinder. The project uses Microsoft 365 Copilot and SharePoint to turn scattered project emails, presentations and notes into structured project histories that record what changed, why and when. Before moving into feasibility, Amy was an Associate Director of Medical Writing, and she contributed to successful oncology NDA submissions. She holds a PhD in neuroscience from Tulane University.
Rob manages a team of agents on the VS Code team. He works on the Agent Host Protocol and all things related to agents in VS Code.

Matt Steele is a Principal Product Manager at Microsoft with more than 20 years of experience building identity and access management (IAM) products. Throughout his career, he has worked across a broad range of identity technologies, including authentication platforms, single sign-on (SSO), authorization standards, identity federation, and public key infrastructure (PKI). Today, Matt focuses on Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and securing non-human identities (NHI), helping organizations navigate the evolving challenges of identity security in an increasingly automated and AI-driven world.

Dina is a Partner GTM Strategy leader in transformation, orchestration/framework strategies, with expertise across the Enterprise and partner ecosystems. She drives joint sales/partner/customer, AI-enabled scalable programs and enablement delivering proven revenue and measurable outcomes. She is a collaboration champion, inclusive leader, as well as industry advisor, speaker, board member, and recipient of industry and campaign awards.

speakers.j: Vice President - Microsoft Discovery and Quantum
speakers.bio:
David Carmona leads Microsoft’s strategy, incubation, and ecosystem for emerging technologies, spanning Artificial Intelligence for Science and R&D, Quantum Computing, and Robotics. Over his 25-year career at Microsoft, David has held a wide range of leadership roles across both engineering and business. He has led the incubation of some of Microsoft’s most important businesses, including its cloud development platform and Artificial Intelligence, where he led the strategy and incubation of Microsoft AI at its inception more than a decade ago, turning AI innovation from Microsoft’s research labs into a global-scale Enterprise platform. 
David is the author of the O’Reilly book “The AI Organization,” which explores Microsoft’s internal AI transformation journey, and he is a frequent international speaker on innovation culture, frontier technologies, and the business transformation in the AI and Quantum era.

Alex is a product leader at Ontinue, helping customers move beyond detection and response toward continuous risk reduction. He builds AI-powered MXDR for Microsoft Security customers: AI agents handle investigation and containment at machine speed, while experienced Cyber Defenders stay in control of the decisions that matter.

Microsoft Responsibilities — Steve leads Microsoft's Copilot, Agents & Platform design and research teams, including interaction design, UX engineering, content strategy, design ops, user research, and product content. The role unites Microsoft's enterprise agent platform with the productivity surfaces where work actually happens — Agent 365, Dynamics 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Copilot experiences like Cowork and Autopilot — setting the experience bar for how AI agents become part of customers‘ day-to-day.

Pre-Microsoft Work Experience — Before joining Microsoft, Steve spent three years as Group VP of Design for platform, AI, design systems, and innovation at ServiceNow. There he led design for Now Assist — ServiceNow's gen AI product — as well as all platform products and design systems, as well as product keynotes and vision demos. Prior to that, Steve spent 17 years at Adobe, including his time from the Omniture acquisition, where he held roles like Chief Creative Director and later head of web platform product management, analytics, and UX.

Education — Steve holds a bachelor's degree in design from Brigham Young University.

Bijoy Boban is an AI and technology leader at KPMG. He leads the firm-wide KPMG Digital Gateway powered by Claude initiative and previously led fine-tuning of domain-specific language models for tax. He’s an Azure Certified Data Scientist with over a decade of AI/ML experience and an MTech in Computer Science.

Brian Hooper is a cybersecurity professional with over 20 years of experience protecting enterprise customers from threats, specializing in cyber threat intelligence, incident response, and threat hunting. As a Principal Research Manager with Microsoft Defender Experts, he leads a team of researchers ensuring that Defender Experts customers are protected from new and emerging threats using the latest AI capabilities. Prior to this role, he was a cyber security consultant and helped customers with incident response, penetration testing, and security architecture assessments, a lead instructor and course developer for security training, a cloud security architect, and a senior SOC analyst.

Juan is a Senior Product Manager in Microsoft’s Customer Value Creation organization. He helps translate customer needs into product strategy and practical solutions, drawing on experience across cloud, identity, security, and customer delivery.
Insight Cybersecurity leader for IAM, DevSecOps and AI Governance & Security.

I lead End User Computing at Zurich North America, supporting thousands of employees across devices, virtual desktops and AI-powered automation. I'm leading our work to use AI to change how IT operations run and how the digital workplace is delivered.

Kevin LeBlanc leads Microsoft Marketplace Marketing, overseeing the strategies and go-to-market programs that help customers find, try, buy, deploy, and manage solutions through Microsoft Marketplace. He partners with Software Development Companies worldwide to expand market reach, accelerate customer acquisition, and drive growth. Throughout his career, he has helped organizations accelerate partner-led growth, scale marketplace adoption, and build high-performing ecosystem marketing strategies.

Aditya Tirumalai Sundararam is Co-founder and Chief Product Officer at DataBahn, where he leads the vision and architecture of an AI-native data intelligence platform powering modern security and observability pipelines. He brings a forward-looking perspective on how organizations can move from reactive data management to intelligent, in-stream decisioning. Prior to DataBahn, Aditya spent over a decade at Securonix, where he helped build and scale SIEM and cyber threat analytics platforms, giving him deep, firsthand insight into the challenges of telemetry at scale—data sprawl, schema fragmentation, cost inefficiencies, and the growing gap between data collection and actionable outcomes. At DataBahn, he is focused on redefining how telemetry is handled before it reaches downstream platforms, applying AI to continuously normalize, enrich, optimize, and govern data in motion. His work centers on enabling enterprises to trust their data pipelines as a foundation for both observability and security in an increasingly AI-driven world.

Jim is a Data Security & AI Architect at Microsoft who helps partners scale their businesses and build successful security practices. His work focuses on helping partners and customers adopt AI safely and securely, with the governance, data protection, and security foundations needed to innovate with confidence.

Ehud Itshaki is a Principal Product Manager at Microsoft Security focused on securing the emerging world of AI agents. He works at the intersection of identity, security, and agentic AI, partnering with customers and engineering teams to shape Microsoft’s approach to securing AI agents. A 20-year Microsoft veteran, Ehud brings deep experience in identity, Zero Trust, and enterprise security, translating complex customer security challenges into practical architectures and product capabilities.

Faniel Altmark is a Principal Group Product Manager at Microsoft, focused on AI-powered experiences across SharePoint and Microsoft 365. His work covers knowledge base, content creation, and AI authoring tools, with an emphasis on making these experiences practical, intuitive, and grounded in customer needs.

Nikhil Malhotra is amongst the top innovators with deep expertise in AI, quantum computing and emerging technologies. At Tech Mahindra, he drives the company’s innovation vision, AI research and emerging technology practice, championing responsible AI adoption and breakthrough research. Known for building visionary teams and challenging conventional thinking, he focuses on translating future technologies into viable business value.

speakers.j: Director of Product Marketing, AI & SaaS
speakers.bio: At Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), I lead global Product Marketing for SaaS and AI as the GM-aligned marketing leader for the business line. I own GTM strategy, narrative and business performance across emerging AI businesses and a $200M+ ARR SaaS portfolio growing approximately 40% YoY.

Subhash Arja is a Director of Product Management at GitHub, where he leads experiences for the Code Security and the Code Quality products. A product leader in the application security and cybersecurity industry for nearly a decade, he has built products across the security lifecycle, from runtime application protection with Contrast Assess and Contrast Protect, to cloud workload and web protection at Virsec, to autonomous pentesting and cyber-risk quantification with Horizon3.ai. He holds an MBA from UC Berkeley Haas, an MS in Computer Science from Harvard, and BS in Electrical Engineering from UCLA.

Katharine Holdsworth is a Partner Product Manager for Windows Security at Microsoft, where she helps shape the security strategy and experiences that protect Windows customers and organizations. During her 23 years at Microsoft, she has worked across Windows and now focuses on making security stronger, simpler, and more accessible, from identity and sign-in to device protection and management.

Michael MacKenzie is the Vice President of Product Management for the Digital Operations group at Microsoft, applying Industrial AI and Physical AI to the world’s connected operations. Prior to joining Microsoft, Michael held engineering leadership roles at Amazon Web Services and Schneider Electric, a global leader in industrial automation and energy management.

Principal Product Manager focused on Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder. He is passionate about empowering customers to build agents, skills, and plugins that solve real-world challenges for information workers, boost productivity, and drive meaningful business outcomes. He looks forward to connecting with customers at Microsoft Ignite to share insights, exchange ideas, and explore what's possible with AI-powered agents.

Roxane Auld is the Microsoft EMEA Partner Enterprise Lead, overseeing and spearheading accountability for GSI/SI sales and business strategy performance. From a multicultural background and with extended experience in Sales and Partner Leadership, Roxane has had various roles within Microsoft as Sales STU director, EMEA Accenture/Avanade Lead, Global Alliance lead for Capgemini, and Microsoft Services EMEA Partner lead. Previously, Roxane has led and managed sales divisions within companies such as Gartner Group, Forrester Research and Western Union.

I'm a technology marketing professional with a decade of experience in cybersecurity, spanning market intelligence, go-to-market marketing, and product management. Currently, I'm a Senior Product Marketing Manager at Microsoft, focused on the intersection of cybersecurity, AI innovation, and business value. My work centers on translating complex technologies into compelling customer value propositions, shaping go-to-market strategies, and accelerating customer adoption. I'm passionate about emerging technologies, the evolving cybersecurity landscape, and how AI is transforming the way organizations innovate, operate, and secure their digital environments.

I help companies build and adopt intelligent business solutions on Microsoft Power Platform. I'm an independent solution architect, trainer, and advisor, and an 8-time Microsoft MVP and Microsoft Certified Trainer. I design and build apps, agents, automations, and websites with Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Pages, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio. I use agentic development practices to build better and faster, and I train client teams to do the same. I also co-host the Power Platform BOOST podcast and share what I'm learning at readyxrm.blog and on YouTube.

Oren is a Product Manager for Azure Red Hat OpenShift who has spent years working across the industry's biggest cloud and container platforms. He's a technologist at heart, and he's sat on just about every side of the table: selling it, explaining it, and now building it, which gives him a pretty complete picture of how companies actually put cloud-native technology to use. His experience spans containerization and container orchestration, hyperscaler infrastructure, and DevOps/CI-CD practices. He works closely across Red Hat and Microsoft, bridging engineering, sales, and customer needs to keep products in step with how enterprises actually run their workloads.

Stephen Allen | Director of Strategy & AI Technology, Clyde & Co Stephen Allen is Director of Strategy & AI Technology at Clyde & Co, where he leads the firm’s approach to AI and technology-enabled transformation. A former lawyer with more than 25 years’ experience across international law firms, Stephen focuses on turning emerging technologies into practical, governed solutions for legal work. He is responsible for Clyde & Co’s AI strategy and Copilot-first approach, with a particular focus on adoption, productivity, client value and the changing way legal services are delivered.

speakers.j: Senior Director, Business Strategy, Partner Skilling
speakers.bio: Justin Slade is Senior Director, Business Strategy for Microsoft Partner Skilling, where he leads global strategy, transformation, and capability development initiatives that help Microsoft's partner ecosystem build the skills required to drive customer outcomes in the era of AI. Justin is responsible for shaping Microsoft's partner skilling strategy across sales, technical delivery, pre-sales, and partner business roles, ensuring skilling investments accelerate partner in-market execution capability, cloud consumption, AI adoption, and business growth. His work spans global channel partners, distributors, systems integrators, ISVs, and managed services providers. With more than 20 years at Microsoft, Justin has held leadership roles across strategy, communications, enablement, and business transformation. Today, he focuses on evolving partner skilling beyond traditional training and certifications, helping partners build the capabilities required to sell, deploy, adopt, and realize value from Microsoft's AI, Cloud, Security, Data, and Business Applications portfolio. Justin is a recognized thought leader in partner capability development and AI readiness. He works closely with Microsoft executives, field leaders, and partners worldwide to align skilling strategies with business outcomes, accelerate adoption of emerging technologies, and help partners transform into AI-first organizations.↵↵He is based in Redmond, Washington.↵↵.
Senior Product Marketing Manager for ProsperOps.
Himali Kelvekar is a content designer and product thinker, designing and improving AI response quality and behavior to meet user needs.
Principal Solutions Architect at Cohere.

As President of Kore.ai, Devendra Kumar (DK) Sharma leads Industry Verticals and Pre built Agentic Solutions driving revenue growth, client success, strategy and cross-functional collaboration. Until recently he served as the CEO of a pioneering payments startup and a lending incubator. As ex-CIO of Citigroup International, he spearheaded large scale core modernization and digitization initiatives. He is renowned for driving enterprise-grade software development and scaling sustainable growth.

Cenk Ozdemir leads PwC’s CIO Advisory practice, helping CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, CAIOs, and CISOs develop strategies that drive measurable value from technology. His work focuses on embedding GenAI and agentic capabilities into operations, transforming talent for an AI-enabled workforce, strengthening cost, risk, and data governance, modernizing core platforms, and accelerating revenue through new digital products & services. As a Global Technology Growth Leader, Cenk drives cross-border coordination across PwC’s global network, enabling member firms to scale faster, enter new markets, and deliver consistent, world-class technology consulting services to clients around the world. Cenk also serves as a senior advisor to clients across key PwC accounts. Previously, Cenk led PwC’s Technology Consulting P&L, overseeing eleven technology platforms and services. His portfolio included ERP(SAP, Oracle,Dynamics), SaaS, Cloud/Hyperscaler practices, Data/Analytics & AI, Tech Strategy, Tech Operations, and Emerging Technologies. He also drove initiatives in cloud strategy and innovation, technology architecture, software and product engineering, and ecosystem partnerships. Cenk directed the acquisition and seamless integration of four technology consulting firms, expanding PwC’s market presence and adding critical service capabilities. He also spearheaded the development of an AI-enabled delivery methodology, established a centralized solutioning organization, and introduced a new quality management framework to support PwC’s global consulting operations. As the Chief Strategy Officer, Cenk helped shape PwC’s three-year consulting strategy, launched and scaled a new Managed Services P&L, and built a comprehensive Alliances Strategy with key ecosystem partners—unlocking new revenue streams and enhancing global delivery capabilities. Prior to PwC, Cenk spent 25 years at Accenture, where he was a Senior Managing Director. He held leadership roles across both technology services and industry verticals, including 18 years in tech and 7 years in the Communications, Media & High-Tech (CMT) industry vertical. He also managed major client relationships and P&Ls, and served as Managing Director of Accenture’s South Florida offices, overseeing growth, operations, talent, and market presence.

Vamsee Aluru is Head of Product for Azure Native Integrations at Microsoft CoreAI, where he leads product strategy and experiences that bring partner solutions natively into Azure. A product and engineering leader with more than 20 years of experience at Microsoft, Vamsee has built and scaled products and cloud services across CoreAI, Azure, Visual Studio, Bing Search, Power BI, and the Microsoft Universal Store. He currently focuses on cloud and AI platforms, ecosystem innovation, and simplifying how organizations build and operate in the AI era.

speakers.j: Global Head of Data, Analytics & AI
speakers.bio: Sandeep Bhat is a Senior Vice President, Global Head of Data, Analytics & AI at Hitachi Energy. Sandeep joined Hitachi Energy in 2020 and was most recently the Global IT Manager for Hitachi Energy’s Business Unit Grid Automation. He previously led the IT Front- End Applications Group and, before that, the Salesforce Platform within Global IT. Before his time at Hitachi Energy, Sandeep served as a key IT Program Manager at ABB from 2018 to 2020. Prior to that, Sandeep spent more than 13 years in various progressive roles across the Service Delivery and Customer Engagement spectrum at Tata Consultancy Services. Sandeep began his career as a Product Designer, working on the shop floor at Ace Manufacturing Systems in Bangalore, India. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Visvesvaraya Technological University and an Executive MBA in Sales & Marketing from Symbiosis Institute of Business Management in India.

Manpreet leads the Modern Workplace AI Solutions Team at Cognizant, where he designs and scales transformative Microsoft-based solutions for global enterprises. Partnering with leadership across diverse verticals—from Media and Entertainment to Financial Services and Healthcare—Manpreet orchestrates Agentic AI strategies that move beyond simple automation to create truly autonomous, intelligent ecosystems. His mission is to redefine the "Agentic Experience," ensuring that AI doesn't just respond to prompts but proactively solves business friction for global customers. As a Microsoft MVP in M365 and AI, he bridges the gap between complex architectural innovation and real-world business impact. Beyond his leadership at Cognizant, Manpreet is a titan in the technical community. A revered MVP, his insights have reached a staggering 10 million+ readers through his extensive library of articles and blogs. He is the driving force behind numerous annual boot camps, hackathons, and fundraisers, all aimed at nurturing the next generation of tech talent. Whether he is architecting a unified AI Command Center for a Fortune 500 firm or mentoring the next generation of developers, Manpreet is driven by a relentless "human-first" philosophy. Amidst the rapid evolution of the AI landscape, he remains easily recognizable by his warm smile—a reflection of his genuine passion for empowering organizations to achieve more through the power of Agentic AI.

Sangeeta Ranjit is a product leader in Microsoft Security, where she leads the company's work on phishing-resistant authentication and verified identity. Throughout her 25-year career at Microsoft, Sangeeta has worked at the intersection of technology, security, and user experience. Her current focus is helping organizations defend against phishing and impersonation attacks by pairing phishing-resistant credentials with verified identity, so that every account is tied to a real, verified person from onboarding through recovery. She began as a software engineer in Windows before moving into product leadership, contributing to Microsoft's evolution from Windows Hello to today's phishing-resistant authentication experiences, making secure authentication simpler to adopt at global scale.

Prasanna serves as the Chief Technology Officer and Chief Product Officer at Kore.ai, an enterprise AI platform focused on optimizing business operations and customer experience. Kore.ai enables organizations to automate complex workflows and scale their service capabilities through the deployment of AI agents.

In his role, Prasanna directs the technical and product strategy, most notably leading the development of Artemis, Kore.ai’s next-generation AI agent platform. Artemis functions as a comprehensive ecosystem designed for sophisticated enterprise automation. It allows businesses to securely build, deploy, govern and optimize agentic AI systems that can autonomously execute multi-step tasks.

Prasanna grounds this work in deep technical expertise, holding over 25 patents in Agentic AI and intelligent automation. His ongoing focus remains on advancing autonomous enterprise technology to create efficient, reliable solutions for Enterprise Agentic AI systems.

speakers.j: Global Product Engineer - Microsoft Security DevOps, Microsoft Security MVP, MCT
speakers.bio: Uros is a Global Product Engineer for Microsoft Security DevOps at SoftwareOne, contributing to the design and innovation of MXDR for Microsoft Sentinel and Managed SOC capabilities. With 20+ years of cybersecurity experience, he is a Microsoft Security MVP and Microsoft Certified Trainer, with a strong focus on Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Cloud Security and AI-driven security automation.

speakers.j: VP, Azure Linux and Cloud Native
speakers.bio: Pritesh Patwa is VP of Engineering for Azure Linux and Cloud Native Platforms, bringing two decades of experience building the Microsoft Cloud. He leads the compute orchestration and Linux infrastructure platforms that power some of the world's largest AI workloads. His focus is on hyperscale infrastructure built for world-class quality, resiliency and security.

I build infrastructure that makes AI useful for billions.

At Microsoft Azure, I lead products across inference capacity management, agentic search, and computer-use agents. The systems behind the next wave of AI experiences for developers, enterprises, and the world.

My work spans LLM platforms, retrieval and orchestration, multi-agent systems, developer platforms, enterprise AI, Microsoft 365, Teams, Loop, Copilot, and now Azure. The cloud layer behind it all.

I am an inventor with 1 published patent, US11714544B2, and 2 confidential patent filings in AI systems.

My curiosity for hard problems started early. For my B.Tech. thesis, I designed a human habitat on the Moon and won a worldwide NASA competition. I started my career in a thermal power plant, where I learned a simple lesson: real impact comes from building foundational systems that scale.

AI. Energy. Space.

Different domains. Same obsession.

Rahul Regulapati is the founder and CEO of Galleri5, the company behind Galleri5 AI Studio, a filmmaking platform that brings 200+ AI models into a single script-to-screen workflow. Under his leadership, Galleri5 brought AI filmmaking to mainstream television with Mahabharat: Ek Dharmayudh, India’s first AI-generated TV series, and is bringing it to cinemas with Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal, an upcoming AI-native theatrical feature.

Regina Manfredi believes in the power of collaboration, learning, and sharing to advance the profession and the ecosystem of technology. Her passion for helping customers and partners optimize and innovate with software, cloud, data, and AI has served as a throughline in her more than 20 years in the technology industry.

As the President of Americas at SoftwareOne, where she also leads direct sales, Regina oversees a team of experts delivering solutions that enable scalable data platforms, AI, and IoT. This follows SoftwareOne’s acquisition of Crayon, where she previously served as Executive Vice President and General Manager of the U.S. business.

Regina brings to SoftwareOne a strong background in Software and Cloud services, Data, and AI innovation. Over the course of her successful career in technology and services, she has led teams to create a shared vision and make strategic decisions while driving growth and operational excellence.

Previously, Regina served as Vice President of Worldwide CSP Alliances at Teradata, a data analytics software company that helps clients build analytics ecosystems and predictive intelligence. Prior to Teradata and Crayon, Regina spent 20+ years in the Microsoft and AWS ecosystem, serving as SVP, Corporate Sales & Software at PCM and Insight, driving growth and enhancing the client experience.

Regina attended the University of Houston. She serves on the board of the Women Executive Channel Advisory Network (WECAN), a group of senior leaders who mentor, empower, and lift women leaders in technology, and as a member of the Athena Alliance, a community that connects women leaders, investors, CEOs, and board directors.

Daniel Wang is an AI Applications Engineer at AMD, where he focuses on advancing the AI software stack and growing the developer community around AMD hardware.
