His answer, built on his work at LinkedIn and as co-author of the New York Times bestseller Open to Work, is that AI will make human capability more valuable, not less, and so the disruption ahead is best met by empowering people and organizations with the mindset and agency to adapt in real time and shape what comes next. Prior to LinkedIn, Aneesh served as a Senior Economic Advisor to California Governor Gavin Newsom, helping shape and communicate the growth agenda for one of the world’s largest economies as well as supporting the state’s response to the global pandemic. He joined the Governor’s Office after five years in the technology sector, including as Head of Economic Impact at Facebook. From 2009 to 2013, he held multiple roles in the Obama Administration, including serving as a speechwriter to President Barack Obama and as speechwriter to the U.S. Treasury Secretary during a global financial crisis. Aneesh began his career as a CNN correspondent, first in Southeast Asia and then across the Middle East, where he spent two years as a war correspondent in Iraq. A graduate of Harvard College and a former Fulbright Scholar, he serves on the boards of College Futures Foundation, which expands access to postsecondary education for underserved learners in California, and Shanti Bhavan, an education nonprofit serving children from some of the most economically disadvantaged communities in India. Director of AI at OZ Digital. Microsoft MVP in AI and Docker Captain. Speaker at Microsoft Reactor and community organizer of Global AI Sarasota and .NET Baires.

More recently, Sarah and her team released ASSERT, an open-source tool to automate AI safety evaluations and Agent Control Specification, an open-source standard to regulate agent controls. 

Before joining Microsoft, Sarah was a founding member of the AI ethics group at Meta (formerly Facebook). She holds a Ph.D. in computer science from UC Berkeley, where she was advised by Turing Award winner Dave Patterson, as well as Krste Asanović and Burton Smith.

That work covers review quality, context, and customization. Ria works closely with enterprise customers to understand how teams review code at scale, then turns that feedback into concrete product improvements.

Ian Zhu is the CEO of Nimo, a skills enablement platform that helps organizations measure and build the skills behind new technology adoption, from Microsoft 365 Copilot to day-to-day client work. Nimo works with Microsoft partners to diagnose what is blocking adoption, give every employee practice on their own work, and turn what top performers know into reusable knowledge for AI agents.

Vivek Vinod Sharma is a Principal AI Security Architect for Microsoft's Internal Enterprise IT Security division. He is a Technical Leader in AI Security and Subject Matter Expert in AI ML Security and Microsoft Cloud Platforms (Azure, M365, D365) Security. He is also empowered to determine which services and features are acceptable for use and how they should be used across Microsoft Enterprise. He is also responsible for creating security guidance that will enable engineering teams to implement services in a secure manner and assessment teams to validate engineering designs and deployments.

Fiona Carney is Vice President, Global Workforce Strategy & Solutions at Microsoft, focused on helping organisations build the workforce capabilities needed to thrive in the era of AI. She works across skilling, leadership, culture and AI transformation, helping customers move from AI experimentation to new ways of working that deliver meaningful business impact. Drawing on Microsoft’s own transformation journey alongside insights from customers around the world, Fiona is passionate about making workforce transformation practical, scalable and human-centred.

Becci DeFrank is a senior technology executive at NVIDIA with more than 30 years of experience in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, business development, and strategic partnerships. She works across industry, government, and academia to accelerate AI adoption, foster innovation ecosystems, and advance technology-driven transformation in the public and private sectors.

Practice Director of Application Modernization service line, I am responsible for guiding TGS customers through the complex process of navigating their Transformation journey primarily focused on modernizing legacy Application Landscape & Operations.

speakers.j: Principal Product Manager, Foundry Developer Experience
speakers.bio: Nick Brady is a Principal Product Manager for developer experience on Microsoft Foundry. He leads the content, code, and community that help developers build, customize, and scale AI apps and agents. He focuses on the work after the demo: clear docs, useful samples, good workflows, and fast feedback loops. Nick writes the monthly "What's new in Microsoft Foundry" post and hosts The Handoff, a weekly livestream for Foundry builders. Since 2018, he has led hundreds of customer and partner engagements and received a Distinguished Speaker Award. On and off the clock: Purdue men's basketball, rock music, coffee, and an occasional old fashioned.

speakers.j: SVP, Head of Product Development - Value Added Services
speakers.bio: Manish Mittal is the Senior Vice President of Value-Added Services (VAS) Product Development (PD) at Visa. He is a technologist and leader with a wealth of experience in tech innovation. Manish leads a 5,000-person technology organization, which spans multiple product verticals, including solutions for Acceptance (Merchants and Acquirers), Issuers, Risk and Identity, Digital Media, Enterprise Risk, Post-Purchase, Sales and Client Services, Open Banking, and more. His team builds the infrastructure that underlies how payments get accepted, disputes get resolved, fraud gets stopped, and new financial products get created across more than 200 countries. The products developed under his leadership grow revenue, enhance customer experience, and deliver exceptional value to Visa's clients. Manish is also a leading champion of the transformative power of Generative AI. His vision and strategy in this revolutionary technology are maximizing productivity and innovation at VAS PD. Prior to joining Visa, Manish spent 25 years at Microsoft, including serving as Corporate Vice President overseeing eCommerce and mobile experiences. During his leadership, Microsoft's Shopping business experienced impressive growth. He led Shopping and Commerce for Microsoft's Web Experiences Team, where the team saved users more than $2 billion through coupons, cashback, and price comparison in a single fiscal year. He also played a pivotal role in doubling Bing's market share through innovative product strategies and collaborations. Manish holds six patents in areas spanning AI-driven search, security systems, and distributed computing. Manish has a master's degree in computer science from the University of Washington and an undergraduate degree in engineering from Shivaji University in India. He lives with his wife and two sons in the Greater Seattle Area.

Rajiv Ranjan is a senior leader in Data & AI Engineering at AT&T, where he heads Agentic AI implementation. He drives the company’s move from AI experimentation to enterprise-scale, production-ready solutions that deliver measurable business impact.”.

Natalie Gilbert is an AI Engineer and Technical Lead at AT&T, where she leads teams building agentic AI solutions at enterprise scale. Her work spans AI engineering, multi-agent architectures, and bringing emerging technologies into production, including an AI platform designed to support more than 130,000 employees. Natalie holds a degree in Computer Science from Tufts University, a master’s degree in Data Science from the University of Pennsylvania, and three patents. She is passionate about bridging the gap between emerging technologies and real-world impact, while creating opportunities for women to take on new challenges, grow as leaders, and help shape the future of AI.

Taylor Schuster is a Senior Learning & Skilling Manager at Microsoft, focused on the intersection of human capabilities, organizational transformation, and AI adoption. Drawing on her experience in business strategy and strategic partnerships, Taylor explores what it really takes to drive change, from building the right skills to creating the motivation and conditions for people to succeed.

Pradeep Gandluru is a Senior Principal Software Engineering Manager at Microsoft, leading engineering initiatives for Azure Migrate and modernization solutions. With nearly two decades of experience building enterprise-scale cloud platforms and migration technologies, he helps organizations accelerate cloud adoption, application modernization, and large-scale transformation efforts.

His current work focuses on building AI-powered experiences and platform capabilities that simplify how organizations discover, assess, modernize, and migrate their application estates. He is driving innovations in intelligent discovery, automated insights, AI-assisted decision making, and scalable platform services that enable customers, partners, and Microsoft teams to accelerate modernization outcomes. Pradeep is passionate about transforming complex technical challenges into intuitive experiences that help organizations modernize with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

speakers.j: Vice President, Head of Data, AI & Service Transformation, North America
Director, Partners and Commercial Operations - Enterprise Software Solutions
speakers.bio: Slade Syrdahl is the Head of Partner Programs and Microsoft Alliance Executive for Hitachi Energy, responsible for driving strategic partnership initiatives, cloud marketplace growth, partner enablement, and ecosystem development. He works closely with Microsoft and global technology partners to accelerate digital transformation, expand go-to-market opportunities, and deliver innovative solutions for customers across the energy sector.

speakers.j: Global Head Data & AI Platforms and Enterprise Architecture
speakers.bio:
Sudipto Dasgupta is the Global Head of Data and AI Platforms and Enterprise Architecture at Aon, where he leads the enterprise-wide delivery and adoption of data and AI capabilities and oversees the definition and governance of the firm’s global technology architecture.

Prior to joining Aon, Sudipto served as Global Head of Analytics and AI Solution Management at Google Cloud. Earlier in his career, he was Founder and CTO of Live Objects (acquired by Zuora), Vice President and Head of Platform Engineering at Infosys, and Chief Architect at SAP.

Sudipto holds a Master of Data Science from the University of California, Berkeley, and a Bachelor of Engineering from Jadavpur University, India. He has also completed Executive Education in General Management at Stanford University. He is the holder of 15 granted patents, and has authored multiple publications in technology and artificial intelligence.

Jevon Tan is a product marketer on Microsoft Security, focused on Microsoft Sentinel, cloud native SIEM, and security operations modernization. He works on customer facing storytelling, web experiences, demos, launch readiness, and field guidance that help security teams understand technical change and act on it. He is especially interested in how AI reshapes security operations, customer adoption, and the way complex products prove value.

speakers.j: Head of Microsoft AI Commerce Platform
speakers.bio: Ori Greenberg is a Partner Product Manager at Microsoft, where he leads the Commerce Platform for Microsoft AI. His team builds the shared commerce foundation behind shopping in Bing, Copilot and Edge: product catalog and enrichment, ranking and relevance, quality evaluation, and the APIs that let AI agents ground their answers in live product and offer data through Web IQ. Ori focuses on turning that foundation into a platform partners can build on, with measurable answer quality and clear value for merchants. Before joining Microsoft, he led Catalog and Content Understanding at Netflix, and before that he led the Platform team at Google Shopping.

Daniel Freedman is President of Sightful, maker of Spacetop, which turns any laptop into a private, 100-inch mobile workspace using AR glasses. Using Windows ML, Spacetop solves two persistent work problems for professionals: lost productivity when working on one cramped laptop screen on the go, and sensitive data exposed on public screens. It is used by banks, law firms, consultancies and other leading companies, and is available on Microsoft Marketplace. Daniel is a serial entrepreneur, journalist and New York Times top-10 bestselling author. He co-founded Burnalong and led it as CEO through its acquisition by Tivity Health, where he went on to run a $150M+ business unit. He also co-founded counter-espionage company CyecureBox. Earlier, he wrote for the Wall Street Journal and Forbes, and held senior roles at the United Nations and intelligence consultancy TSG. He is co-author of the award-winning The Black Banners.

My philosophy is simple: Start with how the business works. Identify where AI can improve the outcome. Then use the Microsoft platform to make it real.

At RitewAI, I work with organizations to identify high-value AI opportunities, rethink business processes, define human-and-agent operating models, and build practical roadmaps that connect Microsoft technology to measurable outcomes.

Before RitewAI, I held global executive leadership roles at Avanade, leading Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement practices, go-to-market initiatives, Centres of Excellence, and global Business Applications strategy. That experience gave me a unique perspective across strategy, innovation, delivery, and the realities of driving transformation inside complex organizations.

I am a Microsoft MVP, industry speaker, and co-author of The Agentic AI Revolution. I am passionate about making complex technology understandable and helping executives move beyond AI experimentation toward meaningful adoption and scale.

My areas of focus include AI and agentic strategy, Microsoft Copilot Studio, digital employees, Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, Contact Center transformation, Power Platform, Dataverse, AI opportunity discovery, governance, and AI Centres of Excellence.

Patrik Wennberg is a Microsoft MVP and Senior Microsoft 365 Advisor specializing in Modern Work, security, governance, and adoption. He helps organizations navigate the complexities of Microsoft 365, balancing innovation with security and compliance, with a strong passion for accessibility, inclusion, and helping people get the most out of technology.

Liz Nash is an Operations Controller with John Deere Power Systems, with a career spanning accounting, financial analysis, sales analytics, and manufacturing finance. She is passionate about finding practical ways to use AI and automation to cut through complexity, eliminate manual work, and create more time for higher value, human centered work.

Shailesh is a senior technology executive with more than 20 years of experience. He builds strong teams and uses technology to drive growth, improve customer experience, and deliver business results. His leadership spans product management, engineering, operations, business strategy, talent, and client relationships. Shailesh has led cross-functional initiatives to create digital, data and AI solutions for property & casualty insurance, focused on profitable growth and customer experience. Shailesh has also consulted and collaborated at CXO and peer leadership level, shaping go-to-market strategies, solution offerings, technology landscapes, talent development strategies, software methodologies, and operational structures.

In his prior roles, Shailesh has held technology leadership positions at Ernst & Young, giving him excellent opportunities to lead, manage and deliver large scale enterprise-wide global systems, projects, and mission critical applications on a global scale.

Boris Krumrey is Field CTO at UiPath, helping CIOs and architects design how AI agents, robots and people run governed processes together. He was CTO at Strato Medien AG, then Germany’s second-largest ISP, and spent 12 years leading IT transformation at Accenture and Infosys. An RPA pioneer, he led Robotics & Automation at Atos from 2015. In 2017 he joined UiPath as Chief Robotics Officer, leading product vision and tech alliances, and later invented its Automation Innovation Lab.

Colin Dembovsky is the Director of Field Services for GitHub Copilot. He is a self-proclaimed DevOpsologist and was an ALM MVP from 2011 to 2022. He is based in Spring, TX but remains proudly South African!

After completing an MSc in Computer Science at Rhodes University, he worked as a developer and later systems architect, implementing DevOps “by feel” and in the trenches. In 2010, he left development to start consulting, using his experience, insight and strategic thinking to help organizations put DevOps into practice. By 2019, Colin was leading a DevOps practice and joined GitHub in 2021. You can read a a longer version of his “work journey” here.

Colin is passionate about helping teams improve the quality of their software, and do it more efficiently and securely. Colin is a frequent guest speaker and regularly blogs at http://colinsalmcorner.com and can be found on twitter at @colindembovsky and on GitHub.com/colindembovsky.

When he is not working, he is playing guitar, mandolin or drums, 3D printing on his Ender3, hacking an rPi, board-gaming, flying a drone, or entertaining his wife and 2 kids.
